let scriptPropertiesMemory_,scriptPropertiesDepth_=0;
function refreshScriptProperties_(){if(scriptPropertiesDepth_)scriptPropertiesMemory_=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();}
function withScriptProperties_(operation){
 const outer=scriptPropertiesDepth_++===0;if(outer)refreshScriptProperties_();
 try{return operation();}finally{if(--scriptPropertiesDepth_===0)scriptPropertiesMemory_=undefined;}
}
function properties_(){
 const store=PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();if(!scriptPropertiesDepth_)return store;
 return {getProperty:key=>scriptPropertiesMemory_[key]??null,getProperties:()=>({...scriptPropertiesMemory_}),
 setProperty(key,value){store.setProperty(key,String(value));scriptPropertiesMemory_[key]=String(value);return this;},
 setProperties(values,remove=false){store.setProperties(values,remove);if(remove)scriptPropertiesMemory_={};Object.assign(scriptPropertiesMemory_,Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(values).map(([key,value])=>[key,String(value)])));return this;},
 deleteProperty(key){store.deleteProperty(key);delete scriptPropertiesMemory_[key];return this;}};
}
const corporateEmailDomains_=['bbva.com','garantibbva.com.tr'];
function corporateEmail_(value){
 const email=String(value??'').trim().toLowerCase(),at=email.indexOf('@');
 return at>0&&corporateEmailDomains_.includes(email.slice(at+1))&&/^[a-z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+$/.test(email.slice(0,at))?email:'';
}
function authorize_(admin) {
  const owner=properties_().getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL'),email=corporateEmail_(Session.getActiveUser().getEmail());
  if(!owner)throw new Error('Ejecuta setupRadar desde el editor de Apps Script.');
  if(!email)throw new Error('Accede con una cuenta corporativa autorizada. Google debe verificar tu identidad.');
  const session={email,admin:email===owner};
  if(admin && !session.admin)throw new Error('Acceso no autorizado: se requiere administrador.');
  return session;
}

function metrics_(events,now) {
 const timezone=settings_().timezone;
 const start=now-30*86400000,week=now-7*86400000,day=now-86400000,users=new Map(),sessions=new Set(),byDay=new Map(),latencies=[];let failures=0,count=0;
 for(const event of events){
  const time=Date.parse(event.fecha);if(!Number.isFinite(time)||time>now)continue;
  let user=users.get(event.correo);if(!user){user={correo:event.correo,first:event.fecha,last:event.fecha,sessions:new Set(),recentSessions:new Set(),actions:0,recentActions:0};users.set(event.correo,user);}
  user.first=user.first<event.fecha?user.first:event.fecha;user.last=user.last>event.fecha?user.last:event.fecha;user.sessions.add(event.sesion);user.actions++;
  if(time<start)continue;
  count++;user.recentActions++;user.recentSessions.add(event.sesion);sessions.add(event.correo+'|'+event.sesion);
  const key=recordDay(event.fecha,timezone);if(!byDay.has(key))byDay.set(key,{sessions:new Set(),users:new Set()});const daily=byDay.get(key);daily.sessions.add(event.correo+'|'+event.sesion);daily.users.add(event.correo);
  if(event.evento==='rendimiento')latencies.push(Number(event.duracion_ms));if(event.evento==='error')failures++;
 }
 const allUsers=[...users.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.last.localeCompare(a.last)).map(({recentSessions,recentActions,sessions,...user})=>({...user,sessions:sessions.size,recentSessions:recentSessions.size,recentActions})),recent=allUsers.filter(user=>Date.parse(user.last)>=start);
 latencies.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
 return {totalUsers:allUsers.length,allUsers,mau:recent.length,wau:recent.filter(user=>Date.parse(user.last)>=week).length,dau:recent.filter(user=>Date.parse(user.last)>=day).length,sessions:sessions.size,returning:recent.filter(user=>user.recentSessions>1).length,users:recent.map(user=>({...user,sessions:user.recentSessions,actions:user.recentActions})),daily:[...byDay].sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b)).map(([date,value])=>({date,users:value.users.size,sessions:value.sessions.size})),latencyP95:latencies.length?latencies[Math.ceil(latencies.length*.95)-1]:null,failures,events:count};
}

const ARCHIVE_WORK=Object.freeze({rows:100,chars:30000});
const LOG_ARCHIVE_FOLDERS=Object.freeze({Auditoria:'auditFolderId',Cobertura:'coverageFolderId',Ejecuciones:'executionsFolderId',Telemetria:'telemetryFolderId'});
function logArchiveFolderId_(name,storage=configuration_().storage){return storage[LOG_ARCHIVE_FOLDERS[name]]||storage.logFolderId;}
function archiveFolder_(id){
 const folder=DriveApp.getFolderById(id);folder.getName();return folder;
}
function fileInFolder_(id,folder){
 const file=DriveApp.getFileById(id),parents=file.getParents(),ids=[];while(parents.hasNext())ids.push(parents.next().getId());
 if(ids.length!==1||ids[0]!==folder.getId())file.moveTo(folder);
 const verified=file.getParents();let found=0;while(verified.hasNext()){if(verified.next().getId()!==folder.getId())throw Error('Carpeta de archivo incorrecta.');found++;}
 if(found!==1)throw Error('No se ha verificado la carpeta del archivo: '+id);return file;
}
function archivePayload_(id){
 const book=SpreadsheetApp.openById(id),info=book.getSheetByName('Archivo').getRange(1,1,1,4).getDisplayValues()[0],headers=JSON.parse(info[2]);
 if(info[0]!=='1')throw Error('Formato de archivo no válido.');
 let rows;
 if(info[1]==='NewsletterEdiciones'){
  const metadataSheet=book.getSheetByName('Edicion'),metadataKeys=metadataSheet.getRange(1,1,1,RADAR.sheets.NewsletterEdiciones.length).getDisplayValues()[0],values=metadataSheet.getRange(2,1,1,metadataKeys.length).getDisplayValues()[0],content=book.getSheetByName('Contenido'),count=content.getLastRow()-1;
  rows=[{metadata:Object.fromEntries(metadataKeys.map((key,index)=>[key,values[index]])),items:count?content.getRange(2,1,count,2).getDisplayValues():[]}];
 }else{
  const sheet=book.getSheetByName('Datos');
  if(JSON.stringify(sheet.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).getDisplayValues()[0])!==JSON.stringify(headers))throw Error('Cabecera de archivo no válida.');
  const count=info[3]!==''?Number(info[3]):Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1);
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(count)||count<0||count>sheet.getMaxRows()-1||sheet.getLastRow()-1>count)throw Error('Contenido de archivo no verificado: '+info[1]);
  rows=count?sheet.getRange(2,1,count,headers.length).getDisplayValues():[];
 }
 return JSON.stringify({schema:1,table:info[1],headers,rows});
}
function writeArchiveTable_(book,name,headers,rows){
 const sheet=book.getSheetByName(name)||book.insertSheet(name),values=[headers,...rows];
 if(values.length>sheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),values.length-sheet.getMaxRows());
 sheet.getRange(1,1,values.length,headers.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values.map(row=>row.map(safeCell_)));sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
}
function archiveSpreadsheet_(name,headers,rows,folderId,key){
 const folder=archiveFolder_(folderId),payload=JSON.stringify({schema:1,table:name,headers,rows}),digest=sha256_(payload),p=properties_(),property='ARCHIVE_SHEET:'+key;
 let checkpoint=JSON.parse(p.getProperty(property)||'null');
 if(checkpoint&&checkpoint.digest!==digest)throw Error('El origen del archivo ha cambiado. Revisa el checkpoint '+key+'.');
 if(!checkpoint){
  const book=SpreadsheetApp.create(recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone).replace(/-/g,'')+'_'+name+'_'+digest.slice(0,12));book.getSheets()[0]?.setName('Archivo');
  checkpoint={id:book.getId(),digest,count:rows.length};p.setProperty(property,JSON.stringify(checkpoint));
 }
 fileInFolder_(checkpoint.id,folder);const book=SpreadsheetApp.openById(checkpoint.id);
 const info=book.getSheetByName('Archivo')||book.insertSheet('Archivo');info.getRange(1,1,1,4).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([['1',name,JSON.stringify(headers),String(rows.length)]]);
 if(name==='NewsletterEdiciones'){
  const metadata=rows[0].metadata,keys=Object.keys(metadata);writeArchiveTable_(book,'Edicion',keys,[keys.map(key=>metadata[key])]);writeArchiveTable_(book,'Contenido',['edicion','contenido'],rows[0].items);
 }else writeArchiveTable_(book,'Datos',headers,rows);
 SpreadsheetApp.flush();if(sha256_(archivePayload_(checkpoint.id))!==digest)throw Error('Contenido de archivo no verificado: '+name);
 p.setProperty(property,JSON.stringify({...checkpoint,verified:true}));
 return {id:checkpoint.id,digest,property,verified:true};
}
function archiveLogBatch_(name){
 if(name==='Adopcion')return true;
 const sheet=recordSheet_(name),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,policy={...configuration_().storage,...logRetention_(name)};
 const expected=RADAR.sheets[name];if(JSON.stringify(sheet.getRange(1,1,1,expected.length).getDisplayValues()[0])!==JSON.stringify(expected))throw Error('Cabecera del log no válida: '+name);
 const checkpointKey='ARCHIVE_SHEET:'+name,checkpoint=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty(checkpointKey)||'null');
 if(checkpoint)return recoverLogArchive_(name,sheet,checkpoint,checkpointKey);
 if(count<=0)return true;
 const keys=RADAR.sheets[name],date=keys.indexOf(name==='Ejecuciones'?'inicio':'fecha'),cutoff=Date.now()-policy.days*86400000;
 const rows=sheet.getRange(2,1,Math.min(count,ARCHIVE_WORK.rows),keys.length).getDisplayValues();
 if(count<policy.rows+ARCHIVE_WORK.rows&&!(Number.isFinite(Date.parse(rows[0][date]))&&Date.parse(rows[0][date])<cutoff))return true;
 let size=0,chars=0;
 for(const row of rows){
  const expired=Number.isFinite(Date.parse(row[date]))&&Date.parse(row[date])<cutoff;
  if(count-size<=policy.rows&&!expired)break;
  const length=JSON.stringify(row).length;if(size&&chars+length>ARCHIVE_WORK.chars)break;size++;chars+=length;
 }
 if(!size)return true;
 const values=rows.slice(0,size),archive=archiveSpreadsheet_(name,keys,values,logArchiveFolderId_(name,policy),name);
 if(sha256_(JSON.stringify(sheet.getRange(2,1,size,keys.length).getDisplayValues()))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(values)))throw Error('El log cambió durante el archivo: '+name);
 const nextRow=count>size?sheet.getRange(size+2,1,1,keys.length).getDisplayValues()[0]:null;
 properties_().setProperty(archive.property,JSON.stringify({...archive,count:size,deleting:true,nextRow}));
 sheet.deleteRows(2,size);SpreadsheetApp.flush();properties_().setProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ACTION',name+': '+size+' filas archivadas y verificadas.');
 if(sheet.getLastRow()-1!==count-size)throw Error('Retirada del log no verificada: '+name);
 properties_().deleteProperty(archive.property);return false;
}
// A checkpoint owns a frozen prefix. Appends must never change its payload or digest.
function recoverLogArchive_(name,sheet,checkpoint,key){
 const headers=RADAR.sheets[name],conflict=()=>{throw Error('Conflicto de archivo '+name+': conserva origen y checkpoint; revisa el archivo '+checkpoint.id+'.');};
 let payload,stored;
 try{const raw=archivePayload_(checkpoint.id);stored=JSON.parse(raw);if(sha256_(raw)===checkpoint.digest)payload=stored;}catch(_){}
 if(payload&&(payload.table!==name||JSON.stringify(payload.headers)!==JSON.stringify(headers)))return conflict();
 const size=payload?.rows.length||Number(checkpoint.count||0),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1;
 if(!size||size>ARCHIVE_WORK.rows)return conflict();
 const first=count>0?sheet.getRange(2,1,1,headers.length).getDisplayValues()[0]:null;
 // The next row proves that deletion finished. An identical boundary is ambiguous.
 if(checkpoint.deleting&&JSON.stringify(first)===JSON.stringify(checkpoint.nextRow)){
  if(!payload||JSON.stringify(first)===JSON.stringify(payload.rows[0]))return conflict();
  properties_().deleteProperty(key);return false;
 }
 if(count<size)return conflict();
 const prefix=sheet.getRange(2,1,size,headers.length).getDisplayValues(),digest=sha256_(JSON.stringify({schema:1,table:name,headers,rows:prefix}));
 if(digest!==checkpoint.digest)return conflict();
 if(!payload){
  if(checkpoint.deleting||checkpoint.verified)return conflict();
  if(stored&&(stored.table!==name||JSON.stringify(stored.headers)!==JSON.stringify(headers)||stored.rows.length>=size||stored.rows.some((row,index)=>JSON.stringify(row)!==JSON.stringify(prefix[index]))))return conflict();
  if(!stored&&(SpreadsheetApp.openById(checkpoint.id).getSheetByName('Datos')?.getLastRow()||0)>1)return conflict();
  archiveSpreadsheet_(name,headers,prefix,logArchiveFolderId_(name),name);payload={rows:prefix};
 }
 const nextRow=count>size?sheet.getRange(size+2,1,1,headers.length).getDisplayValues()[0]:null;
 if(checkpoint.deleting&&JSON.stringify(nextRow)===JSON.stringify(first))return conflict();
 properties_().setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...checkpoint,count:size,deleting:true,nextRow}));
 sheet.deleteRows(2,size);SpreadsheetApp.flush();
 if(sheet.getLastRow()-1!==count-size)throw Error('Retirada del log no verificada: '+name);
 properties_().deleteProperty(key);properties_().setProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ACTION',name+': checkpoint recuperado; '+size+' filas verificadas.');return false;
}
function validateStorageFolders_(storage){for(const key of ['primaryFolderId','logFolderId','newsletterFolderId',...Object.values(LOG_ARCHIVE_FOLDERS)])archiveFolder_(storage[key]);}
function maintainLogArchiveFiles_(){
 const storage=configuration_().storage,root=archiveFolder_(storage.logFolderId),cutoff=Date.now()-storage.logDays*86400000;
 const valid=/^\d{8}_(Auditoria|Cobertura|Ejecuciones|Telemetria)_[a-f0-9]{12}$/;
 let changed=0;
 for(const [name,key] of Object.entries(LOG_ARCHIVE_FOLDERS)){
  const folder=archiveFolder_(storage[key]),files=folder.getFiles();
  while(files.hasNext()&&changed<20){const file=files.next(),match=valid.exec(file.getName());if(!match||match[1]!==name)continue;if(file.getDateCreated().getTime()<cutoff){file.setTrashed(true);changed++;}}
 }
 const files=root.getFiles();while(files.hasNext()&&changed<20){const file=files.next(),match=valid.exec(file.getName());if(!match)continue;const destination=archiveFolder_(storage[LOG_ARCHIVE_FOLDERS[match[1]]]);file.moveTo(destination);if(file.getDateCreated().getTime()<cutoff)file.setTrashed(true);changed++;}
 return changed<20;
}
function verifyPrimaryStorage(){authorize_(true);const storage=configuration_().storage;validateStorageFolders_(storage);fileInFolder_(properties_().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'),archiveFolder_(storage.primaryFolderId));return {primaryId:properties_().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'),folderId:storage.primaryFolderId};}
function recentNewsletterDeliveries_(rows){
 const counts=new Map(),limit=configuration_().storage.newsletterDeliveries;
 return rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>(Date.parse(b.fecha)-Date.parse(a.fecha))||String(b.id||'').localeCompare(String(a.id||''))).filter(row=>{
  const key=row.suscripcion||row.correo,count=counts.get(key)||0;counts.set(key,count+1);return count<limit;
 });
}
function archivedNewsletter_(row){
 const marker=JSON.parse(row.editorial||'null');if(!marker?.archive)return row;
 const payload=archivePayload_(marker.archive);
 if(sha256_(payload)!==marker.digest)throw Error('Newsletter archivada no verificada.');
 const archived=JSON.parse(payload).rows[0];
 if(archived.metadata.id!==row.id||archived.metadata.correo!==row.correo)throw Error('Newsletter archivada no verificada.');
 return {...archived.metadata,archivedItems:archived.items};
}
function archiveNewsletterBatch_(){
 const deliveries=rows_('NewsletterEnvios',undefined,8),sent=new Set(deliveries.filter(row=>row.estado==='Enviada').map(row=>row.id)),retained=new Set(recentNewsletterDeliveries_(deliveries).map(row=>row.id)),keys=RADAR.sheets.NewsletterEdiciones,sheet=newsletterSheet_('NewsletterEdiciones'),p=properties_(),source=newsletterStorageKey_('NewsletterEdiciones'),total=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1);
 const checkpointKey='NEWSLETTER_ARCHIVE_CURSOR';let cursor=JSON.parse(p.getProperty(checkpointKey)||'null');if(!cursor||cursor.source!==source||cursor.next<2||cursor.next>total+2)cursor={source,next:2};
 cursor.total=total;const size=Math.min(8,Math.max(0,total-cursor.next+2));if(!size){p.deleteProperty(checkpointKey);return true;}
 const editions=sheet.getRange(cursor.next,1,size,keys.length).getDisplayValues().map(values=>Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,index)=>[key,values[index]])));
 for(const [index,row] of editions.entries()){
  const position=cursor.next+index;
  if(row.estado!=='Enviada'||!sent.has(row.envio)||retained.has(row.envio))continue;
  const marker=JSON.parse(row.editorial||'null');
  if(marker?.archive){if(marker.cleared)continue;finishNewsletterArchive_(row,position-2,marker);p.setProperty(checkpointKey,JSON.stringify({...cursor,next:position+1}));return false;}
  const count=Number(row.cantidad),items=count?newsletterSheet_('NewsletterContenido').getRange(Number(row.inicio),1,count,2).getDisplayValues():[];
  if(items.some(([id,value])=>id!==row.id||!value))throw Error('Contenido de newsletter incompleto.');
  const archive=archiveSpreadsheet_('NewsletterEdiciones',[],[{metadata:row,items}],configuration_().storage.newsletterFolderId,'newsletter:'+row.id),range=sheet.getRange(position,keys.indexOf('editorial')+1,1,1),value=JSON.stringify({archive:archive.id,digest:archive.digest});
  range.setValues([[value]]);SpreadsheetApp.flush();if(range.getDisplayValues()[0][0]!==value)throw Error('Puntero de newsletter no verificado.');
  markNewsletterArchiveEdited_();finishNewsletterArchive_(row,position-2,{archive:archive.id,digest:archive.digest});properties_().deleteProperty(archive.property);p.setProperty(checkpointKey,JSON.stringify({...cursor,next:position+1}));return false;
 }
 cursor.next+=size;if(cursor.next>total+1){p.deleteProperty(checkpointKey);return true;}p.setProperty(checkpointKey,JSON.stringify(cursor));return false;
}

function finishNewsletterArchive_(row,index,marker){
 archivedNewsletter_({...row,editorial:JSON.stringify(marker)});
 const count=Number(row.cantidad),range=count?newsletterSheet_('NewsletterContenido').getRange(Number(row.inicio),2,count,1):null;
 if(range){range.clearContent();SpreadsheetApp.flush();if(range.getDisplayValues().some(([value])=>value))throw Error('Archivo de newsletter pendiente de compactar.');}
 newsletterSheet_('NewsletterEdiciones').getRange(index+2,RADAR.sheets.NewsletterEdiciones.indexOf('editorial')+1,1,1).setValues([[JSON.stringify({...marker,cleared:true})]]);markNewsletterArchiveEdited_();
}
function logArchiveReadyAt_(){const p=properties_();return p.getProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_PENDING')?Math.max(Date.now(),Number(p.getProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_NEXT')||0)):Infinity;}
function operationalArchiveBatch_(){
 const p=properties_();try{p.setProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_LAST',new Date().toISOString());const done=compactOperationalLogs_();p.deleteProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ATTEMPTS');p.deleteProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_NEXT');p.deleteProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ERROR');return done;}
 catch(error){p.setProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ATTEMPTS',String(Number(p.getProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ATTEMPTS')||0)+1));p.setProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_NEXT',String(Date.now()+Math.min(21600000,settings_().retryMinutes*60000*2**Math.min(8,Number(p.getProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ATTEMPTS')||0)-1))));p.setProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ERROR',String(error.message).slice(0,180));return false;}
}
function resumeOperationalArchive(){authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{for(const key of ['LOG_ARCHIVE_ATTEMPTS','LOG_ARCHIVE_NEXT','LOG_ARCHIVE_ERROR'])properties_().deleteProperty(key);properties_().setProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_PENDING','true');const job=maintenanceJob_();if(job?.state==='Revisar'){job.state='Pendiente';job.attempts=0;job.pausedUntil=0;saveMaintenanceJob_(job);}ensureBackgroundWorker_();return getOperationalSchedule();});}
// Stage content and offsets together; no positional reader observes a partial move.
function restartNewsletterCompaction_(p,revision,source){
 const job={state:'Scanning',revision,source,next:2,active:0,total:Math.max(0,newsletterSheet_('NewsletterEdiciones').getLastRow()-1)};
 p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));return false;
}
function validateNewsletterCompactionPrefix_(job,p){
 if(job.next>job.validationTotal+2)return restartNewsletterCompaction_(p,job.validationRevision,job.source);
 const keys=RADAR.sheets.NewsletterEdiciones;
 if(job.validateNext<job.next){
  const original=book_().getSheetByName(job.source.editions).getRange(job.validateNext,1,1,keys.length).getDisplayValues()[0],staged=book_().getSheetByName(job.editions).getRange(job.validateNext,1,1,keys.length).getDisplayValues()[0],offset=keys.indexOf('inicio');
  if(JSON.stringify(original.filter((_,index)=>index!==offset))!==JSON.stringify(staged.filter((_,index)=>index!==offset)))return restartNewsletterCompaction_(p,job.validationRevision,job.source);
  const marker=JSON.parse(original[keys.indexOf('editorial')]||'null'),count=Number(original[keys.indexOf('cantidad')]);
  if(!marker?.archive&&count){
   const before=book_().getSheetByName(job.source.content).getRange(Number(original[offset]),1,count,2).getDisplayValues(),after=book_().getSheetByName(job.content).getRange(Number(staged[offset]),1,count,2).getDisplayValues();
   if(JSON.stringify(before)!==JSON.stringify(after))return restartNewsletterCompaction_(p,job.validationRevision,job.source);
  }
  job.validateNext++;p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));return false;
 }
 job.revision=job.validationRevision;job.total=job.validationTotal;job.state='Pendiente';delete job.validationRevision;delete job.validationTotal;delete job.validateNext;
 p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));return false;
}
function compactNewsletterBatch_(){
 const p=properties_(),revision=newsletterArchiveVersion_(),source={editions:newsletterStorageKey_('NewsletterEdiciones'),content:newsletterStorageKey_('NewsletterContenido')},keys=RADAR.sheets.NewsletterEdiciones;
 let job=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB')||'null');
 if(job?.state==='Completada'&&job.published===revision)return true;
 if(!job||job.state==='Completada'){
  job={state:'Scanning',revision,source,next:2,active:0,total:Math.max(0,newsletterSheet_('NewsletterEdiciones').getLastRow()-1)};
 }
 if(job.state==='Scanning'){
  if(job.revision!==revision||job.source.editions!==source.editions||job.source.content!==source.content)job={state:'Scanning',revision,source,next:2,active:0,total:Math.max(0,newsletterSheet_('NewsletterEdiciones').getLastRow()-1)};
  const size=Math.min(8,Math.max(0,job.total-job.next+2)),rows=size?newsletterSheet_('NewsletterEdiciones').getRange(job.next,keys.indexOf('cantidad')+1,size,keys.length-keys.indexOf('cantidad')).getDisplayValues():[];
  for(const values of rows)if(!JSON.parse(values[keys.indexOf('editorial')-keys.indexOf('cantidad')]||'null')?.archive)job.active+=Number(values[0]);
  job.next+=size;p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));if(job.next<=job.total+1)return false;
  if(newsletterSheet_('NewsletterContenido').getLastRow()-1<=job.active){job.state='Completada';job.published=revision;p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));return true;}
  const id=Utilities.getUuid();job={state:'Creating',revision,source,next:2,offset:2,total:job.total,editions:'NewsletterEdiciones_gen_'+id,content:'NewsletterContenido_gen_'+id};
  p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));
 }
 if(source.editions===job.editions&&source.content===job.content){markNewsletterArchiveEdited_();job.state='Completada';job.published=newsletterArchiveVersion_();p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));return true;}
 if(job.state!=='Scanning'&&(job.revision!==revision||job.source.editions!==source.editions||job.source.content!==source.content)){
  if(job.state==='Creating'||job.source.editions!==source.editions||job.source.content!==source.content)return restartNewsletterCompaction_(p,revision,source);
  if(job.state!=='Validating'||job.validationRevision!==revision){job.state='Validating';job.validateNext=2;job.validationRevision=revision;job.validationTotal=Math.max(0,newsletterSheet_('NewsletterEdiciones').getLastRow()-1);p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));return false;}
 }
 if(job.state==='Validating')return validateNewsletterCompactionPrefix_(job,p);
 if(job.state==='Creating'){
  generationSheet_(job.editions,keys);generationSheet_(job.content,RADAR.sheets.NewsletterContenido);job.state='Pendiente';p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));
 }

 const editionSheet=book_().getSheetByName(source.editions),contentSheet=book_().getSheetByName(source.content);
 if(job.next<=job.total+1){
  const values=editionSheet.getRange(job.next,1,1,keys.length).getDisplayValues()[0],row=Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),marker=JSON.parse(row.editorial||'null');
  let nextOffset=job.offset;
  if(marker?.archive){archivedNewsletter_(row);values[keys.indexOf('inicio')]='0';}
  else{
   const size=Number(row.cantidad),items=size?contentSheet.getRange(Number(row.inicio),1,size,2).getDisplayValues():[];
   if(items.some(([id,value])=>id!==row.id||!value))throw Error('Contenido activo incompleto: '+row.id);
   if(items.length)writeVerifiedRows_(book_().getSheetByName(job.content),items.map((values,index)=>({row:job.offset+index,values})));
   values[keys.indexOf('inicio')]=String(job.offset);nextOffset+=items.length;
  }
  writeVerifiedRows_(book_().getSheetByName(job.editions),[{row:job.next,values}]);job.next++;job.offset=nextOffset;p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));return false;
 }
 const previous=dataGeneration_(),generation={...previous,newsletterTables:{NewsletterEdiciones:job.editions,NewsletterContenido:job.content}};
 p.setProperty('DATA_GENERATION_ROLLBACK',JSON.stringify(previous));p.setProperty('DATA_GENERATION',JSON.stringify(generation));dataGenerationMemory_=generation;
 markNewsletterArchiveEdited_();job.state='Completada';job.published=newsletterArchiveVersion_();p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));return true;
}

function serviceQuotaPause_(error){return /for one day|daily quota|quota exceeded|limit exceeded/i.test(String(error?.message||error))?86400000:0;}
function scheduledTriggers_(handler){return ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().filter(trigger=>trigger.getHandlerFunction()===handler);}
let operationalTriggersMemory_;
function dailyScheduleStatus_(){
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='daily-schedule',cached=cache.get(key);
  if(cached!==null&&cached!==undefined)return cached==='true';
  const enabled=(operationalTriggersMemory_||ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()).some(trigger=>collectionHandlers_().includes(trigger.getHandlerFunction()));cache.put(key,String(enabled),300);return enabled;
}
const COLLECTION_SLOTS=Object.freeze([{handler:'dailyRadar_',slot:'daily',prefix:'daily',enabled:'morningEnabled'},{handler:'afternoonRadar_',slot:'afternoon',prefix:'afternoon',enabled:'afternoonEnabled'},{handler:'eveningRadar_',slot:'evening',prefix:'evening',enabled:'eveningEnabled'}].map(Object.freeze));
function collectionSchedules_(){const config=settings_();return COLLECTION_SLOTS.map(job=>({...job,hour:config[job.prefix+'Hour'],minute:config[job.prefix+'Minute'],enabled:config[job.enabled],timezone:config.timezone}));}
function collectionPipelineSlots_(){return COLLECTION_SLOTS.map(job=>job.slot);}
function collectionPipelineKey_(slot,suffix){return slot==='daily'?'DAILY_PIPELINE_'+suffix:'COLLECTION_'+slot.toUpperCase()+'_'+suffix;}
function collectionHandlers_(){return COLLECTION_SLOTS.map(job=>job.handler);}
function replaceDailySchedule_(handler,hour,minute=0,timezone=settings_().timezone){
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('operational-trigger-counts');
  scheduledTriggers_(handler).forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
  ScriptApp.newTrigger(handler).timeBased().atHour(hour).nearMinute(minute).everyDays(1).inTimezone(timezone).create();
}
function scheduleTime_(job){return String(job.hour).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(job.minute||0).padStart(2,'0');}
function collectionScheduleLabel_(){return 'Banca digital: '+collectionSchedules_().filter(job=>job.enabled).map(scheduleTime_).join(' · ')+' · '+settings_().timezone;}
function replaceCollectionSchedule_(){
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('operational-trigger-counts');
  const installed=new Set();
  for(const job of collectionSchedules_()){
    scheduledTriggers_(job.handler).forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
    const key=scheduleTime_(job)+'|'+job.timezone;
    if(job.enabled&&!installed.has(key)){replaceDailySchedule_(job.handler,job.hour,job.minute,job.timezone);installed.add(key);}
  }
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('daily-schedule');
}
function ensureBackgroundWorker_(delay=60000){
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');return;}
  properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_PENDING','true');
  const triggers=scheduledTriggers_('backgroundTick_'),next=Date.now()+Math.max(60000,delay);
  const scheduled=Number(properties_().getProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT'));
  if(triggers.length===1&&scheduled>0&&scheduled<=next)return;
  triggers.forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));ScriptApp.newTrigger('backgroundTick_').timeBased().after(Math.max(60000,delay)).create();properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT',String(next));
}
function translationReadyAt_(){
  const job=translationJob_(),request=properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST'),today=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone);
  if(job?.state==='Publicando'||publicationNeedsReview_(job)||!request&&(!job||job.state==='Completada'))return Infinity;
  const paused=Number(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);if(paused>Date.now())return paused;
  if(translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls)return nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone);
  if(request&&(!job||job.state==='Completada'||recordDay(job.started,settings_().timezone)<today))return Date.now();
  return job&&job.state!=='Completada'?Math.max(Date.now(),Number(job.pausedUntil||0)):Infinity;
}
function collectionReadyAt_(work){
  const jobs=new Map(work.jobs.map(job=>[job.id,job])),represented=new Set(),now=Date.now(),retryMs=settings_().retryMinutes*60000,fetchPausedUntil=Number(properties_().getProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);let next=Infinity;
  for(const task of work.tasks){
    if(!['Pendiente','Reintento programado'].includes(task.estado)||!jobs.has(task.ciclo))continue;
    represented.add(task.ciclo);const retry=task.estado==='Reintento programado'?Date.parse(task.actualizada)+retryMs:0;
    next=Math.min(next,Math.max(now,Number(jobs.get(task.ciclo).pausa||0),fetchPausedUntil,retry));
  }
  for(const job of work.jobs)if(Number(job.pendientes)>0&&!represented.has(job.id))next=Math.min(next,Math.max(now,Number(job.pausa||0),fetchPausedUntil));
  return next;
}
function backgroundTick_(){return processBackground_();}
function businessTranslationPending_(){return Boolean(!publicationNeedsReview_(translationJob_())&&(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST')||translationJob_()?.businessPending>0));}
function requestDailyPipeline_(slot='daily'){
  if(!collectionPipelineSlots_().includes(slot))throw Error('Franja de recopilación no válida.');
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_(slot);return;}
  const timezone=settings_().timezone;
  properties_().setProperty(collectionPipelineKey_(slot,'REQUEST'),recordDay(new Date(),timezone));ensureBackgroundWorker_();
}
function dailyPipelineRequested_(){const p=properties_();return collectionPipelineSlots_().some(slot=>p.getProperty(collectionPipelineKey_(slot,'REQUEST')));}
function drainDailyPipeline_(){
  const p=properties_();
  for(const slot of collectionPipelineSlots_()){
    const request=collectionPipelineKey_(slot,'REQUEST'),completed=collectionPipelineKey_(slot,'DAY'),day=p.getProperty(request);if(!day)continue;
    if(p.getProperty(completed)!==day){
      if(dailyCollectionPending_())continue;
      const id=queueScheduledCollection_('daily');if(id)p.setProperty(collectionPipelineKey_(slot,'JOB'),id);p.setProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST',day);p.setProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST',day);p.setProperty(completed,day);
    }
    if(p.getProperty(request)===day)p.deleteProperty(request);
  }
}
function dailyCollectionPending_(work){return collectionRequests_().some(request=>request.kind==='daily')||(work?.jobs||collectionJobs_()).some(job=>job.tipo==='daily'&&(Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando'));}
function businessPipelinePending_(work){
  const p=properties_();return Boolean(snapshotJobsPending_()||dailyPipelineRequested_()||dailyCollectionPending_(work)||p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')&&!publicationNeedsReview_(classificationJob_())||classificationPending_()||p.getProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')||businessTranslationPending_());
}
function drainDailyTranslations_(work){
  const p=properties_(),day=p.getProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
  if(!day||dailyCollectionPending_(work)||p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')&&!publicationNeedsReview_(classificationJob_())||classificationPending_())return;
  requestTranslations_(true);
  if(p.getProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===day)p.deleteProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
}
function snapshotPublicationPending_(work,includeDue=true){return snapshotJobsPending_()||(work?.jobs||collectionJobs_()).some(job=>job.estado==='Publicando')||Boolean(properties_().getProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD'))||includeDue&&dashboardSnapshotsDue_();}
function backgroundTask_(work,daily){
  if(daily)return 'collection';
  const blocked=dailyCollectionPending_(work)||dailyPipelineRequested_(),candidates=[];
  const offer=(task,ready,priority=PROCESS_PRIORITY[task])=>{if(ready)candidates.push({task,priority});};
  if(!blocked){
    offer('classification',classificationReadyAt_()<=Date.now());
    const publishing=snapshotPublicationPending_(work),classifying=classificationPending_();
    offer('taxonomy',!taxonomyPublicationReady_()&&publishing&&taxonomyReadyAt_()<=Date.now()&&(!classifying||classificationJob_()?.state==='Publicando'),PROCESS_PRIORITY.classification);
    offer('snapshot',taxonomyPublicationReady_()&&(!classifying||snapshotJobsPending_())&&publishing);
    if(!classifying&&(!properties_().getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||publicationNeedsReview_(classificationJob_()))){
      offer('newsletter',newsletterReadyAt_(work)<=Date.now());offer('translation',translationReadyAt_()<=Date.now());
      offer('catalogSync',catalogSyncReadyAt_()<=Date.now());offer('taxonomy',taxonomyReadyAt_()<=Date.now());offer('taxonomyTranslation',taxonomyTranslationReadyAt_()<=Date.now());
      offer('archive',logArchiveReadyAt_()<=Date.now()&&!work.pending.length);offer('maintenance',maintenanceReadyAt_()<=Date.now());
    }
  }
  offer('collection',work.pending.length>0,daily?PROCESS_PRIORITY.daily:PROCESS_PRIORITY.maintenance+1);
  const ordered=candidates.sort((a,b)=>a.priority-b.priority),first=ordered[0];
  if(first?.task==='archive'&&properties_().getProperty('BACKGROUND_LAST')==='archive'&&ordered.some(candidate=>candidate.task==='maintenance'&&candidate.priority===first.priority))return 'maintenance';
  return first?.task||'';
}
// Wake only for runnable work; lower queues cannot poll while their prerequisites are paused.
function backgroundNextAt_(work,completed=true){
  const now=Date.now(),p=properties_();if(!work||!completed||backgroundQueued_(work))return now;
  const collection=work.tasks?collectionReadyAt_(work):Math.min(...(work.jobs||[]).filter(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando').map(job=>Math.max(now,Number(p.getProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0),Number(job.pausa||0))));
  if(dailyCollectionPending_(work)||dailyPipelineRequested_())return collection;
  if(classificationJob_()?.state==='Publicando'&&!taxonomyPublicationReady_())return Math.min(collection,taxonomyReadyAt_());
  if(classificationPending_())return snapshotJobsPending_()?now:Math.min(collection,classificationReadyAt_());
  if(dashboardSnapshotsReady_(work))return now;
  return Math.min(catalogSyncReadyAt_(),logArchiveReadyAt_(),collection,translationReadyAt_(),taxonomyReadyAt_(),taxonomyTranslationReadyAt_(),newsletterReadyAt_(work),maintenanceReadyAt_());
}
function processBackground_(batchLimit=BACKGROUND_WORK.maxBatches){return withScriptProperties_(()=>processBackground_Request_(batchLimit));}
function processBackground_Request_(batchLimit=BACKGROUND_WORK.maxBatches){
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');return {added:0,errors:[],paused:true};}
  scheduledTriggers_('backgroundTick_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT');
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(1000)){ensureBackgroundWorker_();return {added:0,errors:[],busy:true};}
  const started=Date.now(),runId=Utilities.getUuid(),errors=[];let work,known,knownRevision,completed=false,added=0,acquired=true;
  try{
    for(let batch=0;batch<batchLimit&&Date.now()-started<BACKGROUND_WORK.maxMs;batch++){
      if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');break;}
      if(batch){lock.releaseLock();acquired=false;if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');break;}if(!lock.tryLock(1000))break;acquired=true;refreshScriptProperties_();dataGenerationMemory_=undefined;if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');break;}if(String(properties_().getProperty('CONFIG_REVISION')||'0')!==configurationVersionMemory_){configurationMemory_=undefined;configurationVersionMemory_=undefined;}}
      drainDailyPipeline_();drainCollectionRequests_();drainMaintenanceRequest_();work=collectionWork_(Date.now());
      const daily=Boolean(work.pending.length&&work.jobs.some(job=>job.id===work.pending[0].ciclo&&job.tipo==='daily'));
      if(!work.pending.length&&batch===0)collectionBatch_(work);
      if(!daily&&!dailyCollectionPending_(work)){drainClassificationRequest_();drainDailyTranslations_(work);drainTaxonomyRequest_();}
      const collectionJob=work.pending[0]?.ciclo,task=backgroundTask_(work,daily);if(!task){if(dashboardSnapshotsReady_(work))dashboardSnapshotBatch_();break;}
      const remaining=Math.min(BACKGROUND_WORK.sliceMs,BACKGROUND_WORK.maxMs-(Date.now()-started));if(remaining<=0)break;
      progressContextMemory_=undefined;properties_().setProperty('SUPERVISOR_DISPATCH',JSON.stringify({task,at:new Date().toISOString()}));properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_RUN_ID',runId);const stage=task==='collection'?'daily':task;properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_ACTIVE',stage);if(task==='collection')properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_COLLECTION_JOB',collectionJob||'');else properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_COLLECTION_JOB');properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_ACTIVE_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+BACKGROUND_WORK.maxMs+BACKGROUND_WORK.activeGraceMs));properties_().setProperty('JOB_LAST_EXECUTED:'+stage,new Date().toISOString());
      if(task==='snapshot')dashboardSnapshotBatch_();
      else if(task==='archive')operationalArchiveBatch_();
      else if(task==='maintenance')maintenanceBatch_(Math.min(MAINTENANCE_POLICY.maxMs,remaining));
      else if(task==='newsletter')deliverNewsletterBatch_(work,remaining);
      else if(task==='catalogSync'){const synced=refreshFunctionalCatalog_();if(synced.error)properties_().setProperty('CATALOG_SYNC_RETRY_AT',String(Date.now()+settings_().retryMinutes*60000));else{properties_().deleteProperty('CATALOG_SYNC_REQUEST');properties_().deleteProperty('CATALOG_SYNC_RETRY_AT');if(synced.changed&&!taxonomyPending_()&&!publicationNeedsReview_(taxonomyJob_()))requestTaxonomy_('catalog-change',false);}}
      else if(task==='taxonomyTranslation')taxonomyTranslationBatch_(Math.min(TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxMs,remaining));
      else if(task==='taxonomy')taxonomyBatch_(Math.min(TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxMs,remaining));
      else if(task==='classification')newsClassificationBatch_(Math.min(CLASSIFICATION_WORK.maxMs,remaining));
      else if(task==='translation'){translationBatch_(Math.min(TRANSLATION_WORK.maxMs,remaining));known=undefined;}
      else{
        const revision=properties_().getProperty('NEWS_REVISION');if(!known||knownRevision!==revision)known=knownUrls_();const result=collectionBatch_({...work,known}),day=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone);added+=result.added;errors.push(...result.errors);
        if(daily&&work.jobs.some(job=>job.id===work.pending[0].ciclo&&job.estado==='Completada')&&properties_().getProperty('MAINTENANCE_DAY')!==day){maintenance_();properties_().setProperty('MAINTENANCE_DAY',day);}
      }
      if(task!=='snapshot'&&backgroundStageComplete_(task,work,collectionJob))requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);
      knownRevision=properties_().getProperty('NEWS_REVISION');properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_LAST',task);
    }
    completed=true;return {...collectionStatus_(null,work?.jobs),added,errors};
  }finally{
    try{
      const next=backgroundNextAt_(work,completed);
      if(Number.isFinite(next))ensureBackgroundWorker_(next-Date.now());else properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_PENDING');
    }finally{if(acquired){if(properties_().getProperty('BACKGROUND_RUN_ID')===runId){properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_RUN_ID');properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_ACTIVE');properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_ACTIVE_UNTIL');properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_COLLECTION_JOB');}lock.releaseLock();}}
  }
}
function initializeBackgroundSchedules_(){
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('operational-trigger-counts');
  const p=properties_();
  installFunctionalCatalogWatcher_();
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('daily-schedule');
  p.deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT');
  const watchdogMinutes=settings_().watchdogMinutes;if(scheduledTriggers_('backgroundWatchdog_').length!==1||Number(p.getProperty('WATCHDOG_INTERVAL'))!==watchdogMinutes){scheduledTriggers_('backgroundWatchdog_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));ScriptApp.newTrigger('backgroundWatchdog_').timeBased().everyMinutes(watchdogMinutes).create();p.setProperty('WATCHDOG_INTERVAL',String(watchdogMinutes));}
  if(p.getProperty('DAILY_ENABLED')===null)p.setProperty('DAILY_ENABLED','true');
  if(p.getProperty('DAILY_ENABLED')==='true')replaceCollectionSchedule_();else for(const handler of collectionHandlers_())scheduledTriggers_(handler).forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
  if(settings_().newsletterEnabled)replaceDailySchedule_('scheduledNewsletters_',settings_().newsletterHour,settings_().newsletterMinute);else scheduledTriggers_('scheduledNewsletters_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
  if(dashboardSnapshotsPending_()||Number.isFinite(taxonomyTranslationReadyAt_())||taxonomyPending_()||p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_REQUEST')||p.getProperty('CATALOG_SYNC_REQUEST')||classificationPending_()||p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||collectionRequests_().length||collectionJobs_().some(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0)||Number.isFinite(translationReadyAt_())||Number.isFinite(newsletterReadyAt_()))ensureBackgroundWorker_();
}
function updateOperationalSchedule(){authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{initializeBackgroundSchedules_();return 'Prioridades y programación actualizadas.';});}

function backgroundWatchdog_(){
  const p=properties_(),values=p.getProperties();p.setProperty('SUPERVISOR_LAST',new Date().toISOString());if(backgroundPaused_()){p.setProperty('SUPERVISOR_DECISION','Edición administrativa: trabajos en espera');return;}
  if(Object.entries(values).some(([key,value])=>key.startsWith('WORK_PENDING:')&&value==='true')){workWake_();return;}
  if(!dashboardSnapshotsPending_()&&!values.BACKGROUND_PENDING&&!dailyPipelineRequested_()&&!['LOG_ARCHIVE_PENDING','MAINTENANCE_REQUEST','CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST','DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST','TRANSLATION_REQUEST','TAXONOMY_REQUEST','CATALOG_SYNC_REQUEST','TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST'].some(key=>values[key])&&!(values.NEWSLETTER_REQUEST&&settings_().newsletterEnabled)&&!Number.isFinite(maintenanceReadyAt_())){p.setProperty('SUPERVISOR_DECISION','Sin trabajos pendientes');return;}
  if(scheduledTriggers_('backgroundTick_').length&&Number(p.getProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT'))>Date.now()-BACKGROUND_WORK.maxMs*2)return;
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(1000))return;
  try{
    recoverBackgroundJobs_();
    const now=Date.now(),jobs=collectionJobs_(),next=backgroundNextAt_({jobs});
    if(Number.isFinite(next)){p.setProperty('SUPERVISOR_DECISION',next>now?'Esperando disponibilidad de cuota o reintento':'Continuación de la cola autorizada');p.deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT');ensureBackgroundWorker_(next-now);}else{p.setProperty('SUPERVISOR_DECISION',jobs.some(job=>job.estado==='Revisar')||[classificationJob_(),taxonomyJob_(),translationJob_()].some(publicationNeedsReview_)?'Publicación pendiente de revisión; consulta los trabajos bloqueados':'Sin trabajos pendientes');p.deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_PENDING');}
  }finally{lock.releaseLock();}
}

function backgroundQueued_(work){
  const p=properties_();return Boolean(p.getProperty('MAINTENANCE_REQUEST')||dailyPipelineRequested_()||collectionRequests_().length||!dailyCollectionPending_(work)&&!classificationPending_()&&(p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')&&!publicationNeedsReview_(classificationJob_())||p.getProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST'))||!businessPipelinePending_(work)&&(p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_REQUEST')&&!taxonomyPending_()&&!publicationNeedsReview_(taxonomyJob_())));
}

function backgroundStageComplete_(task,work,collectionJob){
  if(task==='collection'&&collectionJob)return work.jobs.some(job=>job.id===collectionJob&&Number(job.pendientes)===0&&job.estado!=='Preparando');
  if(task==='collection')return !work.jobs.some(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando');
  const job={classification:classificationJob_,translation:translationJob_,taxonomy:taxonomyJob_,taxonomyTranslation:taxonomyTranslationJob_,maintenance:maintenanceJob_}[task];
  return task==='newsletter'||Boolean(job&&job()?.state==='Completada');
}

function getOperationalSchedule(){
 authorize_(true);const config=settings_(),enabled=properties_().getProperty('DAILY_ENABLED')==='true';
 const times=new Set(),jobs=[...collectionSchedules_().map((job,index)=>{const key=scheduleTime_(job)+'|'+job.timezone,expected=enabled&&job.enabled&&!times.has(key)?1:0;if(expected)times.add(key);return {...job,label:'Recopilación '+(index+1),expected};}),{label:'Envíos planificados',handler:'scheduledNewsletters_',hour:config.newsletterHour,minute:config.newsletterMinute,timezone:config.timezone,expected:config.newsletterEnabled?1:0},{label:'Supervisor de colas',handler:'backgroundWatchdog_',minutes:config.watchdogMinutes,expected:1}];
 const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=cache.get('operational-trigger-counts'),counts=new Map(cached?JSON.parse(cached):[]);
 if(!cached){operationalTriggersMemory_=ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();for(const trigger of operationalTriggersMemory_){const handler=trigger.getHandlerFunction();counts.set(handler,(counts.get(handler)||0)+1);}cache.put('operational-trigger-counts',JSON.stringify([...counts]),90);}
 for(const job of jobs){job.installed=counts.get(job.handler)||0;job.valid=job.installed===job.expected;}
 return {jobs,valid:jobs.every(job=>job.valid),archive:{attempts:Number(properties_().getProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ATTEMPTS')||0),error:properties_().getProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_ERROR')||'',next:Number(properties_().getProperty('LOG_ARCHIVE_NEXT')||0)},workerTriggers:counts.get('backgroundTick_')||0,queued:dailyPipelineRequested_()||Boolean(properties_().getProperty('BACKGROUND_PENDING'))};
}

function operationalProcesses_(){
 const p=properties_().getProperties(),definitions=[['classification','CLASSIFICATION_JOB','CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST'],['translation','TRANSLATION_JOB','TRANSLATION_REQUEST'],['taxonomy','TAXONOMY_JOB','TAXONOMY_REQUEST'],['taxonomyTranslation','TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_JOB','TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST'],['maintenance','MAINTENANCE_JOB','MAINTENANCE_REQUEST']];
 const jobs=definitions.map(([stage,key,request])=>controlProcess_(stage,p[key]?JSON.parse(p[key]):null,Boolean(p[request]||stage==='translation'&&p.DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST)));
 const pending=snapshotJobsPending_()||Boolean(p.DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD)||dashboardSnapshotsPending_();jobs.push(controlProcess_('snapshot',{state:pending?'Pendiente':'Completada',updated:p['JOB_LAST_EXECUTED:snapshot']||''},pending));return jobs;
}

function newsletterIdentity_(query,now=new Date(),testLabel='',language='es'){
 const from=query.from||'',to=query.to||'',start=new Date(from+'T00:00:00Z'),end=new Date(to+'T00:00:00Z'),month=date=>new Intl.DateTimeFormat(language,{month:'long',timeZone:'UTC'}).format(date),day=date=>new Intl.DateTimeFormat(language,{day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric',timeZone:'UTC'}).format(date),fortnightly=(query.view||'briefing')==='briefing',last=Number.isFinite(start.getTime())?new Date(Date.UTC(start.getUTCFullYear(),start.getUTCMonth()+1,0)).getUTCDate():0;
 let period='';
 if(from&&to&&Number.isFinite(start.getTime())&&Number.isFinite(end.getTime())){
  const sameMonth=from.slice(0,7)===to.slice(0,7),naturalHalf=sameMonth&&(start.getUTCDate()===1&&end.getUTCDate()===15||start.getUTCDate()===16&&end.getUTCDate()===last),naturalQuarter=start.getUTCDate()===1&&start.getUTCMonth()%3===0&&to===new Date(Date.UTC(start.getUTCFullYear(),start.getUTCMonth()+3,0)).toISOString().slice(0,10);
  if(fortnightly&&naturalHalf)period=formatText(start.getUTCDate()===1?'Primera quincena de {month} de {year}':'Segunda quincena de {month} de {year}',{month:month(start),year:start.getUTCFullYear()},language);
  else if(!fortnightly&&naturalQuarter)period=formatText(['Lo más relevante del primer trimestre de {year}','Lo más relevante del segundo trimestre de {year}','Lo más relevante del tercer trimestre de {year}','Lo más relevante del cuarto trimestre de {year}'][start.getUTCMonth()/3],{year:start.getUTCFullYear()},language);
  else period=day(start)+' — '+day(end);
 }
 const scope=translateText(String(query.country||'Mirada global'),language).replace(/[\r\n]+/g,' '),subject='[bIA] 🚀 BBVA BEI'+(testLabel?' · ['+testLabel+']':'')+' · '+scope+(period?' · '+period:'');
 return {subject,period,scope,preheader:fortnightly?(query.country?'Novedades y movimientos competitivos en canales digitales para empresas e instituciones.':'Novedades internacionales en canales digitales para empresas e instituciones.'):'Entidades y bloques funcionales destacados en las publicaciones del trimestre.'};
}

function briefing_(rows,perGeography=false,geography=applicationGeography(configuration_().applicationScope,sectorNewsDefaults.segment,configuration_().geographies)){
  const ranked=rows.filter(briefingAllowed).sort(publicationOrder),overview=noveltyOverview(ranked,BRIEFING_ALLOWED_SIGNALS,geography),items=[],counts=new Map(),limit=settings_().briefingLimit;
  for(const row of ranked){const keys=perGeography?[...new Set(articleGeographies(row).map(country=>geography.own(country)?country:geography.region(country)||otherGeography))]:[''];if(keys.some(key=>(counts.get(key)||0)<limit)){items.push(row);for(const key of keys)counts.set(key,(counts.get(key)||0)+1);}}
  const regional=row=>unlocatedGeography(row,geography)?geography.regions:[...new Set(articleGeographies(row).filter(country=>!geography.own(country)).map(country=>geography.region(country)).filter(Boolean))],located=new Map(regionalGeographies(ranked,geography).map(row=>[row.name,row.total])),regions=noveltyOverview(ranked.filter(row=>regional(row).length),BRIEFING_ALLOWED_SIGNALS,regional).geographies.map(row=>({...row,locatedTotal:located.get(row.name)||0}));
  return {...overview,regions,items,limited:overview.total>items.length};
}

function newsletterContent_(selected,query,title,now,subscriptionId,language='es',editionId='',known=new Set()){
 if(!supportedLanguage(language))throw Error('Idioma no admitido.');

 if(editorial.cadence==='quarterly'&&known.verified&&!known.incomplete)identity.preheader='Publicaciones del trimestre con ejemplos que todavía no te hemos compartido.';

 const escape=value=>String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,char=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[char])),label=value=>escape(t(value));
 for(let index=0;index<editorial.cards.length;index++){const card=editorial.cards[index];card.title=newsletterWords_(localized[index].titular,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.titleWords);card.fact=newsletterWords_(newsExcerpt_({excerpt:localized[index].extracto},localized[index].titular,card.publisher).text,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.factWords);}
 const cardHtml=(card,options={})=>newsletterCardHtml_(card,editorial,query,label,escape,links,images,language,options,t),report=newsletterExecutiveReport_(editorial,query,language,t,escape,links,images,cardHtml),parts=[];
 for(const scope of ['local','global']){

  const cards=editorial.cards.filter(card=>card.scope===scope),content=(scope==='global'&&editorial.focused&&editorial.landscapes.local?.total?newsletterIllustrationHtml_('other-banks-visual',t('Canales digitales de otros bancos'),images):'')+report.scopes[scope]+(editorial.cadence==='fortnightly'&&cards.length?'<p class="newsletter-eyebrow">'+label('Bloques funcionales destacados')+'</p>'+cards.map((card,index)=>cardHtml(card,{topic:index+1})).join(''):'')+report.after[scope];
  parts.push(newsletterSectionHtml_(scope==='local'?'TU GEOGRAFÍA':'MIRADA INTERNACIONAL',scope==='local'?identity.scope:'Tendencias globales',content,label));
 }

 const footer=newsletterFooterHtml_(editionLink,links,label,escape,images);
 const html='<!doctype html><html lang="'+language+'"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><meta name="color-scheme" content="light only"><meta name="supported-color-schemes" content="light"><title>'+escape(identity.subject)+'</title><style>'+NEWSLETTER_STYLE+'</style></head><body><div class="newsletter-preheader">'+escape(identity.preheader)+'</div><!--[if mso]><table role="presentation" class="newsletter-outlook-shell" align="center"><tr><td><![endif]--><table role="presentation" class="newsletter-shell" width="100%" align="center"><tr><td class="newsletter-shell-cell">'+newsletterHeaderHtml_(identity,editorial,label,escape,images)+'<p class="newsletter-intro">'+label(editorial.cadence==='quarterly'?'Qué se ha publicado, acerca de los canales digitales de Banca de Empresas, en los medios.':'Qué se ha publicado, acerca de los canales digitales de Banca de Empresas, para revisar esta quincena.')+'</p>'+(editorial.cadence==='quarterly'&&!editorial.focused?'':newsletterIllustrationHtml_(editorial.cadence==='quarterly'?'quarterly-visual':'fortnightly-visual',t(editorial.cadence==='quarterly'?'Planificación trimestral':'Novedades de la quincena'),images))+parts.join('')+report.note+(!items.length?'<p>'+escape(editorial.audit.suppressReason)+'</p>':'')+footer+'</td></tr></table><!--[if mso]></td></tr></table><![endif]--></body></html>';
 const text=[identity.subject,identity.preheader,editorial.heading,...editorial.cards.flatMap(card=>[card.entity+' · '+card.country,t(card.category),card.title,card.fact,card.relevance,card.publisher,card.url]),report.text,editionLink,links.manage||'',links.unsubscribe||''].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
 const corpusIds=new Set(editorial.corpusIds);

let newsletterVisualConfig_,newsletterVisualMemory_=new Map();
function newsletterVisualAsset_(name,images){
 const allowed=['fortnightly-visual','quarterly-visual','other-banks-visual','feedback-positive','feedback-negative'];if(!allowed.includes(name))return false;
 try{
  const configured=newsletterVisualConfig_||(newsletterVisualConfig_=JSON.parse(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_VISUAL_ASSETS')||'{}')),fileId=String(configured[name]||'');
  if(!/^[\w-]{20,100}$/.test(fileId))return false;
  let base64=newsletterVisualMemory_.get(fileId);
  if(!base64){
   const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='newsletter-visual-'+name+'-'+fileId,stored=cache.getAll([key+'-count',...Array.from({length:5},(_,index)=>key+'-'+index)]),chunks=Number(stored[key+'-count']||0);
   if(chunks>0&&chunks<=5){const parts=Array.from({length:chunks},(_,index)=>stored[key+'-'+index]);if(parts.every(part=>typeof part==='string'&&part.length))base64=parts.join('');}
   if(!base64){const blob=DriveApp.getFileById(fileId).getBlob();if(blob.getContentType()!=='image/png')return false;const bytes=blob.getBytes();if(!bytes.length||bytes.length>200000)return false;base64=Utilities.base64Encode(bytes);const segments=base64.match(/.{1,80000}/g)||[];if(segments.length<=5){const values={[key+'-count']:String(segments.length)};segments.forEach((segment,index)=>values[key+'-'+index]=segment);cache.putAll(values,21600);}}
   newsletterVisualMemory_.set(fileId,base64);
  }
  images.set(name,{id:name,data:base64});return true;
 }catch(error){return false;}
}

 const heading=options.compact?'<p class="newsletter-meta">'+identityMark('countries',card.country,escape,images)+' '+label(card.country)+'</p>':'<p class="newsletter-eyebrow">'+(options.topic?escape(formatText('Trending topic {scope} #{number}',{scope:translate(card.scope==='local'?'nacional':'internacional'),number:options.topic},language)):label('Bloque funcional'))+'</p><h2 class="newsletter-lever">'+contextual(label(card.category),'',card.category)+'</h2><table role="presentation" class="newsletter-article-heading"><tr><td><p class="newsletter-bank">'+contextual(escape(card.entity),card.entity)+' · '+label(card.country)+'</p></td><td class="newsletter-identity-cell">'+storyIdentity(card.entity,card.country,escape,images)+'</td></tr></table>';

function newsletterInline_(html,escape){
  return html.replace(/<([a-z][\w-]*)(\s[^>]*|)>/g,(tag,name,attributes)=>{
    const classes=attributes.match(/class="([^"]*)"/)?.[1].split(/\s+/)||[],style=(NEWSLETTER_INLINE[name]||'')+classes.map(value=>NEWSLETTER_INLINE['.'+value]||'').join('');
    const existing=attributes.match(/style="([^"]*)"/)?.[1]||'';
    return style?'<'+name+' style="'+escape(style+existing)+'"'+attributes.replace(/\sstyle="[^"]*"/,'')+'>':tag;
  });
}
function newsletterLinks_(subscriptionId,editionId,view='briefing',period={}){
  const configured=settings_().newsletterAppUrl,url=configured||(typeof ScriptApp!=='undefined'&&ScriptApp.getService?ScriptApp.getService().getUrl():'');
  const app=canonicalUrl_(url);if(!app)return {app:'',manage:'',unsubscribe:''};
  const base=app.split('?')[0],manage=base+'?view=subscriptions';
  return {app:editionId?base+'?edition='+encodeURIComponent(editionId)+'&view='+encodeURIComponent(view)+(period.from?'&from='+encodeURIComponent(period.from):'')+(period.to?'&to='+encodeURIComponent(period.to):''):base+'?view='+encodeURIComponent(view),manage,unsubscribe:subscriptionId?manage+'&unsubscribe='+encodeURIComponent(subscriptionId):manage};
}

function newsletterExploreLink_(app,view,country,entity='',palanca='',subpalanca='',benchmark='',newsGeography=''){if(!app)return '';return app.replace(/([?&])view=[^&]*&?/,'$1').replace(/[?&]$/,'')+(app.includes('?edition=')?'&':'?')+'view='+encodeURIComponent(view)+'&country='+encodeURIComponent(country)+'&entity='+encodeURIComponent(entity)+(benchmark?'&benchmark='+encodeURIComponent(benchmark):'')+(newsGeography?'&newsGeography='+encodeURIComponent(newsGeography):'')+(palanca?'&palanca='+encodeURIComponent(palanca):'')+(subpalanca?'&subpalanca='+encodeURIComponent(subpalanca):'');}

function calendarDate_(now){return new Date(recordDay(now,settings_().timezone)+'T00:00:00Z');}
function dashboardPeriod_(view,now=new Date()){return readingWindow(view,recordDay(now,settings_().timezone));}
function dashboardQuery_(query={},now=new Date(),currentScope=true){
  query=geographyTabQuery(query);
  const view=query.view||'news',initial=query.initial,filters=Object.fromEntries([...subscriptionFilterKeys,'from','to','page','newsGeography','benchmark'].filter(key=>Object.hasOwn(query,key)).map(key=>[key,query[key]]));
  if(currentScope&&filters.coverage&&!Object.hasOwn(coverageOptions,filters.coverage))throw Error('Filtro de cobertura no válido.');
  if(!readingViews.includes(view))return filters;
  if(currentScope&&view==='briefing')return {...sectorNewsDefaults,...(!initial&&(filters.from||filters.to)?Object.fromEntries(['from','to'].filter(key=>filters[key]).map(key=>[key,filters[key]])):dashboardPeriod_(view,now))};
  if(currentScope&&view==='radar'){
    const year=String(query.year||'');if(year&&(!/^\d{4}$/.test(year)||Number(year)<2000||Number(year)>Number(recordDay(now,settings_().timezone).slice(0,4))))throw Error('Año no válido.');
    return {...sectorNewsDefaults,...Object.fromEntries(['entity','type','palanca','subpalanca'].filter(key=>filters[key]).map(key=>[key,filters[key]])),country:filters.country||'',...(year?{from:year+'-01-01',to:year+'-12-31'}:!initial&&(filters.from||filters.to)?Object.fromEntries(['from','to'].filter(key=>filters[key]).map(key=>[key,filters[key]])):dashboardPeriod_(view,now))};
  }
  const defaults={...(view==='radar'?{entity:''}:{}),...sectorNewsDefaults};
  return {...(initial?{...defaults,...(filters.newsGeography?{newsGeography:filters.newsGeography}:{})}:currentScope?{...filters,...sectorNewsDefaults}:filters),...(initial||currentScope&&!filters.from&&!filters.to?dashboardPeriod_(view,now):{})};
}

function candidateRecord_(item,feed,now,reason){
  const row={id:sha256_(newsUrlIdentity_(item.url)).slice(0,32),fecha:recordDay(item.date,settings_().timezone),pais:item.country,entidad:item.entity,titular:item.title.slice(0,1000),extracto:item.excerpt.slice(0,CANDIDATE_POLICY.excerptChars),url:item.url,fuente:feed.name,idioma:item.language,capturada:now.toISOString(),estado:item.labels.estado,motivo:reason,procedencia:JSON.stringify({fuente:feed.url,tipo:feed.kind||'rss',dominio:feed.domain,capacidad:Boolean(feed.capabilitySearch),medio:item.publisher||(feed.kind==='rss'?feed.name:''),extracto:item.provenance,...(item.sourceUrl?{medioUrl:item.sourceUrl}:{}),consulta:feed.range||null}),clasificacion:JSON.stringify(item.labels)};
  return RADAR.sheets.Candidatos.map(key=>row[key]||'');
}
function candidateSheet_(){
  let sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Candidatos');if(!sheet){sheet=book_().insertSheet('Candidatos');sheet.getRange(1,1,1,RADAR.sheets.Candidatos.length).setValues([RADAR.sheets.Candidatos]);}return sheet;
}
// A bounded identity column is read once per collection batch, never per article.
function persistCandidates_(records,now=new Date()){
  const p=properties_(),day=recordDay(now,settings_().timezone);
  if(!records.length&&(!book_().getSheetByName('Candidatos')||p.getProperty('CANDIDATE_RETENTION_DAY')===day&&book_().getSheetByName('Candidatos').getLastRow()-1<=CANDIDATE_POLICY.maxRows))return;
  const sheet=candidateSheet_(),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),cutoff=new Date(now.getTime()-CANDIDATE_POLICY.retentionDays*86400000).toISOString();
  let expired=0;
  if(count&&p.getProperty('CANDIDATE_RETENTION_DAY')!==day)for(const [captured] of sheet.getRange(2,10,count,1).getDisplayValues()){if(captured>=cutoff)break;expired++;}
  if(expired)sheet.deleteRows(2,expired);
  const size=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='candidate-ids:'+RADAR.version+':'+(p.getProperty('CANDIDATES_REVISION')||'0')+':'+size,cached=!expired&&readDashboardCache_(cache,key),known=new Set(cached||(size?sheet.getRange(2,1,size,1).getDisplayValues().flat():[])),added=[];
  for(const record of records)if(!known.has(record[0])){known.add(record[0]);added.push(record);}
  // Keep the newest bounded recoverable corpus; expired/displaced records are counted explicitly.
  const overflow=Math.max(0,size+added.length-CANDIDATE_POLICY.maxRows),removed=Math.min(size,overflow),discarded=Math.max(0,overflow-size);
  if(removed)sheet.deleteRows(2,removed);
  append_('Candidatos',added.slice(discarded));
  if(p.getProperty('CANDIDATE_RETENTION_DAY')!==day)p.setProperty('CANDIDATE_RETENTION_DAY',day);
  if(added.length||expired||removed){const revision=Utilities.getUuid();p.setProperty('CANDIDATES_REVISION',revision);const retained=removed?sheet.getRange(2,1,Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),1).getDisplayValues().flat():[...known];writeDashboardCache_(cache,'candidate-ids:'+RADAR.version+':'+revision+':'+Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),retained);}
  else if(!cached)writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,[...known]);
  telemetry_('candidatos',0,'OK',JSON.stringify({recibidos:records.length,nuevos:added.length-discarded,duplicados:records.length-added.length,expirados:expired,limite:removed+discarded}));
}
function appendCoverage_(records){
  if(!records.length)return;
  let sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Cobertura');if(!sheet){sheet=book_().insertSheet('Cobertura');sheet.getRange(1,1,1,RADAR.sheets.Cobertura.length).setValues([RADAR.sheets.Cobertura]);}
  append_('Cobertura',records);
}

function reclassifyCandidates_(first,limit,maxMs){
 const sheet=candidateSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Candidatos,total=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),count=Math.min(limit,Math.max(0,total-first+2)),started=Date.now(),updates=[];let read=0;
 if(maxMs<=0)return {next:first,total,changed:0,done:first>total+1};
 const rows=count?sheet.getRange(first,1,count,keys.length).getDisplayValues():[];
 for(const values of rows){
  if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||backgroundPaused_(true))break;
  const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),provenance=JSON.parse(row.procedencia||'{}'),saved=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion),title=searchText_(row.titular),text=searchText_(row.titular+' '+row.extracto),hash=sha256_(JSON.stringify([title,text])),country=newsCountry_({...row,medio:provenance.medio,sourceUrl:provenance.medioUrl}),entity=entityKey_(row.entidad);
  const current=saved.schema===1&&saved.version===CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion&&saved.revision===newsClassificationRevision_()&&saved.contentHash===hash;
  if(!current||country!==row.pais||entity!==row.entidad){const labels=current?saved:classification_(title,text,true,provenance.medio).labels,changed={...row,pais:country,entidad:entity,clasificacion:JSON.stringify(labels),estado:labels.estado};updates.push({row:first+read,values:keys.map(key=>String(changed[key]||''))});}
  read++;
 }
 writeVerifiedRows_(sheet,updates);if(updates.length)properties_().setProperty('CANDIDATES_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());
 return {next:first+read,total,changed:updates.length,done:first+read>total+1};
}

function businessNews_(row){
  const labels=row.etiquetas||savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion);
  return labels.digital&&labels.capacidades.some(name=>name.startsWith('Empresas: '));
}
function newsLabels_(assessment,hash){
  const state=assessment.relevant?'relevante':assessment.excluded||assessment.editorial?'no relevante':'indeterminado';
  return {contentHash:hash,digital:assessment.relevant,capacidades:[...new Set(assessment.capabilities.map(row=>row.segment+': '+row.name))],schema:1,version:CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion,revision:newsClassificationRevision_(),estado:state,segmento:assessment.business?sectorNewsDefaults.segment:'indeterminado',segmentos:assessment.business?[sectorNewsDefaults.segment]:[],canal:assessment.channel?'digital':'indeterminado',evento:assessment.relevant?(assessment.signals.includes(INCIDENT_SIGNAL)?INCIDENT_SIGNAL:assessment.signals[0]||'indeterminado'):'indeterminado',senales:assessment.relevant?assessment.signals:[],score:assessment.score,evidencia:assessment.evidence};
}
function savedNewsLabels_(value){
  if(!value)return {digital:false,capacidades:[]};
  try{const labels=JSON.parse(value);return {...labels,digital:labels.digital===true,capacidades:Array.isArray(labels.capacidades)?labels.capacidades:[]};}
  catch(_){return {digital:false,capacidades:[]};}
}
let classificationRevisionMemory_;
function newsClassificationRevision_(){const config=configuration_();if(classificationRevisionMemory_?.config===config)return classificationRevisionMemory_.revision;const revision=classificationRulesRevision_(config);classificationRevisionMemory_={config,revision};return revision;}
function classificationRulesRevision_(config=configuration_()){return sha256_(JSON.stringify([CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion,config.capabilities,config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.functions),config.relevanceRules,config.signals,config.entities,config.segments,config.geographies,config.feeds.map(({name,country,url})=>({name,country,url}))]));}
function classificationJob_(){const raw=properties_().getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_JOB');return raw?JSON.parse(raw):null;}
function classificationProcessed_(job){return Math.max(0,Math.min(Number(job.total||0),(job.next||2)-(job.firstRow||2)));}
function classificationPending_(){const job=classificationJob_();return Boolean(job&&job.state!=='Completada'&&!publicationNeedsReview_(job));}
function classificationReadyAt_(){const job=classificationJob_();return job&&!['Completada','Publicando','Revisar'].includes(job.state)?Math.max(Date.now(),Number(job.pausedUntil||0)):Infinity;}
function writeClassificationJob_(job){progressContextMemory_=undefined;properties_().setProperty('CLASSIFICATION_JOB',JSON.stringify(snapshotJob_('CLASSIFICATION_JOB',job)));}
function requestNewsClassification_(force=false,geographyOnly=false){
  const job=classificationJob_(),revision=newsClassificationRevision_(),source=newsStorageKey_(),sourceTotal=Math.max(0,newsSheet_().getLastRow()-1),recordsRevision=properties_().getProperty('NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION')||'0',inputRevision=classificationInputRevision_();
  const reusable=!force&&job&&Boolean(job.geographyOnly)===geographyOnly&&job.revision===revision&&job.source===source&&(job.inputRevision||job.recordsRevision)===inputRevision,previousTotal=job?.sourceTotal??job?.total;
  if(reusable&&sourceTotal>=previousTotal&&(job.state!=='Completada'||previousTotal===sourceTotal))return;
  const firstRow=reusable&&previousTotal<sourceTotal?previousTotal+2:2,total=sourceTotal-firstRow+2;
  const now=new Date();
  writeClassificationJob_({source,sourceTotal,recordsRevision,inputRevision,firstRow,next:firstRow,total,revision,version:CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion,force,geographyOnly,state:total?'Pendiente':'Completada',started:now.toISOString(),updated:now.toISOString(),day:recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),classified:0,digital:0});
  if(total)ensureBackgroundWorker_();
}
function drainClassificationRequest_(){
  const p=properties_();if(!p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||classificationPending_()||publicationNeedsReview_(classificationJob_()))return;
  requestNewsClassification_();p.deleteProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST');
}
function getClassificationStatus(){
  authorize_(true);const job=classificationJob_(),queued=Boolean(properties_().getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST'));
  return {newsRevision:publishedNewsRevision_(),queued,scheduled:dailyScheduleStatus_(),timezone:settings_().timezone,job:withJobProgress_('classification',job?{...job,processed:classificationProcessed_(job)}:null,queued)};
}
function startClassification(){
  authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    if(publicationNeedsReview_(classificationJob_()))resumeSnapshotJobs_();
    else if(!classificationPending_())requestNewsClassification_(true);
    else{const job=classificationJob_();if(job.state==='En pausa'){job.state='Pendiente';job.pausedUntil=0;writeClassificationJob_(job);}ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
    return getClassificationStatus();
  });
}
function newsClassificationBatch_(maxMs=CLASSIFICATION_WORK.maxMs){
 const job=classificationJob_();if(!job||['Completada','Publicando','Revisar'].includes(job.state))return;
 const started=Date.now();let read=0,classified=0,digital=0;
 try{
  const revision=newsClassificationRevision_();if(job.revision!==revision||job.source!==newsStorageKey_()||(job.inputRevision||job.recordsRevision)!==classificationInputRevision_()){requestNewsClassification_(job.force,Boolean(job.geographyOnly));return;}
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias,sourceTotal=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1);if(sourceTotal<(job.sourceTotal??job.total)){requestNewsClassification_(job.force,Boolean(job.geographyOnly));return;}
  const size=Math.min(CLASSIFICATION_WORK.batchRows,sourceTotal-job.next+2),updates=[],items=job.geographyOnly?[]:taxonomyCatalog_();
  const rows=size>0?sheet.getRange(job.next,1,size,keys.length).getDisplayValues():[];
  for(const values of rows){
   if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||backgroundPaused_(true))break;
   const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),position=job.next+read,saved=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion);
   read++;
   let labels=saved,changed;
   if(job.geographyOnly){
    const provenance=saved.procedencia||{},feedUrl=provenance.feedUrl||configuration_().feeds.find(feed=>feed.name===row.fuente)?.url||'';
    const geography=newsCountryDecision_({...row,sourceUrl:provenance.medioUrl,feedUrl,language:row.idioma});
    const prior={...provenance};delete prior.locale;delete prior.origenLocale;
    labels.procedencia={...prior,...newsMediaProvenance_({url:row.url,sourceUrl:provenance.medioUrl,medio:row.medio,rssCountry:provenance.paisRSS||sourceGeographies_().get(searchText_(row.fuente)),feedUrl,language:row.idioma}),geografias:geography.geographies,scope:geography.scope,paisMetodo:geography.reason,paisConfianza:geography.confidence,paisEvidencias:geography.countryEvidence,tipoGeografia:geography.type,...(geography.locale?{locale:geography.locale,origenLocale:geography.localeOrigin}:{}),versionReglas:RADAR.version};
    changed={clasificacion:JSON.stringify(labels),pais:geography.country};
   }else{
    const cleanTitle=plainText_(row.titular),cleanExcerpt=plainText_(row.extracto),title=searchText_(cleanTitle),text=searchText_(cleanTitle+' '+cleanExcerpt),hash=sha256_(JSON.stringify([title,text])),nextEntity=entityKey_(row.entidad);
    const current=saved.schema===1&&saved.version===CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion&&saved.revision===revision&&saved.contentHash===hash;
    let taxonomyValid=true;
    try{validateTaxonomyAssignment_(taxonomySaved_(row.taxonomia),items,row.id,true,row);}catch(_){taxonomyValid=false;}
    if(!job.force&&current&&taxonomyValid&&nextEntity===row.entidad&&cleanTitle===row.titular&&cleanExcerpt===row.extracto)continue;
    if(!current||job.force)labels={...classification_(title,text,true,row.medio).labels,procedencia:saved.procedencia};
    const classification=JSON.stringify(labels);
    changed={titular:cleanTitle,extracto:cleanExcerpt,clasificacion:classification,entidad:nextEntity,taxonomia:JSON.stringify(necessaryTaxonomyRecord_({...row,titular:cleanTitle,extracto:cleanExcerpt,clasificacion:classification},items))};
   }
   for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(changed))if(value!==row[key])updates.push({row:position,column:keys.indexOf(key)+1,value});
   if(changed.clasificacion!==row.clasificacion)classified++;if(labels.digital)digital++;
  }
  writeNewsCells_(updates);if(updates.length)invalidateNews_(false,true,false);
  job.sourceTotal=sourceTotal;job.total=sourceTotal-(job.firstRow||2)+2;job.next+=read;Object.assign(job,{state:job.next>sourceTotal+1?'Completada':'En curso',updated:new Date().toISOString(),classified:job.classified+classified,digital:job.digital+digital,error:'',pausedUntil:0});if(job.state==='Completada')job.recordsRevision=properties_().getProperty('NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION')||'0';writeClassificationJob_(job);if(job.state==='Completada')requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);
  telemetry_('clasificacion',Date.now()-started,'OK',read+' leídas; '+classified+' clasificadas; '+updates.length+' celdas modificadas');
 }catch(error){Object.assign(job,{state:'En pausa',error:String(error.message).slice(0,180),pausedUntil:Date.now()+(serviceQuotaPause_(error)||settings_().retryMinutes*60000)});writeClassificationJob_(job);telemetry_('clasificacion',Date.now()-started,'Error',job.error);}
}

function necessaryTaxonomyRecord_(row,items=taxonomyCatalog_()){
 const saved=taxonomySaved_(row.taxonomia);
 try{validateTaxonomyAssignment_(saved,items,row.id,true,row);return JSON.parse(row.taxonomia);}catch(_){return taxonomyRecord_(row.titular,row.extracto,items,savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion));}
}
