function collectionStatus_(tasks,jobs){
  progressContextMemory_=undefined;
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache();if(!tasks&&!jobs){const cached=cache.get('collection-status');if(cached){const status=JSON.parse(cached);progressContext_(status.jobs);return status;}}
  jobs=jobs||collectionJobs_();if(tasks)collectionSnapshots_(tasks,jobs);
  const requests=collectionRequests_().filter(request=>!jobs.some(job=>job.id===request.id));
  const ordered=jobs.filter(job=>job.estado!=='Cancelada').sort((a,b)=>b.inicio.localeCompare(a.inicio)),active=ordered.filter(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando'),selected=active.length?active:ordered.slice(0,1);
  const slotIds=new Set(collectionPipelineSlots_().map(slot=>properties_().getProperty(collectionPipelineKey_(slot,'JOB'))).filter(Boolean));
  const status={blocked:recoveryAvailability(jobs,requests),total:0,processed:0,pending:0,skipped:0,failed:0,added:0,lastActivity:'',queued:requests.length,jobs:[],slotJobs:jobs.filter(job=>slotIds.has(job.id)).map(({row,...job})=>job)};
  for(const job of selected){
    for(const [key,column] of [['total','total'],['processed','procesadas'],['pending','pendientes'],['skipped','omitidas'],['failed','fallidas'],['added','nuevas']])status[key]+=Number(job[column]||0);
    if(job.actualizada>status.lastActivity)status.lastActivity=job.actualizada;
  }
  const fetchPause=Number(properties_().getProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);
  status.jobs=recoveryProgressJobs(jobs.map(({row,...job})=>job).concat(requests.map(request=>({id:request.id,tipo:request.kind,desde:request.range.from,hasta:request.range.to,inicio:request.created,estado:'En cola',total:0,procesadas:0,pendientes:0,omitidas:0,fallidas:0,nuevas:0})))).map(job=>{const pause=Math.max(Number(job.pausa||0),fetchPause),stage='daily';return {...job,progress:jobProgressState_(stage,{state:job.estado,updated:job.actualizada},{jobs,jobId:job.id,lastExecutedAt:job.actualizada||job.inicio||'',queued:job.estado==='En cola',pausedUntil:pause})};});
  status.progress=(status.jobs.find(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando')||status.jobs[0])?.progress;
  cacheJson_('collection-status',status,15);return status;
}
function resumeCollection(mode='today'){
  authorize_(true);if(mode!=='today')throw Error('Tipo de recuperación no válido.');
  ensureBackgroundWorker_();return {...collectionStatus_(),added:0,errors:[],notice:'Continuación en cola.'};
}
function collectNow(mode='today'){
  authorize_(true);if(mode!=='today')throw Error('Selecciona la recopilación diaria.');const now=new Date(),blocked=recoveryAvailability(collectionJobs_(),collectionRequests_());
  if(blocked.today)throw Error('Ya hay una recuperación diaria en curso.');
  requestDailyCollection_(now);
  return {...collectionStatus_(),added:0,errors:[],notice:'Recuperación diaria en cola.'};
}
function requestDailyCollection_(now=new Date()){const id=requestCollection_('daily',collectionRecentRange_(now)),p=properties_(),day=recordDay(now,settings_().timezone);p.setProperty('COLLECTION_MANUAL_JOB',id);p.setProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST',day);p.setProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST',day);return id;}
function afternoonRadar_(){requestDailyPipeline_('afternoon');}
function eveningRadar_(){requestDailyPipeline_('evening');}
function dailyRadar_(){requestDailyPipeline_();backgroundTick_();}
function queueScheduledCollection_(kind){
  const active=job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||['Preparando','En curso','En cola'].includes(job.estado);
  if(!collectionJobs_().some(job=>job.tipo===kind&&active(job))&&!collectionRequests_().some(request=>request.kind===kind)){
    const now=new Date(),range=collectionRecentRange_(now),key='COLLECTION_SCHEDULED_AT:'+kind,last=properties_().getProperty(key);
    if(last){const from=new Date(Date.parse(last)-86400000);if(Number.isFinite(from.getTime()))range.from=[range.from,recordDay(from,settings_().timezone)].sort().at(-1);}
    const id=requestCollection_(kind,range);properties_().setProperty(key,now.toISOString());return id;
  }
}
function collectionBatch_({tasks,pending,jobs,known:knownIndex}){
  const started=Date.now(),news=[],audit=[],candidates=[],coverage=[],errors=[],newTasks=[];let evaluated=0,relevant=0,digital=0,duplicated=0,excluded=0,saturated=0,queued;
  try{
    if(!pending.length){
      const previous=new Map(jobs.map(job=>[job.id,JSON.stringify(job)]));collectionSnapshots_(tasks,jobs);
      const changed=jobs.filter(job=>previous.get(job.id)!==JSON.stringify(job));for(const job of changed)writeCollectionJob_(job);if(changed.length)SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      return {...collectionStatus_(tasks,jobs),added:0,evaluated:0,errors:[]};
    }
    const feeds=collectionFeedIndex_(),known=knownIndex||knownUrls_(),now=new Date(),updates=new Map(pending.map(task=>[task.row,[task.estado,task.intentos,task.actualizada,task.evaluadas,task.nuevas,task.error]]));
    const jobIndex=new Map(jobs.map(job=>[job.id,job]));
    const affected=new Set(pending.map(task=>task.ciclo));for(const job of jobs)if(affected.has(job.id)){job.estado='En curso';writeCollectionJob_(job);}
    CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');
    const work=pending.map(task=>({task,feed:collectionTaskFeed_(task,feeds,jobRange_(jobIndex.get(task.ciclo)))})),fetchStart=Date.now();
    const responses=fetchFeedBatch_(work.filter(item=>item.feed).map(item=>item.feed));
    const fetchMs=Date.now()-fetchStart,processingStarted=Date.now();let responseIndex=0;
    for(const {task,feed} of work){
      let attempts=Number(task.intentos)+1;let status='Completada',count=0,added=0,error='';
      try{
        if(!feed){status='Omitida';audit.push([task.ciclo,now.toISOString(),task.fuente,task.url,status,'Fuente desactivada o eliminada']);}
        else{const response=responses[responseIndex++];if(response.error)throw response.error;
          const result=ingestFeed_(feed,known,task.ciclo,now,response.response);news.push(...result.news);audit.push(...result.audit);candidates.push(...result.candidates);coverage.push([task.ciclo,now.toISOString(),feed.name,feed.country||'',feed.range?.from||'',feed.range?.to||'',result.evaluated,result.inside,result.saturated?'sí':'no',result.saturated?splitCollectionFeed_(feed).length:0,result.saturated?'Parcial':'OK',result.saturated?'Consulta saturada; cobertura pendiente de particiones':'']);count=result.evaluated;added=result.news.length;evaluated+=count;
          relevant+=result.relevant||0;digital+=result.digital||0;duplicated+=result.duplicated||0;excluded+=result.excluded||0;
          if(result.saturated){saturated++;
            const split=splitCollectionFeed_(feed);queued=queued||collectionQueuedKeys_(tasks);
            for(const child of split){const key=task.ciclo+'|'+child.url;if(queued.has(key))continue;queued.add(key);newTasks.push([task.ciclo,child.name,child.url,'Pendiente',0,'',0,0,'',child.range.to]);}
            audit.push([task.ciclo,now.toISOString(),feed.name,feed.url,'Cobertura parcial',split.length?'Consulta saturada; dividida en dos períodos menores':'Consulta diaria saturada; el proveedor puede omitir publicaciones']);
          }}
      }catch(e){error=String(e.message).slice(0,180);if(e.quota)attempts--;status=e.quota?'Reintento programado':(e.retryable||/HTTP (429|5\d\d)/.test(error))&&attempts<3?'Reintento programado':'Error';errors.push(task.fuente+': '+error);audit.push([task.ciclo,now.toISOString(),task.fuente,task.url,status,error]);coverage.push([task.ciclo,now.toISOString(),task.fuente,feed?.country||'',feed?.range?.from||'',feed?.range?.to||'',0,0,'',0,status,error]);}
      updates.set(task.row,[status,attempts,now.toISOString(),count,added,error]);
      Object.assign(task,{estado:status,actualizada:now.toISOString(),nuevas:added});
    }
    const processingMs=Date.now()-processingStarted,writeStarted=Date.now(),persistence={};
    const measure=(phase,operation)=>{const at=Date.now();try{return operation();}finally{persistence[phase]=(persistence[phase]||0)+Date.now()-at;}};
    measure('candidates',()=>persistCandidates_(candidates,now));measure('coverage',()=>appendCoverage_(coverage));
    measure('news',()=>append_('Noticias',news));
    try{measure('media',()=>registerUnknownMedia_(news));}catch(error){telemetry_('catalogo_medios',0,'Error',String(error.message).slice(0,180));}
    measure('audit',()=>append_('Auditoria',audit));measure('children',()=>append_('Recopilacion',newTasks));
    measure('tasks',()=>writeCollectionTasks_(pending,updates));
    if(news.length)measure('invalidation',()=>{SpreadsheetApp.flush();invalidateNews_(true,true,false);});
    if(news.some(row=>businessNews_(Object.fromEntries(RADAR.sheets.Noticias.map((key,index)=>[key,row[index]])))))requestTranslations_(true);
    measure('runs',()=>append_('Ejecuciones',[...affected].map(id=>{const batch=pending.filter(task=>task.ciclo===id),rows=batch.map(task=>updates.get(task.row)),failures=rows.map(row=>row[5]).filter(Boolean);return [id,now.toISOString(),new Date().toISOString(),failures.length?'Parcial':'Completada',batch.length,rows.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+Number(row[3]),0),rows.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+Number(row[4]),0),failures.join(' | ')];})));
    for(const job of jobs)if(pending.filter(task=>task.ciclo===job.id&&updates.get(task.row)[5]).length>=2)job.pausa=String(Date.now()+settings_().pauseMinutes*60000);
    if(newTasks.length){const first=book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion').getLastRow()-newTasks.length+1;tasks.push(...newTasks.map((row,index)=>({ciclo:row[0],url:row[2],estado:row[3],nuevas:row[7],row:first+index})));}
    measure('snapshots',()=>{collectionSnapshots_(tasks,jobs);for(const job of jobs)if(affected.has(job.id))writeCollectionJob_(job);});
    measure('flush',()=>SpreadsheetApp.flush());const collection=measure('status',()=>collectionStatus_(null,jobs));
    telemetry_('recopilacion',Date.now()-started,errors.length?'Parcial':'OK',pending.length+' fuentes; '+news.length+' nuevas; '+evaluated+' recuperadas; '+relevant+' relevantes; '+news.length+' clasificadas; '+digital+' digitales; '+duplicated+' duplicadas; '+excluded+' excluidas; '+saturated+' saturadas; '+errors.length+' fallidas; preparación '+(fetchStart-started)+' ms; red '+fetchMs+' ms; proceso '+processingMs+' ms; escritura '+(Date.now()-writeStarted)+' ms; '+JSON.stringify({runId:properties_().getProperty('BACKGROUND_RUN_ID')||'',version:RADAR.version,planned:pending.length,completed:pending.filter(task=>task.estado==='Completada').length,evaluated,added:news.length,retries:[...updates.values()].filter(row=>row[0]==='Reintento programado').length,errors:errors.length,persistence}));
    return {...collection,added:news.length,evaluated,errors};
  }catch(error){telemetry_('recopilacion',Date.now()-started,'Error',error.message);throw error;}
}
function collectionQueuedKeys_(tasks){
 const missing=tasks.filter(task=>task.url===undefined),byRow=new Map(missing.map(task=>[task.row,task]));
 if(missing.length){const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion');for(const [first,last] of sheetRowRanges_([...byRow.keys()].sort((a,b)=>a-b)))sheet.getRange(first,3,last-first+1,1).getDisplayValues().forEach(([url],index)=>{const task=byRow.get(first+index);if(task)task.url=url;});}
 return new Set(tasks.map(task=>task.ciclo+'|'+task.url));
}
function retryCollectionErrors() {
  authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    const tasks=rows_('Recopilacion'),daily=new Set(collectionJobs_().filter(job=>job.tipo==='daily'&&job.estado!=='Cancelada').map(job=>job.id));let count=0;
    const values=tasks.map(task=>{if(task.estado==='Error'&&daily.has(task.ciclo)){task.estado='Pendiente';task.intentos=0;task.error='';count++;}return [task.estado,task.intentos,task.actualizada,task.evaluadas,task.nuevas,task.error];});
    if(count){book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion').getRange(2,4,values.length,6).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values.map(row=>row.map(safeCell_)));ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
    const jobs=collectionJobs_();for(const job of jobs)job.pausa='';collectionSnapshots_(tasks,jobs);for(const job of jobs)writeCollectionJob_(job);
    CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');
    return count+' fuentes preparadas para reintentar.';
  });
}

function writeCollectionTasks_(pending,updates){
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion');let start=0;
  for(let end=1;end<=pending.length;end++){
    if(end<pending.length&&pending[end].row===pending[end-1].row+1)continue;
    const group=pending.slice(start,end);sheet.getRange(group[0].row,4,group.length,6).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(group.map(task=>updates.get(task.row).map(safeCell_)));start=end;
  }
}

function collectionWork_(started){
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion'),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,keys=RADAR.sheets.Recopilacion.slice(3),jobs=collectionJobs_(),jobIndex=new Map(jobs.map(job=>[job.id,job]));
  const cycles=count>0?sheet.getRange(2,1,count,1).getDisplayValues():[];
  const active=new Set(jobs.filter(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando').map(job=>job.id)),positions=cycles.flatMap(([id],index)=>active.has(id)?[{id,row:index+2}]:[]),tasks=[];
  for(let start=0,end=1;end<=positions.length;end++){
    if(end<positions.length&&positions[end].row===positions[end-1].row+1)continue;
    const group=positions.slice(start,end);if(!group.length)break;
    sheet.getRange(group[0].row,4,group.length,7).getDisplayValues().forEach((values,index)=>tasks.push({...Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),ciclo:group[index].id,row:group[index].row}));start=end;
  }
  const retryMs=settings_().retryMinutes*60000,batch=settings_().collectionBatch,fetchPausedUntil=Number(properties_().getProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);
  const eligible=tasks.filter(task=>jobIndex.has(task.ciclo)&&Math.max(Number(jobIndex.get(task.ciclo).pausa||0),fetchPausedUntil)<=started&&(task.estado==='Pendiente'||(task.estado==='Reintento programado'&&started-Date.parse(task.actualizada)>=retryMs)))
    .sort((a,b)=>a.prioridad===b.prioridad?a.row-b.row:a.prioridad>b.prioridad?-1:1);
  const selected=eligible.find(task=>jobIndex.get(task.ciclo).tipo==='daily')||eligible[0],size=batch;
  const pending=selected?eligible.filter(task=>task.ciclo===selected.ciclo).slice(0,size).sort((a,b)=>a.row-b.row):[];
  let start=0;
  for(let end=1;end<=pending.length;end++){
    if(end<pending.length&&pending[end].row===pending[end-1].row+1)continue;
    const group=pending.slice(start,end),sources=sheet.getRange(group[0].row,2,group.length,2).getDisplayValues();
    group.forEach((task,index)=>Object.assign(task,{fuente:sources[index][0],url:sources[index][1]}));start=end;
  }
  return {tasks,pending,jobs};
}

function collectSlot(slot){authorize_(true);if(!collectionPipelineSlots_().includes(slot))throw Error('Franja de recopilación no válida.');return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{if(recoveryAvailability(collectionJobs_(),collectionRequests_()).today)throw Error('Ya hay una recuperación diaria en curso.');const id=requestDailyCollection_();properties_().setProperty(collectionPipelineKey_(slot,'JOB'),id);return 'Recuperación diaria en cola.';});}

function validateConfiguration_(config){
  const storage=config?.storage;
  if(!storage||['primaryFolderId','logFolderId','newsletterFolderId','auditFolderId','coverageFolderId','executionsFolderId','telemetryFolderId'].some(key=>typeof storage[key]!=='string'||!/^[-\w]{10,100}$/.test(storage[key]))||['logRows','logDays','newsletterDeliveries'].some(key=>!Number.isInteger(storage[key])||storage[key]<1||storage[key]>(key==='logRows'?5000:1000)))throw Error('Configuración de almacenamiento no válida.');
  const numeric={windowDays:[1,90],pageSize:[1,100],maxCustomFeeds:[1,100],maxFeedBytes:[10000,2000000],maxItems:[1,1000],exportLimit:[1,10000],eventLimit:[100,20000],retentionDays:[1,90],trendPoints:[2,60],trendSeries:[1,6],collectionBatch:[1,5],retryMinutes:[1,60],pauseMinutes:[1,60],dailyHour:[0,23],briefingLimit:[1,100],newsletterBatch:[1,100],newsletterDailyLimit:[1,1500]};
  if(!config||typeof config.settings!=='object')throw Error('Falta configuración operativa.');
  for(const [name,[min,max]] of Object.entries(numeric)){const n=config.settings[name];if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<min||n>max)throw Error(name+': requiere un entero entre '+min+' y '+max+'.');}
  for(const key of ['afternoonHour','eveningHour','newsletterHour','dailyMinute','afternoonMinute','eveningMinute','newsletterMinute']){const max=key.endsWith('Hour')?23:59;if(!Number.isInteger(config.settings[key])||config.settings[key]<0||config.settings[key]>max)throw Error(key+': requiere un entero entre 0 y '+max+'.');}
  if(![1,5,10,15,30].includes(config.settings.watchdogMinutes))throw Error('El supervisor admite intervalos de 1, 5, 10, 15 o 30 minutos.');
  if(['morningEnabled','afternoonEnabled','eveningEnabled'].some(key=>typeof config.settings[key]!=='boolean'))throw Error('Activación de recopilaciones no válida.');
  if(typeof config.settings.newsletterEnabled!=='boolean')throw Error('Configuración de newsletter no válida.');
  newsletterEmail_(config.settings.newsletterSender);
  if(typeof config.settings.newsletterAppUrl!=='string'||(config.settings.newsletterAppUrl&&!/^https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/(?:a\/macros\/bbva\.com\/|macros\/)s\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\/exec$/.test(config.settings.newsletterAppUrl)))throw Error('URL de newsletter no válida: indica la WebApp publicada en Apps Script.');
  if(typeof config.settings.newsletterSenderName!=='string'||!config.settings.newsletterSenderName.trim()||config.settings.newsletterSenderName.length>100||/[\r\n]/.test(config.settings.newsletterSenderName))throw Error('Nombre del remitente no válido.');
  try{new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es',{timeZone:config.settings.timezone});}catch(_){throw Error('Zona horaria no válida.');}
  for(const key of ['entities','geographies','segments','signals','feeds','searchLanguages','relevanceRules']){
    const list=config[key];if(!Array.isArray(list)||list.length>200)throw Error('Catálogo no válido: '+key);
    const names=new Set();
    for(const row of list){
      if(!row||typeof row.name!=='string'||!row.name.trim()||row.name.length>100||names.has(row.name)||typeof row.enabled!=='boolean')throw Error('Nombre duplicado, vacío o activación no válida: '+key);
      names.add(row.name);
      for(const field of ['terms','context','aliases','countries','exclude','publisherDomains','publisherNames'])if(field in row&&(!Array.isArray(row[field])||row[field].length>(['searchLanguages','segments'].includes(key)?160:key==='signals'?120:80)||row[field].some(value=>typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim()||value.length>100)))throw Error('Lista de términos no válida: '+row.name);
      if(['segments','signals'].includes(key)&&!row.terms?.length)throw Error('Añade términos a '+row.name);
      if(key==='signals'&&(!Array.isArray(row.context)||!Array.isArray(row.exclude)||!['headline','fullText'].includes(row.scope)))throw Error('Define el contexto de '+row.name+' (puede estar vacío).');
      if(key==='signals'&&!['Novedad','Problema'].includes(row.group))throw Error('Define el tipo de señal: '+row.name);
      if(key==='entities'&&(!row.type||!Array.isArray(row.aliases)||!Array.isArray(row.countries)))throw Error('Entidad incompleta: '+row.name);
      if(key==='geographies'&&row.region!=null&&(typeof row.region!=='string'||row.region.length>40))throw Error('Zona regional no válida.');
      if(key==='geographies'&&(!row.searchName||!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(row.code)||!/^\d{3}$/.test(row.mapId)||!/^[a-z]{2}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})?$/.test(row.language)))throw Error('País: código ISO, identificador cartográfico o idioma incorrectos.');
      if(key==='feeds'&&row.language&&feedLanguage(row.language)!==row.language)throw Error('Idioma de fuente no válido.');
      if(key==='feeds'&&(!row.id||!canonicalUrl_(row.url)||!domainMatches_(row.url,row.domain)||!/^[a-z0-9-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$/.test(row.domain)||!row.entity))throw Error('Fuente RSS no válida: '+row.name);
    }
    if(JSON.stringify(list).length>40000)throw Error('El catálogo excede el tamaño de una celda: '+key);
  }
  if(config.segments.length!==1||config.segments[0].name!==sectorNewsDefaults.segment||!config.segments[0].enabled)throw Error('El ámbito de contenido es Empresas e instituciones.');
  validateCapabilities_(config.capabilities);
  validateTaxonomy_(config.taxonomy);
  if(typeof config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl!=='string'||(config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl&&!/^https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[\w-]+(?:\/edit(?:[?#].*)?)?$/.test(config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl)))throw Error('Fuente del catálogo funcional no válida.');
  for(const row of config.relevanceRules)if(!RELEVANCE_ROLES.includes(row.role)||!row.terms.length||Object.keys(row).sort().join(',')!=='enabled,name,role,terms'||row.terms.some(term=>/[\\^$+?(){}[\]|]/.test(term)||term.includes('**')||term.split(' ').some(word=>word.includes('*')&&word.indexOf('*')!==word.length-1)))throw Error('Criterio de relevancia no válido.');
  const languages=new Set();for(const row of config.searchLanguages){if(!/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(row.language)||languages.has(row.language)||!row.terms.length||row.terms.length>160||Object.keys(row).sort().join(',')!=='enabled,language,name,terms')throw Error('Perfil de búsqueda no válido.');languages.add(row.language);}
  if(Object.keys(config).sort().join(',')!=='applicationScope,capabilities,entities,feeds,geographies,relevanceRules,searchLanguages,segments,settings,signals,storage,taxonomy')throw Error('Claves de configuración no reconocidas.');
  for(const key of ['searchTerms','disabledSources'])if(!Array.isArray(config.settings[key])||config.settings[key].length>1000||config.settings[key].some(value=>typeof value!=='string'||value.length>160))throw Error('Lista operativa no válida: '+key);
  if(!config.settings.searchTerms.length||config.settings.searchTerms.length>80)throw Error('Define entre 1 y 80 términos de búsqueda.');
  if(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(functionalConfigurationSettings_(config))).replace(/%[A-F\d]{2}/gi,'x').length>500000)throw Error('Configuración demasiado grande.');
  const countries=new Set(config.geographies.map(row=>row.name)),aliases=new Set();
  const publisherDomains=new Map(),publisherNames=new Map();for(const geo of config.geographies){for(const domain of geo.publisherDomains||[]){if(!/^[a-z0-9-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$/.test(domain)||publisherDomains.has(domain)&&publisherDomains.get(domain)!==geo.name)throw Error('Dominio de medio no válido o compartido.');publisherDomains.set(domain,geo.name);}for(const name of geo.publisherNames||[]){const key=searchText_(name);if(publisherNames.has(key)&&publisherNames.get(key)!==geo.name)throw Error('Medio asignado a más de un país.');publisherNames.set(key,geo.name);}}
  const scopes=config.applicationScope,scopeNames=applicationScopeSegments;
  if(!Array.isArray(scopes)||scopes.length!==scopeNames.length||new Set(scopes.map(row=>row?.name)).size!==scopeNames.length||scopes.some(row=>!row||!scopeNames.includes(row.name)||Object.keys(row).sort().join(',')!=='countries,name'||!Array.isArray(row.countries)||row.countries.some(country=>!countries.has(country))||new Set(row.countries).size!==row.countries.length))throw Error('Ámbito de aplicación no válido.');
  for(const row of config.entities){
    if(!countries.has(row.headquartersCountry)||row.countries.some(country=>!countries.has(country)))throw Error('País desconocido en '+row.name);
    for(const name of [row.name,...row.aliases]){const key=searchText_(name);if(aliases.has(key))throw Error('Alias compartido por varias entidades: '+name);aliases.add(key);}
  }
  if(new Set(config.geographies.map(row=>row.code)).size!==config.geographies.length||new Set(config.geographies.map(row=>row.mapId)).size!==config.geographies.length)throw Error('Código de país duplicado.');
  if(typeof config.settings.unknownCountry!=='string'||!config.settings.unknownCountry.trim()||config.settings.unknownCountry.length>100)throw Error('Define la geografía predeterminada de los RSS.');
  if(new Set(config.feeds.map(row=>row.id)).size!==config.feeds.length||new Set(config.feeds.map(row=>canonicalUrl_(row.url))).size!==config.feeds.length)throw Error('Fuente RSS duplicada.');
  return config;
}
function configurationRevision_(){configuration_();return configurationVersionMemory_;}
function getConfiguration(){authorize_(true);return {config:{...configuration_(),mediaCatalog:geographyCatalog_('CatalogoMedios').map(row=>({...row})),localeRules:geographyCatalog_('ReglasIdiomaGeografia').map(row=>({...row}))},revision:configurationRevision_(),capabilityDefaults:CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.capabilities,storagePrimaryId:properties_().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID')};}

function writeConfiguration_(config,revision,catalogs){
  validateConfiguration_(config);const canonical=functionalConfiguration_(config);if(JSON.stringify(config.taxonomy.map(block=>[block.name,block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row.name])]))!==JSON.stringify(canonical.taxonomy.map(block=>[block.name,block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row.name])])))throw Error('Los códigos y nombres oficiales se actualizan exclusivamente desde el catálogo maestro.');config=canonical;return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    if(revision!==String(properties_().getProperty('CONFIG_REVISION')||'0'))throw Error('La configuración ha cambiado en otra sesión. Recarga los catálogos antes de guardar.');
    const catalogChanges=catalogs?Object.entries(catalogs).filter(([name,rows])=>JSON.stringify(geographyCatalog_(name))!==JSON.stringify(rows)):[],reclassify=classificationRulesRevision_()!==classificationRulesRevision_(config)||catalogChanges.length>0;
    const taxonomyChanged=JSON.stringify(configuration_().taxonomy)!==JSON.stringify(config.taxonomy)||configuration_().settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl!==config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl;
    const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Configuracion'),rows=Object.entries(functionalConfigurationSettings_(config)).map(([key,value])=>[key,JSON.stringify(value)]);
    sheet.getRange(2,1,Math.max(rows.length,sheet.getLastRow()-1),2).clearContent();append_('Configuracion',rows);for(const [name,values] of catalogChanges)writeGeographyCatalog_(name,values);invalidateConfiguration_();if(reclassify)requestNewsClassification_(true);if(taxonomyChanged)requestTaxonomy_();initializeBackgroundSchedules_();refreshNewsletterStatus_();
    return 'Configuración guardada. Se aplicará a filtros, clasificación y próximas recopilaciones.';
  });
}

function validateCapabilities_(capabilities){
  if(!capabilities||Object.keys(capabilities).join(',')!=='Empresas')throw Error('Define capacidades digitales para Empresas e instituciones.');
  for(const [segment,rows] of Object.entries(capabilities)){
    if(!Array.isArray(rows)||rows.length>60)throw Error('Máximo 60 capacidades por segmento: '+segment);
    const names=new Set();
    for(const row of rows){
      const name=searchText_(row?.name);
      if(!row||typeof row.name!=='string'||!name||row.name.length>100||names.has(name)||typeof row.enabled!=='boolean'||Object.keys(row).sort().join(',')!=='enabled,name,terms')throw Error('Capacidad vacía, duplicada o no válida: '+segment);
      names.add(name);
      if(!Array.isArray(row.terms)||!row.terms.length||row.terms.length>24||row.terms.some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>80||/[";\r\n]/.test(term)))throw Error('Define entre 1 y 24 términos de hasta 80 caracteres: '+row.name);
    }
  }
  if(JSON.stringify(capabilities).length>40000)throw Error('El catálogo de capacidades excede el tamaño de una celda.');
}





function canonicalSignalRules_(rows,seeds){
 return seeds.map(seed=>{
  const saved=rows.find(row=>row.name===seed.name||seed.group==='Problema'&&row.group==='Problema');
  return {...saved,...seed,...Object.fromEntries(['terms','context','exclude'].map(key=>[key,[...new Map([...(saved?.[key]||[]),...(seed[key]||[])].map(term=>[searchText_(term),term])).values()]]))};
 });
}

}

function newsRecordsKey_(){return 'news-records:'+sha256_(JSON.stringify([RADAR.version,llmRevision_(),newsStorageKey_(),taxonomyStorageKey_(),configurationRevision_(),properties_().getProperty('NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION')||'0']));}
function newsRecordIndex_(){
  const key='news-records:index:'+newsStorageKey_()+':'+RADAR.version+':'+(properties_().getProperty('NEWS_CONTENT_REVISION')||'0'),cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);if(cached)return cached;
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,days=Object.create(null),entities=new Set(),sources=new Set();
  if(count>0)sheet.getRange(2,2,count,4).getDisplayValues().forEach(([date,,source,entity],index)=>{
    const position=index+2,ranges=days[date]||(days[date]=[]),last=ranges.at(-1);
    if(last&&last[1]===position-1)last[1]=position;else ranges.push([position,position]);
    if(entity)entities.add(entity);if(source)sources.add(source);
  });
  const value={days,entities:[...entities],sources:[...sources]};writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,value);return value;
}
function cachedNewsRecords_(query={}){
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key=newsRecordsKey_()+':'+sha256_(JSON.stringify([query.from||'',query.to||''])),raw=cache.get(key);
  if(raw){
    const manifest=JSON.parse(raw),keys=Array.from({length:manifest.parts},(_,index)=>key+':'+manifest.id+':'+index),parts=cache.getAll(keys);
    if(keys.every(key=>parts[key]))return keys.flatMap(key=>JSON.parse(parts[key])).map(unpackNews_);
  }
  const rows=annotateNews_(newsRowsForPeriod_(query).filter(businessNews_)),chunks=[];
  function chunk(items){
    const value=cacheJsonValue_(items);if(value){chunks.push(value);return chunks.length<=NEWS_CACHE.recordParts;}
    if(items.length<2)return false;const middle=Math.ceil(items.length/2);return chunk(items.slice(0,middle))&&chunk(items.slice(middle));
  }
  let complete=true;for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i+=NEWS_CACHE.chunkRows)if(!chunk(rows.slice(i,i+NEWS_CACHE.chunkRows).map(packNews_))){complete=false;break;}
  if(complete)try{const id=Utilities.getUuid();if(chunks.length)cache.putAll(Object.fromEntries(chunks.map((value,index)=>[key+':'+id+':'+index,value])),NEWS_CACHE.seconds);cache.put(key,JSON.stringify({id,parts:chunks.length}),NEWS_CACHE.seconds);}catch(_){}
  return rows;
}
function newsRowsForPeriod_(query={}){
  const positions=[];
  for(const [day,ranges] of Object.entries(newsRecordIndex_().days))if((!query.from||day>=query.from)&&(!query.to||day<=query.to))for(const [first,last] of ranges)for(let row=first;row<=last;row++)positions.push(row);
  return newsRowsAt_(positions.sort((a,b)=>a-b));
}
function newsRowsAt_(positions,gap=8){
  if(!positions.length)return [];
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias,result=[],wanted=new Set(positions);
  for(const [first,last] of sheetRowRanges_(positions,gap)){
    sheet.getRange(first,1,last-first+1,keys.length).getDisplayValues().forEach((values,index)=>{if(wanted.has(first+index))result.push({...Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),_sheetRow:first+index});});
  }
  return result;
}

// A manifest is published only after all bounded fragments have been stored.
function readDashboardCache_(cache,key){
  const raw=cache.get(key);if(!raw)return null;
  const manifest=JSON.parse(raw),keys=Array.from({length:manifest.parts},(_,index)=>key+':'+manifest.id+':'+index),parts=cache.getAll(keys);
  return keys.every(key=>typeof parts[key]==='string')?JSON.parse(keys.map(key=>JSON.parse(parts[key])).join('')):null;
}
function writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,data){
  const encoded=JSON.stringify(data),size=NEWS_CACHE.dashboardChars,count=Math.ceil(encoded.length/size);
  if(count>NEWS_CACHE.dashboardParts)return;
  const id=Utilities.getUuid(),parts={};
  for(let index=0;index<count;index++)parts[key+':'+id+':'+index]=JSON.stringify(encoded.slice(index*size,(index+1)*size));
  try{cache.putAll(parts,NEWS_CACHE.seconds);cache.put(key,JSON.stringify({id,parts:count}),NEWS_CACHE.seconds);}catch(_){}
}

function defaultDashboardSnapshot_(view,query,language){
  if(!DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.includes(view))return null;
  const page=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(query.page)||0));
  if(page&&(view!=='news'||page>=NEWS_SNAPSHOT_PAGES))return null;
  const defaults=dashboardQuery_({view,initial:true}),revision=dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view),manifest=dashboardSnapshotManifest_(view);
  if(Object.entries(query).some(([key,value])=>value!==''&&value!=null&&key!=='newsGeography'&&key!=='page'&&value!==defaults[key]))return null;
  if(manifest?.revision!==revision){requestDashboardSnapshots_();return null;}
  if(page>=(manifest.pageCount||1))return null;
  if(manifest.schema!==NEWS_CACHE.schema||manifest.periodFallback||manifest.period?.from!==query.from||manifest.period?.to!==query.to)return null;
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key=dashboardSnapshotCacheKey_(view,manifest.revision,language,query.newsGeography||'',page),cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);if(cached)return cached;
  try{
    const rows=book_().getSheetByName(manifest.sheet||'DashboardSnapshots')?.getRange(manifest.first,1,manifest.parts,4).getDisplayValues();
    if(!rows||rows.some(([name,generation,part],index)=>name!==view||generation!==manifest.generation||Number(part)!==index))throw Error('Fragmentos incompletos');
    const encoded=rows.map(row=>row[3]).join('');if(sha256_(encoded)!==manifest.digest)throw Error('Contenido incompleto');
    const bundle=JSON.parse(Utilities.ungzip(Utilities.newBlob(Utilities.base64Decode(encoded),'application/gzip')).getDataAsString()),data=view==='news'?compactNewsSnapshotData_(bundle.news,query.newsGeography,language,page):bundle.variants[''][view==='radar'?'es':language];
    if(!data)return null;
    const value={data,metadata:bundle.metadata,period:bundle.period,periodFallback:bundle.periodFallback};writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,value);return value;
  }catch(error){console.warn('Snapshot '+view+': '+String(error.message||error));properties_().setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT','true');requestDashboardSnapshots_();return null;}
}

function buildDashboardSnapshotBatch_(job=null){

function buildPreparedDashboardSnapshotBatch_(job=null){
  const p=properties_().getProperties(),now=new Date(),signature=sha256_(JSON.stringify(DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.map(view=>dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view,now,p))));
  let build=JSON.parse(p.DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD||'null');
  if(!build||build.signature!==signature)build={signature,manifests:{}};
  if(!job&&!dashboardSnapshotsPending_()){completeSnapshotJobs_();clearDashboardSnapshotRequest_();return false;}
  const batchStart=Date.now(),feeds=feeds_(),recordSets=new Map(),metadata=dashboardMetadata_();
  while(Date.now()-batchStart<BACKGROUND_WORK.sliceMs*2){
  const view=DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.find(view=>!build.manifests[view]);
  if(!view)return publishDashboardSnapshotSet_(build,job);
  const started=Date.now(),revision=dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view);let query=dashboardQuery_({view,initial:true}),rows=snapshotRecords(query),data=dashboardSnapshotData_(rows,query,feeds,view),periodFallback=false;
  const period={from:query.from,to:query.to};
  let pageCount=NEWS_SNAPSHOT_PAGES,payload=view==='news'?{news:compactNewsSnapshot_(rows,query,data)}:{variants:{'':dashboardSnapshotLanguages_(data,view)}};
  const encode=()=>Utilities.base64Encode(Utilities.gzip(Utilities.newBlob(JSON.stringify({period,periodFallback,metadata,...payload}),'application/json')).getBytes());
  let encoded=encode();
  if(view==='news'&&encoded.length>DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.chars*DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.parts){
    pageCount=1;payload={news:compactNewsSnapshot_(rows,query,data,pageCount)};encoded=encode();
  }
  const parts=Math.ceil(encoded.length/DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.chars);
  if(parts>DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.parts)throw Error('Snapshot demasiado grande: '+view);
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache();
  for(const language of view==='radar'?['es']:Object.keys(languageNames)){
    const localized=view==='news'?compactNewsSnapshotData_(payload.news,'',language):payload.variants[''][language];
    writeDashboardCache_(cache,dashboardSnapshotCacheKey_(view,revision,language),{data:localized,metadata,period,periodFallback});
  }
  if(revision!==dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view))return true;
  let sheet=book_().getSheetByName('DashboardSnapshots');if(!sheet){sheet=book_().insertSheet('DashboardSnapshots');sheet.getRange(1,1,1,4).setValues([RADAR.sheets.DashboardSnapshots]);sheet.setFrozenRows(1);}
  const previous=dashboardSnapshotManifest_(view),slot=previous?.slot===0?1:0,first=2+(DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.indexOf(view)*2+slot)*DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.parts,generation=Utilities.getUuid(),needed=first+parts-1;
  if(needed>sheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),needed-sheet.getMaxRows());
  sheet.getRange(first,1,parts,4).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(Array.from({length:parts},(_,index)=>[view,generation,String(index),encoded.slice(index*DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.chars,(index+1)*DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.chars)]));SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  build.updated=new Date().toISOString();
  build.manifests[view]={schema:NEWS_CACHE.schema,revision,generation,slot,first,parts,digest:sha256_(encoded),generated:new Date().toISOString(),period,periodFallback,...(view==='news'?{pageCount}:{})};
  properties_().setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD',JSON.stringify(build));
  telemetry_('dashboard-snapshot',Date.now()-started,'OK',view+'; '+period.from+' — '+period.to+'; anterior '+periodFallback+'; variantes '+(view==='news'?1:Object.keys(payload.variants).length)+'; comprimido '+encoded.length+' caracteres');
  if(DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.every(view=>build.manifests[view]))return publishDashboardSnapshotSet_(build,job);
  }return true;
  function snapshotRecords(query){const key=query.from+'|'+query.to;if(!recordSets.has(key))recordSets.set(key,cachedNewsRecords_(query));return recordSets.get(key);}
}
function clearDashboardSnapshotRequest_(){for(const key of ['DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST','DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUESTED_AT','DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD','DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT'])properties_().deleteProperty(key);}
function publishDashboardSnapshotSet_(build,job){
  const signature=sha256_(JSON.stringify(DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.map(view=>dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view))));
  if(build.signature!==signature)return true;
  for(const view of DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views)try{verifyDashboardSnapshot_(view,build.manifests[view]);}catch(error){delete build.manifests[view];properties_().setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD',JSON.stringify(build));throw error;}
  const previous=dataGeneration_(),generation={...previous,...(job?.categorization?{categorization:job.categorization}:{}),newsSheet:newsStorageKey_(),taxonomySheet:taxonomyStorageKey_(),snapshots:build.manifests,revision:build.signature,published:new Date().toISOString()};
  // All view manifests and the historical corpus switch together. The previous slots remain intact.
  properties_().setProperty('DATA_GENERATION_ROLLBACK',JSON.stringify(previous));
  properties_().setProperty('DATA_GENERATION',JSON.stringify(generation));dataGenerationMemory_=generation;
  clearDashboardSnapshotRequest_();completeSnapshotJobs_();if(job?.llm){const llm=llmJob_();properties_().setProperty('LLM_JOB',JSON.stringify({...llm,state:'Completada',progress:100,error:'',published:generation.published}));}pruneNewsGenerations_();return true;
}
function rebuildDashboardSnapshots(){authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{resumeSnapshotJobs_();properties_().setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT','true');requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);return 'Snapshots de Novedades, Noticias y Radar en cola.';});}

function dashboardSnapshotsReady_(work){return taxonomyPublicationReady_()&&(!classificationPending_()||snapshotJobsPending_())&&!dailyCollectionPending_(work)&&!dailyPipelineRequested_()&&dashboardSnapshotsPending_();}

function verifyDashboardSnapshot_(view,manifest){
  if(!manifest)throw Error('Falta snapshot de '+view);
  const rows=book_().getSheetByName(manifest.sheet||'DashboardSnapshots').getRange(manifest.first,1,manifest.parts,4).getDisplayValues();
  if(rows.some(([name,generation,part],index)=>name!==view||generation!==manifest.generation||Number(part)!==index)||sha256_(rows.map(row=>row[3]).join(''))!==manifest.digest)throw Error('Snapshot incompleto: '+view);return rows;
}
// One shared catalogue and article table replace country × language copies of the same payload.
function compactNewsSnapshot_(rows,query,data,pageCount=NEWS_SNAPSHOT_PAGES){
  const selected=selectAnnotatedNews_(rows,query),geography=newsReadingGeography_(null,query),groups=new Map([...data.newsGeographies,...regionalGeographies(selected,geography)].map(row=>[row.name,[]]));
  for(const row of selected){for(const name of geography.members(row))groups.get(name)?.push(row);for(const region of unlocatedGeography(row,geography)?geography.regions:new Set(articleGeographies(row).filter(country=>!geography.own(country)).map(country=>geography.region(country)).filter(Boolean)))groups.get(region)?.push(row);}
  const articles=[],positions=new Map(),pages={};
  for(const [name,items] of groups){const page=newsEntityPage(items,0,data.pageSize*pageCount);pages[name]={total:items.length,positions:page.map(row=>{if(!positions.has(row)){positions.set(row,articles.length);articles.push(row);}return positions.get(row);})};}
  const fields=[...new Set(articles.flatMap(row=>Object.keys(row)))].filter(key=>!['_sheetRow','identityTitles'].includes(key)),records=articles.map(row=>fields.map(key=>row[key]??null)),translations={};
  for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames))translations[language]=savedArticleTranslations_(articles,language).map((row,index)=>[snapshotTextDelta_(articles[index].titular,row.titular),snapshotTextDelta_(articles[index].extracto??'',row.extracto??''),row.translation]);
  const {items,page,newsGeography,total,...metadata}=data;return {metadata,fields,records,translations,pages,defaultGeography:newsGeography};
}
function compactNewsSnapshotData_(bundle,geography,language,requestedPage=0){
  let name=Object.hasOwn(bundle.pages,geography)?geography:bundle.defaultGeography;
  if(name===otherGeography||REGION_CODES.includes(name)){const grouping=newsReadingGeography_(null,{});name=preferredRegion(bundle.metadata.newsRegions||[],grouping.region(geography),grouping.ownRegions,name);}
  const group=bundle.pages[name]||{total:0,positions:[]},size=bundle.metadata.pageSize;
  const page=Math.min(requestedPage,Math.max(0,Math.ceil(group.total/size)-1)),offset=page*size;
  if(group.positions.length<Math.min(group.total,offset+size))return null;
  const items=group.positions.slice(offset,offset+size).map(index=>{
    const row=Object.fromEntries(bundle.fields.flatMap((key,position)=>bundle.records[index][position]===null?[]:[[key,bundle.records[index][position]]])),[titular,extracto,translation]=bundle.translations[language][index];
    return {...row,titular:snapshotTextValue_(row.titular,titular),extracto:snapshotTextValue_(row.extracto??'',extracto),...(translation.state==='translated'?{original:{titular:row.titular,extracto:row.extracto}}:{}),translation};
  });
  return {...bundle.metadata,items,total:group.total,page,newsGeography:name};
}

function snapshotTextDelta_(original,value){
  if(original===value)return null;
  let prefix=0,suffix=0;while(prefix<original.length&&prefix<value.length&&original[prefix]===value[prefix])prefix++;
  while(suffix<original.length-prefix&&suffix<value.length-prefix&&original[original.length-1-suffix]===value[value.length-1-suffix])suffix++;
  return prefix+suffix>24?[prefix,suffix,value.slice(prefix,value.length-suffix)]:value;
}
function snapshotTextValue_(original,delta){return delta===null?original:Array.isArray(delta)?original.slice(0,delta[0])+delta[2]+(delta[1]?original.slice(-delta[1]):''):delta;}

function newsUrlIdentity_(value){
  const url=canonicalUrl_(value);if(!url)return '';
  const [path,query='']=url.split('?'),google=domainMatches_(url,'news.google.com'),parameters=query.split('&').filter(value=>value&&!/^msclkid=/i.test(value)&&!(google&&/^oc=/i.test(value))).join('&');
  return (google?path.replace('/rss/articles/','/articles/'):path)+(parameters?'?'+parameters:'');
}
function cleanNewsTitle_(title,...publishers){
  let text=plainText_(title);
  for(const publisher of publishers){
    const source=plainText_(publisher);if(!source)continue;
    const suffix=text.slice(-source.length);
    if(searchText_(suffix)!==searchText_(source))continue;
    const prefix=text.slice(0,-source.length);
    if(/\s+[-–—|:]\s*$/.test(prefix))text=prefix.replace(/\s+[-–—|:]\s*$/,'').trim();
  }
  return text;
}
function titleKey_(title,publisher){
  const normalized=searchText_(cleanNewsTitle_(title,publisher)).replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu,' ').trim();
  return normalized.length>=30&&normalized.split(' ').length>=5?normalized:'';
}
const titleIdentityMemory_=new WeakMap(),editorialIdentityMemory_=new WeakMap();
function titleIdentity_(item){
  const dateValue=String(item.date),cached=titleIdentityMemory_.get(item);if(cached&&cached.title===item.title&&cached.publisher===item.publisher&&cached.date===dateValue)return cached.identity;
  const key=titleKey_(item.title,item.publisher),date=new Date(item.date);
  if(!key||!Number.isFinite(date.getTime()))return null;
  const day=typeof item.date==='string'&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(item.date)?date:calendarDate_(date);
  const identity={key,day:day.getTime()/86400000};titleIdentityMemory_.set(item,{title:item.title,publisher:item.publisher,date:dateValue,identity});return identity;
}
const EDITORIAL_STOPWORDS=new Set('para por con sin del las los una uno unos unas que como desde hasta sobre entre este esta sus the and for with from into this that are was has have not but you your their its dos das uma uns nas nos com sem pelo pela aos sao por que nao em as os de da do es en el la un o a e y i di il lo gli le dei delle per nel nella con che non der die das den dem des ein eine und oder von zur zum mit auf aus bei ist im zu et les des une dans sur pour pas aux du au ne ou ce ces se son sa ses un entre um ao pelo para sem ve bir bu ile icin gibi olan mais como foi'.split(' '));
const editorialGeographyIndexes_=new WeakMap();
function editorialGeographies_(title,index=businessIndex_()){
 let compiled=editorialGeographyIndexes_.get(index);
 if(!compiled){
  const terms=new Map();for(const geo of index.geographies)for(const term of geo.terms){if(!terms.has(term))terms.set(term,new Set());terms.get(term).add(geo.name);}
  compiled={terms,pattern:phrasePattern_([...terms.keys()].sort((a,b)=>b.length-a.length),'g')};editorialGeographyIndexes_.set(index,compiled);
 }
 const countries=new Set();for(const match of title.matchAll(compiled.pattern))for(const name of compiled.terms.get(match[0].replace(/^[^a-z0-9]+/,''))||[])countries.add(name);return [...countries].sort();
}
function editorialIdentity_(item,identity=titleIdentity_(item)){
  const index=businessIndex_(),cached=editorialIdentityMemory_.get(item);if(cached&&cached.identity===identity&&cached.entity===item.entity&&cached.index===index)return cached.editorial;
  const entity=item.entity?searchText_(entityKey_(item.entity)):'';if(!identity||!entity)return null;
  const excluded=new Set([...entity.split(' '),...searchText_(item.publisher).split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u)]);
  const catalog=index.entities.get(entity);for(const alias of catalog?.aliases||[])for(const token of searchText_(alias).split(' '))excluded.add(token);
  const tokens=[...new Set(identity.key.split(' ').filter(token=>(token.length>=3||/\d/.test(token))&&!EDITORIAL_STOPWORDS.has(token)&&!excluded.has(token)))];
  const editorial=tokens.length>=4?{key:JSON.stringify([entity,tokens.filter(token=>/\d/.test(token)).sort(),/\b(?:no|not|never|nao|non|nicht|yok)\b/.test(identity.key)]),tokens}:null;editorialIdentityMemory_.set(item,{identity,entity:item.entity,index,editorial});return editorial;
}
function rememberTitle_(known,item,entry=true){
  const identity=titleIdentity_(item);if(!identity)return;
  if(!known.titles.has(identity.key))known.titles.set(identity.key,new Map());known.titles.get(identity.key).set(identity.day,entry);
  const editorial=editorialIdentity_(item,identity);if(!editorial)return;
  known.editorial=known.editorial||new Map();if(!known.editorial.has(editorial.key))known.editorial.set(editorial.key,new Map());
  const days=known.editorial.get(editorial.key);if(!days.has(identity.day))days.set(identity.day,[]);
  const candidates=days.get(identity.day);
  candidates.push({tokens:editorial.tokens,entry,title:identity.key});
}
function equivalentEditorialTitle_(a,b){
  if(a.length<4||b.length<4)return false;
  const numbers=tokens=>tokens.filter(token=>/\d/.test(token)).sort(),leftNumbers=numbers(a),rightNumbers=numbers(b);if(leftNumbers.length&&rightNumbers.length&&!leftNumbers.some(value=>rightNumbers.includes(value)))return false;
  const right=new Set(b),intersection=a.filter(token=>right.has(token)).length;
  return intersection/Math.min(a.length,b.length)>=.72||intersection/(a.length+b.length-intersection)>=.60;
}
function* duplicateTitleEntries_(known,item){
  const identity=titleIdentity_(item);if(!identity)return;
  const days=known.titles.get(identity.key);
  if(days)for(let offset=-COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays;offset<=COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays;offset++)if(days.has(identity.day+offset))yield days.get(identity.day+offset);
  const editorial=editorialIdentity_(item,identity),candidates=editorial&&known.editorial?.get(editorial.key);if(!candidates)return;
  for(let offset=-COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays;offset<=COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays;offset++)for(const candidate of candidates.get(identity.day+offset)||[])if(equivalentEditorialTitle_(editorial.tokens,candidate.tokens)&&JSON.stringify(editorialGeographies_(identity.key))===JSON.stringify(editorialGeographies_(candidate.title)))yield candidate.entry;
}
function duplicateTitleEntry_(known,item){return duplicateTitleEntries_(known,item).next().value;}
function duplicateTitle_(known,item){return duplicateTitleEntry_(known,item)!==undefined;}
function newsRepresentative_(a,b){
  const original=row=>/europa\s*press/i.test(String(row.medio||''))||domainMatches_(row.url||'','europapress.es');
  const origin=Number(original(a))-Number(original(b));
  const richer=String(a.extracto||'').length-String(b.extracto||'').length;
  const direct=Number(!domainMatches_(a.url||'','news.google.com'))-Number(!domainMatches_(b.url||'','news.google.com'));
  return (origin||richer||direct||String(b.url||'').localeCompare(String(a.url||''))||String(b.id||'').localeCompare(String(a.id||'')))>0?a:b;
}
function uniqueNews_(rows,groups=null){
  const known={titles:new Map()},urls=new Map(),result=[],parents=[],members=groups?[]:null;
  const root=index=>{while(parents[index]!==index){parents[index]=parents[parents[index]];index=parents[index];}return index;};
  for(const row of rows){
    const items=[row.titular,row.original?.titular,...(row.identityTitles||[])].filter(Boolean).map(title=>({title,date:row.fecha,publisher:row.medio,entity:entityKey_(row.entidad),country:row.pais})),url=newsUrlIdentity_(row.url);
    const matches=new Set([url?urls.get(url):undefined,...items.flatMap(item=>[...duplicateTitleEntries_(known,item)])].filter(index=>index!==undefined).map(root));
    const index=matches.size?Math.min(...matches):result.length;
    if(!matches.size){parents.push(index);result.push(row);}
    else{for(const other of matches)if(other!==index){result[index]=newsRepresentative_(result[index],result[other]);parents[other]=index;result[other]=null;}result[index]=newsRepresentative_(result[index],row);}
    if(members)members.push(index);if(url)urls.set(url,index);for(const item of items)rememberTitle_(known,item,index);
  }
  if(groups){const positions=new Map(rows.map((row,index)=>[row,index]));rows.forEach((row,index)=>{const representative=result[root(members[index])];if(representative!==row)groups.push({index,representativeIndex:positions.get(representative)});});}
  return result.filter(Boolean);
}

// Read-only consolidation plan. Historical newsletter snapshots keep their original IDs.
function previewNewsDeduplication(){
  authorize_(true);
  const rows=translationIdentityRows_(rows_('Noticias')),aliases=[],survivors=uniqueNews_(rows,aliases),groups=new Map();
  for(const alias of aliases){
    if(!groups.has(alias.representativeIndex))groups.set(alias.representativeIndex,{representative:rows[alias.representativeIndex],duplicates:[]});
    groups.get(alias.representativeIndex).duplicates.push(rows[alias.index]);
  }
  return {revision:properties_().getProperty('NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION')||'0',total:rows.length,unique:survivors.length,duplicates:aliases.length,groups:[...groups.values()]};
}

function newsletterPipelinePending_(work){const p=properties_();return Boolean(snapshotPublicationPending_(work,false)||dailyPipelineRequested_()||dailyCollectionPending_(work)||p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||classificationPending_());}
function newsletterQuotaReset_(deliveries,now=new Date()){
  const timestamps=deliveries.filter(row=>['Enviando','Enviada','Revisar'].includes(row.estado)).map(row=>Date.parse(row.fecha)).filter(value=>value>now.getTime()-86400000).sort((a,b)=>a-b),index=timestamps.length-settings_().newsletterDailyLimit;
  return index>=0?timestamps[index]+86400000:0;
}
function pauseNewsletterQuota_(error){
  if(error.quota||serviceQuotaPause_(error))properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_QUOTA_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+(error.dailyQuota?86400000:serviceQuotaPause_(error)||settings_().pauseMinutes*60000)));
}
function newsletterDeliveryPlan_(now,deliveries){
  const periods=new Map(),attempts=newsletterDeliveryAttempts_(deliveries),planned=[];
  for(const subscription of subscriptionRows_().filter(row=>row.activa))for(const periodicity of Object.keys(newsletterCadences)){
    const row={...subscription,periodicidad:periodicity};
    if(!periods.has(periodicity))periods.set(periodicity,newsletterPeriod_(periodicity,now));
    const period=periods.get(periodicity);if(recordDay(now,settings_().timezone)<period.available||new Date(row.actualizada)>=new Date(period.cutoff))continue;
    const id=newsletterDeliveryId_(row,period);planned.push({row,id,attempt:newsletterDeliveryAttempt_(row,period,attempts)});
  }
  return {periods,planned,due:planned.filter(item=>!item.attempt||['No enviado','Bloqueada'].includes(item.attempt.estado)).map(item=>({...item,query:subscriptionQuery_(item.row,now,true)}))};
}
function refreshNewsletterStatus_(){

  const now=new Date(),p=properties_(),deliveries=rows_('NewsletterEnvios',undefined,8),{planned,due}=newsletterDeliveryPlan_(now,deliveries),completed=planned.filter(item=>['Enviada','Sin novedades'].includes(item.attempt?.estado)),review=planned.filter(item=>['Enviando','Revisar'].includes(item.attempt?.estado)).length,enabled=settings_().newsletterEnabled,queued=enabled&&Boolean(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST')),pausedUntil=Number(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_NEXT')||0),running=Number(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_RUNNING_UNTIL')||0)>Date.now();
  const job={total:planned.length,processed:completed.length,pending:due.length,accepted:completed.filter(item=>item.attempt.estado==='Enviada').length,empty:completed.filter(item=>item.attempt.estado==='Sin novedades').length,review,pausedUntil,updated:planned.reduce((date,item)=>item.attempt?.fecha>date?item.attempt.fecha:date,''),error:p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_LAST_ERROR')||'',state:running?'En curso':review?'En pausa':queued&&newsletterPipelinePending_()?'En cola':queued&&pausedUntil>Date.now()?'En pausa':due.length?queued?'En cola':'Pendiente':'Completada'};
  job.progress=jobProgressState_('newsletter',job,{queued,quotaUntil:Math.max(Number(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_QUOTA_UNTIL')||0),due.length?newsletterQuotaReset_(deliveries,now):0)});
  const result={enabled,queued,active:enabled&&(queued||running),job};p.setProperty('NEWSLETTER_STATUS_SUMMARY',JSON.stringify(result));return result;
}
function getNewsletterProgress(){
 authorize_(true);const p=properties_(),saved=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_STATUS_SUMMARY')||'null'),queued=settings_().newsletterEnabled&&Boolean(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST')),running=Number(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_RUNNING_UNTIL')||0)>Date.now(),job={...(saved?.job||{total:0,processed:0,pending:0,accepted:0,empty:0,review:0,updated:'',state:'Completada'}),pausedUntil:Number(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_NEXT')||0),error:p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_LAST_ERROR')||''};
 if(running)job.state='En curso';else if(queued)job.state=job.pausedUntil>Date.now()?'En pausa':'En cola';job.progress=jobProgressState_('newsletter',job,{queued,quotaUntil:Number(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_QUOTA_UNTIL')||0)});
 return {enabled:settings_().newsletterEnabled,queued,active:queued||running,job};
}
function requestNewsletterDelivery_(delay=0){properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST','true');properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_NEXT',String(Date.now()+delay));ensureBackgroundWorker_(delay);}
function scheduledNewsletters_(){
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('newsletter');return;}
  if(dailyScheduleStatus_())requestDailyPipeline_();requestNewsletterDelivery_();refreshNewsletterStatus_();
}
function newsletterReadyAt_(work){return properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST')&&settings_().newsletterEnabled&&!newsletterPipelinePending_(work)?Math.max(Date.now(),Number(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_NEXT')||0),Number(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_QUOTA_UNTIL')||0)):Infinity;}
function deliverNewsletterBatch_(work,maxMs=BACKGROUND_WORK.sliceMs){
  const started=Date.now(),now=new Date(started),result={accepted:0,empty:0,duplicates:0,pending:0,state:'disabled'};
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('newsletter');return {...result,state:'configuration_pause'};}
  if(!settings_().newsletterEnabled){properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST');return result;}
  if(newsletterPipelinePending_(work)){ensureNewsletterContinuation_();return {...result,state:'collection_priority'};}
  const quotaPause=Number(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_QUOTA_UNTIL')||0);if(quotaPause>Date.now()){requestNewsletterDelivery_(quotaPause-Date.now());return {...result,state:'limit'};}
  try{
    properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_LAST_ERROR');properties_().setProperty('JOB_LAST_EXECUTED:newsletter',new Date().toISOString());properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_RUNNING_UNTIL',String(started+maxMs+BACKGROUND_WORK.activeGraceMs));CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('newsletter-progress');
    const deliveries=rows_('NewsletterEnvios'),{due,periods}=newsletterDeliveryPlan_(new Date(),deliveries);
    result.pending=due.length;result.state='no_due';
    if(!due.length){properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST');return result;}
    let remaining=settings_().newsletterBatch,quota=newsletterBudget_(deliveries,now);
    if(!quota){requestNewsletterDelivery_(newsletterQuotaReset_(deliveries,now)-Date.now());return {...result,state:'limit'};}
    let sender;
    const history=newsletterSentContent_(deliveries),window={from:due.reduce((start,item)=>item.query.from<start?item.query.from:start,due[0].query.from),to:due.reduce((end,item)=>item.query.to>end?item.query.to:end,due[0].query.to)};
    const news=annotateNews_(rows_('Noticias',undefined,undefined,window).filter(row=>businessNews_(row)&&newsScope_(row,window,''))),prepared=new Map(),sheet=book_().getSheetByName('NewsletterEnvios');
    sheet.getRange(1,9,1,1).setValues([['contenido']]);
    result.state='processed';
    for(const {row,id,query} of due){
      if(!remaining||!quota||Date.now()-started>=maxMs)break;
      if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('newsletter');result.state='configuration_pause';break;}
      if(newsletterPipelinePending_(work)){result.state='collection_priority';break;}
      const selection=newsletterSelectionQuery_(query),key=JSON.stringify(selection);
      if(!prepared.has(key))prepared.set(key,selectAnnotatedNews_(news,selection));
      const email=newsletterEmail_(row.correo);if(!history.has(email)){const set=new Set();set.verified=true;history.set(email,set);}
      const known=history.get(email),selected=prepared.get(key),unseen=selected,edition=Utilities.getUuid();let content=newsletterContent_(unseen,query,row.nombre,now,row.id,row.idioma,edition,known);const keys=content.items.flatMap(newsletterItemKeys_);
      telemetry_('newsletter-selection',Date.now()-started,'OK',JSON.stringify({cadence:content.editorial.cadence,...content.editorial.audit,exclusions:content.editorial.audit.exclusions.length}));
      const skipped=content.editorial.audit.exclusions.filter(row=>row.reason.includes('ya enviado')).length;content.omitted=skipped;result.duplicates+=skipped;
      const needsTranslation=content.count&&!content.translationReady;
      if(needsTranslation&&!newsletterTranslationsReady_(content.items,row.idioma,started,maxMs)){result.state='translation_pending';continue;}
      if(needsTranslation&&content.items.length){content=newsletterContent_(unseen,query,row.nombre,now,row.id,row.idioma,edition,known);content.omitted=skipped;}
      if(content.count&&!sender)try{sender=newsletterSender_();}catch(error){recordNewsletterBlock_(error,properties_().getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL'));throw error;}
      if(content.count)saveNewsletterEdition_(edition,id,row.correo,content.subject,query,row.idioma,content.evidence,content.editorial);
      append_('NewsletterEnvios',[[id,row.id,row.correo,query.from,query.to,content.count?'Enviando':'Sin novedades',now.toISOString(),newsletterContentDetail_(content),JSON.stringify(keys)]]);
      remaining--;result.pending--;
      if(!content.count){result.empty++;continue;}
      for(const key of keys)known.add(key);quota--;
      try{completeNewsletterDelivery_(sheet,sheet.getLastRow(),sender,row.correo,content);result.accepted++;}
      catch(error){pauseNewsletterQuota_(error);properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_LAST_ERROR',String(error.message).slice(0,300));result.state='error';result.error=error.message;if(error.rejected){quota++;result.pending++;}break;}
    }
    if(result.pending||result.state==='error'){
      const delay=!quota?Math.max(60000,newsletterQuotaReset_(rows_('NewsletterEnvios'),new Date())-Date.now()):result.state==='error'?settings_().pauseMinutes*60000:result.state==='translation_pending'&&translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls?nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone)-Date.now():60000;
      requestNewsletterDelivery_(delay);
    }else properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST');
    return result;
  }catch(error){pauseNewsletterQuota_(error);properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_LAST_ERROR',String(error.message).slice(0,300));ensureNewsletterContinuation_();throw error;}
  finally{properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_RUNNING_UNTIL');refreshNewsletterStatus_();}
}

function newsletterTranslationsReady_(items,language,started,maxMs){
 const pending=savedArticleTranslations_(items,language).filter(row=>row.translation.state==='pending');if(!pending.length)return true;
 let calls=0;for(const row of pending){if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||calls>=TRANSLATION_WORK.batchCalls||translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls)break;storeArticleTranslation_(row,language);calls++;const today=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone),usage=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_TRANSLATION_USAGE')||'{}');properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_TRANSLATION_USAGE',JSON.stringify({day:today,calls:(usage.day===today?Number(usage.calls)||0:0)+1}));}
 requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);return !savedArticleTranslations_(items,language).some(row=>row.translation.state==='pending');
}

function newsletterWords_(text,limit){const words=plainText_(text).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);return words.slice(0,limit).join(' ')+(words.length>limit?'…':'');}
function newsletterSelectionQuery_(query){return {...query,country:query.country===otherGeography||REGION_CODES.includes(query.country)?query.country:''};}
function newsletterDigest_(items,query,language,t,known=new Set()){
 const config=configuration_(),geographies=config.geographies,regions=new Set(geographies.map(row=>row.region).filter(Boolean)),own=new Set(config.applicationScope.filter(row=>!query.segment||row.name===query.segment).flatMap(row=>row.countries)),cadence=Object.entries(newsletterCadences).find(([,value])=>value.view===(query.view||'briefing'))?.[0];if(!cadence)throw Error('Periodicidad no válida.');
 const fortnightly=cadence==='fortnightly',focused=Boolean(query.country)&&query.country!==otherGeography&&!regions.has(query.country),origin=focused?countryRegion(query.country,geographies):'',has=(row,country)=>articleGeographies(row).includes(country),regionOf=row=>articleGeographies(row).map(country=>regions.has(country)?country:countryRegion(country,geographies)).find(Boolean)||'',outside=row=>articleGeographies(row).some(country=>!own.has(country)),exclusions=[],warnings=[];
 if(focused&&!origin)warnings.push('La geografía no tiene zona configurada.');
 const eligible=[],corpus=[],ids=new Set(),keys=new Set();
 for(const row of items){
  let reason='';const identity=[canonicalUrl_(row.url),recordText(cleanNewsTitle_(row.titular,row.medio))];
  if(!row.id||!plainText_(row.titular).trim()||!canonicalUrl_(row.url)||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(row.fecha)||query.from&&row.fecha<query.from||query.to&&row.fecha>query.to)reason='Evidencia o fecha no válida.';
  else if(query.palanca&&!row.taxonomia.some(tag=>tag.palanca===query.palanca)||query.subpalanca&&!row.taxonomia.some(tag=>taxonomyPath(tag)===query.subpalanca))reason='Fuera del bloque funcional solicitado.';
  else if(!briefingAllowed(row)||!row.etiquetas?.digital||query.segment&&!row.segmentos?.includes(query.segment))reason='Fuera del ámbito empresarial solicitado.';
  else if(query.country===otherGeography&&!outside(row)||regions.has(query.country)&&!articleGeographies(row).some(country=>!own.has(country)&&(regions.has(country)?country:countryRegion(country,geographies))===query.country))reason='Fuera de la zona solicitada.';
  else if(ids.has(row.id)||identity.some(key=>keys.has(key)))reason='Duplicada.';
  if(reason){exclusions.push({id:row.id,reason});continue;}
  ids.add(row.id);identity.forEach(key=>keys.add(key));corpus.push(row);if(newsletterWasSent_(row,known)){exclusions.push({id:row.id,reason:'Contenido ya enviado al destinatario.'});continue;}eligible.push(row);
 }
 const external=eligible.filter(row=>!focused||!has(row,query.country)),bestCompetitor=Math.max(0,...external.filter(row=>row.entidad!=='BBVA').map(newsRelevance_)),exceptional=new Set(external.filter(row=>row.entidad==='BBVA'&&newsRelevance_(row)>=bestCompetitor+NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.exceptionalMargin&&taxonomyPrimarySource_(row)).map(row=>row.id));
 const tier=row=>{
  if(focused&&has(row,query.country))return 0;
  const same=Boolean(origin)&&regionOf(row)===origin;
  return articleGeographies(row).some(country=>own.has(country))?same?1:2:same?3:4;
 };
 const candidates=eligible.map(row=>({row,tier:tier(row),scope:focused&&has(row,query.country)?'local':'global',tag:row.taxonomia.find(tag=>(!query.palanca||tag.palanca===query.palanca)&&(!query.subpalanca||taxonomyPath(tag)===query.subpalanca))||{palanca:'Otros',subpalanca:''},quality:newsRelevance_(row)+(row.extracto?.length>40?1:0)+(row.taxonomia.length?1:0)}));
 const landscapes={local:focused?newsletterLandscape_(corpus.filter(row=>has(row,query.country))):null,global:newsletterLandscape_(corpus.filter(row=>!focused||!has(row,query.country)))},suppressReason=known.incomplete?'Historial de contenido enviado incompleto.':!candidates.length?'Sin evidencia nueva elegible.':'',chosen=[],selectedIds=new Set(),limit=Math.min(NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.cards,settings_().briefingLimit),signals=['Lanzamiento de producto','Alianza estratégica','Mejora de oferta'];
 const rank=(a,b)=>a.tier-b.tier||Number(a.scope==='global'&&a.row.entidad==='BBVA'&&!exceptional.has(a.row.id))-Number(b.scope==='global'&&b.row.entidad==='BBVA'&&!exceptional.has(b.row.id))||Math.floor(b.quality/3)-Math.floor(a.quality/3)||signals.indexOf(a.row.senales[0])-signals.indexOf(b.row.senales[0])||b.quality-a.quality||b.row.fecha.localeCompare(a.row.fecha)||a.row.id.localeCompare(b.row.id);
 if(!suppressReason)for(const scope of focused?['local','global']:['global']){
  const data=landscapes[scope],usedThemes=new Set();if(!data?.total)continue;
  const groups=fortnightly?data.themes:data.leaders;let count=0;
  for(const group of groups){
   if(count>=limit)break;
   const pool=candidates.filter(entry=>entry.scope===scope&&!selectedIds.has(entry.row.id)&&(!fortnightly?entry.row.entidad===group.name:true)).flatMap(entry=>(entry.row.taxonomia.length?entry.row.taxonomia:[entry.tag]).filter(tag=>(!query.palanca||tag.palanca===query.palanca)&&(!query.subpalanca||taxonomyPath(tag)===query.subpalanca)&&(!fortnightly||tag.palanca===group.name)).map(tag=>({...entry,tag})));
   pool.sort((a,b)=>(fortnightly?0:Number(usedThemes.has(a.tag.palanca))-Number(usedThemes.has(b.tag.palanca))||data.themes.findIndex(theme=>theme.name===a.tag.palanca)-data.themes.findIndex(theme=>theme.name===b.tag.palanca))||rank(a,b));
   const entry=pool[0];if(!entry)continue;chosen.push(entry);selectedIds.add(entry.row.id);usedThemes.add(entry.tag.palanca);count++;
  }
 }
 for(const entry of candidates)if(!selectedIds.has(entry.row.id))exclusions.push({id:entry.row.id,reason:'Fuera de la selección ejecutiva por actividad y diversidad.'});
 const cards=chosen.map(({row,tag,scope,tier,quality})=>({id:row.id,type:row.tipo,signals:row.senales.slice(),segments:row.segmentos.slice(),digital:Boolean(row.etiquetas.digital),tags:row.taxonomia.map(tag=>({palanca:tag.palanca,subpalanca:tag.subpalanca})),title:newsletterWords_(row.titular,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.titleWords),fact:newsletterWords_(row.extracto,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.factWords),relevance:newsletterWords_(t(row.senales[0]),NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.relevanceWords),evidenceIds:[row.id],relatedCount:1,additionalCount:0,entityCount:1,countryCount:articleGeographies(row).length,scope,tier,quality,selectionReason:scope==='local'?'Evidencia local elegible.':(!fortnightly?'Ejemplo de una de las entidades con más menciones en prensa.':row.entidad==='BBVA'?(exceptional.has(row.id)?'Evidencia oficial BBVA con relevancia superior a alternativas.':'Evidencia del bloque funcional destacado; ejemplo BBVA.'):'Evidencia competitiva elegible; nivel geográfico '+tier+'.'),countries:articleGeographies(row),subcategory:tag.subpalanca||'',subcategoryPath:taxonomyPath(tag),subcategories:row.taxonomia.filter(item=>item.palanca===tag.palanca).map(item=>item.subpalanca),category:tag.palanca,entity:row.entidad,country:focused&&has(row,query.country)?query.country:row.pais,publisher:row.medio,date:row.fecha,url:canonicalUrl_(row.url)}));
 return {cadence,corpusIds:corpus.map(row=>row.id),heading:t(fortnightly?'Publicaciones de la quincena':'Publicaciones del trimestre'),intro:t('Movimientos verificables en canales digitales para empresas e instituciones.'),cards,reusedCount:0,landscapes,focusLabel:fortnightly?'Trending topic':'Bloque funcional',focused,localCount:corpus.filter(row=>focused&&has(row,query.country)).length,globalCount:corpus.filter(row=>!focused||!has(row,query.country)).length,context:query,scope:config.applicationScope.map(row=>({...row,countries:row.countries.slice()})),geographies:geographies.map(row=>({...row,terms:row.terms?.slice()})),audit:{eligible:corpus.length,unseen:eligible.length,historyVerified:Boolean(known.verified)&&!known.incomplete,selected:cards.length,exclusions,warnings,suppressReason,competitorShare:cards.length?Math.round(cards.filter(card=>card.entity!=='BBVA').length/cards.length*100):0,countries:[...new Set(cards.map(card=>card.country))],blocks:[...new Set(cards.map(card=>card.category))]}};
}

function saveNewsletterFeedback(input){

  if(!['positive','negative',''].includes(input.rating)||typeof input.comment!=='string'||input.comment.length>NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.commentChars)throw Error('Valoración o comentario no válido.');
  return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    const id=sha256_(input.edition+'|'+session.email),sheet=book_().getSheetByName('NewsletterFeedback'),rows=rows_('NewsletterFeedback'),index=rows.findIndex(row=>row.id===id),comment=plainText_(input.comment).trim();
    if(!input.rating&&!comment){if(index>=0)sheet.deleteRow(index+2);return {feedback:null};}
    const feedback={id,edicion:input.edition,correo:session.email,valoracion:input.rating,comentario:comment,fecha:new Date().toISOString(),estado:'pendiente'},values=RADAR.sheets.NewsletterFeedback.map(key=>safeCell_(feedback[key]));
    if(index>=0)sheet.getRange(index+2,1,1,values.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([values]);else append_('NewsletterFeedback',[values]);

  });
}

function recordNewsletterEvents_(events,email){
  const attributed=events.filter(event=>event.edition&&['acceso','vista','lectura','exportacion'].includes(event.event));if(!attributed.length)return;
  const editions=new Map(),known=new Set(rows_('NewsletterEventos',settings_().eventLimit,1).map(row=>row.id)),values=[];
  for(const event of attributed){
    if(!/^[a-z0-9-]{16,80}$/i.test(event.id))throw Error('Evento no válido.');
    if(!editions.has(event.edition))editions.set(event.edition,newsletterEditionMetadata_(event.edition,email));
    if(known.has(event.id))continue;known.add(event.id);
    const edition=editions.get(event.edition),cadence=Object.entries(newsletterCadences).find(([,row])=>row.view===(JSON.parse(edition.filtros).view||'briefing'))[0],destination=event.event==='lectura'?'fuente':event.event==='exportacion'?'exportacion':event.view;
    values.push([event.id,event.edition,email,event.session,event.event,destination,cadence,new Date().toISOString()]);
  }
  append_('NewsletterEventos',values);
}
