function parseFeed_(xml) {
  const channel=XmlService.parse(xml).getRootElement().getChild('channel');
  if(!channel)throw Error('Se requiere RSS 2.0 con channel/item.');
  const items=channel.getChildren('item'),xmlNamespace=XmlService.getXmlNamespace(),contentNamespace=XmlService.getNamespace('http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/'),language=feedLanguage(channel.getChildText('language')||channel.getAttribute('lang',xmlNamespace)?.getValue());
  if(items.length>settings_().maxItems)throw Error('Feed demasiado grande (máximo '+settings_().maxItems+' entradas).');
  return items.map(item=>{const description=item.getChildText('description'),content=item.getChildText('encoded',contentNamespace),articleLanguage=feedLanguage(item.getAttribute('lang',xmlNamespace)?.getValue());return {title:item.getChildText('title'),url:item.getChildText('link'),date:item.getChildText('pubDate'),excerpt:description||content||'',rssContent:content||'',excerptSource:description?'rss:description':content?'rss:content:encoded':'rss:title',source:item.getChild('source')?.getText()||'',sourceUrl:canonicalUrl_(item.getChild('source')?.getAttribute('url')?.getValue()||''),language:articleLanguage||language,articleLanguage};});
}
function newsRecord_(item,feed,now) {
  const geography=item.geography||newsCountryDecision_({titular:item.title,extracto:item.excerpt,url:item.url,sourceUrl:item.sourceUrl,entidad:item.entity||feed.entity,fuente:feed.name,feedUrl:feed.url,rssCountry:feed.country,language:item.language||feed.language||'',articleLanguage:item.articleLanguage||''}),index=businessIndex_();
  const rssCountry=index.countryNames.has(feed.country)?feed.country:rssUrlCountry_(feed.url,index);
  const provenance={fuente:feed.name,feedUrl:feed.url,paisRSS:rssCountry||'',url:item.url,...(item.sourceUrl?{medioUrl:item.sourceUrl}:{}),extracto:item.provenance||'rss:description',geografias:geography.geographies,scope:geography.scope,paisMetodo:geography.reason,paisConfianza:geography.confidence,paisEvidencias:geography.countryEvidence,tipoGeografia:geography.type,...(geography.locale?{locale:geography.locale,origenLocale:geography.localeOrigin}:{}),...newsMediaProvenance_({url:item.url,sourceUrl:feed.domain&&feed.domain!=='news.google.com'?'https://'+feed.domain:item.sourceUrl,medio:item.publisher,rssCountry,feedUrl:feed.url,language:item.language||feed.language},index),versionReglas:geography.version};
  const publisher=configuredPublisher_('https://'+provenance.dominioMedio,index);
  const record={id:Utilities.getUuid(),fecha:Utilities.formatDate(item.date,settings_().timezone,'yyyy-MM-dd'),pais:geography.country,medio:resolvedPublisher_(item.publisher||(feed.kind==='profile'?'':feed.name),publisher),entidad:entityKey_(item.entity||feed.entity),titular:item.title,extracto:item.excerpt,url:item.url,capturada:now.toISOString(),fuente:feed.name,idioma:item.language||feed.language||'',clasificacion:JSON.stringify({...item.labels,procedencia:provenance}),taxonomia:JSON.stringify(taxonomyRecord_(item.title,item.excerpt,undefined,item.labels))};
  return RADAR.sheets.Noticias.map(key=>record[key]);
}
function ingestFeed_(feed,known,cycle,now,response) {
  if(response.getResponseCode()!==200)throw Error('HTTP '+response.getResponseCode());
  const xml=response.getContentText();if(xml.length>settings_().maxFeedBytes)throw Error('Feed excede el tamaño máximo permitido.');
  const items=parseFeed_(xml),news=[],audit=[],candidates=[],date=now.toISOString();let excluded=0,duplicated=0,inside=0,relevant=0,digital=0;const reasons={};
  known.titles=known.titles||new Map();
  for(const raw of items){
    const result=evaluate_(raw,feed,now),item=result.item;
    if(result.inRange)inside++;
    if(result.candidate)candidates.push(candidateRecord_(result.candidate,feed,now,result.reason));
    let state='Excluida',reason=result.reason;
    if(item){
      if(result.relevant)relevant++;
      if(known.has(newsUrlIdentity_(item.url))){state='Duplicada';reason='URL ya recopilada';}
      else if(duplicateTitle_(known,item)){state='Duplicada';reason='Titular sindicado equivalente en fecha próxima';known.add(newsUrlIdentity_(item.url));}
      else{known.add(newsUrlIdentity_(item.url));rememberTitle_(known,item);state='Incluida';reason=feed.kind==='profile'||feed.domain==='news.google.com'?'Noticia integrada desde RSS de Google News':'Noticia integrada desde RSS del editor';const record=newsRecord_(item,feed,now);news.push(record);if(item.labels.digital)digital++;}
    }
    if(state==='Excluida'){excluded++;reasons[reason]=(reasons[reason]||0)+1;}else if(state==='Duplicada')duplicated++;
    if(state==='Incluida')audit.push([cycle,date,feed.name,item?.url||String(raw.url||''),state,reason]);
  }
  audit.push([cycle,date,feed.name,feed.url,'Fuente consultada',items.length+' evaluadas; '+news.length+' nuevas; '+excluded+' excluidas; '+duplicated+' duplicadas; '+relevant+' relevantes; '+inside+' dentro del período; motivos '+JSON.stringify(reasons)+((feed.kind==='profile'||feed.domain==='news.google.com')&&items.length>=COLLECTION_POLICY.providerLimit?'; posible límite del proveedor: cobertura parcial':'')]);
  return {news,audit,candidates,inside,evaluated:items.length,relevant,digital,duplicated,excluded,saturated:(feed.kind==='profile'||feed.domain==='news.google.com')&&items.length>=COLLECTION_POLICY.providerLimit&&inside>=COLLECTION_POLICY.providerLimit*COLLECTION_POLICY.saturationRatio};
}
let knownUrlsMemory_;
function knownUrls_(){
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),revision=newsStorageKey_()+':'+count+':'+(properties_().getProperty('NEWS_CONTENT_REVISION')||'0');
  if(knownUrlsMemory_?.revision===revision)return knownUrlsMemory_.known;
  const known=new Set();known.titles=new Map();
  if(count){const rows=sheet.getRange(2,2,count,5).getDisplayValues(),urls=sheet.getRange(2,8,count,1).getDisplayValues();
    for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){const row=rows[i],url=newsUrlIdentity_(urls[i][0]);if(url)known.add(url);rememberTitle_(known,{date:row[0],country:row[1],publisher:row[2],entity:entityKey_(row[3]),title:row[4]});}
  }
  knownUrlsMemory_={revision,known};return known;
}

function fetchFeedBatch_(feeds){
  const results=feeds.map(()=>({}));let pending=feeds.map((feed,index)=>({feed,index,url:feed.url}));
  for(let hop=0;pending.length;hop++){
    let responses;const requests=pending.map(({url,feed})=>({url,muteHttpExceptions:true,followRedirects:false,headers:{Accept:'application/rss+xml, application/atom+xml, application/xml, text/xml;q=0.9', 'Accept-Language':feed.language||'en'}}));
    try{responses=UrlFetchApp.fetchAll(requests);}
    catch(error){
      const pause=serviceQuotaPause_(error);if(pause){error.quota=true;error.retryable=true;properties_().setProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+pause));for(const item of pending)results[item.index]={error};break;}
      if(pending.length===1){error.retryable=true;results[pending[0].index]={error};break;}
      responses=requests.map((request,index)=>{try{return UrlFetchApp.fetchAll([request])[0];}catch(failure){failure.retryable=true;results[pending[index].index]={error:failure};return null;}});
    }
    const next=[];
    pending.forEach((item,index)=>{
      const response=responses[index];if(!response)return;const status=response.getResponseCode();
      if(![301,302,303,307,308].includes(status)){results[item.index]={response};return;}
      const headers=response.getAllHeaders(),location=Object.entries(headers).find(([key])=>key.toLowerCase()==='location')?.[1];
      const raw=String(Array.isArray(location)?location[0]:location||''),origin=item.url.match(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/)[0];
      const path=item.url.split('?')[0],url=canonicalUrl_(raw.startsWith('//')?'https:'+raw:raw.startsWith('/')?origin+raw:raw.startsWith('?')?path+raw:/^https?:/i.test(raw)?raw:raw&&!/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(raw)?path.slice(0,path.lastIndexOf('/')+1)+raw:'');
      if(hop>=3||!url||!domainMatches_(url,item.feed.domain)){results[item.index]={error:Error('HTTP '+status+': redirección no permitida o demasiados saltos')};return;}
      next.push({...item,url});
    });
    pending=next;
  }
  return results;
}

// Official labels and descriptions come exclusively from the read-only catalogue mirror.
function functionalCatalogRules(catalogue,rules){
 const aliases=new Map(rules.flatMap(block=>block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row])));
 return catalogue.map(block=>{
  const ids=new Set(block.functions.map(row=>row.id)),rule=rules.find(row=>row.name===block.name)||rules.find(row=>row.functions.some(item=>ids.has(item.id)));
  return {...block,terms:rule?.terms||[],emerging:rule?.emerging||[],functions:block.functions.map(row=>{const alias=aliases.get(row.id);return {...row,terms:alias?.terms||[],context:alias?.context||[],exclude:alias?.exclude||[]};})};
 });
}
function functionalRuleSettings(blocks){
 const key=value=>String(value||'').normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase();
 return blocks.map(({name,terms,emerging,functions})=>({name,terms,emerging:emerging.map(functionalConditions),functions:functions.map(({id,name,terms,context,exclude})=>functionalConditions({id,terms:terms.filter(term=>!name||key(term)!==key(name)),context,exclude}))}));
}
function functionalConditions({context,exclude,...row}){return {...row,...(context?.length?{context}:{}),...(exclude?.length?{exclude}:{})};}

function validateTaxonomy_(blocks){
  if(!Array.isArray(blocks)||!blocks.length||blocks.length>60)throw Error('Define los bloques funcionales del catálogo.');
  const names=new Set(),ids=new Set();let count=0;
  for(const block of blocks){
    if(!block||!/^\d{2}\..{1,100}$/.test(block.name)||names.has(block.name)||!Array.isArray(block.functions)||!Array.isArray(block.terms)||!Array.isArray(block.emerging)||block.terms.length>80||block.emerging.length>20||block.terms.some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>100))throw Error('Bloque funcional no válido o duplicado.');
    names.add(block.name);
    const concepts=new Set();for(const concept of block.emerging){if(!concept||typeof concept.name!=='string'||!concept.name.trim()||concept.name.length>100||concepts.has(taxonomyText(concept.name))||!Array.isArray(concept.terms)||!concept.terms.length||concept.terms.length>24||concept.terms.some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>100)||('primary' in concept&&typeof concept.primary!=='boolean'))throw Error('Concepto emergente no válido.');concepts.add(taxonomyText(concept.name));}
    for(const row of [...block.functions,...block.emerging])for(const key of ['context','exclude','primaryTerms'])if(row[key]!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(row[key])||row[key].length>24||row[key].some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>200)))throw Error('Condición funcional no válida.');
    for(const row of block.functions){
      if(!row||!/^\d{2}\.\d{2}$/.test(row.id)||!row.id.startsWith(block.name.slice(0,3))||ids.has(row.id)||typeof row.name!=='string'||!row.name.trim()||row.name.length>200||!Array.isArray(row.terms)||row.terms.length>24||row.terms.some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>200))throw Error('Funcionalidad no válida o duplicada: '+row?.id);
      if(row.description!==undefined&&(typeof row.description!=='string'||row.description.length>10000))throw Error('Descripción funcional no válida.');ids.add(row.id);count++;
    }
  }
  if(count>1000||JSON.stringify(functionalRuleSettings(blocks)).length>40000)throw Error('El catálogo funcional excede los límites de almacenamiento.');
}
function functionalCatalogRows_(sheets){
  const blocks=new Map();
  for(const rows of sheets){
    const header=rows.findIndex(row=>row.includes('Bloque funcional')&&row.includes('Funcionalidad/Sub Operativa'));
    if(header<0)throw Error('No se encuentran las columnas del catálogo funcional.');
    const columns=rows[header],idColumn=columns.indexOf('ID'),blockColumn=columns.indexOf('Bloque funcional'),functionColumn=columns.indexOf('Funcionalidad/Sub Operativa'),descriptionColumn=columns.indexOf('Descripción');
    for(const row of rows.slice(header+1)){
      const id=String(row[idColumn]||'').trim();if(!/^\d{2}\.\d{2}$/.test(id))continue;
      const name=String(row[blockColumn]||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),label=id.slice(0,2)+'.'+name,key=[...blocks.keys()].find(key=>taxonomyText(key)===taxonomyText(label))||label;
      if(!blocks.has(key))blocks.set(key,{name:key,terms:[],emerging:[],functions:[]});
      blocks.get(key).functions.push({id,name:String(row[functionColumn]||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),terms:[],description:descriptionColumn<0?'':String(row[descriptionColumn]||'').trim()});
    }
  }
  const result=[...blocks.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es'));validateTaxonomy_(result);
  if(!result.some(row=>row.name.startsWith('08.'))||!result.some(row=>row.name.startsWith('20.')))throw Error('Catálogo incompleto: faltan Financiación o Venta Digital.');
  return result;
}
let functionalCatalogMemory_;
function functionalCatalog_(){
 const revision=properties_().getProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_REVISION')||'seed';if(functionalCatalogMemory_?.revision===revision)return functionalCatalogMemory_.items;
 const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='functional-catalog:'+revision,cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);let items=cached;
 if(!items){
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('CatalogoFuncional'),blocks=new Map();
  if(revision!=='seed'&&sheet?.getLastRow()>1)for(const [id,name,label,description] of sheet.getRange(2,1,sheet.getLastRow()-1,4).getDisplayValues()){if(!blocks.has(name))blocks.set(name,{name,functions:[]});blocks.get(name).functions.push({id,name:label,description});}
  items=blocks.size?[...blocks.values()]:FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_SEED;writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,items);
 }functionalCatalogMemory_={revision,items};return items;
}
function functionalConfiguration_(config){return {...config,settings:{...CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.settings,...config.settings},storage:{...CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.storage,...config.storage},taxonomy:functionalCatalogRules(functionalCatalog_(),config.taxonomy)};}
function functionalConfigurationSettings_(config){return {...config,taxonomy:functionalRuleSettings(config.taxonomy)};}
function writeFunctionalCatalog_(blocks){
 const descriptions=new Map(FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_SEED.flatMap(block=>block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row])));
 const catalogue=blocks.map(({name,functions})=>({name,functions:functions.map(({id,name,description})=>({id,name,description:description||(descriptions.get(id)?.name===name?descriptions.get(id).description:'')||''}))})),revision=sha256_(JSON.stringify(catalogue)),p=properties_();
 let sheet=book_().getSheetByName('CatalogoFuncional');if(revision===p.getProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_REVISION')&&sheet?.getLastRow()>1)return false;
 if(!sheet){sheet=book_().insertSheet('CatalogoFuncional');sheet.getRange(1,1,1,4).setValues([RADAR.sheets.CatalogoFuncional]);sheet.setFrozenRows(1);}
 const rows=catalogue.flatMap(block=>block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,block.name,row.name,row.description])),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1;
 sheet.getRange(2,1,rows.length,4).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(rows);if(count>rows.length)sheet.getRange(rows.length+2,1,count-rows.length,4).clearContent();
 p.setProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_REVISION',revision);p.setProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_MODIFIED',new Date().toISOString());functionalCatalogMemory_={revision,items:catalogue};invalidateConfiguration_();return true;
}
function refreshFunctionalCatalog_(){
 const config=configuration_();if(!config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl)return {source:'espejo',detail:'Se utiliza el último espejo del catálogo.'};
 const started=Date.now();
 try{
  const id=config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl.match(/\/d\/([\w-]+)/)[1];if(id===properties_().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'))throw Error('El maestro debe ser un documento distinto del libro de News Radar.');
  const book=SpreadsheetApp.openById(id),names=['Soluciones Funcionales','Capacidades canal (core y VD)'];
  const tables=names.map(name=>{const sheet=book.getSheetByName(name);if(!sheet||sheet.getLastRow()>1500)throw Error('Pestaña del catálogo ausente o fuera de límite: '+name);return sheet.getRange(1,1,sheet.getLastRow(),6).getDisplayValues();});
  const changed=writeFunctionalCatalog_(functionalCatalogRows_(tables));
  if(changed){requestNewsClassification_(true);requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}
  properties_().setProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_SYNCED',new Date().toISOString());properties_().deleteProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_ERROR');telemetry_('catalogo_funcional',Date.now()-started,'OK',changed?'Espejo actualizado desde el maestro de Drive':'Sin cambios en el maestro de Drive');return {source:'drive',changed};
 }catch(error){const detail=String(error.message).slice(0,180);properties_().setProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_ERROR',detail);telemetry_('catalogo_funcional',Date.now()-started,'Error',detail);return {source:'espejo',error:detail};}
}

// Upgrade operational aliases and audiences without modifying the official
// catalogue, user activations, sources, geography or administrative settings.
function functionalRuleUpgrade_(config){
 const next=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(config)),seeds=CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS,union=(a,b)=>[...new Set([...a,...b])],byId=new Map(seeds.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row])));
 for(const block of next.taxonomy){
  const seed=seeds.taxonomy.find(row=>row.name===block.name);if(!seed)continue;
  if(block.name.startsWith('09.')||block.name.startsWith('03.'))block.terms=union(block.terms,seed.terms);
  if(block.name.startsWith('18.'))for(const concept of seed.emerging)if(!block.emerging.some(row=>row.name===concept.name))block.emerging.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(concept)));
  for(const row of block.functions)if(row.id.startsWith('09.')||row.id==='17.16'){const rule=byId.get(row.id);if(rule)row.terms=union(row.terms,rule.terms);}
 }
 for(const row of next.capabilities.Empresas)if(['API bancarias','Asistentes digitales'].includes(row.name)){const seed=seeds.capabilities.Empresas.find(item=>item.name===row.name);if(seed)row.terms=union(row.terms,seed.terms);}
 for(const row of next.relevanceRules)if(row.role==='retail')row.terms=union(row.terms,['personal loan','personal loans','consumer loan','consumer loans']);
 validateConfiguration_(next);return next;
}
function getFunctionalRuleUpgrade(){
 authorize_(true);const before=functionalConfigurationSettings_(configuration_()),after=functionalConfigurationSettings_(functionalRuleUpgrade_(configuration_()));
 return {version:RADAR.version,revision:configurationRevision_(),changed:Object.keys(after).filter(key=>JSON.stringify(before[key])!==JSON.stringify(after[key])),upgrade:JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('FUNCTIONAL_RULE_UPGRADE')||'null'),taxonomy:getTaxonomyStatus().job};
}
function reportFunctionalRuleUpgrade(){const status=getFunctionalRuleUpgrade();console.log(JSON.stringify(status));return status;}
function applyFunctionalRuleUpgrade(){
 authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
  const p=properties_(),previous=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('FUNCTIONAL_RULE_UPGRADE')||'null');
  if(previous?.version===RADAR.version&&previous.state==='Staged')return getFunctionalRuleUpgrade();
  if(classificationPending_()||taxonomyPending_()||llmJob_()&&llmJob_().state!=='Completada')throw Error('Espera a que terminen clasificación, taxonomía y publicación LLM antes de actualizar reglas.');
  const config=configuration_(),next=functionalRuleUpgrade_(config),source=book_(),backup=source.copy('News Radar · Reglas '+RADAR.version+' · '+new Date().toISOString());
  fileInFolder_(backup.getId(),archiveFolder_(config.storage.primaryFolderId));
  for(const sheet of source.getSheets()){
   const copy=backup.getSheetByName(sheet.getName()),rows=sheet.getLastRow(),width=sheet.getLastColumn();
   if(!copy||rows!==copy.getLastRow()||width!==copy.getLastColumn()||rows&&width&&sha256_(JSON.stringify(sheet.getRange(1,1,rows,width).getDisplayValues()))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(copy.getRange(1,1,rows,width).getDisplayValues())))throw Error('Backup no verificado: '+sheet.getName());
  }
  const checkpoint={version:RADAR.version,state:'Prepared',backupId:backup.getId(),backupUrl:backup.getUrl(),generation:dataGeneration_(),properties:Object.fromEntries(['CATALOG_VERSION','TAXONOMY_APPLIED_MODEL','TAXONOMY_APPLIED_RULES','TAXONOMY_EVALUATED_CORPUS','CLASSIFICATION_JOB','TAXONOMY_JOB'].map(key=>[key,p.getProperty(key)]))};
  p.setProperty('FUNCTIONAL_RULE_UPGRADE',JSON.stringify(checkpoint));
  try{
   const settings=functionalConfigurationSettings_(next),sheet=source.getSheetByName('Configuracion'),rows=sheet.getRange(2,1,sheet.getLastRow()-1,2).getValues();
   for(const key of ['taxonomy','capabilities','relevanceRules']){const index=rows.findIndex(row=>row[0]===key);if(index<0)throw Error('Falta catálogo '+key);sheet.getRange(index+2,2,1,1).setValues([[JSON.stringify(settings[key])]]);}
   SpreadsheetApp.flush();invalidateConfiguration_();
   if(JSON.stringify(functionalConfigurationSettings_(configuration_()))!==JSON.stringify(settings))throw Error('Configuración escrita incompleta.');
   requestTaxonomy_('functional-rules:'+RADAR.version,false);const job=taxonomyJob_();job.reclassify=true;writeTaxonomyJob_(job);
   p.setProperty('CATALOG_VERSION',CONFIGURATION_CATALOG_VERSION);p.setProperty('FUNCTIONAL_RULE_UPGRADE',JSON.stringify({...checkpoint,state:'Staged',job:job.id}));
   return getFunctionalRuleUpgrade();
  }catch(error){restoreFunctionalRuleUpgrade_();throw error;}
 });
}
function restoreFunctionalRuleUpgrade_(){
 const p=properties_(),checkpoint=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('FUNCTIONAL_RULE_UPGRADE')||'null');if(!checkpoint)throw Error('No hay backup de reglas.');
 const backup=SpreadsheetApp.openById(checkpoint.backupId);
 const generation=checkpoint.generation,restored=new Map(),suffix=Utilities.getUuid();
 for(const name of new Set([generation.newsSheet,generation.taxonomySheet,generation.categorization?.sheet,...Object.values(generation.newsletterTables||{})].filter(Boolean))){
  const saved=backup.getSheetByName(name);if(!saved)throw Error('Falta tabla en el backup: '+name);
  const target=book_().insertSheet(name.split('_')[0]+'_gen_'+suffix);
  const height=saved.getLastRow(),width=saved.getLastColumn(),values=height?saved.getRange(1,1,height,width).getDisplayValues():[];
  if(height)writeVerifiedRows_(target,values.map((values,index)=>({row:index+1,values})));
  if(target.getLastRow()!==height||height&&sha256_(JSON.stringify(values))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(target.getRange(1,1,height,width).getDisplayValues())))throw Error('Restauración no verificada: '+name);
  restored.set(name,target.getName());
 }
 const source=backup.getSheetByName('Configuracion'),target=book_().getSheetByName('Configuracion'),rows=source.getRange(1,1,source.getLastRow(),2).getValues();
 target.getRange(1,1,Math.max(target.getLastRow(),rows.length),2).clearContent();target.getRange(1,1,rows.length,2).setValues(rows);SpreadsheetApp.flush();
 if(sha256_(JSON.stringify(rows))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(target.getRange(1,1,rows.length,2).getValues())))throw Error('Restauración de configuración no verificada.');
 p.setProperty('DATA_GENERATION',JSON.stringify({...generation,newsSheet:restored.get(generation.newsSheet),taxonomySheet:restored.get(generation.taxonomySheet),...(generation.categorization?{categorization:{...generation.categorization,sheet:restored.get(generation.categorization.sheet)}}:{}),...(generation.newsletterTables?{newsletterTables:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(generation.newsletterTables).map(([key,value])=>[key,restored.get(value)]))}:{})}));dataGenerationMemory_=undefined;
 for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(checkpoint.properties)){if(value===null)p.deleteProperty(key);else p.setProperty(key,value);}
 for(const key of ['SNAPSHOT_JOBS','DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD','CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST','TAXONOMY_REQUEST'])p.deleteProperty(key);
 invalidateConfiguration_();p.setProperty('FUNCTIONAL_RULE_UPGRADE',JSON.stringify({...checkpoint,state:'RolledBack'}));
}
function rollbackFunctionalRuleUpgrade(){authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{restoreFunctionalRuleUpgrade_();return getFunctionalRuleUpgrade();});}

// Explicit, bounded editorial pilot. Frozen editions and LLM evidence are never rewritten.
function functionalPilotChange_(row,items=taxonomyCatalog_()){
 if(llmIndex_().has(row.id))return null;
 const title=searchText_(row.titular),text=searchText_(row.titular+' '+row.extracto),focus=functionalPrimary(row.titular),recruitment=recruitmentHeadline_(title);
 if(!focus&&!recruitment)return null;
 const saved=taxonomySaved_(row.taxonomia),byId=taxonomyValidationIndex_(items).byId,previous=byId.get(saved.primary||saved.ids[0])?.palanca||'';
 const assignment=taxonomyRecord_(row.titular,row.extracto,items,savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion)),next=byId.get(assignment.primary)?.palanca||'';
 if(!recruitment&&(previous===next||!next))return null;
 validateTaxonomyAssignment_(assignment,items,row.id,true,row);
 const after={taxonomia:JSON.stringify(assignment)};
 if(recruitment){const labels=newsLabels_(digitalAssessment_(title,text),sha256_(JSON.stringify([title,text])));labels.procedencia=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion).procedencia;after.clasificacion=JSON.stringify(labels);}
 if(Object.entries(after).every(([key,value])=>row[key]===value))return null;
 return {id:row.id,row:row._sheetRow,fingerprint:llmArticle_(row).contentHash,previous,next,evidence:focus?.terms||[row.titular],before:Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(after).map(key=>[key,row[key]])),after};
}
function previewFunctionalPilot(options={}){
 authorize_(true);const sheet=newsSheet_(),offset=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(options.offset)||0)),limit=Math.min(100,Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(options.limit)||100))),total=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),count=Math.max(0,Math.min(limit,total-offset)),items=taxonomyCatalog_();
 const rows=newsRowsAt_(Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>offset+i+2)),changes=rows.map(row=>functionalPilotChange_(row,items)).filter(Boolean),source=newsStorageKey_(),distribution={before:{},after:{}};
 for(const change of changes){distribution.before[change.previous]=(distribution.before[change.previous]||0)+1;distribution.after[change.next]=(distribution.after[change.next]||0)+1;}
 const digest=sha256_(JSON.stringify([RADAR.version,source,configurationRevision_(),llmRevision_(),rows,changes]));
 return {dryRun:true,version:RADAR.version,source,offset,count,total,next:offset+count,digest,changes,distribution};
}
function applyFunctionalPilot(options){
 authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
  const key='ARCHIVE_SHEET:functional-pilot:'+String(options?.digest||''),checkpoint=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty(key)||'null');
  if(checkpoint?.applied)return {applied:checkpoint.count,archive:checkpoint.id,idempotent:true};
  if(classificationPending_()||taxonomyPending_()||snapshotJobsPending_())throw Error('Espera a que terminen clasificación, taxonomía y publicación LLM antes de actualizar reglas.');
  if(checkpoint?.verified){const changes=functionalPilotArchive_(checkpoint);writeFunctionalPilot_(changes,false);properties_().setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...checkpoint,applied:true}));return {applied:changes.length,archive:checkpoint.id};}
  const preview=previewFunctionalPilot(options);if(preview.digest!==options?.digest)throw Error('El origen del archivo ha cambiado. Revisa el checkpoint '+key+'.');
  if(!preview.changes.length)return {applied:0};
  const records=preview.changes.map(change=>[change.id,JSON.stringify(change)]),archive=archiveSpreadsheet_('PilotoFuncional',['id','cambio'],records,configuration_().storage.primaryFolderId,'functional-pilot:'+preview.digest);
  properties_().setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty(key)),source:preview.source}));
  writeFunctionalPilot_(preview.changes,false);properties_().setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty(key)),applied:true}));
  telemetry_('piloto-funcional',0,'OK',preview.changes.length+'; archivo '+archive.id);return {applied:preview.changes.length,archive:archive.id};
 });
}
function restoreFunctionalPilot(options){
 authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
  const key='ARCHIVE_SHEET:functional-pilot:'+String(options?.digest||''),checkpoint=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty(key)||'null');
  const changes=functionalPilotArchive_(checkpoint);
  writeFunctionalPilot_(changes,true);properties_().setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...checkpoint,applied:false,restored:true}));return {restored:changes.length,archive:checkpoint.id};
 });
}
function functionalPilotArchive_(checkpoint){
 if(!checkpoint?.verified||checkpoint.source!==newsStorageKey_())throw Error('El origen del piloto funcional ha cambiado.');
 const raw=archivePayload_(checkpoint.id);if(sha256_(raw)!==checkpoint.digest)throw Error('Archivo del piloto funcional no verificado.');
 const payload=JSON.parse(raw);if(payload.table!=='PilotoFuncional')throw Error('Formato de archivo no válido.');
 return payload.rows.map(([id,value])=>{const change=JSON.parse(value);if(change.id!==id)throw Error('Formato de archivo no válido.');return change;});
}
function writeFunctionalPilot_(changes,restore){
 const rows=newsRowsForCandidates_(changes),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias,updates=[];
 // Validate the entire batch before the first write; retries accept only before or after values.
 for(const change of changes){const row=rows.get(change.id);if(!row?._sheetRow||llmArticle_(row).contentHash!==change.fingerprint||llmIndex_().has(change.id))throw Error('El origen del archivo ha cambiado. Revisa el checkpoint '+change.id+'.');
  for(const key of Object.keys(change.after)){if(row[key]!==change.before[key]&&row[key]!==change.after[key])throw Error('El origen del archivo ha cambiado. Revisa el checkpoint '+change.id+'.');updates.push({row:row._sheetRow,column:keys.indexOf(key)+1,value:(restore?change.before:change.after)[key]});}
 }
 writeNewsCells_(updates);SpreadsheetApp.flush();
 const verified=newsRowsForCandidates_(changes);for(const change of changes)for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(restore?change.before:change.after))if(verified.get(change.id)?.[key]!==value)throw Error('Configuración escrita incompleta.');
 invalidateNews_();requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);ensureBackgroundWorker_();
}

function configurationStorageKey_(name){return name==='Noticias'?newsStorageKey_():name==='Taxonomia'?taxonomyStorageKey_():NEWSLETTER_ARCHIVE_TABLES.includes(name)?newsletterStorageKey_(name):name;}
function generationSheet_(name,headers){let sheet=book_().getSheetByName(name);if(!sheet)sheet=book_().insertSheet(name);if(sheet.getLastRow()===0)sheet.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).setValues([headers]);return sheet;}

function writeVerifiedRows_(sheet,records){
  if(!records.length)return;
  const ordered=records.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.row-b.row),width=ordered[0].values.length,needed=ordered.at(-1).row;
  if(needed>sheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),needed-sheet.getMaxRows());
  const writes=[];
  for(let start=0;start<ordered.length;){
    let end=start+1;while(end<ordered.length&&ordered[end].row-ordered[end-1].row<=64&&ordered[end].row-ordered[start].row<250)end++;
    const first=ordered[start].row,size=ordered[end-1].row-first+1,rows=size===end-start?ordered.slice(start,end).map(record=>record.values):sheet.getRange(first,1,size,width).getDisplayValues();
    if(size!==end-start)for(const record of ordered.slice(start,end))rows[record.row-first]=record.values;
    sheet.getRange(first,1,size,width).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(rows);writes.push({first,rows});start=end;
  }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  for(const {first,rows} of writes)if(sha256_(JSON.stringify(rows))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(sheet.getRange(first,1,rows.length,width).getDisplayValues())))throw Error('La verificación del backup o de la generación ha fallado.');
}

function pruneNewsGenerations_(){
 const generation=dataGeneration_(),active=new Set([generation.newsSheet,generation.taxonomySheet,generation.categorization?.sheet,...Object.values(generation.newsletterTables||{})].filter(Boolean));
 const rollback=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('DATA_GENERATION_ROLLBACK')||'{}');
 for(const value of [rollback.newsSheet,rollback.taxonomySheet,rollback.categorization?.sheet,...Object.values(rollback.newsletterTables||{})])if(value)active.add(value);
 const compaction=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_COMPACTION_JOB')||'null');if(compaction&&compaction.state!=='Completada')for(const value of [compaction.editions,compaction.content,compaction.source?.editions,compaction.source?.content])if(value)active.add(value);
 const taxonomy=taxonomyJob_();clearTaxonomyCheckpoints_(['scan','publish'].includes(taxonomy?.phase)?taxonomy.checkpoint:null);
 for(const key of ['TAXONOMY_JOB','CLASSIFICATION_JOB','LLM_JOB','MAINTENANCE_JOB','EXCERPT_RECOVERY_JOB']){
  const job=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty(key)||'null');if(!job||job.state==='Completada')continue;
  for(const value of [job.source,job.target,job.sheet,job.generation?.source,job.generation?.newsSheet,job.generation?.taxonomySheet,job.categorization?.sheet])if(value)active.add(value);
 }
 const removed=[];for(const sheet of book_().getSheets()){const name=sheet.getName();if(/^(?:Noticias|Taxonomia|NewsletterContenido|NewsletterEdiciones|CategorizacionLLM)_(?:tax|class|gen|maintenance|llm)_[-a-zA-Z0-9]+$/.test(name)&&!active.has(name)){book_().deleteSheet(sheet);removed.push(name);}}return removed;
}

function compactStorageDimensions_(){
  for(const sheet of book_().getSheets()){
    const name=sheet.getName(),schema=Object.keys(RADAR.sheets).find(key=>name===key||name.startsWith(key+'_'));if(!schema)continue;
    const rows=Math.max(1,sheet.getLastRow())+100,columns=Math.max(RADAR.sheets[schema]?.length||4,sheet.getLastColumn());
    if(sheet.getMaxRows()>rows)sheet.deleteRows(rows+1,sheet.getMaxRows()-rows);
    if(sheet.getMaxColumns()>columns)sheet.deleteColumns(columns+1,sheet.getMaxColumns()-columns);
  }
}

 const source=newsSheet_(),target=book_().getSheetByName(news)||source.copyTo(book_()).setName(news);
 const width=RADAR.sheets.Noticias.length,sourceDigest=sha256_(JSON.stringify(source.getRange(1,1,source.getLastRow(),width).getDisplayValues()));
 if(sourceDigest!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(target.getRange(1,1,target.getLastRow(),width).getDisplayValues())))throw Error('Copia de noticias incompleta.');
 generationSheet_(taxonomy,RADAR.sheets.Taxonomia);
 job.generation={newsSheet:news,taxonomySheet:taxonomy,sourceDigest,source:newsStorageKey_()};

}
function withTaxonomyGeneration_(job,operation){
 const previousNews=newsSheetOverride_,previousTaxonomy=taxonomySheetOverride_;
 try{if(job?.generation){newsSheetOverride_=job.generation.newsSheet;taxonomySheetOverride_=job.generation.taxonomySheet;}return operation();}
 finally{newsSheetOverride_=previousNews;taxonomySheetOverride_=previousTaxonomy;}
}

const GEOGRAPHY_CATALOG_SEEDS=Object.freeze({CatalogoMedios:typeof MEDIA_CATALOG_SEED==='undefined'?[]:MEDIA_CATALOG_SEED,ReglasIdiomaGeografia:typeof LOCALE_GEOGRAPHY_SEED==='undefined'?[]:LOCALE_GEOGRAPHY_SEED});
function mediaCatalogKey_(row){return String(row.domain||'').toLowerCase()+'|'+(row.seedId||row.editionPattern||'');}
function geographyCatalogKey_(name,row){return name==='CatalogoMedios'?mediaCatalogKey_(row):String(row.name||'').toLowerCase();}
const geographyCatalogMemory_=new Map();
function geographyCatalog_(name){
 const revision=typeof PropertiesService==='undefined'?'0':properties_().getProperty('CONFIG_REVISION')||'0',cached=geographyCatalogMemory_.get(name);if(cached?.revision===revision)return cached.rows;
 const sheet=typeof SpreadsheetApp!=='undefined'&&typeof SpreadsheetApp.openById==='function'?book_().getSheetByName(name):null,count=sheet?.getLastRow()-1||0,rows=!sheet?GEOGRAPHY_CATALOG_SEEDS[name].map(row=>({...row})):count?sheet.getRange(2,2,count,1).getValues().flat().filter(Boolean).map(value=>JSON.parse(value)):[];
 geographyCatalogMemory_.set(name,{revision,rows});return rows;
}
function validateGeographyCatalog_(name,rows){
 if(!Array.isArray(rows)||rows.length>600)throw Error('Catálogo geográfico demasiado grande.');
 const keys=new Set();for(const row of rows){
  const key=geographyCatalogKey_(name,row);if(!key||keys.has(key)||typeof row.enabled!=='boolean'||!row.name)throw Error('Entrada de catálogo duplicada o incompleta: '+key);
  if(name==='CatalogoMedios'&&(!/^[a-z0-9-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$/.test(row.domain)||!['PENDIENTE','VERIFICADO','RECHAZADO'].includes(row.status)||row.enabled&&row.status!=='VERIFICADO'))throw Error('Medio: dominio o verificación no válidos: '+row.name);
  if(name==='ReglasIdiomaGeografia'&&(!/^[a-z]{2}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})?$/.test(row.name)||!['PAIS','REGION'].includes(row.type)||!Number.isFinite(Number(row.precedence))||!['low','medium','high'].includes(row.confidence)))throw Error('Regla de idioma no válida: '+row.name);
  keys.add(key);
 }
}
function writeGeographyCatalog_(name,rows){
 validateGeographyCatalog_(name,rows);const sheet=book_().getSheetByName(name),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1;
 if(count)sheet.getRange(2,1,count,2).clearContent();
 if(rows.length)sheet.getRange(2,1,rows.length,2).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(rows.map(row=>[geographyCatalogKey_(name,row),JSON.stringify(row)]));
 geographyCatalogMemory_.delete(name);
}
function initializeGeographyCatalogs_(){for(const [name,seed] of Object.entries(GEOGRAPHY_CATALOG_SEEDS))if(book_().getSheetByName(name).getLastRow()<2)writeGeographyCatalog_(name,seed);}
function verifiedEditorialCatalogUpgrade_(dryRun=true){
 authorize_(true);
 const operation=()=>{
 const name='CatalogoMedios',current=geographyCatalog_(name).map(row=>({...row})),byKey=new Map(current.map((row,index)=>[mediaCatalogKey_(row),index])),changes=[];
 for(const seed of GEOGRAPHY_CATALOG_SEEDS[name].filter(row=>row.seedId?.startsWith('v7_')||['seed_981653c20afac89d','seed_b417a7b9c3da37ba','seed_73f57709fc0a7aec','seed_30ed4dada5f27a4d'].includes(row.seedId))){
  const key=mediaCatalogKey_(seed),index=byKey.get(key);
  if(index===undefined){
   if(!seed.editionPattern&&current.some(row=>row.domain===seed.domain&&row.ruleType===seed.ruleType&&row.status==='VERIFICADO'&&row.enabled===true&&!(row.editionPattern||'')))continue;
   const observed=current.findIndex(row=>row.domain===seed.domain&&row.ruleType==='DOMINIO_OBSERVADO'&&row.status==='PENDIENTE'&&row.enabled===false);
   if(observed>=0&&!seed.editionPattern){const before=current[observed],after={...before,...seed,seedId:before.seedId||'',source:'Iteración 43 · edición verificada'};changes.push({type:'verify',key:mediaCatalogKey_(before),before,after});current[observed]=after;}
   else {changes.push({type:'add',key,after:seed});byKey.set(key,current.length);current.push({...seed});}
  }else{
   const before=current[index];
   if(before.ruleType==='DOMINIO_GENERICO'&&before.source==='Iteración 29'&&before.status==='VERIFICADO'&&before.enabled===true){
    const after={...before,ruleType:seed.ruleType,editionCountry:seed.editionCountry,editionPattern:seed.editionPattern,source:'Iteración 43 · edición verificada'};
    changes.push({type:'correct',key,before,after});current[index]=after;
   }
  }
 }
 validateGeographyCatalog_(name,current);
 if(!dryRun&&changes.length){writeGeographyCatalog_(name,current);invalidateConfiguration_();}
 return {dryRun,changes:changes.map(({type,key,before,after})=>({type,key,before:before?{ruleType:before.ruleType,status:before.status,enabled:before.enabled}:null,after:{ruleType:after.ruleType,status:after.status,enabled:after.enabled}})),count:changes.length};
 };
 return dryRun?operation():withForegroundWrite_(operation);
}
function registerUnknownMedia_(news){
 if(!news.length)return 0;const name='CatalogoMedios',catalog=geographyCatalog_(name),known=new Set(catalog.map(row=>row.domain)),pending=[];
 for(const values of news){if(catalog.length+pending.length>=600)break;const row=Object.fromEntries(RADAR.sheets.Noticias.map((key,index)=>[key,values[index]])),domain=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion).procedencia?.dominioMedio||'';
  if(!domain||known.has(domain)||domain==='news.google.com')continue;known.add(domain);
  const candidate={name:row.medio||domain,domain,country:'',iso2:'',status:'PENDIENTE',enabled:false,ruleType:'DOMINIO_OBSERVADO',editionCountry:'',editionPattern:'',historical:0,sourceUrl:'https://'+domain,notes:'Detectado automáticamente en source.url; sin verificación editorial.',source:'RSS',updated:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)};
  pending.push([geographyCatalogKey_(name,candidate),JSON.stringify(candidate)]);
 }
 if(pending.length){append_(name,pending);geographyCatalogMemory_.delete(name);}return pending.length;
}

function auditGeographyMigration(options={}){
 authorize_(true);const sheet=newsSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias,total=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),offset=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(options.offset)||0)),limit=Math.min(200,Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(options.limit)||100))),count=Math.min(limit,total-offset),byMethod={},samples=[];let changed=0,multicountry=0,missing=0;
 if(count>0)for(const values of sheet.getRange(offset+2,1,count,keys.length).getDisplayValues()){
  const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,index)=>[key,values[index]])),decision=newsCountryDecision_(row);byMethod[decision.reason]=(byMethod[decision.reason]||0)+1;if(decision.country!==row.pais)changed++;if(decision.geographies.length>1)multicountry++;if(!decision.country)missing++;
  if(samples.length<12&&(decision.country!==row.pais||decision.geographies.length>1||decision.reason==='apac_fallback'))samples.push({id:row.id,title:row.titular,previous:row.pais,next:decision.country,geographies:decision.geographies,method:decision.reason});
 }
 return {dryRun:true,offset,count,total,next:offset+count,changed,multicountry,missing,byMethod,samples};
}
function applyGeographyMigration(){
 authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
  const previous=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('GEOGRAPHY_MIGRATION')||'null');if(previous?.version===RADAR.version)return previous;
  const source=book_(),backup=source.copy('News Radar · Geografías '+RADAR.version+' · '+new Date().toISOString()),newsName=newsStorageKey_();
  for(const name of ['Configuracion',newsName]){const active=source.getSheetByName(name),copy=backup.getSheetByName(name),height=active.getLastRow(),width=active.getLastColumn();if(!copy||copy.getLastRow()!==height||copy.getLastColumn()!==width||sha256_(JSON.stringify(active.getRange(1,1,height,width).getDisplayValues()))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(copy.getRange(1,1,height,width).getDisplayValues())))throw Error('Backup no verificado: '+name);}
  const state={version:RADAR.version,backupId:backup.getId(),backupUrl:backup.getUrl(),rows:Math.max(0,source.getSheetByName(newsName).getLastRow()-1),created:new Date().toISOString()};properties_().setProperty('GEOGRAPHY_MIGRATION',JSON.stringify(state));return state;
 });
}
function getGeographyMigrationStatus(){authorize_(true);const state=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('GEOGRAPHY_MIGRATION')||'null'),job=classificationJob_();return {...state,classification:job?{state:job.state,processed:classificationProcessed_(job),total:job.total,error:job.error||''}:null};}
function reportGeographyMigration(){
 const status=getGeographyMigrationStatus(),result={total:0,changed:0,multicountry:0,missing:0,byMethod:{},samples:[]};let offset=0;
 do{const batch=auditGeographyMigration({offset,limit:200});result.total=batch.total;for(const key of ['changed','multicountry','missing'])result[key]+=batch[key];for(const [method,count] of Object.entries(batch.byMethod))result.byMethod[method]=(result.byMethod[method]||0)+count;result.samples.push(...batch.samples);offset=batch.next;}while(offset<result.total);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({status,...result}));return result;
}
function continueGeographyMigration(){
 authorize_(true);const status=getGeographyMigrationStatus();if(status.version!==RADAR.version||!status.backupId)throw Error('Primero crea una copia verificada con applyGeographyMigration.');
 const result=processBackground_();console.log(JSON.stringify(getGeographyMigrationStatus()));return result;
}

let newsletterKeyMemory_;
function newsletterItemKeys_(row){
  if(!newsletterKeyMemory_)newsletterKeyMemory_=new WeakMap();if(newsletterKeyMemory_.has(row))return newsletterKeyMemory_.get(row);
  const url=canonicalUrl_(row.url),keys=[...(row.id?['id:'+sha256_(row.id)]:[]),...(url?['url:'+sha256_(url)]:[]),'text:'+sha256_(recordText(row.titular)+'\n'+recordText(row.extracto))];
  newsletterKeyMemory_.set(row,keys);return keys;
}
function newsletterSentContent_(deliveries){
  const recipients=new Map(),editions=new Map(rows_('NewsletterEdiciones',undefined,12).map(row=>[row.envio,row]));
  for(const delivery of deliveries){
    if(String(delivery.id||'').startsWith('prueba:')||!delivery.suscripcion||!['Enviada','Enviando','Revisar'].includes(delivery.estado))continue;
    const email=newsletterEmail_(delivery.correo),keys=JSON.parse(delivery.contenido||'[]');
    if(!Array.isArray(keys)||keys.some(key=>!/^(id|url|text):[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(key)))throw Error('Registro de contenido no válido. Revisa el envío '+delivery.id+' antes de continuar.');
    if(!recipients.has(email)){const set=new Set();set.verified=true;recipients.set(email,set);}for(const key of keys)recipients.get(email).add(key);const edition=editions.get(delivery.id),cards=JSON.parse(edition?.editorial||'null')?.cards;if(cards){for(const card of cards)recipients.get(email).add('id:'+sha256_(card.id));}else if(!keys.some(key=>key.startsWith('id:')))recipients.get(email).incomplete=true;
  }
  return recipients;
}
function newsletterWasSent_(row,known){return known.size>0&&newsletterItemKeys_(row).some(key=>known.has(key));}
function newsletterUnseen_(rows,known){
  const seen=new Set();
  return rows.filter(row=>{const keys=newsletterItemKeys_(row);if(keys.some(key=>known.has(key)||seen.has(key)))return false;for(const key of keys)seen.add(key);return true;});
}

function newsletterContentDetail_(content){return content.count+' noticias incluidas'+(content.editorial?.audit?.suppressReason?'; '+content.editorial.audit.suppressReason:'')+(content.omitted?'; '+content.omitted+' noticias repetidas omitidas':'')+(content.editorial?.reusedCount?'; '+content.editorial.reusedCount+' ejemplos reutilizados en su tema':'');}

function collectionRequests_(){
  return Object.entries(properties_().getProperties()).filter(([key])=>key.startsWith('COLLECTION_REQUEST:')).map(([key,value])=>({key,value,...JSON.parse(value)}));
}
function requestCollection_(kind,range){
  const id=kind==='daily'?'daily/'+range.to+'/'+Utilities.getUuid():Utilities.getUuid(),request={id,kind,range,created:new Date().toISOString()};
  properties_().setProperty('COLLECTION_REQUEST:'+sha256_(kind+'|'+range.from+'|'+range.to),JSON.stringify(request));
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');ensureBackgroundWorker_();return id;
}
function collectionJobs_(){return rows_('Recargas').map((job,index)=>({...job,row:index+2}));}
function writeCollectionJob_(job){
  book_().getSheetByName('Recargas').getRange(job.row,1,1,RADAR.sheets.Recargas.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([RADAR.sheets.Recargas.map(key=>safeCell_(job[key]??''))]);
}
function jobRange_(job){return {from:job.desde,to:job.hasta};}
function drainCollectionRequests_(){
  const requests=collectionRequests_().sort((a,b)=>(b.kind==='daily')-(a.kind==='daily'));if(!requests.length)return;
  const jobs=collectionJobs_(),tasks=rows_('Recopilacion');
  const finished=new Set(jobs.filter(job=>['Completada','Parcial'].includes(job.estado)).map(job=>job.id));
  const existing=new Set(tasks.filter(task=>!finished.has(task.ciclo)||task.estado==='Error').map(task=>task.ciclo+'|'+task.url));
  for(const request of requests){
    let job=jobs.find(job=>job.id===request.id)||jobs.find(job=>(Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando')&&job.tipo===request.kind&&(job.desde===request.range.from&&job.hasta===request.range.to));
    if(!job){
      job={id:request.id,tipo:request.kind,desde:request.range.from,hasta:request.range.to,inicio:request.created,estado:'Preparando',total:0,procesadas:0,pendientes:0,omitidas:0,fallidas:0,nuevas:0,actualizada:'',pausa:'',fin:'',row:book_().getSheetByName('Recargas').getLastRow()+1};
      append_('Recargas',[RADAR.sheets.Recargas.map(key=>job[key])]);jobs.push(job);SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    if(job.estado==='Preparando'){
      const feeds=collectionFeeds_(jobRange_(job)),missing=feeds.filter(feed=>{const key=job.id+'|'+feed.url;if(existing.has(key))return false;existing.add(key);return true;});
      append_('Recopilacion',missing.map(feed=>[job.id,feed.name,feed.url,'Pendiente',0,'',0,0,'',feed.range.to]));
      Object.assign(job,{estado:feeds.length?'Pendiente':'Completada',total:feeds.length,pendientes:feeds.length,fin:feeds.length?'':new Date().toISOString()});writeCollectionJob_(job);SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    if(properties_().getProperty(request.key)===request.value)properties_().deleteProperty(request.key);
  }
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');
}
function collectionSnapshots_(tasks,jobs,now=new Date()){
  const summaries=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('COLLECTION_TASK_SUMMARIES')||'{}'),counters=new Map();
  for(const task of tasks){
    let count=counters.get(task.ciclo);if(!count){count={total:0,procesadas:0,pendientes:0,omitidas:0,fallidas:0,nuevas:0,actualizada:'',...summaries[task.ciclo]};counters.set(task.ciclo,count);}
    count.total++;count.nuevas+=Number(task.nuevas||0);
    if(task.estado==='Completada')count.procesadas++;
    if(['Pendiente','Reintento programado'].includes(task.estado))count.pendientes++;
    if(task.estado==='Omitida')count.omitidas++;
    if(task.estado==='Error')count.fallidas++;
    if(task.actualizada>count.actualizada)count.actualizada=task.actualizada;
  }
  for(const job of jobs){
    const count=counters.get(job.id);if(!count||['Cancelada','Revisar'].includes(job.estado))continue;
    Object.assign(job,count,{estado:count.pendientes?(Number(job.pausa)>now.getTime()?'En pausa':'Pendiente'):count.fallidas?'Parcial':'Completada',fin:count.pendientes?'':job.fin||now.toISOString()});
    if(!count.pendientes&&dashboardSnapshotsPending_()){job.estado='Publicando';job.fin='';requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}
  }
  return jobs;
}

function compactCollectionTasks_(){
 const jobs=collectionJobs_().filter(job=>['Completada','Parcial'].includes(job.estado)),finished=new Set(jobs.map(job=>job.id)),p=properties_(),summaries=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('COLLECTION_TASK_SUMMARIES')||'{}'),tasks=rows_('Recopilacion'),seen=new Set(),remove=[],counts=new Map();
 for(const [index,task] of tasks.entries()){
  const count=counts.get(task.ciclo)||{total:0,procesadas:0,omitidas:0,nuevas:0};count.total++;if(task.estado==='Completada')count.procesadas++;if(task.estado==='Omitida')count.omitidas++;count.nuevas+=Number(task.nuevas||0);counts.set(task.ciclo,count);
  if(!finished.has(task.ciclo)||!['Completada','Omitida'].includes(task.estado))continue;
  const key=JSON.stringify(RADAR.sheets.Recopilacion.map(key=>task[key]));if(seen.has(key))remove.push(index+2);else seen.add(key);
 }
 // Persist the authoritative counters before deletion; a retry can reconstruct summaries after a partial delete.
 const totals=jobs.map(job=>({...job}));
 if(remove.length){
  for(const job of totals){const summary=summaries[job.id]||{},count=counts.get(job.id)||{};for(const key of ['total','procesadas','omitidas','nuevas'])job[key]=Math.max(Number(job[key]||0),Number(summary[key]||0)+Number(count[key]||0));writeCollectionJob_(job);}
 }
 try{if(remove.length)deleteSheetRows_(book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion'),remove);}
 finally{
  const retained=new Map();for(const task of remove.length?rows_('Recopilacion'):tasks){const count=retained.get(task.ciclo)||{total:0,procesadas:0,omitidas:0,nuevas:0};count.total++;if(task.estado==='Completada')count.procesadas++;if(task.estado==='Omitida')count.omitidas++;count.nuevas+=Number(task.nuevas||0);retained.set(task.ciclo,count);}
  for(const job of totals){const count=retained.get(job.id)||{total:0,procesadas:0,omitidas:0,nuevas:0},summary={actualizada:job.actualizada||''};for(const key of ['total','procesadas','omitidas','nuevas'])summary[key]=Math.max(0,Number(job[key]||0)-count[key]);if(summary.total)summaries[job.id]=summary;}
  const encoded=JSON.stringify(summaries);if(encoded!==p.getProperty('COLLECTION_TASK_SUMMARIES'))p.setProperty('COLLECTION_TASK_SUMMARIES',encoded);
  if(remove.length)CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');
 }
 return remove.length;
}

function newsletterCoverageOrder_(a,b){return b.count-a.count||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es');}
function newsletterComparisonRows_(items,editorial,scope){if(scope!=='international')throw Error('Ámbito no disponible.');return items.filter(row=>!editorial.context.country||!articleGeographies(row).includes(editorial.context.country));}
function newsletterLandscape_(items){
  const entities=new Map(),themes=new Map(),countries=new Set(),bbva={count:0};let unknownCountryCount=0;
  for(const row of items){
    if(row.entidad==='BBVA')bbva.count++;
    for(const country of articleGeographies(row))if(country&&country!=='Sin determinar')countries.add(country);else unknownCountryCount++;
    if(!entities.has(row.entidad))entities.set(row.entidad,{name:row.entidad,count:0,themes:new Map()});
    const entity=entities.get(row.entidad);entity.count++;
    const labels=new Set(row.taxonomia.map(tag=>tag.palanca));if(!labels.size)labels.add('Otros');
    for(const name of labels){
      entity.themes.set(name,(entity.themes.get(name)||0)+1);
      if(!themes.has(name))themes.set(name,{name,count:0});
      const theme=themes.get(name);theme.count++;
    }
  }
  const rank=newsletterCoverageOrder_,share=count=>items.length?Math.round(count/items.length*100):0;
  const rankedThemes=[...themes.values()].sort(rank).map(theme=>({name:theme.name,count:theme.count,share:share(theme.count)}));
  const leaders=[...entities.values()].sort(rank).slice(0,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.cards).map((entity,index,top)=>({position:top.findIndex(row=>row.count===entity.count)+1,name:entity.name,count:entity.count,share:share(entity.count),themes:[...entity.themes].map(([name,count])=>({name,count})).sort(rank)}));
  return {total:items.length,entityCount:entities.size,countryCount:countries.size,unknownCountryCount,bbvaCount:bbva.count,themes:rankedThemes,leaders};
}
function newsletterMetricsHtml_(metrics,label){
 return '<table role="presentation" class="newsletter-metrics"><tr>'+metrics.map(([name,count])=>'<td class="newsletter-metric"><strong class="newsletter-metric-value">'+count+'</strong><span class="newsletter-metric-label">'+label(name)+'</span></td>').join('')+'</tr></table>';
}
function newsletterExecutiveReport_(editorial,query,language,t,escape,links,images,renderCard){
 const label=value=>escape(t(value)),scopes={},after={},texts=[],quarterly=editorial.cadence==='quarterly';
 for(const [scope,data] of Object.entries(editorial.landscapes)){
  if(!data?.total)continue;const local=scope==='local',country=local?query.country:'',heading=country||'Mirada global',theme=data.themes[0];
  const link=(text,entity='',palanca='')=>links.app.includes('edition=')&&!/^(?:\d+[.\s]*)?Otros$/i.test(palanca)?'<a href="'+escape(newsletterExploreLink_(links.app,'news',country,entity,palanca,'',!local&&query.country?'international':''))+'">'+escape(text)+newsletterLinkIconHtml_(images)+'</a>':escape(text);
  const metrics=newsletterMetricsHtml_([['Entidades',data.entityCount],['Menciones totales en prensa',data.total],['Menciones directas a BBVA',data.bbvaCount]],label);
  const lead=theme?formatText(local?'{theme} fue el bloque funcional, en {country}, con más menciones en prensa: {count}, el {share}% de las publicaciones analizadas.':'{theme} fue el bloque funcional, dentro de la mirada internacional, con más menciones en prensa: {count}, el {share}% de las publicaciones analizadas.',{theme:taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(theme.name)),country:t(country),count:theme.count,share:theme.share},language):t('La selección no tiene noticias clasificadas por bloque funcional.');
  const highlight='<table role="presentation" class="newsletter-highlight"><tr><td class="newsletter-highlight-cell"><p class="newsletter-executive">'+escape(lead)+'</p></td></tr></table>';
  const leaders=quarterly?data.leaders.map(row=>{
   const example=editorial.cards.find(card=>card.scope===scope&&card.entity===row.name);
   const themes='<ul class="newsletter-theme-list">'+row.themes.map(theme=>'<li class="newsletter-entity-theme"><strong>'+link(taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(theme.name)),row.name,theme.name)+'</strong> ('+escape(formatText(theme.count===1?'{count} publicación':'{count} publicaciones',{count:theme.count},language))+')</li>').join('')+'</ul>';
   return '<tr><td class="newsletter-leader"><table role="presentation" class="newsletter-entity"><tr><td class="newsletter-entity-cell"><h3 class="newsletter-bank newsletter-entity-name">'+identityMark('entities',row.name,escape,images)+' '+link(row.name,row.name)+'</h3>'+newsletterMetricsHtml_([['Menciones en prensa',row.count],[formatText('Menciones de {entity} sobre el total de publicaciones del periodo',{entity:row.name},language),row.share+'%']],label)+'<p class="newsletter-lever-label">'+label('Bloques funcionales mencionados en prensa:')+'</p>'+themes+(example?renderCard(example,{compact:true}):'')+'</td></tr></table></td></tr>';
  }).join(''):'';
  scopes[scope]='<table role="presentation" class="newsletter-report"><tr><td class="newsletter-report-cell"><p class="newsletter-lever-label">'+label(quarterly?'EL TRIMESTRE EN CIFRAS':'LA QUINCENA EN CIFRAS')+'</p>'+metrics+(quarterly?'<h3>'+label('Quién ocupó la conversación')+'</h3><table role="presentation" class="newsletter-leaders">'+leaders+'</table><p class="newsletter-meta">'+label('Menciones y porcentaje de las publicaciones. Los temas de una entidad pueden solaparse.')+'</p>'+highlight:'')+'</td></tr></table>';
  after[scope]=quarterly?'':highlight;
  texts.push(t(heading),lead,...data.leaders.map(row=>row.name+': '+row.count));
 }
 const note=t('Presencia en las fuentes y filtros de esta edición; no mide cuota de mercado. Una noticia puede pertenecer a varios bloques funcionales.');
 return {scopes,after,note:'<p class="newsletter-meta">'+escape(note)+'</p>',text:[...texts,note].join('\n\n')};
}

function llmStrongResult_(saved,row,items=taxonomyCatalog_()){

  const source=saved.sources.find(source=>source.id===e.source),text=taxonomyText([row.titular,row.extracto,source?.passage||''].join(' '));

 });
}

function exportLlmPending(payload={}){
 authorize_(true);const started=Date.now(),selection=payload.selection||'pending';if(!['pending','abstentions','all'].includes(selection))throw Error('Selección de exportación no válida.');const signature=sha256_(llmExportSignature_()+':'+selection);

 const flush=()=>{if(!articles.length)return;batches.push(JSON.stringify({schemaVersion:LLM_OFFLINE.schemaVersion,sourceRevision:signature,articles}));count+=articles.length;articles=[];};
 if(size>LLM_OFFLINE.archiveBytes)throw Error('Catálogo o noticia demasiado grande para exportar.');
 const sheet=newsSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias;
 for(let first=cursor;first<=Math.min(sheet.getLastRow(),cursor+LLM_OFFLINE.exportRows-1)&&!stop;first+=250){
  const values=sheet.getRange(first,1,Math.min(250,sheet.getLastRow()-first+1,cursor+LLM_OFFLINE.exportRows-first),keys.length).getDisplayValues();
  for(let i=0;i<values.length;i++){
   const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,n)=>[key,values[i][n]]));next=first+i;
   const saved=index.get(row.id),valid=llmValid_(saved,row,context);if(selection==='all'||!valid||selection==='abstentions'&&saved.status!=='classified'){
    const article={...llmArticle_(row),previousResultHash:saved?llmResultHash_(saved):''},bytes=llmUtf8(JSON.stringify(article)).length+200;
    if(size+bytes>LLM_OFFLINE.archiveBytes){if(!count&&!articles.length)throw Error('Catálogo o noticia demasiado grande para exportar.');stop=true;break;}
    size+=bytes;articles.push(article);if(articles.length===LLM_OFFLINE.batchRows)flush();
   }
   next++;
  }
 }
 flush();batches.forEach((text,index)=>files.push({name:(index+1)+'_'+batches.length+'.json',text}));if(signature!==sha256_(llmExportSignature_()+':'+selection))throw Error('Los pendientes han cambiado durante la descarga. Reintenta.');
 telemetry_('llm-export',Date.now()-started,'OK',count+' noticias; '+selection+'; '+size+' bytes');
 return {revision:signature,cursor:next,done:next>sheet.getLastRow(),count,progress:Math.round((next-2)/Math.max(1,sheet.getLastRow()-1)*100),files,review};
}
function llmParseImport_(payload){
 llmExact(payload,['name','base64'],'Archivo');llmString(payload.name,150,'Nombre');llmString(payload.base64,Math.ceil(LLM_OFFLINE.importBytes/3)*4,'Archivo');
 if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(payload.base64))throw Error('Archivo base64 no válido.');
 const bytes=Utilities.base64Decode(payload.base64);if(bytes.length>LLM_OFFLINE.importBytes)throw Error('Importación superior a 2 MiB.');
 const files=/\.zip$/i.test(payload.name)?llmUnzip(bytes):/\.json$/i.test(payload.name)?[{text:llmDecode(bytes.map(b=>b&255))}]:null;
 if(!files)throw Error('Importa un ZIP_STORED o JSON.');
 const results=[];
 for(const file of files){let value;try{value=JSON.parse(file.text);}catch(_){throw Error('JSON corrupto.');}llmExact(value,['schemaVersion','results'],'Lote');if(value.schemaVersion!==LLM_OFFLINE.schemaVersion||!Array.isArray(value.results)||!value.results.length||value.results.length>LLM_OFFLINE.importRows)throw Error('Lote vacío, esquema o límite de resultados no válido.');results.push(...value.results);}
 if(results.length>LLM_OFFLINE.importRows)throw Error('Máximo 250 resultados por importación.');return results;
}
function llmAssertIdle_(){if(llmJob_()?.state==='Publicando'||publicationNeedsReview_(llmJob_()))throw Error('La generación LLM sigue publicándose. Espera a que termine.');}
function importLlmResults(payload){
 authorize_(true);const started=Date.now(),results=llmParseImport_(payload);
 return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
  const context=llmContext_(),wanted=new Set(),changes=[];
  const pending=llmJob_();let current;
  if(pending?.state==='Publicando'){llmStateOverride_=pending.categorization;try{current=llmIndex_();}finally{llmStateOverride_=undefined;llmIndexMemory_=undefined;}}else current=llmIndex_();
  for(const result of results){llmString(result?.newsId,150,'newsId');if(wanted.has(result.newsId))throw Error('newsId duplicado en la importación: '+result.newsId);wanted.add(result.newsId);}
  const news=new Map(rowsById_('Noticias',wanted).map(row=>[row.id,row]));
  for(const result of results){
   const row=news.get(result.newsId);if(!row)throw Error('Noticia no publicada o eliminada: '+result.newsId);
   llmValidateResult(result,llmArticle_(row),context);
   const previous=current.get(row.id);
   if(previous&&JSON.stringify(llmCanonicalResult_(previous))===JSON.stringify(llmCanonicalResult_(result)))continue;
   if(result.replaces!==(previous?llmResultHash_(previous):''))throw Error('Resultado conflictivo: la revisión previa ha cambiado para '+row.id);
   changes.push({...llmCanonicalResult_(result),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
  }
  if(!changes.length){if(pending?.state==='Publicando')ensureBackgroundWorker_();return {...getLlmCategorization(),imported:0,duplicates:results.length};}
  llmAssertIdle_();llmCompactPublication_();const state=llmState_(),name='CategorizacionLLM',keys=RADAR.sheets.CategorizacionLLM,sheet=generationSheet_(name,keys),revision=Utilities.getUuid();
  sheet.getRange(1,1,1,keys.length).setValues([keys]);
  const previousLast=sheet.getLastRow(),updates=changes.map((result,i)=>({row:previousLast+i+1,values:keys.map(key=>key==='publication'?revision:typeof result[key]==='object'?JSON.stringify(result[key]):String(safeCell_(result[key])))}));
  try{writeVerifiedRows_(sheet,updates);}catch(error){
   const appended=sheet.getLastRow()-previousLast;if(appended>0)sheet.getRange(previousLast+1,1,appended,keys.length).clearContent();SpreadsheetApp.flush();llmIndexMemory_=undefined;throw error;
  }
  llmIndexMemory_=undefined;llmQueuePublication_({...state,sheet:name,revision},changes.length>=25&&changes.every(row=>row.status!=='classified'&&!row.sources.length));
  telemetry_('llm-import',Date.now()-started,'OK',changes.length+' preparadas; '+(results.length-changes.length)+' duplicadas; '+updates.length+' filas escritas');
  return {...getLlmCategorization(),imported:changes.length,duplicates:results.length-changes.length};
 });
}
// Fold only the previously published sparse overlay before accepting another batch.
function llmCompactPublication_(){
 const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('CategorizacionLLM');if(!sheet||sheet.getLastRow()<2)return;
 const keys=RADAR.sheets.CategorizacionLLM,column=keys.indexOf('publication'),rows=sheet.getRange(2,1,sheet.getLastRow()-1,keys.length).getDisplayValues(),positions=new Map(),updates=[],remove=[],revision=llmState_().revision;
 rows.forEach((values,index)=>{if(!values[column])positions.set(values[0],index+2);});
 rows.forEach((values,index)=>{
  if(!values[column])return;
  if(values[column]===revision){const target=positions.get(values[0])||index+2,canonical=values.slice();canonical[column]='';updates.push({row:target,values:canonical});if(target!==index+2)remove.push(index+2);}
  else remove.push(index+2);
 });
 writeVerifiedRows_(sheet,updates);if(remove.length)deleteSheetRows_(sheet,remove);llmIndexMemory_=undefined;
}

function llmResultHash_(result){return sha256_(JSON.stringify(llmCanonicalResult_(result)));}
// Review-only data is included once in the unified export.
function llmProposals_(context,index){

 if([...index.values()].some(saved=>saved?.proposals?.length))llmPublishedRows_(row=>{const saved=index.get(row.id);if(!saved?.proposals?.length||!llmValid_(saved,row,context))return;for(const proposal of saved.proposals){
  const key=proposal.block+':'+llmConcept(proposal.name);if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,{concept:key,block:proposal.block,code:proposal.code,name:proposal.name,status:'review_only',articles:[]});

 }});
 const proposals=[...groups.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.concept.localeCompare(b.concept)),report={schemaVersion:LLM_OFFLINE.schemaVersion,catalogRevision:context.catalogRevision,taxonomyRevision:context.taxonomyRevision,proposals};
 if(llmUtf8(JSON.stringify(report)).length>LLM_OFFLINE.archiveBytes)throw Error('Propuestas demasiado grandes para una descarga; revisa la hoja de categorización.');
 return report;
}
function llmQueuePublication_(state,reviewRequired=false){
 const job={id:Utilities.getUuid(),state:'Publicando',progress:0,reviewRequired,categorization:state,started:new Date().toISOString(),error:''};
 properties_().setProperty('LLM_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));
 try{requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);ensureBackgroundWorker_();}catch(error){job.error=String(error.message).slice(0,180);properties_().setProperty('LLM_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));throw error;}
}
function llmSnapshotBatch_(){
 const job=llmJob_();if(job?.state!=='Publicando')return false;
 llmStateOverride_=job.categorization;
 try{
  const worked=buildDashboardSnapshotBatch_({llm:true,categorization:job.categorization}),current=llmJob_();
  if(current.state==='Publicando'){const build=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD')||'{}');current.progress=Math.round(Object.keys(build.manifests||{}).length/DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.length*100);properties_().setProperty('LLM_JOB',JSON.stringify(current));}
  return worked;
 }catch(error){job.error=String(error.message).slice(0,180);properties_().setProperty('LLM_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));throw error;}
 finally{llmStateOverride_=undefined;llmIndexMemory_=undefined;}
}
