function radarOutages_(rows,previousRows,query,entityName=entityKey_,comparable=true){
  const incident=row=>row.senales?.some(name=>name===INCIDENT_SIGNAL||name==='Incidencia operativa'),items=rows.filter(incident),prior=previousRows.filter(incident),entities=new Map(),vectors=new Map(),months=new Map();
  const from=query.from||rows.map(row=>row.fecha).sort()[0]||'',to=query.to||rows.map(row=>row.fecha).sort().at(-1)||'';
  for(let month=(from||to).slice(0,7),last=(to||from).slice(0,7);month&&month<=last;){months.set(month,0);const date=new Date(month+'-01T00:00:00Z');date.setUTCMonth(date.getUTCMonth()+1);month=date.toISOString().slice(0,7);}
  for(const row of items){for(const entity of articleEntities(row).map(entityName)){const entry=entities.get(entity)||{entity,total:0,countries:new Map()};entry.total++;for(const country of articleGeographies(row))entry.countries.set(country,(entry.countries.get(country)||0)+1);entities.set(entity,entry);}const month=row.fecha.slice(0,7);if(months.has(month))months.set(month,months.get(month)+1);const names=new Set((row.taxonomia||[]).map(tag=>tag.palanca).filter(Boolean));if(!names.size)names.add('Canales digitales');for(const name of names)vectors.set(name,(vectors.get(name)||0)+1);}
  const ranking=[...entities.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.total-a.total||a.entity.localeCompare(b.entity,'es')).map(row=>({...row,countries:[...row.countries].map(([country,total])=>({country,total}))})),functional=[...vectors].map(([name,total])=>({name,total})).sort((a,b)=>b.total-a.total||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es')),active=new Set(rows.flatMap(row=>articleEntities(row).map(entityName))).size,total=items.length;
  return {signal:INCIDENT_SIGNAL,from,to,total,previous:prior.length,comparable,change:comparable?(prior.length?Math.round((total-prior.length)/prior.length*100):total?null:0):null,affected:entities.size,active,ratio:active?Math.round(entities.size/active*100):0,top:ranking[0]||null,concentration:total?Math.round((ranking[0]?.total||0)/total*100):0,vector:functional[0]||null,ranking:ranking.slice(0,8),vectors:functional.slice(0,6),months:[...months].map(([month,total])=>({month,total})),latest:[...items].sort((a,b)=>b.fecha.localeCompare(a.fecha)||String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))).slice(0,4).map(row=>({id:row.id,entity:entityName(row.entidad),country:row.pais,date:row.fecha,publisher:row.medio,title:plainText_(row.titular),text:{titular:row.titular,extracto:row.extracto,fuente:row.fuente,idioma:row.idioma},url:canonicalUrl_(row.url)})),summary:total?total+' incidencias operativas publicadas en '+entities.size+' entidades durante el período seleccionado. '+(ranking[0]?ranking[0].entity+' concentra el '+Math.round(ranking[0].total/total*100)+'% de las evidencias.':''):'Sin incidencias operativas registradas en el canal para los filtros y periodo seleccionados'};
}

const NEWSLETTER_STORAGE=Object.freeze({cellChars:50000});
function newsletterEditorialSnapshot_(editorial){
 if(!editorial)return null;
 const {corpusIds,geographies,scope,audit,...snapshot}=editorial,reasons=new Map();
 for(const row of audit?.exclusions||[])reasons.set(row.reason,(reasons.get(row.reason)||0)+(row.count||1));
 return {...snapshot,...(geographies?{geographies:geographies.map(({name,code,region,mapId,searchName,enabled,language})=>({name,code,region,mapId,searchName,enabled,language}))}:{}),...(scope?{scope:scope.map(({name,countries})=>({name,countries}))}:{}),...(audit?{audit:{...audit,exclusions:[...reasons].map(([reason,count])=>({reason,count}))}}:{})};
}
function validateNewsletterCells_(rows){
 for(const row of rows)for(const value of row)if(String(value??'').length>NEWSLETTER_STORAGE.cellChars)throw Error('La edición supera el límite de almacenamiento. No se ha guardado ni enviado.');
}

    }

const ADMIN_PAGE_SIZE=10;
function recordText(value){return String(value??'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/ı/g,'i').trim();}
function recordQuery(input={},fields=[]){
  const query={};
  for(const key of ['search','from','to',...fields]){const value=String(input[key]??'').trim();if(value.length>160)throw Error('Filtro demasiado largo.');if(value)query[key]=value;}
  for(const key of ['from','to'])if(query[key]&&(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(query[key])||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(query[key]))||new Date(query[key]).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==query[key]))throw Error('Fecha no válida.');
  if(query.from&&query.to&&query.from>query.to)throw Error('La fecha desde debe ser anterior o igual a la fecha hasta.');
  query.page=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(input.page)||0));return query;
}
let recordDateFormatter;
function filterRecords(rows,input,fields,searchFields,dateKey='fecha',timezone='UTC'){
  const query=recordQuery(input,fields),term=recordText(query.search);

  return rows.filter(row=>{
    if(fields.some(key=>query[key]&&String(row[key])!==query[key]))return false;
    if(term&&!recordText(searchFields.map(key=>row[key]??'').join(' ')).includes(term))return false;
    if(!query.from&&!query.to)return true;
    const date=new Date(row[dateKey]);if(!Number.isFinite(date.getTime()))return false;
    const day=recordDay(date,timezone);
    return (!query.from||day>=query.from)&&(!query.to||day<=query.to);
  });
}
function recordOptions(rows,fields){return Object.fromEntries(fields.map(key=>[key,[...new Set(rows.map(row=>String(row[key]??'')).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'es'))]));}
function recordPage(rows,input={},pageSize=ADMIN_PAGE_SIZE){const page=Math.min(Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(input.page)||0)),Math.max(0,Math.ceil(rows.length/pageSize)-1));return {items:rows.slice(page*pageSize,(page+1)*pageSize),total:rows.length,page,pageSize};}

function recordDay(value,timezone='UTC'){
  if(recordDateFormatter?.timezone!==timezone)recordDateFormatter={timezone,formatter:new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:timezone,year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'})};
  const parts=Object.fromEntries(recordDateFormatter.formatter.formatToParts(new Date(value)).map(part=>[part.type,part.value]));return parts.year+'-'+parts.month+'-'+parts.day;
}

function collectionWindows_(range){
  const windows=[],first=Date.parse(range.from),cursor=Date.parse(range.to);
  for(let to=cursor;to>=first;to-=COLLECTION_POLICY.windowDays*86400000)windows.push({from:new Date(Math.max(first,to-(COLLECTION_POLICY.windowDays-1)*86400000)).toISOString().slice(0,10),to:new Date(to).toISOString().slice(0,10)});
  return windows;
}
function collectionFeeds_(range){
  const enabled=feeds_(),windows=collectionWindows_(range);
  const rss=enabled.filter(feed=>feed.kind==='rss').flatMap(feed=>domainMatches_(feed.url,'news.google.com')?windows.map(window=>collectionProfile_(feed,window)):[{...feed,range}]);
  const profiles=enabled.filter(feed=>feed.kind==='profile');
  const selected=rss.concat(windows.flatMap(window=>profiles.flatMap(base=>{
    const variants=[base,{...base,capabilitySearch:true}];
    return variants.map(feed=>collectionProfile_(feed,window)).filter(Boolean);
  })));
  const primary=new Set(configuration_().applicationScope.find(scope=>scope.name==='Empresas e instituciones').countries),seen=new Set();
  return selected.filter(feed=>{if(seen.has(feed.url))return false;seen.add(feed.url);return true;}).sort((a,b)=>String(b.range?.to||'').localeCompare(String(a.range?.to||''))||Number(primary.has(b.country))-Number(primary.has(a.country)));
}

function splitCollectionFeed_(feed){
  if(!feed.range||feed.range.from===feed.range.to)return [];
  const from=Date.parse(feed.range.from),to=Date.parse(feed.range.to),mid=from+Math.floor((to-from)/86400000/2)*86400000;
  const ranges=[{from:feed.range.from,to:new Date(mid).toISOString().slice(0,10)},{from:new Date(mid+86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10),to:feed.range.to}];
  return ranges.reverse().map(range=>domainMatches_(feed.url,'news.google.com')?{...collectionProfile_({...feed,kind:'rss'},range),kind:feed.kind}:collectionProfile_(feed,range)).filter(Boolean);
}
function collectionTaskFeed_(task,feeds,range){
  if(feeds.has(task.url))return {...feeds.get(task.url),range};
  const base=feeds.get('source:'+task.fuente);if(!base||(base.kind!=='profile'&&!domainMatches_(base.url,'news.google.com')))return null;
  const periodRange=collectionQueryRange_(task.url);if(!periodRange)return null;
  if(!domainMatches_(task.url,'news.google.com'))return null;
  const language=base.language?.split('-')[0],query=decodeURIComponent((task.url.match(/[?&]q=([^&]*)/)||[])[1]||'').toLowerCase();
  if(['it','de','fr','pt','tr'].includes(language)){
    const languages=configuration_().searchLanguages,native=new Set((languages.find(row=>row.language===language)?.terms||[]).map(searchText_));
    if((languages.find(row=>row.language==='en')?.terms||[]).some(term=>!native.has(searchText_(term))&&query.includes('"'+term.toLowerCase()+'"')))return null;
  }
  // Preserve the historical query: rotating capabilities are not a new task identity.
  return countryScopedSource_({...base,url:task.url,range:periodRange});
}

function collectionRecentRange_(now){
  const to=calendarDate_(now),from=new Date(to);from.setUTCDate(from.getUTCDate()-settings_().windowDays);
  return {from:from.toISOString().slice(0,10),to:to.toISOString().slice(0,10)};
}

function collectionProfile_(base,range){
  base=countryScopedSource_(base);
  if(base.kind==='rss'&&domainMatches_(base.url,'news.google.com')){
    const query=decodeURIComponent((base.url.match(/[?&]q=([^&]*)/)||[])[1]||'').replace(/\s*when:\d+d\b/g,'').replace(/\s*(?:after|before):\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/g,'').trim();
    return {...base,range,url:canonicalUrl_(base.url.replace(/([?&]q=)[^&]*/,(_,prefix)=>prefix+encodeURIComponent(collectionPeriod_(range)+' '+query)))};
  }
  const config=configuration_(),entity=config.entities.find(row=>row.name===base.entity),geo=config.geographies.find(row=>row.name===base.country);
  const feed=profileFeed_(geo,entity,range,base.capabilitySearch);return feed?{...feed,range}:null;
}
function collectionFeedIndex_(){
  const index=new Map();for(const feed of feeds_()){index.set(feed.url,feed);index.set('source:'+feed.name,feed);}return index;
}

function initializeCollectionQueue_(){
  const value=properties_().getProperty('COLLECTION_RANGE'),range=value?JSON.parse(value):null,paused=properties_().getProperty('COLLECTION_AFTER')||'',tasks=rows_('Recopilacion'),jobs=collectionJobs_();
  for(const job of jobs)if(job.tipo==='manual'){job.tipo='daily';writeCollectionJob_(job);}
  if(tasks.length){
    const jobIndex=new Map(jobs.map(job=>[job.id,job]));
    const priorities=tasks.map(task=>{if(task.prioridad)return task.prioridad;const before=task.url.match(/before(?::|%3A)(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/i);return before?new Date(Date.parse(before[1])-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10):jobIndex.get(task.ciclo)?.hasta||range?.to||calendarDate_(new Date()).toISOString().slice(0,10);});
    book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion').getRange(2,10,tasks.length,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(priorities.map(value=>[value]));
    for(const id of new Set(tasks.map(task=>task.ciclo)))if(!jobs.some(job=>job.id===id)){
      const dates=tasks.filter(task=>task.ciclo===id).map(task=>task.actualizada).filter(Boolean).sort(),period=range||{from:priorities.slice().sort()[0],to:priorities.slice().sort().at(-1)};
      const job={id,tipo:'daily',desde:period.from,hasta:period.to,inicio:dates[0]||new Date().toISOString(),fin:'',estado:'Pendiente',total:0,procesadas:0,pendientes:0,omitidas:0,fallidas:0,nuevas:0,actualizada:'',pausa:paused};
      collectionSnapshots_(tasks,[job]);append_('Recargas',[RADAR.sheets.Recargas.map(key=>job[key])]);jobs.push(job);
    }
  }
  properties_().deleteProperty('COLLECTION_RANGE');properties_().deleteProperty('COLLECTION_AFTER');CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');
}

function collectionQueryRange_(url){
  let query;try{query=decodeURIComponent((url.match(/[?&]q=([^&]*)/)||[])[1]||'');}catch(_){return null;}
  const period=query.match(/after:(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) before:(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/);if(!period)return null;
  const after=Date.parse(period[1]),before=Date.parse(period[2]);
  if(!Number.isFinite(after)||!Number.isFinite(before)||new Date(after).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==period[1]||new Date(before).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==period[2]||before-after<2*86400000)return null;
  return {from:new Date(after+86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10),to:new Date(before-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10)};
}
function upgradeCollectionQueries_(){
  const feeds=collectionFeedIndex_(),tasks=rows_('Recopilacion'),urls=tasks.map(task=>[task.url]);let changed=false;
  tasks.forEach((task,index)=>{
    const base=feeds.get('source:'+task.fuente);if(!base||!['Pendiente','Reintento programado'].includes(task.estado))return;
    const url=countryScopedSource_({...base,url:task.url}).url;
    if(url!==task.url){urls[index]=[url];changed=true;}
  });
  if(changed)book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion').getRange(2,3,urls.length,1).setValues(urls);
}

function recoveryAvailability(jobs,requests=[]){
  const active=jobs.filter(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||['Preparando','En curso','En cola'].includes(job.estado));
  return {today:active.some(job=>job.tipo==='daily')||requests.some(request=>request.kind==='daily'),year:active.some(job=>job.tipo==='annual')||requests.some(request=>request.kind==='annual')};
}

function recoveryProgressJobs(jobs){
  const grouped=new Map();
  const active=job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||['Preparando','En curso','En cola'].includes(job.estado);
  for(const job of jobs){
    const current=grouped.get(job.tipo);
    if(!current||Number(active(job))>Number(active(current))||(active(job)===active(current)&&String(job.inicio)>String(current.inicio)))grouped.set(job.tipo,job);
  }
  return [...grouped.values()].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.tipo==='daily')-Number(a.tipo==='daily')||String(a.tipo).localeCompare(String(b.tipo)));
}

function publisherKey_(value){const text=String(value||'').trim();return /^bbva(?:\s*[·-]\s*empresas|\s+empresas|\s+noticias)?$/i.test(text)?'BBVA':text;}
function resolvedPublisher_(explicit,configured){const name=publisherKey_(explicit),catalog=publisherKey_(configured);return catalog&&name&&searchText_(catalog).startsWith(searchText_(name)+' ')?catalog:name||catalog;}
function plainText_(value) {
  const html=String(value||'').replace(/<\s*(\/?)\s*(h)\s*([1-6])\s*>/gi,'<$1$2$3>').replace(/(^|\s)(?:le|h[1-6]|article)\s*>/gi,'$1'), parts=[];
  let cursor=0, hidden='';
  // Extrae texto para clasificación. El cliente escapa este texto al mostrarlo.
  for(const tag of html.matchAll(/<!--[\s\S]*?(?:-->|$)|<[^>]*(?:>|$)/g)){
    if(!hidden)parts.push(html.slice(cursor,tag.index),' ');
    const name=tag[0].match(/^<\s*(\/?)\s*(script|style)\b/i);
    if(name){
      const kind=name[2].toLowerCase();
      if(!name[1]&&!hidden)hidden=kind;
      else if(name[1]&&hidden===kind)hidden='';
    }
    cursor=tag.index+tag[0].length;
  }
  if(!hidden)parts.push(html.slice(cursor));
  return parts.join('').replace(/&#(x[\da-f]+|\d+);/gi,(_,n)=>String.fromCodePoint(Math.min(parseInt(n[0].toLowerCase()==='x'?n.slice(1):n,n[0].toLowerCase()==='x'?16:10),0x10ffff))).replace(/&(?:amp|lt|gt|quot|apos|nbsp);/g,m=>({'&amp;':'&','&lt;':'<','&gt;':'>','&quot;':'"','&apos;':"'",'&nbsp;':' '})[m]).replace(/<\/?[a-z][^>]*(?:>|$)/gi,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
}
function canonicalUrl_(value) {
  const match = String(value || '').trim().match(/^https:\/\/([a-z0-9.-]+)(?::443)?(\/[^#?]*)?(?:\?([^#]*))?(?:#.*)?$/i);
  if (!match) return '';
  const query = (match[3] || '').split('&').filter(x=>x&&!/^(utm_\w+|fbclid|gclid)=/i.test(x)).sort().join('&');
  return 'https://' + match[1].toLowerCase() + (match[2] || '/') + (query?'?'+query:'');
}
function domainMatches_(url, domain) {
  const host = (url.match(/^https:\/\/([^/]+)/)||[])[1] || '';
  return host === domain || host.endsWith('.'+domain);
}
let businessIndexMemory_;
const newsRelevanceMemory_=new WeakMap();
function newsRelevance_(row){
  if(!newsRelevanceMemory_.has(row))newsRelevanceMemory_.set(row,Number(savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion).score||0));
  return newsRelevanceMemory_.get(row);
}
function packNews_(row){return [row,newsRelevanceMemory_.get(row)??0];}
function unpackNews_(record){newsRelevanceMemory_.set(record[0],record[1]);return record[0];}
function businessIndex_(){
  const config=configuration_();if(businessIndexMemory_?.config===config)return businessIndexMemory_;
  const entities=new Map(),entityTerms=new Map();for(const row of config.entities){const terms=[row.name,...row.aliases].map(searchText_);entityTerms.set(row.name,terms);for(const term of terms)entities.set(term,row);}
  const rules=rows=>rows.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>{const terms=[...new Set(row.terms.map(searchText_))];return {...row,terms,pattern:phrasePattern_(terms),context:(row.context||[]).map(searchText_),contextPattern:phrasePattern_((row.context||[]).map(searchText_)),exclude:(row.exclude||[]).map(searchText_),excludePattern:phrasePattern_((row.exclude||[]).map(searchText_))};});
  const capabilities=Object.entries(config.capabilities).flatMap(([segment,rows])=>rules(rows).map(row=>({...row,segment}))),aliases=[...entities].filter(([,row])=>row.enabled).sort((a,b)=>b[0].length-a[0].length);
  // These words also describe the vendor or the subject of a story. Require
  // audience context before treating a standalone occurrence as segment proof.
  const ambiguous=/^(?:empresa[s]?|business(?:es)?|compan(?:y|ies)|corporations?|instituci[oó]n(?:es)?|institutions?|institutional|institucional(?:es)?|corporate|corporativ[ao]s?|comercio|profesional|entreprises?|impresa|imprese|unternehmen|isletme|ticari|cib)$/;
  const segmentEvidence=phrasePattern_(config.segments.filter(row=>row.enabled).flatMap(row=>row.terms.map(searchText_)).filter(term=>!ambiguous.test(term.replace(/\*$/,''))));
  const relevance=Object.fromEntries(RELEVANCE_ROLES.map(role=>[role,phrasePattern_(config.relevanceRules.filter(row=>row.enabled&&row.role===role).flatMap(row=>row.terms.map(searchText_)))]));
  const serviceNames=phrasePattern_(aliases.filter(([alias])=>alias.includes(' ')&&relevance.service.test(alias)).map(([alias])=>alias),'g');
  const cataloguePattern=phrasePattern_(config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.functions.flatMap(row=>[row.name,...row.terms])).map(searchText_));
  const geographies=config.geographies.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>({...row,names:[...new Set([row.name,row.searchName,...(row.aliases||[])].map(searchText_))],terms:[...new Set([row.name,row.searchName,...(row.aliases||[]),...(row.terms||[])].map(searchText_))]})),publisherCountries=new Map(),publisherDomains=new Map(),marketCountries=[];
 for(const geo of geographies){for(const name of geo.publisherNames||[])publisherCountries.set(searchText_(name),geo.name);for(const domain of geo.publisherDomains||[])publisherDomains.set(domain.toLowerCase(),geo.name);for(const term of geo.terms)if(!geo.names.includes(term))marketCountries.push({term,country:geo.name});}
 return businessIndexMemory_={publisherPatterns:new Map(),cataloguePattern,config,entities,entityTerms,aliases,serviceNames,relevance,capabilities,segmentEvidence,signals:rules(config.signals),geographies,publisherCountries,publisherDomains,marketCountries,countryNames:new Set(config.geographies.map(row=>row.name))};
}
function phrasePattern_(terms,flags=''){return new RegExp('(?:^|[^a-z0-9])(?:'+(terms.map(term=>term.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&').replace(/\\\*/g,'[a-z0-9]*')).join('|')||'(?!)')+')(?![a-z0-9])',flags);}
function phrasePosition_(text,term,from=0){
  let at=from-1;while((at=text.indexOf(term,at+1))>=0){if((at===0||!/[a-z0-9]/.test(text[at-1]))&&(at+term.length===text.length||!/[a-z0-9]/.test(text[at+term.length])))return at;}return -1;
}
function phraseMatch_(text,term){return phrasePosition_(text,term)>=0;}
function headlineEntity_(headline,index){
  let entity,first=Infinity;for(const [alias,row] of index.aliases){const position=phrasePosition_(headline,alias);if(position>=0&&position<first){entity=row;first=position;}}return entity;
}
function headlineProtagonists_(row,index){
  const primary=index.entities.get(searchText_(row.entidad))?.name||row.entidad,title=searchText_(plainText_(row.titular));
  const found=new Map();
  for(const [alias,entity] of index.aliases){const at=phrasePosition_(title,alias),previous=found.get(entity.name);if(at>=0&&(!previous||at<previous.at||at===previous.at&&alias.length>previous.alias.length))found.set(entity.name,{name:entity.name,alias,at,end:at+alias.length});}
  const matches=[...found.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.at-b.at||b.alias.length-a.alias.length),first=matches[0];
  const prefix=first?title.slice(0,first.at):'';
  if(!first||!matches.some(match=>match.name===primary)||prefix&&!/^(?:(?:los?|las?)\s+)?(?:bancos?|entidades?|fintechs?)\s+$|^[a-z0-9 .-]{2,30},\s*$/.test(prefix))return [primary];
  const subjects=[first];for(const match of matches.slice(1)){
    if(match.at<subjects.at(-1).end)continue;
    const between=title.slice(subjects.at(-1).end,match.at).replace(/\([a-z0-9]{1,6}\)/g,'').trim();
    if(between?!/^(?:,\s*)*(?:y|e|and|&)?\s*,?$/.test(between):matches.length<3)break;
    subjects.push(match);
  }
  return subjects.length>1&&subjects.some(match=>match.name===primary)?[primary,...subjects.map(match=>match.name).filter(name=>name!==primary)]:[primary];
}
// Exactly one business signal. Operational evidence is evaluated per clause so a
// generic prevention mention cannot mask a separately reported real outage.
function businessSignals_(title,text,index=businessIndex_()){
  const priority=['Problema','Alianza estratégica','Lanzamiento de producto','Mejora de oferta'];
  for(const kind of priority){
    const row=index.signals.find(rule=>kind==='Problema'?rule.group===kind:rule.name===kind);
    if(!row)continue;
    if(kind==='Lanzamiento de producto'&&/\b(?:launch(?:es|ed)?|lanza|inicia)\b.{0,40}\b(?:pilot|piloto|test|trial)\b/.test(title))continue;
    const scope=row.scope==='headline'?title:text;
    // A question mark is common in live-service headlines ("outage today?").
    // It is punctuation, not evidence that the outage is hypothetical.
    const clauses=kind==='Problema'?scope.split(/[.;!\n]+|\b(?:pero|however|but)\b/):[scope];
    if(clauses.some(value=>{
      const evidence=kind==='Alianza estratégica'?value.replace(/\bde acuerdo con\b/g,' '):value;
      const denied=kind==='Problema'&&/\b(?:no|nunca)\s+(?:(?:se|han?|ha)\s+)?(?:hay|hubo|existe[n]?|reporta[n]?|reportado|registra[n]?|registrado|sufre[n]?|detecta[n]?|detectado)\b.{0,50}\b(?:caida[s]?|fallo[s]?|problema[s]?|incidencia[s]?|interrupcion|outage[s]?)\b/.test(value);
      return !denied&&row.pattern.test(evidence)&&(!row.exclude.length||!row.excludePattern.test(evidence))&&(!row.context.length||row.contextPattern.test(kind==='Problema'?evidence:text));
    }))return [row];
  }
  return [];
}
function recruitmentHeadline_(title){return /\b(?:job vacancies|job openings|is hiring|oferta de empleo|ofertas de empleo|alimi yapacagini|personel alimi)\b/.test(title);}
function businessSegmentEvidence_(text,index){
  const audience=/\b(?:para|for|a|to|destinad[oa]s? a|dirigid[oa]s? a|serves?)\s+(?:(?:las|los|sus|the|its|small|large|grandes|particulares y|consumers and|people and|small and medium-sized)\s+)*(?:empresas?|businesses|companies|corporations|instituciones|institutions|comercios)\b|\b(?:businesses|empresas)\s+(?:unable to (?:make|accept) (?:paye )?payments|can (?:use|manage|make|accept) .{0,65}(?:payments|funds|payouts)|haran transacciones|pueden (?:cobrar|pagar)|podran (?:cobrar|pagar|aceptar|hacer|realizar|recibir pagos))\b|\b(?:clientes?|customers?) (?:de empresas|empresariales)\b|\b(?:corporate|institutional|business)\s+(?:transaction banking|clients?|customers?|accounts?|cards?|payments?|(?:overseas |cross-border )?remittances|checkout|custody|lending|(?:mobile |digital |online )?banking|mobile (?:app|login)|mobile(?=\s*&\s*web login))\b|\b(?:clientes?|cuentas?|pagos?|tarjetas?|cobros?)\s+(?:de empresa|corporativ[ao]s?|institucionales?|empresariales?)\b/;
  const implicit=/\b(?:app['’"”»]? de empresas|app empresarial|recebimentos de empresas|adquirencia|merchant acquiring|merchant settlement|erp embedded finance|real-time forex settlement|liquidity management|conto business|softpos|tpv|plataforma de cobros y pagos|confirming|factoring|cash management|treasury|accept(?:s|ing)? (?:card |online |stablecoin )?payments (?:at checkout|on (?:their|your) (?:website|store))|aceptar (?:pagos|tarjetas) en (?:su|tu) (?:tienda|web)|pagos? de universidades e instituciones|(?:cobros?|pagos?(?: masivos)?|transferencias?|gastos?|finanzas) de (?:las )?empresas|corporate bankers?|relationship managers?)\b/;
  for(const clause of text.split(/[.!?;\n]+/)){
    if(/\b(?:menciona|mentions?|cites?|cita)\b/.test(clause))continue;
    const value=clause.replace(/(?:^|[|—])\s*(?:empresas|business)\s*:/g,' ');
    const match=index.segmentEvidence.exec(value)?.[0]?.trim()||audience.exec(value)?.[0]||implicit.exec(value)?.[0];
    if(match)return [match];
  }
  return [];
}
function digitalAssessment_(title,text,index=businessIndex_()){
  // Entity names are not evidence of a service (for example, Mercado Pago).
  const headline=title,excerpt=text.startsWith(title)?text.slice(title.length):text,clean=value=>value.replace(/\b(?:business news|business standard|the business|expansion empresas|cinco dias)\b/g,' ');title=clean(title).replace(index.serviceNames,' ');text=clean(text).replace(index.serviceNames,' ');
  const capabilities=index.capabilities.filter(row=>row.pattern.test(text));
  const functional=functionalContext(text);
  const segmentEvidence=businessSegmentEvidence_(title+'\n'+clean(excerpt).replace(index.serviceNames,' '),index),business=segmentEvidence.length>0;
  let channel=index.relevance.channel.test(text),shared=index.relevance.shared.test(title);
  const instantBusinessTransfers=/\b(?:(?:transferencias|transfers|payments|pagos)\s+b2b\s+(?:instantane[ao]s?|instant|real-time)|(?:instant|real-time)\s+b2b\s+(?:transfers|payments))\b/;
  if(business&&instantBusinessTransfers.test(title))channel=true;
  if(functional.bankingApi)channel=true;
  if(functional.staffAgent&&business&&headlineEntity_(headline,index))channel=true;
  const signals=businessSignals_(title,text,index);
  const catalogue=index.cataloguePattern.test(text)?taxonomyDecision(taxonomyText(text),taxonomyDefinitions(index.config.taxonomy),title).matches.filter(match=>match.evidence.method==='literal'&&!/\.xx Otros$/.test(match.row.subpalanca)):[];
  const operational=business&&catalogue.length>0&&(channel||Boolean(headlineEntity_(headline,index)))&&(channel||catalogue.some(match=>match.evidence.location==='headline'&&match.evidence.terms.some(term=>/[ -]/.test(term))));
  if(operational){channel=true;for(const match of catalogue)capabilities.push({name:match.row.subpalanca,segment:'Empresas',pattern:phrasePattern_(match.evidence.terms)});}
  const recruitment=recruitmentHeadline_(title);
  const change=signals.length>0,problem=signals.some(row=>row.group==='Problema'),liveReport=/\b(?:users|customers) report\b/.test(title),editorial=!liveReport&&index.relevance.editorial.test(title)&&!change,excluded=recruitment||headlineEntity_(headline,index)?.name==='Santander'&&santanderExcluded_(text)||index.relevance.corporate.test(title)||index.relevance.incidental.test(title)||!problem&&!business&&index.relevance.retail.test(text);
  const incident=!recruitment&&problem&&business&&(channel||index.relevance.service.test(text))&&Boolean(headlineEntity_(text,index))&&!excluded&&!editorial;
  if(incident){channel=true;if(!capabilities.length)capabilities.push({segment:'Empresas',name:/\b(?:pagos|transferencias|payments|transfers)\b/.test(text)?'Pagos':/\b(?:app|movil|mobile)\b/.test(text)?'Aplicaciones móviles empresariales':'Banca electrónica corporativa',pattern:index.relevance.service});}
  const aiOnly=!functional.bankingApi&&index.relevance.channel.test(text)&&!index.relevance.channel.test(text.replace(/\b(?:ai|ia|artificial intelligence|inteligencia artificial)\b/g,' ')),workforce=/\b(?:(?:cut|slash)\b.{0,35}\bjobs|(?:recorta|reduce|elimina)\b.{0,35}\b(?:empleos|puestos|plantilla)|despidos|despide)\b/.test(title),bilateral=/\b(?:secures?\b.{0,60}\bfacility|grants?\b.{0,60}\bloan to|syndicated loan|bilateral facility|otorga prestamo a|firma prestamo con)\b/.test(text),explicitDigital=/\b(?:platform|plataforma|app|api|online|portal|digital banking|banca digital)\b/.test(text);
  const apiOnly=capabilities.length>0&&capabilities.every(row=>row.name==='API bancarias'||row.name.startsWith('17.16.'));
  const debtSettlement=/\b(?:propuestas? de pago|disputas? de cobro|refinanciaci[o]?n|reestructuraci[o]?n|concursad[ao]s?|concurso de acreedores|repayment proposals?|debt restructuring|debt disputes?)\b/.test(text);
  const settlementDigital=explicitDigital||/\b(?:pagos? digitales?|digital payments?|pagos? moviles?|mobile payments?|qr|billeteras? digitales?|digital wallets?)\b/.test(text);
  // Evidence describes the customer service, rather than merely an AI business
  // investment or an individual financing transaction.
  const clientAi=/\b(?:ai|ia|artificial intelligence|inteligencia artificial)\b.{0,65}\b(?:for|to|para|a)\s+(?:[\d,.]+\s+)?(?:corporate|business|empresariales|corporativos)\s+(?:banking\s+)?(?:clients|customers|clientes)\b/.test(title);
  const fundingFacility=/\b(?:trade finance|credit|loan|financiacion|credito)\s+(?:facility|facilities|line|linea)\b/.test(title)&&/\b(?:lands|secures?|receives?|obtains?|grants?|provides?|announces?|signs?|obtiene|concede|anuncia)\b/.test(title);
  const consumerInstallment=(functional.financing||/\bplazos\b.{0,35}\bfacilitea\b/.test(title))&&/\b(?:tiendas? fisicas?|physical stores?|iphone|online shopping|paylah|facilitea|personal cards?|tarjetas? personales?)\b/.test(title)&&!/\b(?:empresas?|corporate|business|pymes|instituciones|b2b)\b/.test(title);
  const consumerService=consumerInstallment||!business&&/\b(?:foreign (?:medical )?(?:patients|tourists)|medical patients|pacientes extranjeros|particulares|for consumers|personal loan applications)\b/.test(title);
  const financialInvestment=/\b(?:buys?|acquires?) (?:a )?stake in\b|\binvests in\b.{0,80}\b(?:firm|network|company)\b/.test(title)&&!clientAi&&!/\b(?:launches?|offers?|rolls out|introduces?|lanza|ofrece)\b/.test(title);
  const analysisOnly=/\b(?:strategy|market) report\b.{0,160}\b(?:budget|researchandmarkets)\b/.test(title)||/^(?:can|could|will|would)\b.{0,100}\([a-z]{1,5}\).{0,180}\?$/.test(title);
  const unrelatedEvent=/\b(?:price target|stock forecast|market forecast|stablecoin forecast|delays? .{0,40}forecast|prevision bursatil|precio objetivo|dictan .{0,55}(?:carcel|prision)|condenad[oa] .{0,35}(?:carcel|prision)|condena por|sentenced to|convicted of|cobro por asesoria|grants? .{0,45}licen[cs]es?|obtiene .{0,40}licencia)\b/.test(title);
  // A named partnership or strategy does not by itself describe a change
  // to the way customers or operators perform a banking task.
  const initiative=signals.some(row=>row.name==='Alianza estratégica')||/\b(?:strategy|estrategia)\b/.test(title);
  const functionalChange=explicitDigital||/\b(?:checkout|custody|custodia|liquidacion|settlement|remittances|remesas|merchant acquiring|softpos|cash management|trade financ(?:e|ing)|erp|financiamiento digital|financiacion digital|digital financing|onboarding|invoice digiti[sz]ation|digitalizacion de facturas|integrat[a-z]*|automat[a-z]*|accept[a-z]*|acepta[a-z]*|reconcil[a-z]*|concilia[a-z]*)\b/.test(text);
  const relevant=business&&(!initiative||functionalChange)&&!unrelatedEvent&&!consumerService&&!financialInvestment&&!analysisOnly&&!(fundingFacility&&!explicitDigital)&&!(debtSettlement&&!settlementDigital)&&(incident||Boolean(!recruitment&&!workforce&&(!apiOnly||functional.bankingApi)&&!(aiOnly&&!clientAi&&!functional.agentBanking&&(!/\b(?:payments?|pagos?|treasury|tesoreria|onboarding|kyb|trade finance|credit|credito|reconciliation|conciliacion|api|erp|asistentes?|assistants?)\b/.test(text)))&&!(bilateral&&!explicitDigital)&&capabilities.length&&!excluded&&!editorial&&((channel||shared)&&(index.relevance.service.test(text)||headlineEntity_(headline,index))||shared&&(channel||change||index.relevance.infrastructure.test(title)))));
  if(relevant&&functional.financing){
    if(!functional.transfer)for(let i=capabilities.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(capabilities[i].name==='Pagos')capabilities.splice(i,1);
    if(!capabilities.some(row=>row.name==='Financiación digital'))capabilities.push({name:'Financiación digital',segment:'Empresas',pattern:phrasePattern_([functional.financing.evidence])});
  }
  if(relevant&&!signals.length)signals.push({name:'Mejora de oferta',group:'Novedad',scope:'fullText',pattern:/(?!) /});
  const score=relevant?6+Math.min(3,capabilities.length)+(change?2:0):0;
  const evidence=(pattern,value)=>pattern.exec(value)?.[0]?.trim().slice(0,120)||'';
  return {capabilities,score,channel,change,editorial,excluded:excluded||unrelatedEvent,relevant,business,shared,signals:signals.map(row=>row.name),evidence:{segmento:segmentEvidence,canal:evidence(index.relevance.channel,text)||evidence(instantBusinessTransfers,title),capacidades:capabilities.slice(0,8).map(row=>({nombre:row.name,texto:evidence(row.pattern,text)})),senales:signals.map(row=>({nombre:row.name,texto:evidence(row.pattern,row.scope==='headline'?title:text)})),corporativa:evidence(index.relevance.corporate,title),retail:!business?evidence(index.relevance.retail,text):'',editorial:evidence(index.relevance.editorial,title)}};
}
function classification_(title,text,includeLabels=true,publisher=''){
  const index=businessIndex_(),key=searchText_(publisher);if(key&&!index.publisherPatterns.has(key))index.publisherPatterns.set(key,phrasePattern_([key],'g'));
  const publisherPattern=index.entities.has(key)?null:index.publisherPatterns.get(key),assessment=digitalAssessment_(publisherPattern?title.replace(publisherPattern,' '):title,publisherPattern?text.replace(publisherPattern,' '):text,index);
  const signals=assessment.signals;
  const segments=assessment.business?[sectorNewsDefaults.segment]:[];
  return {signals,assessment,segments,labels:includeLabels?newsLabels_(assessment,sha256_(JSON.stringify([title,text]))):undefined};
}
function santanderExcluded_(text){
  if(!phraseMatch_(text,'santander'))return false;
  if(phrasePattern_(['ayuntamiento de santander','alcaldia de santander','alcalde de santander','alcaldesa de santander','concejal','vecinos de santander','mercado de mexico','bahia de santander','puerto de santander','universidad de cantabria','gobierno de cantabria','diputacion','gobernador de santander','gobernacion de santander','departamento de santander','bucaramanga','barrancabermeja','policia de santander','bomberos de santander','eln','bus incinerado','extorsion','norte de santander','santander y cesar']).test(text))return true;
  if(phrasePattern_(['cucuta','floridablanca','piedecuesta','giron','socorro','san gil','malaga','curos','barbosa','veolia','aguas del','pae','renta ciudadana','soat','mineria ilegal','mineria criminal','granadas','disidencias','farc','ejercito','policia','asesinato','capturados']).test(text)&&!phrasePattern_(['banco santander','banco de santander','grupo santander','santander empresas','santander corporate','santander cib','app de santander','banca','banking','pagos digitales','transferencias']).test(text))return true;
  if(phrasePattern_(['banco santander','banco de santander','grupo santander','santander empresas','santander corporate','santander cib','santander uk','santander brasil','santander mexico','santander chile','santander argentina','santander portugal','getnet','pagonxt','ebury','cash nexus','openbank','ana botin']).test(text))return false;
  return !phrasePattern_(['banco','banca','bank','banking','entidad financiera','clientes del santander','app de santander']).test(text)||/\b(?:en|de|hacia|desde) santander\b/.test(text);
}
function unresolvedNewsGeography_(provenance){
  return provenance?.paisMetodo==='undetermined'&&provenance.geografias?.[0]==='Sin determinar';
}
function annotateNews_(rows){
  const index=businessIndex_(),items=taxonomyCatalog_(),taxonomy=new Map(items.map(({id,palanca,subpalanca})=>[id,{id,palanca,subpalanca}]));
  return rows.map(row=>{
    const catalog=index.entities.get(searchText_(row.entidad)),assignment=effectiveTaxonomyAssignment_(row,items),classification=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion),labels={digital:classification.digital,capacidades:classification.capacidades};
    if(assignment.editorialExcluded)return null;
    const provenance=classification.procedencia;
    const recovered=unresolvedNewsGeography_(provenance)
      ?newsCountryDecision_({...row,feedUrl:provenance.feedUrl},index):null;
    const country=recovered?.country||row.pais||'Sin determinar',geographies=recovered?.geographies||provenance?.geografias||[country];
    const protagonists=headlineProtagonists_(row,index),annotated={...row,clasificacion:JSON.stringify(labels),medio:resolvedPublisher_(row.medio,configuredPublisher_(provenance?.dominioMedio?'https://'+provenance.dominioMedio:provenance?.medioUrl||'',index)),pais:country,geografias:geographies,...(protagonists.length>1?{entidades:protagonists}:{}),...(assignment.evidence?{functionalEvidence:assignment.evidence}:{}),taxonomia:assignment.ids.map(id=>taxonomy.get(id)),etiquetas:labels,entidad:catalog?.name||row.entidad,tipo:catalog?.type||'',segmentos:classification.segmentos||[],senales:classification.senales||[]};newsRelevanceMemory_.set(annotated,Number(classification.score||0));return annotated;
  }).filter(Boolean);
}
function newsExcerpt_(item,title,publisher=''){
 const redundant=new Set([title,title+' '+publisher].map(searchText_));
 for(const [value,mechanism] of [[item.excerpt,item.excerptSource||'rss:description'],[item.rssContent,'rss:content:encoded']]){
  const text=plainText_(value).replace(/\s*(?:read more|leer m[aá]s|continue reading)[.…]*$/i,'').trim();
  if(text&&!redundant.has(searchText_(text)))return {text:text.slice(0,1500),mechanism};
 }
 return {text:'',mechanism:'rss:empty'};
}
function evaluate_(item, feed, now) {
  const publisher=plainText_(item.source),rawTitle=plainText_(item.title);
  const title=cleanNewsTitle_(rawTitle,publisher,feed.name);
  const url=canonicalUrl_(item.url),date=new Date(item.date);
  if (!title || !url || !domainMatches_(url,feed.domain) || !Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return {reason:'Falta titular, URL del editor o fecha válida'};
  if(date>now)return {reason:'Fecha futura'};
  if(feed.range){const day=calendarDate_(date).toISOString().slice(0,10);if(day<feed.range.from||day>feed.range.to)return {reason:'Fuera del período de recuperación'};}
  else if(now-date>settings_().windowDays*86400000)return {reason:'Fuera de la ventana de '+settings_().windowDays+' días'};
  const extracted=newsExcerpt_(item,title,publisher),excerpt=extracted.text,headline=searchText_(title),text=searchText_(title+' '+excerpt),index=businessIndex_();
  const entity=feed.entity==='Sector'?headlineEntity_(headline,index):index.entities.get(searchText_(feed.entity));
  const classification=classification_(headline,text,true,publisher);
  const geography=newsCountryDecision_({titular:title,extracto:excerpt,url,sourceUrl:item.sourceUrl,medio:publisher,fuente:feed.name,feedUrl:feed.url,rssCountry:feed.country,language:item.language||feed.language||'',articleLanguage:item.articleLanguage||'',entidad:entity?.name||feed.entity},index),country=geography.country;
  const candidate={date,title,excerpt,url,labels:classification.labels,entity:entity?.name||feed.entity,country,geography,language:item.language||feed.language||'',publisher:publisher||'',sourceUrl:canonicalUrl_(item.sourceUrl),provenance:extracted.mechanism};
  const reject=reason=>({inRange:true,reason,candidate});
  if(feed.entity==='Sector'&&!entity)return reject('Sin entidad de seguimiento en el titular');
  if(feed.kind==='profile'&&entity&&!index.entityTerms.get(entity.name).some(alias=>phraseMatch_(text,alias)))return reject('Sin evidencia de la entidad buscada');
  if(entityKey_(entity?.name||feed.entity)==='Santander'&&santanderExcluded_(text))return reject('Santander geográfico o municipal');
  if(!classification.labels.digital||!classification.labels.capacidades.some(name=>name.startsWith('Empresas: ')))return reject('Fuera de canal digital de Empresas e instituciones');
  if(feed.capabilitySearch&&classification.assessment.excluded)return reject('Información corporativa sin novedad de canal digital');
  if(feed.capabilitySearch&&(!classification.assessment.capabilities.length||!classification.assessment.channel))return reject('Sin capacidad digital activa en contexto de canal');
  return {inRange:true,relevant:classification.labels.digital||(!classification.assessment.excluded&&classification.assessment.score>0),item:{date,title,excerpt:excerpt===title?'':excerpt,url,labels:classification.labels,entity:entity?.name||feed.entity,country,geography,language:item.language||feed.language||'',publisher:publisher||'',sourceUrl:canonicalUrl_(item.sourceUrl),provenance:extracted.mechanism}};
}
function safeCell_(value) {
  return typeof value==='string' && /^[=+@-]/.test(value) ? "'"+value : value;
}

function sha256_(value){return Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,value,Utilities.Charset.UTF_8).map(byte=>(byte&255).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');}
let sourceGeographyMemory_;
function sourceCountry_(feed,index=businessIndex_()){
 const country=index.config.geographies.find(row=>row.name===feed.country);if(country)return country.name;
 const text=searchText_(feed.name),named=index.geographies.find(row=>row.terms.some(term=>phraseMatch_(text,term)));
 if(named)return named.name;
 const code=(String(feed.url||'').match(/[?&](?:gl|ceid)=([a-z]{2})(?:[&:]|%3A|$)/i)||[])[1];
 return index.config.geographies.find(row=>row.code===code?.toUpperCase())?.name||'';
}
function sourceGeographies_(index=businessIndex_()){
 if(sourceGeographyMemory_?.config===index.config)return sourceGeographyMemory_.values;
 const values=new Map();
 for(const feed of index.config.feeds){const country=sourceCountry_(feed,index);if(country)values.set(searchText_(feed.name),country);}
 for(const entity of index.config.entities)for(const country of entity.countries)for(const alias of [entity.name,...entity.aliases])values.set(searchText_(alias+' · '+country),country);
 sourceGeographyMemory_={config:index.config,values};return values;
}
const domainCountryIndexes_=new WeakMap();
function domainCountry_(url,index=businessIndex_()){
 let countries=domainCountryIndexes_.get(index);
 if(!countries){countries=new Map(index.config.geographies.map(row=>[row.code.toLowerCase(),row.name]));countries.set('uk',countries.get('gb'));domainCountryIndexes_.set(index,countries);}
 const host=String(canonicalUrl_(url)||'').match(/^https:\/\/([^/:?#]+)/i)?.[1].toLowerCase();
 const suffix=host?.split('.').at(-1);
 return host&&host!=='t.co'&&!domainMatches_(url,'news.google.com')&&suffix!=='co'?countries.get(suffix)||'':'';
}
function geographicMentionScore_(text,at,term,actor=false){
 const before=text.slice(Math.max(0,at-65),at),after=text.slice(at+term.length,at+term.length+35);
 if(/\b(?:(?:sede|matriz|headquarters|based|founded|headquartered|fundad[oa])(?:\s+(?:esta|is|situada|ubicada))?(?:\s+(?:en|in))?|turistas\s+de|tourists\s+from)\s+$/.test(before)||/^\s+(?:bank|banco)\b/.test(after))return 60;
 if(/\b(?:en|in|para|for|across|hacia|into|a|al|del|de)\s+(?:(?:el|la|los|las|the)\s+)?$/.test(before)&&!actor)return 120;
 return actor?95:100;
}
function geographyListSeparator_(text){return Boolean(text.trim())&&!text.replace(/and|y|e|[\s,]/g,'');}
function newsCountryDecision_(row,index=businessIndex_()){
 const title=searchText_(row.titular).replace(/[\u2010-\u2015]/g,'-'),saved=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion).procedencia||{};
 const known=country=>index.countryNames.has(country)||REGION_CODES.includes(country);
 const manual=saved.manualGeografias||row.manualGeografias||(['manual','manual_verified_content'].includes(saved.paisMetodo)?saved.geografias?.length?saved.geografias:[row.pais]:null);
 const evidence=[];let matches=[];
 const add=(country,method,value,score,position)=>{if(country&&index.countryNames.has(country))evidence.push({country,method,value,score,...(position===undefined?{}:{position})});};
 if(Array.isArray(manual)&&manual.length){matches=[...new Set(manual.filter(country=>index.countryNames.has(country)||REGION_CODES.includes(country)||country==='Sin determinar'))];if(matches.length)return geographyDecision_(matches,saved.paisMetodo==='manual_verified_content'?'manual_verified_content':'manual','manual',Array.isArray(saved.paisEvidencias)?saved.paisEvidencias:evidence,'high',matches[0]==='Sin determinar'?'DESCONOCIDA':REGION_CODES.includes(matches[0])?'REGION':'PAIS');}
 const headlineActor=headlineEntity_(title,index)||index.entities.get(searchText_(row.entidad));
 for(const geo of index.geographies)for(const term of geo.names){if(!term)continue;if(['georgia','jordan','santander'].includes(term)&&!new RegExp('(?:pais|country|estado|state|en) '+term+'\\b').test(title))continue;for(let at=phrasePosition_(title,term);at>=0;at=phrasePosition_(title,term,at+term.length))if(!/\bvs\.?\s*$/.test(title.slice(0,at))){const subject=headlineActor&&[headlineActor.name,...headlineActor.aliases].some(name=>title.slice(0,at).trim().endsWith(searchText_(name)));add(geo.name,'headline',term,geographicMentionScore_(title,at,term,subject),at);}}
 for(const {term,country} of index.marketCountries)if(phraseMatch_(title,term))add(country,'market',term,105);
 // A market adjective qualifies an acquiring service, rather than the bank or the publisher.
 const spanishAcquiring=title.match(/\b(?:spanish (?:acquiring (?:rails|infrastructure|services?)|merchant acquiring)|(?:red|infraestructura|servicios?) de adquirencia espanola)\b/);
 if(spanishAcquiring)add(index.geographies.find(geo=>geo.code==='ES')?.name,'market',spanishAcquiring[0],120);
 const regionalMentions=[...title.matchAll(/\b(?:asia|apac|taiwan|taipei|europa|europe)\b/g)].map(match=>({country:/^europ/.test(match[0])?'EMEA':'APAC',method:'headline_region',value:match[0],score:geographicMentionScore_(title,match.index,match[0]),position:match.index}));
 const europeanMarkets=title.match(/\b\d+\s+paises\s+europeos\b/);if(europeanMarkets&&geographicMentionScore_(title,europeanMarkets.index,europeanMarkets[0])!==60)regionalMentions.push({country:'EMEA',method:'headline_region',value:europeanMarkets[0],score:120,position:europeanMarkets.index});
 const mentions=[...evidence.filter(item=>item.method==='headline'),...regionalMentions].sort((a,b)=>a.position-b.position||b.value.length-a.value.length);let previous;
 for(const item of mentions){if(previous&&item.position<previous.position+previous.value.length)continue;const between=previous?title.slice(previous.position+previous.value.length,item.position):'';if(previous?.score===120&&item.score>=95&&geographyListSeparator_(between))item.score=120;previous=item;}
 const regionalDestinations=regionalMentions.filter(item=>item.score===120).sort((a,b)=>a.position-b.position),regionalTitle=regionalDestinations.map(item=>item.value).join(' · '),regions=[...new Set(regionalDestinations.map(item=>item.country))],withRegion=countries=>[...countries,...regions];
 const destination=evidence.some(item=>item.score===120),actorEvidence=evidence.filter(item=>item.score===95),top=evidence.filter(item=>item.score>=100||item.score===95&&!destination&&!regionalTitle);
 evidence.push(...regionalDestinations);
 if(top.some(item=>item.score>=100)){
  const priority=country=>actorEvidence.some(item=>item.country===country)?130:100;
  matches=[...new Set(top.map(item=>item.country))].sort((a,b)=>priority(b)-priority(a)||a.localeCompare(b,'es'));
  const primary=top.find(item=>item.country===matches[0]);return geographyDecision_(withRegion(matches),primary.method,primary.value,evidence,withRegion(matches).length>1?'medium':'high');
 }
 const publisher=searchText_(row.medio||''),headline=searchText_(row.titular),description=searchText_(plainText_(row.extracto||'')),excerpt=(publisher&&description.endsWith(publisher)?description.slice(0,-publisher.length):description).replace(headline,'').trim();
 if(excerpt){for(const geo of index.geographies)for(const term of geo.names)if(term.length>3)for(let at=phrasePosition_(excerpt,term);at>=0;at=phrasePosition_(excerpt,term,at+term.length)){const score=geographicMentionScore_(excerpt,at,term);if(score!==60)add(geo.name,'content',term,score===120?90:70+Math.min(term.length,19),at);}
  for(const {term,country} of index.marketCountries)if(phraseMatch_(excerpt,term))add(country,'content',term,85);}
 const content=evidence.filter(item=>item.method==='content').sort((a,b)=>(a.position??phrasePosition_(excerpt,a.value))-(b.position??phrasePosition_(excerpt,b.value)));
 for(let i=1;i<content.length;i++){const previous=content[i-1],item=content[i],between=excerpt.slice((previous.position??phrasePosition_(excerpt,previous.value))+previous.value.length,item.position??phrasePosition_(excerpt,item.value));if(previous.score===90&&geographyListSeparator_(between))item.score=90;}
 const destinations=content.filter(item=>item.score===90),contentEvidence=regionalTitle?destinations:actorEvidence.length&&!/\b(?:launch|offers?|lanza|ofrece|disponible|expande|presenta|despliega|mercado)\w*/.test(excerpt)?[]:destinations.length?destinations:content;
 if(!contentEvidence.length&&!regionalTitle){if(actorEvidence.length)return geographyDecision_([...new Set(actorEvidence.map(item=>item.country))],'headline',actorEvidence[0].value,evidence,'high');}
 if(contentEvidence.length){const best=[...contentEvidence].sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.country.localeCompare(b.country,'es'))[0];return geographyDecision_(withRegion([...new Set([best.country,...contentEvidence.map(item=>item.country)])]),'content',best.value,evidence,'medium');}
 if(regionalTitle)return geographyDecision_(regions,'headline_region',regionalTitle,evidence,'medium','REGION');
 const publisherUrl=row.sourceUrl||saved.medioUrl||'',url=row.url||'',publisherDomain=/^[a-z0-9-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$/i.test(row.medio||'')?'https://'+row.medio:'';
 const candidates=[...new Set([url,publisherUrl,saved.urlEditorial,publisherDomain].filter(candidate=>canonicalUrl_(candidate)&&!domainMatches_(candidate,'news.google.com')))];
 const historic=row.id&&known(row.pais)?geographyDecision_(
  [...new Set([row.pais,...(Array.isArray(saved.geografias)?saved.geografias.filter(known):[])])],
  saved.paisMetodo&&saved.paisMetodo!=='undetermined'?saved.paisMetodo:'historic_country',
  'país histórico conservado',Array.isArray(saved.paisEvidencias)?saved.paisEvidencias:[],
  saved.paisConfianza||'low',REGION_CODES.includes(row.pais)?'REGION':'PAIS'
 ):null;
 if(historic&&['headline','content','market','headline_region'].includes(historic.reason)&&historic.confidence!=='low')return historic;
 for(const candidate of candidates){const edition=articleEdition_(candidate,index);if(edition.country)return geographyDecision_([edition.country],'edition',edition.evidence,evidence,'medium');}
 if(historic)return historic;
 for(const candidate of candidates.length?candidates:['']){const editorial=editorialCountry_(candidate,row.medio,index);if(editorial.country&&editorial.verified)return geographyDecision_([editorial.country],'publisher',editorial.evidence,evidence,'low');}
 for(const candidate of candidates){const country=domainCountry_(candidate,index);if(country)return geographyDecision_([country],'domain',canonicalUrl_(candidate),evidence,'medium');}
 if(candidates.some(candidate=>verifiedMedia_(index).some(media=>media.ruleType==='EDITOR_GLOBAL'&&mediaEditionMatches_(candidate,media)))){
  const rssCountry=row.rssCountry||saved.paisRSS||sourceGeographies_(index).get(searchText_(row.fuente));
  if(rssCountry==='México'&&candidates.some(candidate=>domainMatches_(candidate,'cronista.com')))return geographyDecision_(['México'],'rss_fallback','El Cronista · México',evidence,'low');
  return geographyDecision_(['Sin determinar'],'undetermined','editor global sin país de evento',evidence,'low','DESCONOCIDA');
 }
 const explicit=row.rssCountry||saved.paisRSS||'',fromFeed=sourceGeographies_(index).get(searchText_(row.fuente))||'',rss=explicit&&index.countryNames.has(explicit)?explicit:fromFeed,fromUrl=rssUrlCountry_(row.feedUrl||'',index,rss);
 if(fromUrl===null||rss&&fromUrl&&rss!==fromUrl){/* Contradicción: pasar al idioma. */}
 else if(rss||fromUrl)return geographyDecision_([rss||fromUrl],'rss_fallback',row.feedUrl||row.fuente||rss,evidence,'low');
 const locale=localeGeography_(row,index);if(locale)return {...geographyDecision_([locale.country],'locale_fallback',locale.evidence,evidence,'low',locale.type),locale:locale.locale,localeOrigin:locale.origin};
 return geographyDecision_(['Sin determinar'],'undetermined','sin evidencia geográfica',evidence,'low','DESCONOCIDA');
}

function geographyDecision_(geographies,reason,value,evidence,confidence,type='PAIS'){
 const country=geographies[0];return {country,geographies,reason,evidence:value,confidence,type,scope:type==='DESCONOCIDA'?'unknown':type==='REGION'&&geographies.every(value=>REGION_CODES.includes(value))?'regional_fallback':geographies.length>1?'multicountry':'single_country',countryEvidence:evidence,version:RADAR.version};
}
function rssUrlCountry_(url,index,rss=''){
 const countries=[...String(url||'').matchAll(/[?&](?:gl|ceid)=([a-z]{2})(?=[&:]|%3A|$)/gi)].map(match=>index.config.geographies.find(row=>row.code===match[1].toUpperCase())?.name).filter(Boolean),unique=[...new Set(countries)];
 // US is a technical edition for our Uruguay searches, never article evidence.
 const query=String(url||'').match(/[?&]q=([^&]*)/)?.[1]||'';let decoded='';try{decoded=decodeURIComponent(query.replace(/\+/g,' '));}catch(_){}
 if(rss==='Uruguay'&&unique.length===1&&unique[0]==='Estados Unidos'&&domainMatches_(url,'news.google.com')&&/\buruguay\b/i.test(decoded))return '';
 return unique.length>1?null:unique[0]||'';
}
function localeGeography_(row,index){

 const raw=article||decoded||row.language||row.idioma||'',origin=article?'article':decoded?'hl':'feed_language';
 const locale=String(raw).replace(/_/g,'-').toLowerCase().replace(/^en-uk(?=-|$)/,'en-gb');if(!/^[a-z]{2}(?:-[a-z0-9]{2,8})*$/.test(locale))return null;
 const rules=geographyCatalog_('ReglasIdiomaGeografia').filter(rule=>rule.enabled),base=locale.slice(0,2),rule=rules.filter(item=>[locale,base].includes(item.name.toLowerCase())).sort((a,b)=>Number(b.precedence)-Number(a.precedence)||Number(b.name.toLowerCase()===locale)-Number(a.name.toLowerCase()===locale))[0];if(!rule)return null;
 const country=rule.type==='REGION'?(rule.destination==='EMAE'?'EMEA':rule.destination):index.config.geographies.find(geo=>geo.code===rule.destination)?.name;

}
function verifiedMedia_(index){return index.verifiedMedia||(index.verifiedMedia=geographyCatalog_('CatalogoMedios').filter(row=>row.enabled&&row.status==='VERIFICADO').sort((a,b)=>(b.editionPattern||'').length-(a.editionPattern||'').length||b.domain.length-a.domain.length||mediaCatalogKey_(a).localeCompare(mediaCatalogKey_(b))));}
function mediaEditionMatches_(url,row){
 const address=canonicalUrl_(url),host=address.match(/^https:\/\/([^/]+)/)?.[1].replace(/^www\./,''),domain=String(row.domain||'').replace(/^www\./,'');
 if(!host||host!==domain)return false;
 const pattern=String(row.editionPattern||'').trim();if(!pattern)return true;
 const target=pattern.startsWith('https://')?address:address.replace(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/,'');
 return target.startsWith(pattern)&&(pattern.endsWith('/')||!target[pattern.length]||/[/?#]/.test(target[pattern.length]));
}

 let domain=host;while(domain.includes('.')){const country=index.publisherDomains.get(domain);if(country)return {country,verified:true,evidence:domain};domain=domain.slice(domain.indexOf('.')+1);}

 return {country:'',verified:false,evidence:host};
}
function articleEdition_(url,index){

 return {country:'',evidence:''};
}

function applyGeographyUpgrade(){
 authorize_(true);
 return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Configuracion'),rows=sheet.getRange(2,1,sheet.getLastRow()-1,2).getValues(),index=rows.findIndex(([key])=>key==='entities');
  if(index<0)throw Error('No se encuentra el catálogo de entidades.');
  const entities=JSON.parse(rows[index][1]),seeds=new Map(CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.entities.map(row=>[row.name,row.headquartersCountry]));
  if(entities.some(row=>!row.headquartersCountry&&!seeds.has(row.name)))throw Error('Hay entidades sin país de sede configurado.');
  const updated=entities.map(row=>({...row,headquartersCountry:row.headquartersCountry||seeds.get(row.name)}));
  const geoIndex=rows.findIndex(([key])=>key==='geographies'),geographies=JSON.parse(rows[geoIndex][1]),geoSeeds=new Map(CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.geographies.map(row=>[row.code,row]));
  const merged=geographies.map(row=>{const seed=geoSeeds.get(row.code);return {...row,region:row.region||seed?.region||'',...Object.fromEntries(['publisherDomains','publisherNames','aliases'].map(key=>[key,[...new Set([...(row[key]||[]),...(seed?.[key]||[])])]]))};});
  merged.push(...CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.geographies.filter(seed=>!geographies.some(row=>row.code===seed.code)));
  const previous=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('GEOGRAPHY_UPGRADE')||'null');if(previous?.version===RADAR.version&&updated.every((row,i)=>row.headquartersCountry===entities[i].headquartersCountry)&&JSON.stringify(merged)===JSON.stringify(geographies))return getGeographyUpgrade();
  const source=book_(),backup=source.copy('News Radar · Geografías '+RADAR.version+' · '+new Date().toISOString()),original=rows[index][1];
  fileInFolder_(backup.getId(),archiveFolder_(JSON.parse(rows.find(([key])=>key==='storage')[1]).primaryFolderId));
  for(const name of ['Configuracion',newsStorageKey_()]){
   const active=source.getSheetByName(name),copy=backup.getSheetByName(name),height=active.getLastRow(),width=active.getLastColumn();
   if(!copy||copy.getLastRow()!==height||copy.getLastColumn()!==width||sha256_(JSON.stringify(active.getRange(1,1,height,width).getDisplayValues()))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(copy.getRange(1,1,height,width).getDisplayValues())))throw Error('Backup no verificado: '+name);
  }
  try{
   sheet.getRange(index+2,2,1,1).setValues([[JSON.stringify(updated)]]);sheet.getRange(geoIndex+2,2,1,1).setValues([[JSON.stringify(merged)]]);SpreadsheetApp.flush();invalidateConfiguration_();
   if(configuration_().entities.some(row=>!row.headquartersCountry))throw Error('Sedes no verificadas.');
   requestNewsClassification_(true,true);
   properties_().setProperty('GEOGRAPHY_UPGRADE',JSON.stringify({version:RADAR.version,backupId:backup.getId(),backupUrl:backup.getUrl(),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),entities:updated.length}));
   return getGeographyUpgrade();
  }catch(error){sheet.getRange(index+2,2,1,1).setValues([[original]]);sheet.getRange(geoIndex+2,2,1,1).setValues([[rows[geoIndex][1]]]);invalidateConfiguration_();throw error;}
 });
}

function snapshotEntity_(value){return String(value||'').trim();}
function newsReadingGeography_(context,query){
 const current=configuration_().geographies,geographies=context?.geographies?context.geographies.map(row=>({...row,region:Object.hasOwn(row,'region')?row.region:current.find(geo=>geo.code===row.code)?.region||''})):current,geography=applicationGeography(context?.scope||configuration_().applicationScope,query.segment,geographies);
 if(context?.cadence==='fortnightly'&&query.benchmark==='international'&&(!query.country||geography.regions.includes(query.country)||query.country===otherGeography)){const group=()=>otherGeography;return Object.assign(group,geography,{own:()=>false,members:()=>[otherGeography]});}
 return geography;
}
function newsGeographySelection_(rows,query,geography=applicationGeography(configuration_().applicationScope,query.segment,configuration_().geographies)){
  query=geographyTabQuery({...query,view:'news'},geography.regions,geography);
  return query.newsGeography?rows.filter(row=>readingGeographyMatches(row,query.newsGeography,geography)):rows;
}
function searchText_(value) {
  return String(value||'').normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/ı/g,'i').trim();
}
function newsScope_(row,query,entity,entityName=entityKey_,geography){
  return (!query.country||(query.country===otherGeography||REGION_CODES.includes(query.country)?geographyMatches(row,query.country,geography||applicationGeography(configuration_().applicationScope,query.segment,configuration_().geographies)):articleGeographies(row).includes(query.country)))&&(!entity||articleEntities(row).some(name=>entityName(name)===entity))&&(!query.source||row.medio===query.source||row.fuente===query.source)&&(!query.from||row.fecha>=query.from)&&(!query.to||row.fecha<=query.to);
}
function selectNews_(rows,query){
  const periodAndSource={...query,country:''};
  const scoped=rows.filter(row=>newsScope_(row,query,'')||(
    newsScope_(row,periodAndSource,'')&&unresolvedNewsGeography_(savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion).procedencia)
  ));
  return selectAnnotatedNews_(annotateNews_(scoped),query);
}
function newsSearchText_(row){return searchText_([row.titular,row.extracto,row.original?.titular,row.original?.extracto,...articleEntities(row),row.medio].filter(Boolean).join(' '));}
function newsFiltersMatch_(row,query,entity,entityName=entityKey_,geography){
 return newsScope_(row,query,entity,entityName,geography)&&(!query.type||row.tipo===query.type)&&(!query.segment||row.segmentos.includes(query.segment))&&(!query.signal||(query.signal===NON_INCIDENT_SIGNAL?!row.senales.includes(INCIDENT_SIGNAL):row.senales.includes(query.signal)))&&(!query.coverage||row.etiquetas?.[query.coverage]===true)&&(!query.palanca||row.taxonomia.some(item=>item.palanca===query.palanca))&&(!query.subpalanca||row.taxonomia.some(item=>item.subpalanca===taxonomySubLabel(query.subpalanca)&&(!query.palanca||item.palanca===query.palanca)));
}
function selectAnnotatedNews_(rows,query,entityName=entityKey_,identities=false,geography,searchMatch) {
 const q=searchText_(String(query.search||'').slice(0,160));
 if(query.from&&query.to&&query.from>query.to)throw new Error('La fecha desde debe ser anterior o igual a la fecha hasta.');
 const entity=query.entity?entityName(query.entity):'',selected=rows.filter(row=>newsFiltersMatch_(row,query,entity,entityName,geography)&&(!q||(searchMatch?searchMatch(row):newsSearchText_(row).includes(q))));
 return uniqueNews_(identities||entityName===snapshotEntity_?selected:translationIdentityRows_(selected)).sort((a,b)=>b.fecha.localeCompare(a.fecha));
}
function newsDashboard_(rows, query, feeds,view='radar',context=null,pagination=null,previousRows=null,searchMatch=null) {
  const identities=Boolean(context)||view==='radar';if(!context&&view==='radar')rows=translationIdentityRows_(rows);
  const entityName=context?snapshotEntity_:entityKey_,geography=newsReadingGeography_(context,query);query=geographyTabQuery({...query,view},geography.regions,geography);
  const selected=selectAnnotatedNews_(view==='briefing'?rows.filter(briefingAllowed):rows,query,entityName,identities,geography,searchMatch),radar=view==='radar'?radarMetrics_(selected,query,context?.geographies,entityName):null;
  if(radar){radar.outages=radarOutageSelection_(selected,query,entityName,previousRows);const available={total:0,from:'',to:'',limited:false},period=['country','entity','source','search','type','segment','signal','coverage','palanca','subpalanca'].some(key=>query[key])?uniqueNews_(rows.filter(row=>newsScope_(row,{from:query.from,to:query.to},''))):selected;for(const row of period){available.total++;if(!available.from||row.fecha<available.from)available.from=row.fecha;if(row.fecha>available.to)available.to=row.fecha;}radar.available=available;}
  const newsRegions=view==='news'?regionalGeographies(selected,geography):[],newsGeographies=view==='news'?noveltyOverview(selected,[],geography).geographies.map(({name,total})=>({name,total})):[];
  let newsGeography=[...newsGeographies,...newsRegions].some(row=>row.name===query.newsGeography)?query.newsGeography:newsGeographies[0]?.name||'';
  if(view==='news'&&(newsGeography===otherGeography||REGION_CODES.includes(newsGeography)||!newsGeography&&(query.newsGeography===otherGeography||REGION_CODES.includes(query.newsGeography))))newsGeography=preferredRegion(newsRegions,geography.region(query.newsGeography),geography.ownRegions,newsGeography);
  const visible=view==='news'?newsGeographySelection_(selected,{...query,newsGeography},geography):selected;
  const page=Math.min(Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(query.page)||0)),Math.max(0,Math.ceil(visible.length/settings_().pageSize)-1));
  const ordered=view==='news'&&pagination?newsEntityGroups(visible,true).flatMap(group=>group.items):visible;if(pagination)pagination(ordered);
  const values=items=>[...new Set(items.filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'es'));
  return {...taxonomyOptions_(),items:view==='news'&&!pagination?newsEntityPage(visible,page*settings_().pageSize,settings_().pageSize):ordered.slice(page*settings_().pageSize,(page+1)*settings_().pageSize),total:visible.length,contextTotal:selected.length,...(view==='news'?{newsGeographies,newsGeography,newsRegions}:{}),page,pageSize:settings_().pageSize,
    countries:values((query.country?selectAnnotatedNews_(rows,{...query,country:''},entityName,identities,geography,searchMatch):selected).flatMap(articleGeographies)),entities:values([...rows.flatMap(r=>articleEntities(r).map(entityName)),...feeds.map(f=>entityName(f.entity))]),sources:values(rows.map(r=>r.medio)),types:values(configuration_().entities.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>row.type)),segments:configuration_().segments.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>row.name),signals:view==='briefing'?[...BRIEFING_ALLOWED_SIGNALS]:[NON_INCIDENT_SIGNAL,...configuration_().signals.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>row.name)],...(radar?{radar,stats:radar.summary,heatmap:taxonomyHeatmap_(selected.filter(row=>!row.senales.includes(INCIDENT_SIGNAL)),entityName)}:{}),...(view==='briefing'?{briefing:briefing_(selected,true,geography)}:{})};
}
function newsCsv_(rows, query, language='es',prepared=false,names,entityName=entityKey_,geography,searchMatch) {
  const label=taxonomyLanguage_(language,names),selected=prepared?selectAnnotatedNews_(rows,query,entityName,false,geography,searchMatch):selectNews_(rows,query),keys=[...RADAR.sheets.Noticias.filter(k=>!['id','capturada','clasificacion','taxonomia'].includes(k)),'geografias','tipo','segmentos','senales','bloques_funcionales','funcionalidades_suboperativas'];
  if(selected.length>settings_().exportLimit)throw new Error('Reduce el período para exportar hasta '+settings_().exportLimit+' publicaciones.');
  return {csv:'\ufeff'+[keys,...selected.map(r=>keys.map(k=>k==='geografias'?articleGeographies(r).join(' · '):k==='bloques_funcionales'?[...new Set(r.taxonomia.map(item=>label(item.palanca)))].join(' · '):k==='funcionalidades_suboperativas'?r.taxonomia.map(item=>label(item.subpalanca)).join(' · '):r[k]))].map(row=>row.map(value=>'"'+String(safeCell_(value)||'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(';')).join('\r\n'),count:selected.length};
}
function entityKey_(entity){return businessIndex_().entities.get(searchText_(entity))?.name||String(entity||'').trim();}

const NON_INCIDENT_SIGNAL='Sin incidencias operativas';
const BRIEFING_ALLOWED_SIGNALS=Object.freeze(['Lanzamiento de producto','Mejora de oferta','Alianza estratégica']);
function briefingAllowed(row){return row.senales?.length===1&&BRIEFING_ALLOWED_SIGNALS.includes(row.senales[0]);}
const applicationScopeSegments=Object.freeze(['Empresas e instituciones']);
const readingViews=Object.freeze(['news','briefing','radar']);
const sectorNewsDefaults=Object.freeze({segment:'Empresas e instituciones',coverage:'digital'});
const coverageOptions=Object.freeze({digital:'Canal digital'});
const subscriptionFilterKeys=Object.freeze(['entity','country','source','type','segment','coverage','signal','search','palanca','subpalanca']);
const otherGeography='Otras geografías';
function geographyLabel(name){return !name||name==='Sin determinar'?otherGeography:name;}
function articleGeographies(row){return [...new Set(Array.isArray(row.geografias)&&row.geografias.length?row.geografias:[row.pais||''])];}
function applicationGeography(scopes,segment,geographies=[]){
  const countries=new Set(scopes.filter(scope=>!segment||scope.name===segment).flatMap(scope=>scope.countries));
  const region=new Map(geographies.map(row=>[row.name,row.region||''])),geography=row=>{const name=articleGeographies(row).find(value=>countries.has(value));return name||otherGeography;};geography.own=country=>countries.has(country);geography.members=row=>[...new Set(articleGeographies(row).map(value=>countries.has(value)?value:otherGeography))];geography.region=country=>region.get(country)||(REGION_CODES.includes(country)?country:'');geography.regions=[...new Set([...REGION_CODES,...[...region.values()].filter(Boolean)])];geography.ownRegions=[...new Set([...countries].map(country=>region.get(country)).filter(Boolean))];return geography;
}
function geographyOrder(a,b){return Number(a.name===otherGeography)-Number(b.name===otherGeography)||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es');}
function entityOrder(a,b){return Number(b.name==='BBVA')-Number(a.name==='BBVA')||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es');}
function entityVolumeOrder(a,b){return Number(b.name==='BBVA')-Number(a.name==='BBVA')||b.total-a.total||entityOrder(a,b);}

const REGION_CODES=Object.freeze(['APAC','EMEA','AMER']);
function countryRegion(country,geographies=[]){return geographies.find(row=>row.name===country)?.region||'';}
function geographyMatches(row,selection,geography){
  return geography.regions.includes(selection)?articleGeographies(row).some(country=>!geography.own(country)&&geography.region(country)===selection):selection===otherGeography?geography.members(row).includes(otherGeography):articleGeographies(row).includes(selection);
}
function unlocatedGeography(row,geography){return articleGeographies(row).every(country=>!geography.own(country)&&!geography.region(country));}
function readingGeographyMatches(row,selection,geography){return geographyMatches(row,selection,geography)||geography.regions.includes(selection)&&unlocatedGeography(row,geography);}
function preferredRegion(rows,local='',configured=[],selected=''){
 const known=rows.filter(row=>REGION_CODES.includes(row.name)),available=known.filter(row=>row.total>0);
 if(available.some(row=>row.name===selected))return selected;
 if(available.some(row=>row.name===local))return local;
 const ranked=available.slice().sort((a,b)=>Number(configured.includes(b.name))-Number(configured.includes(a.name))||b.total-a.total||REGION_CODES.indexOf(a.name)-REGION_CODES.indexOf(b.name));
 return ranked[0]?.name||known.find(row=>row.name===selected)?.name||known.find(row=>row.name===local)?.name||known[0]?.name||REGION_CODES[0];
}
function regionalGeographies(rows,geography){
  const totals=new Map(geography.regions.map(name=>[name,0]));
  for(const row of rows)for(const region of new Set(articleGeographies(row).filter(country=>!geography.own(country)).map(country=>geography.region(country)).filter(Boolean)))if(totals.has(region))totals.set(region,totals.get(region)+1);
  return [...totals].map(([name,total])=>({name,total}));
}

function geographyTabQuery(query,regions=REGION_CODES,geography=null){
  const requested=query.newsGeography||query.country;if(query.view!=='news'||!requested)return query;
  let tab=requested;
  if(geography&&requested!==otherGeography&&!regions.includes(requested)){
    const group=geography({pais:requested});tab=group===otherGeography&&!geography.own(requested)?geography.region(requested)||otherGeography:group;
  }
  return {...query,country:'',newsGeography:tab};
}

// Persist the completion barrier with the job; publication failure leaves it visibly incomplete.
function snapshotJob_(key,job){
  if(job.state!=='Completada'&&job.state!=='Publicando'){const pending=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]').filter(value=>value!==key);if(pending.length)properties_().setProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS',JSON.stringify(pending));else properties_().deleteProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS');}
  if(!['Completada','Publicando'].includes(job.state)||job.total===0&&!(key==='TAXONOMY_JOB'&&job.model))return job;
  const pending=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]');if(!pending.includes(key))pending.push(key);
  properties_().setProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS',JSON.stringify(pending));requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);return {...job,state:'Publicando'};
}
function publicationNeedsReview_(job){return job?.state==='Revisar'&&Number(job.publicationRetries||0)>=3;}
function snapshotJobsPending_(){return llmJob_()?.state==='Publicando'||JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]').length>0;}
function completeSnapshotJobs_(){
  const p=properties_(),pending=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]');
  for(const key of pending){const job=JSON.parse(p.getProperty(key)||'null');if(job?.state==='Publicando')p.setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...job,state:'Completada',error:'',published:new Date().toISOString()}));}
  p.deleteProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS');
  for(const job of collectionJobs_())if(job.estado==='Publicando'){p.deleteProperty('PUBLICATION_RETRY:'+job.id);if(job.tipo==='daily'&&p.getProperty('MAINTENANCE_DAY')!==recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone))p.setProperty('MAINTENANCE_REQUEST',recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone));job.estado=Number(job.fallidas)>0?'Parcial':'Completada';job.fin=new Date().toISOString();writeCollectionJob_(job);}
  compactCollectionTasks_();CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');

}

function recordSnapshotFailure_(error){
  const p=properties_(),message=String(error.message||error).slice(0,180),keys=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]');
  for(const key of keys){const job=JSON.parse(p.getProperty(key)||'null');if(job?.state==='Publicando')p.setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...job,error:message}));}
  telemetry_('dashboard-snapshot',0,'Error',message);
}


// Retry only the publication phase. Durable processing cursors and isolated tables survive.
function recoverBackgroundJobs_(now=Date.now()){
 const p=properties_(),values=p.getProperties(),build=JSON.parse(values.DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD||'null'),jobs=collectionJobs_(),waiting=dailyCollectionPending_({jobs})||dailyPipelineRequested_()||[classificationJob_(),taxonomyJob_()].some(job=>job&&!['Completada','Publicando','Revisar'].includes(job.state));let recovered=false;
 const validPause=value=>Number.isFinite(Number(value))&&Number(value)>=0&&Number(value)<=now+86400000;
 for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(values)){
  if(!/_JOB$/.test(key))continue;
  let job;try{job=JSON.parse(value);}catch(_){continue;}if(!job||typeof job!=='object')continue;
  let changed=false;
  if(job.pausedUntil!=null&&!validPause(job.pausedUntil)){job.pausedUntil=0;changed=true;}
  const progress=Date.parse([build?.updated,job.publicationWaitingAt,job.publicationRetriedAt,job.updated,job.started].filter(Boolean).sort().at(-1)||'');
  if(job.state==='Publicando'&&waiting){job.publicationWaitingAt=new Date(now).toISOString();changed=true;}
  else if(job.state==='Publicando'&&(!Number.isFinite(progress)||now-progress>600000)){
   if(Number(job.publicationRetries||0)>=3){job.state='Revisar';job.error=job.error||'Publicación sin progreso tras tres recuperaciones; revisión necesaria.';p.setProperty(key,JSON.stringify(snapshotJob_(key,job)));continue;}
   job.publicationRetries=Number(job.publicationRetries||0)+1;job.publicationRetriedAt=new Date(now).toISOString();changed=true;recovered=true;
   telemetry_('supervisor',0,'Recuperación',key+': publicación sin progreso; reintento desde los cursores guardados');
  }
  if(changed)p.setProperty(key,JSON.stringify(job));
 }
 for(const job of jobs){
  let changed=false;if(job.pausa&&!validPause(job.pausa)){job.pausa=0;changed=true;}
  const retryKey='PUBLICATION_RETRY:'+job.id,retry=JSON.parse(values[retryKey]||'{}'),progress=Date.parse([build?.updated,retry.waitingAt,retry.at,job.actualizada,job.inicio].filter(Boolean).sort().at(-1)||'');
  if(job.estado==='Publicando'&&waiting)p.setProperty(retryKey,JSON.stringify({...retry,waitingAt:new Date(now).toISOString()}));
  else if(job.estado==='Publicando'&&(!Number.isFinite(progress)||now-progress>600000)){if(Number(retry.count||0)>=3){retry.error=retry.error||'Publicación sin progreso tras tres recuperaciones; revisión necesaria.';p.setProperty(retryKey,JSON.stringify(retry));job.estado='Revisar';writeCollectionJob_(job);continue;}p.setProperty(retryKey,JSON.stringify({count:Number(retry.count||0)+1,at:new Date(now).toISOString()}));job.actualizada=new Date(now).toISOString();changed=true;recovered=true;telemetry_('supervisor',0,'Recuperación',job.id+': reintento de publicación');}
  if(changed)writeCollectionJob_(job);
 }
 for(const key of ['CATALOG_SYNC_RETRY_AT','FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL','NEWSLETTER_NEXT','TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL'])if(values[key]&&!validPause(values[key]))p.deleteProperty(key);
 if(recovered){p.deleteProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD');p.setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST','ready');p.setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUESTED_AT',String(now));p.deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT');}
 progressContextMemory_=undefined;return recovered;
}

function resumeSnapshotJobs_(){
 const p=properties_();
 for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(p.getProperties())){
  if(!/_JOB$/.test(key))continue;let job;try{job=JSON.parse(value);}catch(_){continue;}
  if(!publicationNeedsReview_(job))continue;
  Object.assign(job,{state:'Publicando',publicationRetries:0,publicationRetriedAt:new Date().toISOString()});p.setProperty(key,JSON.stringify(job));
  if(key!=='LLM_JOB')snapshotJob_(key,job);
 }
 for(const job of collectionJobs_())if(job.estado==='Revisar'&&Number(JSON.parse(p.getProperty('PUBLICATION_RETRY:'+job.id)||'{}').count)>=3){job.estado='Publicando';const key='PUBLICATION_RETRY:'+job.id;p.setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...JSON.parse(p.getProperty(key)),count:0,at:new Date().toISOString()}));writeCollectionJob_(job);}
 progressContextMemory_=undefined;
}
