const SOURCE_QUALITY=Object.freeze({rows:5000,seconds:120});
function sourceQualityData_(days,now=Date.now()){
 const started=Date.now(),limit=Math.min(settings_().eventLimit,SOURCE_QUALITY.rows),since=now-days*86400000,within=(row,key='fecha')=>{const value=Date.parse(row[key]);return value>=since&&value<=now;},feeds=configuredFeeds_(),groups=new Map(),entry=name=>{if(!groups.has(name)){const feed=feeds.find(row=>row.name===name);groups.set(name,{source:name,country:feed?.country||'',enabled:feed?.enabled??false,queries:0,attempts:0,successful:0,errors:0,retrieved:0,relevant:0,discarded:0,duplicates:0,reasons:{},lastQuery:'',lastNews:'',publishers:new Set(),news:0,local:0,unknown:0,coverageQueries:0,saturated:0});}return groups.get(name);};
 feeds.forEach(feed=>entry(feed.name));
 const audit=rows_('Auditoria',limit),tasks=rows_('Recopilacion',limit),coverage=rows_('Cobertura',limit),runs=rows_('Ejecuciones',limit),seen=new Set();
 for(const row of audit.filter(row=>within(row)&&row.resultado==='Fuente consultada')){
  const key=JSON.stringify([row.ejecucion,row.fecha,row.fuente,row.url]);if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);
  const group=entry(row.fuente),value=String(row.motivo||''),number=label=>Number(value.match(new RegExp('(\\d+) '+label))?.[1]||0);group.queries++;group.retrieved+=number('evaluadas');group.relevant+=number('relevantes');group.discarded+=number('excluidas');group.duplicates+=number('duplicadas');if(row.fecha>group.lastQuery)group.lastQuery=row.fecha;
  const raw=value.match(/; motivos (\{.*\})(?:; posible|$)/)?.[1];if(raw)try{for(const [reason,count] of Object.entries(JSON.parse(raw)))if(Number.isFinite(Number(count)))group.reasons[reason]=(group.reasons[reason]||0)+Number(count);}catch(_){}
 }
 // Attempts are ingestion attempts recorded by the existing task cursor, not redirects.
 for(const row of tasks.filter(row=>within(row,"actualizada")&&row.estado!=="Omitida")){
  const attempts=Math.max(0,Number(row.intentos)||0);if(!attempts)continue;const group=entry(row.fuente),successful=row.estado==="Completada"?1:0;group.attempts+=attempts;group.successful+=successful;group.errors+=Math.max(0,attempts-successful);if(row.actualizada>group.lastQuery)group.lastQuery=row.actualizada;
 }
 for(const row of coverage.filter(row=>within(row))){const group=entry(row.fuente);if(['OK','Parcial'].includes(row.estado)){group.coverageQueries++;if(row.saturada==='sí')group.saturated++;}}
 const sheet=newsSheet_(),count=Math.min(limit,Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1)),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias;
 if(count){
  const first=sheet.getLastRow()-count+1,metadata=sheet.getRange(first,keys.indexOf('fecha')+1,count,3).getDisplayValues(),sources=sheet.getRange(first,keys.indexOf('fuente')+1,count,1).getDisplayValues(),labels=sheet.getRange(first,keys.indexOf('clasificacion')+1,count,1).getDisplayValues();
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const [fecha,pais,medio]=metadata[i];if(!within({fecha}))continue;const group=entry(sources[i][0]),provenance=savedNewsLabels_(labels[i][0]).procedencia||{},confirmed=['high','medium'].includes(provenance.paisConfianza);group.news++;if(medio)group.publishers.add(medio);if(fecha>group.lastNews)group.lastNews=fecha;if(!pais||pais===settings_().unknownCountry||provenance.scope==='unknown')group.unknown++;if(confirmed&&pais===group.country)group.local++;}
 }
 const percentage=(n,d)=>d?Math.round(1000*n/d)/10:null,items=[...groups.values()].map(group=>({...group,publishers:group.publishers.size,availability:percentage(group.successful,group.attempts),localPercent:group.country&&group.country!==settings_().unknownCountry?percentage(group.local,group.news):null,unknownPercent:percentage(group.unknown,group.news),saturationPercent:percentage(group.saturated,group.coverageQueries)})).sort((a,b)=>a.source.localeCompare(b.source,'es'));
 const dates=audit.map(row=>row.fecha).filter(Boolean).sort(),timings=runs.filter(row=>within(row,'inicio')).map(row=>Date.parse(row.fin)-Date.parse(row.inicio)).filter(value=>Number.isFinite(value)&&value>=0).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
 return {items,days,since:new Date(since).toISOString(),retainedFrom:dates[0]||null,limited:[audit,tasks,coverage,runs].some(rows=>rows.length===limit)||count===limit,limit,retentionDays:settings_().retentionDays,cycles:{n:timings.length,medianMs:timings.length?timings[Math.floor(timings.length/2)]:null,p95Ms:timings.length>=20?timings[Math.ceil(timings.length*.95)-1]:null},measurement:{serverMs:Date.now()-started,rows:audit.length+tasks.length+coverage.length+runs.length+count,readRanges:count?7:4}};
}
function getSourceQuality(query={}){
 authorize_(true);const days=query.days?Number(query.days):30;if(![7,30,90].includes(days))throw Error('Período de calidad no válido.');
 const now=Date.now(),cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='source-quality:'+RADAR.version+':'+configurationRevision_()+':'+days+':'+Math.floor(now/(SOURCE_QUALITY.seconds*1000));let data=readDashboardCache_(cache,key),cacheHit=Boolean(data);
 if(!data){data=sourceQualityData_(days,now);writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,data);}
 const status=String(query.status||''),matches={never:row=>!row.news&&!row.retrieved,errors:row=>row.errors>0,news:row=>row.news>0};if(status&&!matches[status])throw Error('Estado de fuente no válido.');
 const base=filterRecords(data.items,query,['source'],['source','country']),items=status?base.filter(matches[status]):base,sum=key=>base.reduce((n,row)=>n+row[key],0),queries=sum('queries'),errors=sum('errors');
 const overview=base.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.news-a.news||b.retrieved-a.retrieved||a.source.localeCompare(b.source,'es')).slice(0,8).map(({source,news,queries,errors,lastNews})=>({source,news,queries,errors,lastNews}));
 return {...data,...recordPage(items,query,ADMIN_PAGE_SIZE),overview,cacheHit,options:{source:data.items.map(row=>row.source),status:[['never','Sin noticias'],['errors','Con errores'],['news','Con noticias']]},metrics:{sources:base.length,never:base.filter(matches.never).length,withErrors:base.filter(matches.errors).length,news:sum('news'),queries,errors,retrieved:sum('retrieved'),relevant:sum('relevant'),discarded:sum('discarded'),duplicates:sum('duplicates'),saturated:sum('saturated')}};
}

function collectionPeriod_(range){
  if(!range)return 'when:'+settings_().windowDays+'d';
  return 'after:'+new Date(Date.parse(range.from)-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10)+' before:'+new Date(Date.parse(range.to)+86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
}
function profileFeed_(geo,entity,range,capabilitySearch=false) {
  const quote=value=>'"'+value.replace(/"/g,'')+'"';
  const period=collectionPeriod_(range);
  const terms=capabilitySearch?capabilitySearchTerms_(geo,entity):collectionSearchTerms_(geo);
  if(!terms.length)return null;
  const language=geo.language.split('-')[0],scopes=collectionLanguageMemory_.scopes;
  if(capabilitySearch&&!scopes.has(language))scopes.set(language,localizedSearchTerms_(configuration_().segments.filter(row=>row.enabled).flatMap(row=>row.terms),geo,true).slice(0,6));
  if(capabilitySearch&&!scopes.get(language).length)return null;
  const scope=capabilitySearch?' ('+scopes.get(language).map(quote).join(' OR ')+')':'';
  // Fechas al principio y OR agrupados: el proveedor no debe ampliar el período por una alternativa.
  const prefix=period+(geo.code==='UY'?' "Uruguay"':'')+' ('+[entity.name,...entity.aliases].slice(0,COLLECTION_POLICY.entityAliases+1).map(quote).join(' OR ')+') (',selected=[];let length=prefix.length+1+scope.length;
  for(const term of terms){const value=quote(term),size=value.length+(selected.length?4:0);if(length+size>COLLECTION_POLICY.queryChars)continue;selected.push(value);length+=size;}
  if(!selected.length)return null;const query=prefix+selected.join(' OR ')+')'+scope;
  // Google News no publica edición UY; su redirección legítima utiliza US en español latinoamericano.
  const code=geo.code==='UY'?'US':geo.code;
  const url=canonicalUrl_('https://news.google.com/rss/search?q='+encodeURIComponent(query)+'&hl='+geo.language+'&gl='+code+'&ceid='+code+':'+geo.language);
  return {id:'profile/'+geo.code+'/'+entity.name,name:entity.name+' · '+geo.name,url,domain:'news.google.com',entity:entity.name,country:geo.name,kind:'profile',language:geo.language,capabilitySearch,enabled:entity.enabled&&geo.enabled};
}
let collectionLanguageMemory_;
function localizedSearchTerms_(terms,geo,strict=false){
  const config=configuration_();if(collectionLanguageMemory_?.config!==config){
    const terms=new Map();
    for(const row of config.searchLanguages.filter(row=>row.enabled))for(const term of row.terms){const key=searchText_(term);if(!terms.has(key))terms.set(key,new Set());terms.get(key).add(row.language);}
    collectionLanguageMemory_={config,terms,scopes:new Map()};
  }
  const language=geo.language.split('-')[0],native=[],english=[],custom=[];
  for(const term of terms){if(strict&&language!=='es'&&/[()]/.test(term))continue;const languages=collectionLanguageMemory_.terms.get(searchText_(term));if(!languages){if((!strict||language==='es')&&!/[()]/.test(term))custom.push(term);}else if(languages.has(language))native.push(term);else if(languages.has('en'))english.push(term);}
  return ['it','de','fr','pt','tr'].includes(language)?native:[...native,...english,...custom];
}
function collectionSearchTerms_(geo){
  const local=(configuration_().searchLanguages.find(row=>row.enabled&&row.language===geo.language.split('-')[0])?.terms||[]).slice(0,COLLECTION_POLICY.localTerms),terms=localizedSearchTerms_([...new Set(settings_().searchTerms)],geo),count=Math.min(terms.length,Math.max(0,COLLECTION_POLICY.searchTerms-local.length));
  return [...new Set([...local,...Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>terms[Math.floor(i*terms.length/count)])])];
}
let catalogueSearchMemory_;
function catalogueSearchRows_(){
  const config=configuration_(),revision=taxonomyMemory_?.revision||properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_REVISION')||'0';if(catalogueSearchMemory_?.config===config&&catalogueSearchMemory_.revision===revision)return catalogueSearchMemory_.rows;
  // Every catalogue ID participates; aliases improve recall without changing the canonical names.
  const rows=config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>[
    ...block.functions.map(row=>({key:row.id,terms:[...new Set([...row.terms,row.name.replace(/^Landing(?: de)?\s*/i,'')])]})),
    ...block.emerging.map(row=>({key:block.name+'|'+row.name,terms:row.terms}))
  ]).filter(row=>row.terms.length);
  const admitted=new Map(config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.emerging.map(row=>[block.name+'|'+taxonomyText(row.name),row])));
  for(const row of taxonomyCatalog_().filter(row=>row.origen==='tf-idf')){const key=row.palanca+'|'+taxonomyText(row.subpalanca.replace(/^\d{2}\.xx\s+/,'')),concept=admitted.get(key),entry=rows.find(item=>item.key===row.palanca+'|'+concept?.name);if(entry)entry.priority=Number(row.peso)||0;}
  catalogueSearchMemory_={config,revision,rows};return rows;
}
function capabilitySearchTerms_(geo,entity){
  const capabilities=businessIndex_().capabilities,catalogue=catalogueSearchRows_();
  if(!capabilities.length&&!catalogue.length)return [];
  const seed=[entity.name,geo.code].join('|'),day=Math.floor(Date.parse(recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone))/86400000),hash=[...seed].reduce((sum,char)=>sum*31+char.charCodeAt(0),0)>>>0;
  const terms=new Set(),base=new Set(collectionSearchTerms_(geo).map(searchText_)),limit=COLLECTION_POLICY.capabilityTerms,problems=configuration_().signals.filter(row=>row.enabled&&row.group==='Problema').map(row=>({terms:row.terms.map(term=>term.replace(/\*/g,''))})),reserve=problems.length?1:0;
  const add=(rows,budget)=>{
    if(!rows.length)return;const offset=(hash+day*budget)%rows.length;
    for(let i=0,added=0;i<rows.length&&added<budget;i++){
      const row=rows[(offset+i)%rows.length],choices=localizedSearchTerms_(row.terms,geo,true),term=choices.find(value=>!base.has(searchText_(value))&&!terms.has(value));
      if(term){terms.add(term);added++;}
    }
  };
  const priorities=catalogue.filter(row=>row.priority>0).sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority||a.key.localeCompare(b.key));
  add(priorities,priorities.length?1:0);add(catalogue,Math.ceil((limit-reserve)/2)-terms.size);add(capabilities,limit-reserve-terms.size);add(problems,limit-terms.size);
  return [...terms];
}
function defaultFeeds_(range) {
  const config=configuration_(),disabled=new Set(config.settings.disabledSources);
  const profiles=config.entities.flatMap(entity=>config.geographies.filter(geo=>entity.countries.includes(geo.name)).map(geo=>{const feed=profileFeed_(geo,entity,range);return {...feed,enabled:feed.enabled&&!disabled.has(feed.id)};})),covered=new Set(profiles.filter(feed=>feed.enabled).map(feed=>feed.country));
  return config.feeds.map(feed=>countryScopedSource_({...feed,kind:'rss',enabled:feed.enabled&&config.geographies.find(geo=>geo.name===feed.country)?.enabled!==false})).concat(profiles,config.geographies.filter(geo=>geo.enabled&&!covered.has(geo.name)).map(geo=>geographyFeed_(geo,range)).filter(Boolean).map(feed=>({...feed,enabled:!disabled.has(feed.id)})));
}
function geographyFeed_(geo,range){
 const config=configuration_(),quote=value=>'"'+String(value).replace(/["*]/g,'')+'"',scope=localizedSearchTerms_(config.segments.filter(row=>row.enabled).flatMap(row=>row.terms),geo,true).slice(0,6),channel=localizedSearchTerms_(config.searchLanguages.filter(row=>row.enabled).flatMap(row=>row.terms).filter(term=>businessIndex_().relevance.channel.test(searchText_(term))),geo,true).slice(0,6);
 if(!scope.length||!channel.length)return null;
 const places=[...new Set([geo.searchName,...(geo.terms||[]).filter(term=>term.length>3)].filter(Boolean))].slice(0,3),query=collectionPeriod_(range)+' ('+places.map(quote).join(' OR ')+') ('+scope.map(quote).join(' OR ')+') ('+channel.map(quote).join(' OR ')+')',code=geo.code==='UY'?'US':geo.code;
 if(query.length>COLLECTION_POLICY.queryChars)throw Error('Consulta geográfica demasiado larga.');
 return {id:'geography/'+geo.code,name:'BEI · '+geo.name,url:canonicalUrl_('https://news.google.com/rss/search?q='+encodeURIComponent(query)+'&hl='+geo.language+'&gl='+code+'&ceid='+code+':'+geo.language),domain:'news.google.com',entity:'Sector',country:geo.name,language:geo.language,kind:'rss',geographySearch:true,enabled:geo.enabled};
}

  if(!Array.isArray(enabledIds)||enabledIds.length>all.length||enabledIds.some(id=>!known.has(id)))throw Error('Configuración de fuentes no válida.');
  const enabled=new Set(enabledIds);config.feeds.forEach(feed=>feed.enabled=enabled.has(feed.id));config.settings.disabledSources=[...new Set([...all.filter(feed=>feed.kind==='profile').map(feed=>feed.id),...config.geographies.map(geo=>'geography/'+geo.code)])].filter(id=>!enabled.has(id));
  writeConfiguration_(config,configurationRevision_());return enabled.size+' fuentes seleccionadas. Entidades y países desactivados permanecen desactivados.';
}

  return writeConfiguration_(config,configurationRevision_());
}

function countryScopedSource_(feed){
 if(feed.country!=='Uruguay'||!domainMatches_(feed.url,'news.google.com'))return feed;
 return {...feed,url:feed.url.replace(/([?&](?:gl|ceid)=)UY(?=:|%3A|&|$)/gi,'$1US').replace(/([?&]q=)([^&]*)/,(_,prefix,value)=>{
  const query=decodeURIComponent(value.replace(/\+/g,' '));return prefix+encodeURIComponent(/\buruguay\b/i.test(query)?query:query+' "Uruguay"');
 })};
}

let radarBook_;

function setupRadar() {
  const p=properties_(), email=Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase();
  if (p.getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL') && p.getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL')!==email) throw new Error('Solo el propietario puede inicializar.');
  if(p.getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL'))authorize_(true);
  else if(Session.getActiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase()!==email)throw new Error('Inicializa desde el editor con la cuenta propietaria.');
  const folder=archiveFolder_(CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.storage.primaryFolderId),existing=p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
  const book=existing?SpreadsheetApp.openById(existing):(SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet() || SpreadsheetApp.create('BBVA Empresas · News Radar'));
  radarBook_=book;
  fileInFolder_(book.getId(),folder);
  p.setProperties({OWNER_EMAIL:email,SPREADSHEET_ID:book.getId()});
  initializeConfiguration();
  book.setSpreadsheetTimeZone(settings_().timezone);
  Object.entries(RADAR.sheets).forEach(([name,headers])=>{
    let sheet=book.getSheetByName(name);
    if (sheet) {
      const actual=sheet.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).getValues()[0];
      if (actual.some((value,i)=>value && value!==headers[i])) throw new Error('Estructura inesperada en '+name+'.');
      sheet.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).setValues([headers]).setFontWeight('bold').setBackground(SHEET_THEME.background).setFontColor(SHEET_THEME.foreground);
      return;
    }
    sheet=book.insertSheet(name);sheet.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).setValues([headers]).setFontWeight('bold').setBackground(SHEET_THEME.background).setFontColor(SHEET_THEME.foreground);sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
  });
  return 'News Radar preparado: fuentes predeterminadas, recopilación automática y métricas.';
}
function rows_(sheet, limit, width=RADAR.sheets[sheet].length,period=null) {
  if(sheet==='Noticias'&&period){const rows=newsRowsForPeriod_(period);for(const row of rows)delete row._sheetRow;return rows;}
  const s=recordSheet_(sheet), count=s.getLastRow()-1;
  if (count<1) return [];
  const size=limit?Math.min(count,limit):count;
  const keys=RADAR.sheets[sheet].slice(0,width);
  return s.getRange(count-size+2,1,size,keys.length).getDisplayValues().map(r=>Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k,i)=>[k,r[i]])));
}
function append_(name,rows){
 const valid=rows.filter(row=>Array.isArray(row)&&row.some(cell=>cell!==''&&cell!=null));if(!valid.length)return;
 const lock=LockService.getScriptLock(),owned=Boolean(foregroundWriteDepth_||lock.hasLock?.());
 if(!owned&&!lock.tryLock(10000))throw Error('No se ha podido bloquear la escritura de '+name+'.');
 try{
  if(NEWSLETTER_ARCHIVE_TABLES.includes(name))markNewsletterArchiveEdited_();
  const sheet=recordSheet_(name),start=sheet.getLastRow()+1,needed=start+valid.length-1;
  if(needed>sheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),needed-sheet.getMaxRows());
  sheet.getRange(start,1,valid.length,valid[0].length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(valid.map(row=>row.map(safeCell_)));
  enforceLogLimit_(name,sheet);if(name==='Ejecuciones')CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('dashboard-runs:'+RADAR.version);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
 }finally{if(!owned)lock.releaseLock();}
}

function rowsById_(name,ids,limit=Infinity,includePosition=false){
  const sheet=recordSheet_(name),count=Math.min(Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),limit),keys=RADAR.sheets[name],result=[];
  if(!count||!ids.size)return result;
  const first=sheet.getLastRow()-count+1,positions=sheet.getRange(first,1,count,1).getDisplayValues().flatMap(([id],index)=>ids.has(id)?[first+index]:[]);
  let start=0;
  for(let end=1;end<=positions.length;end++){
    if(end<positions.length&&positions[end]===positions[end-1]+1)continue;
    for(const [offset,row] of sheet.getRange(positions[start],1,end-start,keys.length).getDisplayValues().entries())result.push({...Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,index)=>[key,row[index]])),...(includePosition?{_sheetRow:positions[start]+offset}:{})});
    start=end;
  }
  return result;
}

function newsRowsForCandidates_(candidates){
 const last=newsSheet_().getLastRow(),positions=[...new Set(candidates.map(candidate=>candidate.row).filter(row=>Number.isInteger(row)&&row>=2&&row<=last))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),physical=new Map(newsRowsAt_(positions).map(row=>[row._sheetRow,row])),articles=new Map(),displaced=new Set();
 for(const candidate of candidates){const row=physical.get(candidate.row);if(row?.id===candidate.id)articles.set(candidate.id,row);else displaced.add(candidate.id);}
 if(displaced.size)for(const row of rowsById_('Noticias',displaced,Infinity,true))articles.set(row.id,row);
 return articles;
}

function cacheJsonValue_(value){
  const encoded=JSON.stringify(value);
  return encoded.length<=90000&&encodeURIComponent(encoded).replace(/%[A-F\d]{2}/gi,'x').length<=90000?encoded:null;
}
function cacheJson_(key,value,seconds){const encoded=cacheJsonValue_(value);if(encoded)try{CacheService.getScriptCache().put(key,encoded,seconds);}catch(_){}}

function sheetRowRanges_(positions,gap=8){
  if(!positions.length)return [];
  const dense=positions.at(-1)-positions[0]+1<=Math.max(2000,positions.length*4),ranges=[];let start=0;
  for(let end=1;end<=positions.length;end++){
    if(end<positions.length&&positions[end]-positions[start]<2000&&(dense||positions[end]-positions[end-1]<=gap))continue;
    ranges.push([positions[start],positions[end-1]]);start=end;
  }
  return ranges;
}

function newsWorkRows_(job,limit){
  const selected=[],days=newsRecordIndex_().days;
  scan:for(const day of Object.keys(days).sort().reverse()){
    if(job.cursor&&day>job.cursor.date)continue;
    for(const [first,last] of days[day].slice().reverse())for(let row=Math.min(last,job.total+1);row>=Math.max(first,job.firstRow||2);row--){
      if(job.cursor&&day===job.cursor.date&&row>=job.cursor.row)continue;
      selected.push({day,row});if(selected.length>=limit)break scan;
    }
  }
  const rows=new Map(newsRowsAt_(selected.map(item=>item.row).sort((a,b)=>a-b),64).map(row=>[row._sheetRow,row]));return selected.map(item=>rows.get(item.row));
}

function newsWorkCursor_(row){return {date:row.fecha,row:row._sheetRow};}

function writeNewsCells_(updates){
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),ordered=updates.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.column-b.column||a.row-b.row);
  for(let start=0;start<ordered.length;){
    let end=start+1;while(end<ordered.length&&ordered[end].column===ordered[start].column&&ordered[end].row-ordered[end-1].row<=64&&ordered[end].row-ordered[start].row<250)end++;
    const first=ordered[start].row,column=ordered[start].column,size=ordered[end-1].row-first+1,values=size===end-start?ordered.slice(start,end).map(item=>[item.value]):sheet.getRange(first,column,size,1).getDisplayValues();
    if(size!==end-start)for(const item of ordered.slice(start,end))values[item.row-first]=[item.value];
    sheet.getRange(first,column,size,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values);start=end;
  }
}

// Shared membership index: translations and functional analysis only read business articles.
function businessNewsIndex_(){
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),job=classificationJob_();
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='business-news-index:'+newsStorageKey_()+':'+RADAR.version+':'+(properties_().getProperty('NEWS_CONTENT_REVISION')||'0')+':'+(job?.revision||'0')+':'+(job?.next||0)+':'+count,cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);if(cached)return cached;
  if(!count)return {rows:[],revision:sha256_('[]')};
  const labels=sheet.getRange(2,RADAR.sheets.Noticias.indexOf('clasificacion')+1,count,1).getDisplayValues(),dates=sheet.getRange(2,1,count,2).getDisplayValues(),captured=sheet.getRange(2,RADAR.sheets.Noticias.indexOf('capturada')+1,count,1).getDisplayValues();
  const rows=dates.flatMap(([id,fecha],index)=>id&&businessNews_({clasificacion:labels[index][0]})?[{id,fecha,captured:captured[index][0],row:index+2,priority:0}]:[]).sort((a,b)=>b.fecha.localeCompare(a.fecha)||b.row-a.row);
  const value={rows,revision:sha256_(JSON.stringify(rows.map(row=>[row.id,row.fecha,row.row])))};writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,value);return value;
}

function subscriptionDates_(row,attempts,now=new Date()){
  return Object.keys(newsletterCadences).map(periodicidad=>{const subscription={...row,periodicidad},period=newsletterPeriod_(periodicidad,now);return newsletterNextDate_(subscription,now,newsletterDeliveryAttempt_(subscription,period,attempts));}).filter(Boolean).sort()[0]||'';
}
function getSubscriptions(){const email=authorize_().email,deliveries=rows_('NewsletterEnvios',undefined,8),attempts=newsletterDeliveryAttempts_(deliveries);return subscriptionRows_(email).map(row=>({...row,nextDelivery:subscriptionDates_(row,attempts),ultimaEntrega:deliveries.filter(item=>item.correo===email).at(-1)||null}));}
function getAdminSubscriptions(){authorize_(true);const deliveries=rows_('NewsletterEnvios',undefined,8),attempts=newsletterDeliveryAttempts_(deliveries);return subscriptionRows_().map(row=>({...row,nextDelivery:subscriptionDates_(row,attempts),ultimaEntrega:deliveries.filter(item=>item.correo===row.correo).at(-1)||null}));}
function subscriptionRecord_(input,email,id,now){
  const language=input.language||'es',country=String(input.country||'');
  if(!supportedLanguage(language))throw Error('Idioma no admitido.');
  if(country&&!newsletterCountries_().includes(country))throw Error('Geografía no disponible para Empresas e instituciones.');
  return {id,correo:email,nombre:'Mi Newsletter'+(country?' · '+country:''),filtros:subscriptionFilters_({country}),periodicidad:'all',activa:input.active!==false,actualizada:now.toISOString(),idioma:language};
}
function newsletterPeriod_(periodicity,now){return newsletterWindow(periodicity,recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),true);}
function subscriptionQuery_(subscription,now,closed=false){const periodicity=subscription.periodicidad,period=newsletterWindow(periodicity,recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),closed);return {...subscriptionFilters_(subscription.filtros),from:period.from,to:period.to,view:newsletterCadences[periodicity].view};}
function newsletterDeliveryId_(subscription,period){return subscription.id+':'+subscription.periodicidad+':'+period.from;}
function newsletterSubscriptionIds_(subscription){return [subscription.id,...(subscription.filtros?.aliases||[])];}
function newsletterAttemptPriority_(row){return !row?0:row.estado==='Enviada'?4:row.estado==='Sin novedades'?3:['Enviando','Revisar'].includes(row.estado)?2:1;}
function newsletterDeliveryAttempts_(deliveries){
  const attempts=new Map();for(const row of deliveries)if(newsletterAttemptPriority_(row)>=newsletterAttemptPriority_(attempts.get(row.id)))attempts.set(row.id,row);return attempts;
}
function newsletterDeliveryAttempt_(subscription,period,attempts){
  let selected;for(const id of newsletterSubscriptionIds_(subscription)){const attempt=attempts.get(newsletterDeliveryId_({...subscription,id},period));if(newsletterAttemptPriority_(attempt)>newsletterAttemptPriority_(selected))selected=attempt;}return selected;
}
function newsletterNextDate_(subscription,now,last){
  if(!subscription.activa)return '';
  const day=recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),period=newsletterPeriod_(subscription.periodicidad,now),completed=newsletterSubscriptionIds_(subscription).some(id=>last?.id===newsletterDeliveryId_({...subscription,id},period))&&!['No enviado','Bloqueada'].includes(last.estado);
  const available=completed||new Date(subscription.actualizada)>=new Date(period.cutoff)?newsletterWindow(subscription.periodicidad,day).available:period.available;
  return day>available?day:available;
}
function writeSubscription_(input,admin){
  const session=authorize_(admin),email=admin?newsletterEmail_(input.email):session.email;
  return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    const rows=subscriptionRows_(),index=rows.findIndex(row=>admin&&input.id?row.id===input.id:row.correo===email);
    if(input.id&&(index<0||rows[index].id!==input.id))throw Error('Suscripción no encontrada.');
    if(rows.some((row,i)=>i!==index&&row.correo===email))throw Error('Ya existe una suscripción para ese correo.');
    const record=subscriptionRecord_(input,email,index>=0?rows[index].id:Utilities.getUuid(),new Date());if(index>=0){const original=JSON.parse(book_().getSheetByName('Suscripciones').getRange(index+2,4,1,1).getDisplayValues()[0][0]);if(original.aliases?.length)record.filtros.aliases=original.aliases;}const values=RADAR.sheets.Suscripciones.map(key=>key==='filtros'?JSON.stringify(record[key]):record[key]);
    if(index<0)append_('Suscripciones',[values]);else book_().getSheetByName('Suscripciones').getRange(index+2,1,1,values.length).setValues([values]);
    properties_().setProperty('SUBSCRIPTIONS_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());refreshNewsletterStatus_();return 'Suscripción guardada. Recibirás las ediciones quincenal y trimestral.';
  });
}
function saveSubscription(input){return writeSubscription_(input,false);}
function saveAdminSubscription(input){return writeSubscription_(input,true);}
function deleteSubscription(id){
  const session=authorize_();return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{const rows=rows_('Suscripciones'),index=rows.findIndex(row=>row.correo===session.email&&(row.id===id||JSON.parse(row.filtros).aliases?.includes(id)));if(index<0)throw Error('Suscripción no encontrada.');book_().getSheetByName('Suscripciones').deleteRow(index+2);properties_().setProperty('SUBSCRIPTIONS_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());refreshNewsletterStatus_();return 'Suscripción eliminada.';});
}
function deleteAdminSubscription(id){authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{const index=rows_('Suscripciones').findIndex(row=>row.id===id);if(index<0)throw Error('Suscripción no encontrada.');book_().getSheetByName('Suscripciones').deleteRow(index+2);properties_().setProperty('SUBSCRIPTIONS_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());refreshNewsletterStatus_();return 'Suscripción eliminada.';});}

// Sparse statistics and bounded evidence; article bodies are never retained.
const TAXONOMY_POLICY=Object.freeze({version:'3.38.0',batchRows:100,maxMs:10000,maxCandidates:600,maxEmergingPerLever:3,minEmergingDocuments:3,minEmergingSources:2,maxTerms:24,checkpointRows:20,checkpointChars:40000,maxAssignments:3,maxOverlapLinks:32,overlapContainment:.8,overlapSizeRatio:.5});
const taxonomyDefinitionMemory=new WeakMap(),rankingIndexes=new WeakMap();
function taxonomyText(value){return String(value||'').normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/ı/g,'i');}
function financingPurpose(value){
 const text=taxonomyText(value),match=text.match(/\b(?:fraccionar|fraccionado|aplazar|aplazado|financiar|financiado)\s+(?:el\s+|un\s+|los\s+)?(?:pago|compra|deuda)s?\b|\b(?:aplazamiento|financiacion|fraccionamiento)\s+de\s+(?:pago|compra|deuda)s?\b|\b(?:pago|compra|deuda)s?\s+(?:fraccionad[oa]s?|aplazad[oa]s?|a plazos|en cuotas)\b|\b(?:payment|purchase|debt)\s+(?:instalments?|installments?|deferral|deferred)\b|\binstal?lments? payments? plans?\b|\bdeferred payments?\b|\bbnpl\b|\bbuy now pay later\b/);
 if(!match||/\b(?:no|sin|not|without)\s+(?:(?:se|permite|ofrece|allow|offer)\s+)?(?:fraccionar|aplazar|financiar|defer|deferred|instalments?|installments?|bnpl)\b/.test(text))return null;
 return {evidence:match[0],confirming:/\bconfirming\b/.test(text)&&/\b(?:comprador|buyer|facturas?|invoices?)\b/.test(text)};
}
// Instrument, interface and audience are distinct from generic words such as
// payment, API or AI. Shared by admission, ranking and the conservative fallback.
function functionalContext(value){
 const text=taxonomyText(value),positive=text.replace(/\b(?:sin|without|no)\s+(?:any\s+)?(?:bank\s+)?(?:transferencias?|transfers?)(?:\s+entre cuentas)?\b/g,' ');
 const card=/\b(?:tarjetas?|cards?)\b/.test(text),transfer=/\b(?:transferencias?|transferir|traspasos?|traspasar|bank transfers?|wire transfers?|sepa transfer|spei|spid|swift transfers?)\b/.test(positive),acquiring=/\b(?:softpos|tpv|acquiring|adquirencia|card acceptance|aceptar pagos con tarjetas?|accept(?:ing)? card payments?|merchant services|payment terminals?|tap to (?:pay|phone))\b/.test(text)||card&&/\b(?:flat transaction rate|merchant fees|tasa de descuento|comisiones de aceptacion)\b/.test(text);
 const api=/\b(?:apis?|mcp|model context protocol|open banking|open finance)\b/.test(text);
 const bankingApi=api&&/\b(?:banking apis?|apis? bancarias?|corporate transaction banking|treasury|tesoreria|payments?|pagos?|account balances?|corporate accounts?|business accounts?|cuentas (?:bancarias|empresariales)|conto business|bank guarantee|trade finance|banking data|datos bancarios|conciliacion bancaria|bank reconciliation|concili[a-z]* (?:sus |las |de )?facturas?|reconcil[a-z]* (?:their )?invoices?|stock de pymes)\b/.test(text);
 const agent=/\b(?:agentic|ai[ -]agents?|agentes? de (?:ia|inteligencia artificial)|(?:banking|digital|virtual) assistants?|asistentes? (?:bancarios?|digitales?|virtuales?))\b/.test(text);
 const staffAgent=agent&&/\b(?:corporate bankers?|relationship managers?|credit risk managers?|gestores?|analistas?|empleados?|bank staff)\b/.test(text)&&/\b(?:credit (?:memos?|assessments?|analysis)|expedientes? de credito|analisis (?:de credito|crediticio)|evaluacion crediticia)\b/.test(text);
 const agentBanking=agent&&(/\b(?:account balances?|transaction history|banking tasks?|saldos? de cuentas?|historial de (?:operaciones|transacciones)|banking assistants?|asistentes? bancarios?)\b/.test(text)||staffAgent);
 return {card,transfer,acquiring,api,bankingApi,agent,staffAgent,agentBanking,financing:financingPurpose(text)};
}
const words=value=>taxonomyText(value).match(/[a-z][a-z0-9]+/g)||[];
function taxonomyDefinitions(blocks){
 if(taxonomyDefinitionMemory.has(blocks))return taxonomyDefinitionMemory.get(blocks);
 const definitions=blocks.flatMap(block=>[
  {key:block.name,palanca:block.name,subpalanca:'',segments:['Empresas'],terms:block.terms.map(taxonomyText),emerging:block.emerging},
  {key:block.name+'|Otros',palanca:block.name,subpalanca:block.name.slice(0,2)+'.xx Otros',segments:['Empresas'],terms:[],context:[],exclude:[],description:'Operativa del bloque sin suboperativa específica demostrada.',origin:'local'},
  ...block.functions.map(row=>({key:row.id,palanca:block.name,subpalanca:row.id+'.'+row.name,segments:['Empresas'],description:row.description||'',context:(row.context||[]).map(taxonomyText),exclude:(row.exclude||[]).map(taxonomyText),terms:[...new Set([taxonomyText(row.name),...row.terms.map(taxonomyText)])]}))
 ]);taxonomyDefinitionMemory.set(blocks,definitions);return definitions;
}
function taxonomySeed(state,definitions){state.catalog=definitions;}
function taxonomyTermCounts(text,terms){
 const counts=new Map();
 for(const term of terms){if(!term)continue;let at=-1,count=0;while((at=text.indexOf(term,at+1))>=0)if((at===0||!/[a-z0-9]/.test(text[at-1]))&&(at+term.length===text.length||!/[a-z0-9]/.test(text[at+term.length])))count++;if(count)counts.set(term,count);}
 return counts;
}
// Compile once per catalogue, then rank bounded phrases by specificity and headline evidence.
const rankingWord=word=>word.length>4?word.replace(/s$/,''):word;
const rankingStopWords=new Set(words('landing de del la el y para con que en un una los las por se su sus al es esta este como donde todos todas cliente clientes permite permitir funcionalidad funcionalidades operativa canal producto productos información desde hasta sobre entre también actualmente través mediante disponer tener haber ser estar poder así más banco banca bancario empresarial empresa negocio pymes digital solución nuevo nueva sistema plataforma servicio gestión operar realizar uso proceso acceso mejora ofrecer incluir disponible usuario titular pago cobro cuenta crédito financiación tarjeta transferencia operación dato forma opción utilizar solicitud consulta reporte seguimiento the and of for to in on with that this from into a an is are can be will has have their it by as at or our your all more new business businesses enterprise corporate bank banking customer client company companies service product solution platform system digital web online mobile app application internet movil telefono phone linea payment pay money finance financial credit account card operation data use offer enable provide process ve bir bu için ile banka bankacilik şirket işletme hizmet yeni ürün ödeme sistem plataforma servicio pagamento servico empresa novo nuova sistema piattaforma').map(rankingWord));
function rankingIndex(definitions){
 let index=rankingIndexes.get(definitions);if(index)return index;
 const frequencies=new Map(),phrases=new Map(),canonical=new Map(),labels=new Map(),contexts=new Map(),rows=definitions.filter(row=>row.subpalanca);const contextWords=value=>words(value).map(rankingWord).filter(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(word)&&word.length>2);
 for(const row of rows){
  const tokens=new Set();for(const term of row.terms){if(!phrases.has(term))phrases.set(term,words(term).map(rankingWord));for(const word of phrases.get(term))tokens.add(word);}
  for(const word of contextWords(row.description))tokens.add(word);contexts.set(row,new Set(contextWords(row.description)));
  for(const word of tokens)frequencies.set(word,(frequencies.get(word)||0)+1);
  labels.set(row,taxonomyText(row.subpalanca.replace(/^\d{2}\.(?:\d{2}|xx)[. ]*/,'')));canonical.set(row,new Set(words(row.subpalanca).map(rankingWord).filter(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(word))));
 }
 const weights=new Map([...phrases].map(([term,tokens])=>[term,tokens.reduce((sum,word)=>sum+1+Math.log((1+rows.length)/(1+(frequencies.get(word)||0))),0)/Math.max(1,tokens.length)*(1+Math.log(1+tokens.length))]));
 const idf=new Map([...frequencies].map(([word,count])=>[word,1+Math.log((1+rows.length)/(1+count))]));
 const norms=new Map([...contexts].map(([row,tokens])=>[row,[...tokens].reduce((sum,word)=>sum+(idf.get(word)||0)**2,0)]));const minimumIdf=Math.min(4.8,1+Math.log((1+rows.length)/2));for(const [row,tokens] of contexts)contexts.set(row,[...tokens].filter(word=>(idf.get(word)||0)>=minimumIdf));
 index={weights,phrases,canonical,labels,contexts,norms,idf,blocks:new Map(definitions.filter(row=>!row.subpalanca).map(row=>[row.palanca,row]))};rankingIndexes.set(definitions,index);return index;
}
// Prefer a demonstrated customer capability over its enabling instrument.
function functionalPrimary(value){
 const title=taxonomyText(value),rules=[
  ['11.',/\b(?:checkout|card acceptance|merchant acquiring|aceptacion (?:comercial|de (?:pagos|tarjetas))|adquirencia|softpos|tap to pay)\b/],
  ['11.',/\bgetnet\b.{0,100}\b(?:pagos|cobros|payments?|comercios)\b/],
  ['09.',/\b(?:virtual cards?|tarjetas? virtuales?)\b/],
  ['03.',/\b(?:pagos?|pagar|payments?|transferencias?|transferir|transfers?)\b.{0,80}\bbre-b\b/],
  ['03.',/\bbre-b\b.{0,80}\b(?:pagos?|pagar|payments?|transferencias?|transferir|transfers?)\b/],
  ['03.',/\btokeni[sz](?:ed|ados?|adas?) deposits?\b.{0,80}\b(?:payments?|transfers?|settle)\b/],
  ['03.',/\b(?:payments?|transfers?|settle)\b.{0,80}\btokeni[sz](?:ed|ados?|adas?) deposits?\b/]
 ];
 const financing=financingPurpose(title);if(financing)return {prefix:'08.',terms:[financing.evidence]};
 for(const [prefix,pattern] of rules){const match=title.match(pattern);if(match)return {prefix,terms:[match[0]]};}
 if(/\b(?:revamps?|revamped|upgraded|all-new|renueva|renovacion|transforma|transforms)\b/.test(title)&&/\b(?:app|platform|plataforma|banca|digital business banking)\b/.test(title)&&/\b(?:business banking|corporate banking|empresas)\b/.test(title)&&!/\b(?:pagos|payments|cuentas|accounts|tarjetas|cards|adquirencia|tpvs?|loans|prestamos)\b/.test(title))return {prefix:'01.',terms:[title]};
 if(/\b(?:app|plataforma|platform)\b/.test(title)&&/\b(?:gestion integral|gestion global|integrated management)\b/.test(title)&&/\b(?:business|corporate|empresas)\b/.test(title))return {prefix:'01.',terms:[title]};
 return null;
}
function taxonomyDecision(text,definitions,headline=''){
 const index=rankingIndex(definitions),title=taxonomyText(headline),tokens=new Set(words(text).map(rankingWord)),titleWords=new Set(words(title).map(rankingWord)),functional=functionalContext(text);let best,second;const ranked=[];
 for(const row of definitions){
  if(!row.subpalanca||/\.xx Otros$/.test(row.subpalanca))continue;
  if(row.context?.length&&!taxonomyTermCounts(text,row.context).size||row.exclude?.length&&taxonomyTermCounts(text,row.exclude).size)continue;
  if(/(?:^|\.)landing\b/i.test(row.subpalanca)&&!/(?:landing|dashboard|visi[oó]n integral|vista (?:global|agregada)|posici[oó]n (?:global|integrada)|aggregate|aggregated|overview|bütünleşik|genel bakış)/i.test(text))continue;
  const terms=row.terms.filter(term=>(row.context?.length||index.phrases.get(term)?.some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(word))||term===index.labels.get(row)&&index.phrases.get(term).length>1)&&!(row.subpalanca.startsWith('03.13.')&&functional.card&&!functional.transfer&&!/transfer|remittance/.test(term))),counts=taxonomyTermCounts(text,terms),context=index.contexts.get(row),shared=context.filter(word=>tokens.has(word));
  let semantic=0;if(shared.length>=3&&(!title||shared.some(word=>titleWords.has(word)))){const matched=shared.reduce((sum,word)=>sum+index.idf.get(word)**2,0),norm=index.norms.get(row);semantic=Math.sqrt(matched/Math.max(1,norm));}
  if(!counts.size&&semantic<.5)continue;
  const titleCounts=title?taxonomyTermCounts(title,[...counts.keys()]):new Map();
  let score=semantic*8,count=counts.size?0:shared.length;
  for(const [term,frequency]of counts){
   const nameEvidence=index.phrases.get(term)?.some(word=>index.canonical.get(row).has(word))?1.5:1,headlineEvidence=titleCounts.has(term)?4*(1+1/(1+title.indexOf(term)/80)):1;
   score+=(index.weights.get(term)||1)*(1+Math.log(frequency))*nameEvidence*headlineEvidence;count+=frequency;
  }
  const block=index.blocks.get(row.palanca);if(block&&taxonomyTermCounts(text,block.terms).size)score*=1.25;
  const evidence={terms:[...(titleCounts.size?titleCounts.keys():counts.size?counts.keys():shared.map(stem=>words(text).find(word=>rankingWord(word)===stem)))].slice(0,3),location:titleCounts.size?'headline':'text',method:counts.size?'literal':'description'},candidate={row,count,score,evidence};
  ranked.push(candidate);
  if(!best||score>best.score||score===best.score&&row.subpalanca.localeCompare(best.row.subpalanca,'es')<0){second=best;best=candidate;}else if(!second||score>second.score)second=candidate;
 }
 const distinct=second&&best.row.subpalanca.replace(/^\d{2}\.(?:\d{2}|xx)[. ]*/, '')!==second.row.subpalanca.replace(/^\d{2}\.(?:\d{2}|xx)[. ]*/, '');
 const ambiguous=best?.evidence.method==='description'&&distinct&&second.score>=best.score*.85;
 const matches=best&&!ambiguous?[best]:[];
 if(matches.length){
  const used=new Set(best.evidence.terms),ordered=ranked.filter(row=>row!==best).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.row.subpalanca.localeCompare(b.row.subpalanca,'es'));
  for(const candidate of ordered){
   if(matches.length>=TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxAssignments)break;
   const independent=candidate.score>=best.score*.35&&taxonomyIndependentEvidence(candidate.evidence,[...used]);
   if(!independent)continue;
   matches.push(candidate);for(const term of candidate.evidence.terms)used.add(term);
  }
 }
 // A block fallback requires a discriminating phrase, never a generic banking word.
 const used=new Set(matches.flatMap(match=>match.evidence.terms));
 for(const block of index.blocks.values()){
  if(functional.staffAgent&&block.palanca.startsWith('17.')||block.palanca.startsWith('09.')&&(functional.transfer||functional.acquiring))continue;
  if(matches.some(match=>match.row.palanca===block.palanca)||matches.length>=TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxAssignments)continue;
  const concepts=(block.emerging||[]).filter(concept=>!(functional.staffAgent&&block.palanca.startsWith('17.')&&concept.name==='Agentes de IA')&&(!concept.context?.length||taxonomyTermCounts(text,concept.context.map(taxonomyText)).size)&&!taxonomyTermCounts(text,(concept.exclude||[]).map(taxonomyText)).size);
  const terms=[...taxonomyTermCounts(text,[...block.terms,...concepts.flatMap(concept=>concept.terms.map(taxonomyText))]).keys()].filter(term=>words(term).some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(rankingWord(word))));
  const evidence={terms:terms.slice(0,3),method:'literal',location:terms.some(term=>title.includes(term))?'headline':'text'};
  if(!terms.length||matches.length&&!taxonomyIndependentEvidence(evidence,[...used]))continue;
  const row=definitions.find(row=>row.palanca===block.palanca&&/\.xx Otros$/.test(row.subpalanca));
  if(row){matches.push({row,count:terms.length,score:0,evidence});for(const term of evidence.terms)used.add(term);}
 }
 const financing=financingPurpose(text),focus=financing?{prefix:'08.',terms:[financing.evidence]}:functionalPrimary(headline);
 if(focus){
  const primary=financing?(financing.confirming?matches.find(match=>match.row.subpalanca.startsWith('08.37.')):null):matches.find(match=>match.row.palanca.startsWith(focus.prefix)),row=primary?.row||financing?.confirming&&definitions.find(row=>row.subpalanca.startsWith('08.37.'))||definitions.find(row=>row.palanca.startsWith(focus.prefix)&&/\.xx Otros$/.test(row.subpalanca));
  if(row){const selected=primary||{row,count:1,score:0,evidence:{terms:focus.terms,method:'literal',location:'headline'}};const secondary=[],used=[...selected.evidence.terms];for(const match of matches)if(match!==primary&&(!financing||!/^(03|09)\./.test(match.row.palanca)||/transferencia|transfer\b/.test(match.evidence.terms.join(' ')))&&taxonomyIndependentEvidence(match.evidence,used)){secondary.push(match);used.push(...match.evidence.terms);}matches.splice(0,matches.length,selected,...secondary.slice(0,TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxAssignments-1));}
 }
 return {matches,reason:matches.length?'matched':ambiguous?'ambiguous':'insufficient'};
}
const evidenceWord=word=>word.length>5?rankingWord(word).replace(/[oa]$/,''):rankingWord(word);
function taxonomyIndependentEvidence(evidence,used){
 return evidence.method==='literal'&&evidence.terms.some(term=>words(term).length>=2&&words(term).some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(rankingWord(word)))&&!used.some(previous=>words(previous).some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(rankingWord(word))&&words(term).map(evidenceWord).includes(evidenceWord(word)))));
}
function taxonomyMatches(text,definitions,headline=''){return taxonomyDecision(text,definitions,headline).matches;}
function taxonomyObserve(state,text,definitions,excludedWords,evidence='',options={}){
 taxonomySeed(state,definitions);
 const matched=taxonomyMatches(text,definitions,options.headline);if(!matched.length&&!definitions.some(row=>!row.subpalanca&&(taxonomyTermCounts(text,row.terms).size||row.emerging.some(concept=>taxonomyTermCounts(text,concept.terms.map(taxonomyText)).size))))return false;
 state.documents++;state.size=Object.keys(state.candidates).length;
 const observed=[];
 const observe=(entry,count)=>{
  let stats=state.candidates[entry.key];
  if(!stats){if(state.size>=definitions.length+TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxCandidates)return;stats=state.candidates[entry.key]={...entry,df:0,tf:0,sources:[]};state.size++;}
  stats.primaryEvidence=Boolean(stats.primaryEvidence||entry.primaryEvidence);stats.df++;stats.tf+=1+Math.log(count);observed.push(stats);
 };
 for(const {row,count}of matched)observe({...row,origin:'regla'},count);
 for(const a of observed)for(const b of observed){if(a===b)continue;a.overlap=a.overlap||{};if(Object.hasOwn(a.overlap,b.key)||Object.keys(a.overlap).length<TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxOverlapLinks)a.overlap[b.key]=(a.overlap[b.key]||0)+1;}
 return true;
}
function taxonomyBuild(state){
 const candidates=new Map((state.catalog||[]).map(row=>[row.key,{...row,origin:'regla',df:0,tf:0}]));
 for(const row of Object.values(state.candidates))candidates.set(row.key,row);
 const rows=[...candidates.values()].map(row=>({...row,peso:Number((row.tf/Math.max(1,state.documents)*(Math.log((1+state.documents)/(1+row.df))+1)).toFixed(6))}));
 const anchors=rows.filter(row=>row.origin==='regla');
 return anchors.sort((a,b)=>a.palanca.localeCompare(b.palanca,'es')||a.subpalanca.localeCompare(b.subpalanca,'es'));
}

function taxonomyEvidenceSupports(text,terms){return [...taxonomyTermCounts(taxonomyText(text),terms.map(taxonomyText)).keys()].some(term=>words(term).some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(rankingWord(word))));}

function taxonomyHeatmap_(rows,entityName=entityKey_){
  const nodes=[],indices=new Map(),entities=new Map(),countries=new Map();let tagged=0;
  function node(category,level){
    const key=level==='palanca'?'p:'+category.palanca:'s:'+category.id;
    if(!indices.has(key)){indices.set(key,nodes.length);nodes.push({id:key,level,palanca:category.palanca,subpalanca:level==='palanca'?'':category.subpalanca,count:0});}
    return indices.get(key);
  }
  function group(map,name,labels){
    if(!map.has(name))map.set(name,{name,total:0,counts:new Map()});const row=map.get(name);row.total++;
    for(const index of labels)row.counts.set(index,(row.counts.get(index)||0)+1);
  }
  for(const row of rows){
    const labels=new Set();for(const category of row.taxonomia){labels.add(node(category,'palanca'));if(category.subpalanca)labels.add(node(category,'subpalanca'));}
    if(labels.size)tagged++;for(const index of labels)nodes[index].count++;
    for(const name of articleEntities(row))group(entities,entityName(name),labels);for(const country of articleGeographies(row))group(countries,country||otherGeography,labels);
  }
  const groups=map=>[...map.values()].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.name==='BBVA')-Number(a.name==='BBVA')||b.total-a.total||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es')).map(row=>({...row,counts:[...row.counts]}));
  return {nodes,entities:groups(entities),countries:groups(countries),total:rows.length,tagged};
}

function taxonomySaved_(value){try{const data=JSON.parse(value||'{}');return {...data,invalid:Boolean(value)&&(!Array.isArray(data.ids)||data.ids.some(id=>typeof id!=='string')),fingerprint:data.fingerprint||'',ids:Array.isArray(data.ids)?data.ids:[],evidence:data.evidence||null,reason:data.reason||''};}catch(_){return {fingerprint:'',ids:[],invalid:Boolean(value)};}}
function taxonomyFingerprint_(title,excerpt){return sha256_(JSON.stringify([title,excerpt]));}
function fallbackTaxonomy_(text,labels,items){
 const capability=new Set((labels.capacidades||[]).map(value=>String(value).replace(/^Empresas:\s*/,''))),event=labels.evento||'',has=pattern=>pattern.test(text),pick=prefix=>items.find(item=>String(item.subpalanca||'').startsWith(prefix))?.id||'';
 const functional=functionalContext(text);let prefix='';
 if(functional.financing)prefix='08.xx';
 else if(functional.acquiring)prefix='11.xx';
 else if(functional.card&&!functional.transfer)prefix='09.xx';
 else if(event===INCIDENT_SIGNAL)prefix=has(/\b(?:login|log in|logins|acceso)\b/)?'16.xx':has(/\b(?:pago|pagos|payment|payments|transferencia|transferencias|bizum)\b/)?'03.xx':has(/\b(?:app|web|portal|banca|banking|canal)\b/)?'17.xx':'19.xx';
 else if(capability.has('Transferencias')||capability.has('Pagos'))prefix='03.xx';
 else if(capability.has('Adquirencia y terminales'))prefix='11.xx';
 else if(capability.has('Cobros y recaudación'))prefix='07.xx';
 else if(capability.has('Financiación digital')||capability.has('Préstamos y líneas de crédito'))prefix='08.xx';
 else if(capability.has('Autenticación y seguridad')||capability.has('Biometría'))prefix='16.xx';
 else if(capability.has('API bancarias')||capability.has('Aplicaciones móviles empresariales')||capability.has('Banca electrónica corporativa'))prefix='17.xx';
 return prefix?{id:pick(prefix),rule:prefix,capabilities:[...capability].sort(),signal:event}:{};
}
function taxonomyRecord_(title,excerpt,items=taxonomyCatalog_(),providedLabels=null){
 const fingerprint=taxonomyFingerprint_(title,excerpt),text=taxonomyText(title+' '+excerpt);
 if(!taxonomyMatchingMemory_.has(items))taxonomyMatchingMemory_.set(items,{rows:items.map(item=>({...item,terms:item.terminos,description:item.descripcion||''})),revision:taxonomyModelRevision_(items)});
 const model=taxonomyMatchingMemory_.get(items),metadata={fingerprint,version:TAXONOMY_POLICY.version,model:model.revision};
 if(!items.length||!taxonomyEligible_(searchText_(title),text))return {...metadata,ids:[],reason:'insufficient'};
 const decision=taxonomyDecision(text,model.rows,title),match=decision.matches[0];
 if(match)return {...metadata,ids:decision.matches.map(match=>match.row.id),primary:match.row.id,reason:decision.reason,evidence:{...match.evidence,assignments:decision.matches.map(({row,evidence})=>({id:row.id,...evidence}))}};
 const labels=providedLabels||classification_(searchText_(title),text).labels;
 const fallback=labels.digital&&fallbackTaxonomy_(text,labels,items);
 const evidence=fallback?.id?{method:'capability-fallback',rule:fallback.rule,capabilities:fallback.capabilities,signal:fallback.signal}:null;
 return evidence?{...metadata,ids:[fallback.id],primary:fallback.id,reason:'capability-fallback',evidence:{...evidence,assignments:[{id:fallback.id,...evidence}]}}:{...metadata,ids:[],reason:decision.reason};
}

function publishTaxonomy_(state){
  taxonomySeed(state,taxonomyDefinitions(configuration_().taxonomy));
  const items=taxonomyBuild(state).map(row=>({id:sha256_(row.key).slice(0,24),palanca:row.palanca,subpalanca:row.subpalanca,segmentos:row.segments,terminos:row.terms,noticias:row.df,peso:row.peso,origen:/\.xx Otros$/.test(row.subpalanca)?'local':row.origin,descripcion:row.description||'',context:row.context||[],exclude:row.exclude||[],condiciones:JSON.stringify({context:row.context||[],exclude:row.exclude||[],...(row.emerging?{emerging:row.emerging}:{})})}));

function taxonomyBatch_(maxMs=TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxMs){

function taxonomyGenerationBatch_(maxMs){
 const job=taxonomyJob_();if(!job||['Completada','Publicando','Revisar'].includes(job.state))return;
 const started=Date.now();let written=false;
 try{
  if(job.phase!=='tag'){
   const state=readTaxonomyCheckpoint_(job),definitions=taxonomyDefinitions(configuration_().taxonomy),excluded=new Set(configuration_().entities.flatMap(row=>[row.name,...row.aliases]).map(taxonomyText));
   taxonomySeed(state,definitions);
   if(job.phase==='scan'){
    const cursor={table:0,row:2,...job.scanCursor};let observed=0;
    while(cursor.table<2&&Date.now()-started<maxMs&&!backgroundPaused_(true)){
     const name=cursor.table===0?'Noticias':'Candidatos',sheet=recordSheet_(name),keys=RADAR.sheets[name],count=cursor.table===0?job.total:job.candidateTotal,width=cursor.table===0?7:6;
     if(cursor.row>count+1){cursor.table++;cursor.row=2;continue;}
     const size=Math.min(5000,count+2-cursor.row),rows=sheet.getRange(cursor.row,2,size,width).getDisplayValues(),provenance=cursor.table===1?sheet.getRange(cursor.row,keys.indexOf('procedencia')+1,size,1).getDisplayValues():null;
     let read=0;
     for(const values of rows){
      if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||backgroundPaused_(true))break;
      const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.slice(1,1+width).map((key,j)=>[key,values[j]]));
      observeTaxonomyRow_(state,row,definitions,excluded,row.medio||JSON.parse(provenance?.[read][0]||'{}').medio||'');read++;observed++;
     }
     cursor.row+=read;if(read<rows.length)break;
    }
    while(cursor.table<2&&cursor.row>(cursor.table===0?job.total:job.candidateTotal)+1){cursor.table++;cursor.row=2;}
    job.scanCursor=cursor;job.documents=state.documents;job.candidatesProcessed=cursor.table>1?job.candidateTotal:cursor.table===1?cursor.row-2:0;
    if(cursor.table===2)job.phase='publish';
    // The manifest and exact next-row cursor commit together, after verification.
    if(observed||job.phase==='publish')saveTaxonomyCheckpoint_(job,state);
   }
   if(job.phase==='publish'&&Date.now()-started<maxMs&&!backgroundPaused_()){
    prepareTaxonomyGeneration_(job);
    withTaxonomyGeneration_(job,()=>{job.model=publishTaxonomy_(state);});job.documents=state.documents;job.phase='tag';job.next=2;
   }
  }else{
   const sheet=newsSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias,items=taxonomyCatalog_(),size=Math.min(TAXONOMY_POLICY.batchRows,job.total-job.next+2),updates=[];let read=0;
   const rows=size>0?sheet.getRange(job.next,1,size,keys.length).getDisplayValues():[],expected=[],expectedLabels=[];
   for(const values of rows){
    if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||backgroundPaused_(true))break;
    const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]]));
    if(job.reclassify){const saved=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion),title=searchText_(plainText_(row.titular)),text=searchText_(plainText_(row.titular)+' '+plainText_(row.extracto)),labels={...classification_(title,text,true,row.medio).labels,...(saved.procedencia?{procedencia:saved.procedencia}:{})};const value=JSON.stringify(labels);if(value!==row.clasificacion)updates.push({row:job.next+read,column:keys.indexOf('clasificacion')+1,value});row.clasificacion=value;}
    const assignment=necessaryTaxonomyRecord_(row,items);validateTaxonomyAssignment_(assignment,items,row.id,true,row);const value=JSON.stringify(assignment);expected.push([value]);expectedLabels.push([row.clasificacion]);if(value!==row.taxonomia)updates.push({row:job.next+read,column:keys.indexOf('taxonomia')+1,value});read++;
   }
   writeNewsCells_(updates);
   if(read&&sha256_(JSON.stringify(expected))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(sheet.getRange(job.next,keys.indexOf('taxonomia')+1,read,1).getDisplayValues())))throw Error('Etiquetado persistido incompleto.');
   if(job.reclassify&&read&&sha256_(JSON.stringify(expectedLabels))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(sheet.getRange(job.next,keys.indexOf('clasificacion')+1,read,1).getDisplayValues())))throw Error('Clasificación candidata persistida incompleta.');
   written=updates.length>0;job.next+=read;job.tagged+=updates.length;job.processed=job.next-2;
   if(job.next>job.total+1){job.state='Completada';job.verified=true;properties_().setProperties({TAXONOMY_APPLIED_MODEL:job.model,TAXONOMY_APPLIED_RULES:job.rules,TAXONOMY_EVALUATED_CORPUS:job.corpus});}
  }
  if(written)invalidateNews_(false);Object.assign(job,{state:job.state==='Completada'?'Completada':'En curso',updated:new Date().toISOString(),error:'',pausedUntil:0});writeTaxonomyJob_(job);
  if(job.phase==='tag'){clearTaxonomyCheckpoints_();if(job.checkpoint){delete job.checkpoint;delete job.scanCursor;writeTaxonomyJob_(job);}}
  if(job.state==='Completada'){requestTaxonomyTranslations_();requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}
  telemetry_('taxonomia',Date.now()-started,'OK',job.phase+'; '+job.processed+' revisadas; '+job.tagged+' etiquetas actualizadas');
 }catch(error){const durable=taxonomyJob_()||job;Object.assign(durable,{state:'En pausa',error:String(error.message).slice(0,180),pausedUntil:Date.now()+(serviceQuotaPause_(error)||settings_().retryMinutes*60000)});writeTaxonomyJob_(durable);telemetry_('taxonomia',Date.now()-started,'Error',durable.error);}
}

function observeTaxonomyRow_(state,row,definitions,excluded,publisher){
  if(!row.titular)return;
  const text=taxonomyText(row.titular+' '+row.extracto),url=newsUrlIdentity_(row.url),urlKey=url?'url:'+sha256_(url):'',identity=titleIdentity_({title:row.titular,date:row.fecha,publisher}),key=identity?sha256_(identity.key):'',days=state.titles[key]||[];
  const duplicate=urlKey&&Object.hasOwn(state.titles,urlKey)||identity&&days.some(day=>Math.abs(day-identity.day)<=COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays);
  if(duplicate)return;
  if(urlKey)state.titles[urlKey]=[];
  if(identity){days.push(identity.day);state.titles[key]=days;}
  if(taxonomyEligible_(searchText_(row.titular),text))taxonomyObserve(state,text,definitions,excluded,publisher,{headline:row.titular,primary:taxonomyPrimarySource_(row)});
}

const taxonomyValidationMemory_=new WeakMap();
function taxonomyValidationIndex_(items){
  if(!taxonomyValidationMemory_.has(items)){
    const ids=new Set();for(const item of items){if(!item.id||ids.has(item.id))throw Error('Catálogo funcional con IDs vacíos o duplicados.');ids.add(item.id);}
    let model;taxonomyValidationMemory_.set(items,{ids,byId:new Map(items.map(item=>[item.id,item])),get model(){return model||(model=taxonomyModelRevision_(items));}});
  }
  return taxonomyValidationMemory_.get(items);
}
function validateTaxonomyAssignment_(saved,items,id,strict=true,row=null){
  const index=taxonomyValidationIndex_(items),fail=message=>{throw Error('Integridad taxonómica ['+id+']: '+message);};
  if(saved.invalid||new Set(saved.ids).size!==saved.ids.length||saved.ids.some(value=>!index.ids.has(value)))fail('IDs inexistentes o duplicados.');
  if((strict||saved.model)&&saved.model!==index.model)fail('Generación del catálogo distinta.');
  if(!strict)return;
  if(saved.version!==TAXONOMY_POLICY.version||!saved.reason||row&&saved.fingerprint!==taxonomyFingerprint_(row.titular,row.extracto))fail('Asignación pendiente de reproceso.');
  if(row&&!saved.ids.length&&saved.reason!=='insufficient'){const labels=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion);if(labels.digital&&fallbackTaxonomy_(taxonomyText(row.titular+' '+row.extracto),labels,items)?.id)fail('Asignación pendiente de reproceso.');}
  const assignments=saved.evidence?.assignments||[];
  if(saved.ids.length>TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxAssignments||assignments.length!==saved.ids.length||saved.ids.some((value,i)=>assignments[i]?.id!==value)||saved.ids.length&&saved.primary!==saved.ids[0])fail('Evidencia o categoría principal incompleta.');
  const text=row?taxonomyText(row.titular+' '+row.extracto):'',used=[];
  for(const evidence of assignments){
    if(evidence.method==='capability-fallback'){
      if(saved.reason!=='capability-fallback'||saved.ids.length!==1||!row)fail('Fallback sin trazabilidad verificable.');
      const labels=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion),expected=labels.digital&&fallbackTaxonomy_(text,labels,items);
      if(!expected?.id||expected.id!==evidence.id||expected.rule!==evidence.rule||expected.signal!==evidence.signal||JSON.stringify(expected.capabilities)!==JSON.stringify(evidence.capabilities)||evidence.terms?.length)fail('Regla, capacidad o señal de fallback incoherente.');
      continue;
    }
    if(!Array.isArray(evidence.terms)||!evidence.terms.length||!['literal','description'].includes(evidence.method)||row&&evidence.terms.some(term=>!taxonomyTermCounts(text,[term]).size))fail('Evidencia individual no verificable.');
    if(used.length&&!taxonomyIndependentEvidence(evidence,used))fail('Evidencia secundaria solapada o genérica.');
    used.push(...evidence.terms);
  }
}


function taxonomyCheckpointFirstRow_(){return 2+DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.length*2*DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.parts;}
function readTaxonomyCheckpoint_(job){
 const manifest=job.checkpoint;if(!manifest)return {documents:0,candidates:{},titles:{}};
 const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('DashboardSnapshots'),rows=sheet?.getRange(manifest.first,1,manifest.parts,4).getDisplayValues();
 if(!rows||rows.some(([kind,generation,part],i)=>kind!=='taxonomy-checkpoint'||generation!==manifest.generation||Number(part)!==i))throw Error('Checkpoint de taxonomía incompleto.');
 const text=rows.map(row=>row[3]).join('');if(sha256_(text)!==manifest.digest)throw Error('Checkpoint de taxonomía corrupto.');return JSON.parse(text);
}
function taxonomyCheckpointFreeRow_(sheet,parts,keep=null){
 const first=taxonomyCheckpointFirstRow_(),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-first+1),rows=count?sheet.getRange(first,1,count,4).getDisplayValues():[];
 let start=first,free=0;
 for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
  const row=first+i,protectedRow=keep&&row>=keep.first&&row<keep.first+keep.parts;
  if(protectedRow||rows[i].some(value=>value!=='')){free=0;start=row+1;continue;}
  if(++free>=parts)return start;
 }
 return keep&&start<keep.first+keep.parts&&start+parts>keep.first?keep.first+keep.parts:start;
}
function saveTaxonomyCheckpoint_(job,state){
 const sheet=generationSheet_('DashboardSnapshots',RADAR.sheets.DashboardSnapshots),text=JSON.stringify(state),parts=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(text.length/40000)),first=taxonomyCheckpointFreeRow_(sheet,parts,job.checkpoint),generation=job.id+':'+Utilities.getUuid(),needed=first+parts-1;
 if(needed>sheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),needed-sheet.getMaxRows());
 sheet.getRange(first,1,parts,4).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(Array.from({length:parts},(_,i)=>['taxonomy-checkpoint',generation,String(i),text.slice(i*40000,(i+1)*40000)]));SpreadsheetApp.flush();
 const candidate={...job,checkpoint:{first,parts,generation,digest:sha256_(text)}};readTaxonomyCheckpoint_(candidate);writeTaxonomyJob_(candidate);job.checkpoint=candidate.checkpoint;clearTaxonomyCheckpoints_(candidate.checkpoint);
}
function clearTaxonomyCheckpoints_(keep=null){
 const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('DashboardSnapshots'),first=taxonomyCheckpointFirstRow_(),count=sheet?sheet.getLastRow()-first+1:0;if(count<=0)return;
 const rows=sheet.getRange(first,1,count,2).getDisplayValues();
 for(let start=0;start<rows.length;){if(rows[start][0]!=='taxonomy-checkpoint'||rows[start][1]===keep?.generation){start++;continue;}let end=start+1;while(end<rows.length&&rows[end][0]==='taxonomy-checkpoint'&&rows[end][1]!==keep?.generation)end++;sheet.getRange(first+start,1,end-start,4).clearContent();start=end;}
}

function taxonomyPath(row){return row.subpalanca?row.palanca+' › '+row.subpalanca:row.palanca;}
function taxonomySubLabel(value){return String(value||'').split(' › ').slice(1).join(' › ')||String(value||'');}
function taxonomyDisplayLabel(value){return taxonomySubLabel(value).replace(/^\d{2}\.(?:\d{2}\.|xx\s+)?\s*/, '');}
function taxonomyChoices(paths,selection={}){
  const rows=paths.map(value=>({value,palanca:value.split(' › ')[0],subpalanca:taxonomySubLabel(value)}));
  return {palanca:[...new Set(rows.filter(row=>!selection.subpalanca||row.subpalanca===taxonomySubLabel(selection.subpalanca)).map(row=>row.palanca))],subpalanca:rows.filter(row=>!selection.palanca||row.palanca===selection.palanca).map(row=>row.value)};
}

let taxonomyTranslationMemory_;
function taxonomyTranslationJob_(){const value=properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_JOB');return value?JSON.parse(value):null;}
function writeTaxonomyTranslationJob_(job){progressContextMemory_=undefined;properties_().setProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_JOB',JSON.stringify(snapshotJob_('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_JOB',job)));}
function taxonomyTranslationNames_(){return [...new Set(taxonomyCatalog_().flatMap(row=>[row.palanca,row.subpalanca]).filter(Boolean))].sort();}
function taxonomyTranslationKey_(name,language){return language+':'+sha256_(name);}
function taxonomyTranslationIndex_(){
  if(taxonomyTranslationMemory_)return taxonomyTranslationMemory_;
  const key='taxonomy-texts:'+(properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATIONS_REVISION')||'0'),cached=CacheService.getScriptCache().get(key),entries=cached?JSON.parse(cached):rows_('TaxonomiaTraducciones').map(row=>[row.clave,row.texto]);
  if(!cached)cacheJson_(key,entries,21600);return taxonomyTranslationMemory_=new Map(entries);
}
function taxonomyTranslations_(){
  const items=taxonomyCatalog_();if(!items.length)return {};
  const key='taxonomy-names:'+taxonomyStorageKey_()+':'+RADAR.version+':'+(properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_REVISION')||'0')+':'+(properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATIONS_REVISION')||'0'),cached=CacheService.getScriptCache().get(key);if(cached)return JSON.parse(cached);
  const values=taxonomyTranslationIndex_(),unique=new Set(items.flatMap(row=>[row.palanca,row.subpalanca]).filter(Boolean)),result={};
  for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames).filter(language=>language!=='es')){
    const names=Object.create(null);for(const name of unique)names[name]=values.get(taxonomyTranslationKey_(name,language))||translateText(name,language);
    for(const row of items)if(row.subpalanca)names[taxonomyPath(row)]=names[row.palanca]+' › '+names[row.subpalanca];
    result[language]=names;
  }const originals=Object.fromEntries([...unique].map(name=>[name,name]));for(const row of items)if(row.subpalanca)originals[taxonomyPath(row)]=taxonomyPath(row);result.es=originals;cacheJson_(key,result,21600);return result;
}
function taxonomyLanguage_(language,names=taxonomyTranslations_()[language]||{}){
  return value=>String(language==='es'?value:Object.hasOwn(names,value)?names[value]:translateText(value,language)).replace(/(^| › )\d{2}\.(?:\d{2}\.|xx\s+)?\s*/g,'$1');
}
function translationCallsToday_(){
  const today=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone),usage=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_TRANSLATION_USAGE')||'{}');
  return (usage.day===today?Number(usage.calls)||0:0)+[translationJob_(),taxonomyTranslationJob_()].reduce((sum,job)=>sum+(job?.callDay===today?Number(job.calls||0):0),0);
}
function taxonomyTranslationPlan_(){const names=taxonomyTranslationNames_(),languages=Object.keys(languageNames).filter(language=>language!=='es').sort();return {names,languages,revision:sha256_(JSON.stringify([names,languages]))};}
function requestTaxonomyTranslations_(){
  const p=properties_(),{revision}=taxonomyTranslationPlan_();if(taxonomyTranslationJob_()?.revision===revision||p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===revision)return false;
  p.setProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST',revision);ensureBackgroundWorker_();return true;
}
function taxonomyTranslationReadyAt_(){
  if(taxonomyPending_()||properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_REQUEST'))return Infinity;
  const job=taxonomyTranslationJob_(),request=properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
  if(job?.state==='Publicando'||publicationNeedsReview_(job)||!request&&(!job||job.state==='Completada'))return Infinity;
  const paused=Number(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);if(paused>Date.now())return paused;
  if(request)return Date.now();
  if(job?.pausedUntil>Date.now())return job.pausedUntil;
  if(translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls){
    // Wake after the daily budget resets, even if article translation is disabled.
    return nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone);
  }
  return Math.max(Date.now(),Number(job.pausedUntil||0));
}
function taxonomyTranslationBatch_(maxMs=TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxMs){
  if(Number(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0)>Date.now())return;
  if(taxonomyTranslationJob_()?.state==='Publicando'||publicationNeedsReview_(taxonomyTranslationJob_()))return;
  const started=Date.now(),p=properties_(),today=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone);let job=taxonomyTranslationJob_(),written=false,touched=false;
  try{
    const {names,languages,revision}=taxonomyTranslationPlan_(),request=p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
    if(job?.revision===revision&&job.state==='Completada'){if(request)p.deleteProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');return;}
    if(!job||job.revision!==revision){
      job={revision,state:'Pendiente',total:names.length*languages.length,processed:0,translated:0,started:new Date().toISOString(),updated:new Date().toISOString(),calls:job?.callDay===today?job.calls:0,callDay:today,error:'',pausedUntil:0};
    }
    if(request&&p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===request)p.deleteProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
    if(job.callDay!==today){job.callDay=today;job.calls=0;job.pausedUntil=0;}
    if(job.pausedUntil>started)return;
    const index=taxonomyTranslationIndex_();let calls=0;
    touched=true;job.state='En curso';job.error='';writeTaxonomyTranslationJob_(job);
    while(job.processed<job.total&&Date.now()-started<maxMs&&!backgroundPaused_()){
      if(collectionRequests_().some(request=>request.kind==='daily'))break;
      const name=names[Math.floor(job.processed/languages.length)],language=languages[job.processed%languages.length],key=taxonomyTranslationKey_(name,language);
      if(!index.has(key)){
        const staticName=Object.hasOwn(translations,name);
        if(!staticName&&(calls>=TRANSLATION_WORK.batchCalls||translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls))break;
        if(!staticName){calls++;job.calls++;writeTaxonomyTranslationJob_(job);}
        const text=staticName?translateText(name,language):String(LanguageApp.translate(name,'',language)||'').trim();
        if(!text||text.length>5000)throw Error('Respuesta de traducción incompleta.');
        append_('TaxonomiaTraducciones',[[key,language,text,new Date().toISOString()]]);index.set(key,text);written=true;job.translated++;
      }
      job.processed++;
    }
    job.state=job.processed===job.total?'Completada':translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls?'En pausa':'Pendiente';
    if(job.state==='En pausa')job.error='Límite diario de traducción alcanzado. Continuará en la siguiente ejecución diaria.';
    if(job.state==='Completada'){
      const active=new Set(names.flatMap(name=>languages.map(language=>taxonomyTranslationKey_(name,language)))),sheet=book_().getSheetByName('TaxonomiaTraducciones'),rows=rows_('TaxonomiaTraducciones'),kept=rows.filter(row=>active.has(row.clave));
      if(kept.length!==rows.length){
        if(kept.length)sheet.getRange(2,1,kept.length,4).setValues(kept.map(row=>RADAR.sheets.TaxonomiaTraducciones.map(key=>row[key])));
        sheet.getRange(kept.length+2,1,rows.length-kept.length,4).clearContent();taxonomyTranslationMemory_=new Map(kept.map(row=>[row.clave,row.texto]));written=true;
      }
    }
    telemetry_('traduccion-taxonomia',Date.now()-started,'OK',job.processed+'/'+job.total+' nombres; '+calls+' llamadas');
  }catch(error){
    if(!job)throw error;
    if(serviceQuotaPause_(error))p.setProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+serviceQuotaPause_(error)));
    touched=true;Object.assign(job,{state:'En pausa',error:'Traducción temporalmente no disponible. Se reintentará automáticamente.',pausedUntil:Date.now()+(serviceQuotaPause_(error)||TRANSLATION_WORK.retryMs)});
    telemetry_('traduccion-taxonomia',Date.now()-started,'Error',String(error.message).slice(0,180));
  }finally{if(written){p.setProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATIONS_REVISION',Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));invalidateNews_(false,false);}if(job&&touched){job.updated=new Date().toISOString();writeTaxonomyTranslationJob_(job);}if(touched&&job?.state==='Completada')requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}
}
