function translationJob_(){const value=properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_JOB');return value?JSON.parse(value):null;}
function writeTranslationJob_(job){progressContextMemory_=undefined;properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATION_JOB',JSON.stringify(snapshotJob_('TRANSLATION_JOB',job)));}
function requestTranslations_(priority=false){properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST',new Date().toISOString());if(priority)properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST','true');ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
function startTranslations(){authorize_(true);requestTranslations_();return getTranslationStatus();}
function getTranslationStatus(){authorize_(true);return {newsRevision:publishedNewsRevision_(),scheduled:true,timezone:settings_().timezone,job:withJobProgress_('translation',translationJob_(),Boolean(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST'))),queued:Boolean(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST'))};}
function translationCandidates_(job){
  return businessNewsIndex_().rows.filter(row=>row.captured<=job.started&&(!job.cursor||row.fecha<job.cursor.fecha||row.fecha===job.cursor.fecha&&row.id<job.cursor.id)).sort((a,b)=>a.fecha===b.fecha?(a.id===b.id?0:a.id>b.id?-1:1):a.fecha>b.fecha?-1:1);
}
function translationCompletionRevision_(){const p=properties_().getProperties();return sha256_(JSON.stringify([RADAR.version,newsStorageKey_(),p.NEWS_CONTENT_REVISION||'0',p.NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION||'0',p.CONFIG_REVISION||'0',p.TRANSLATIONS_INDEX_REVISION||'0',Object.keys(languageNames).map(code=>[code,p['TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+code]||'0'])]));}
function markTranslationComplete_(){if(!properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST'))properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATION_COMPLETED_REVISION',translationCompletionRevision_());}
function translationBatch_(maxMs=TRANSLATION_WORK.maxMs){
  const existing=translationJob_();if(existing?.state==='Publicando'||publicationNeedsReview_(existing))return;
  const revision=translationCompletionRevision_();if(existing?.state==='Completada'&&properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_COMPLETED_REVISION')===revision){properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST');properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST');return;}
  const started=Date.now(),now=new Date(started),today=recordDay(now,settings_().timezone);let job;
  try{
    const paused=Number(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);if(paused>started)return;
    job=translationJob_();const request=properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
    if(!job||properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST')||request&&(job.state==='Completada'||recordDay(job.started,settings_().timezone)<today))job={state:'Pendiente',started:now.toISOString(),updated:now.toISOString(),total:0,processed:0,translated:0,errors:0,calls:job?.callDay===today?job.calls:0,callDay:today,cursor:null,error:'',pausedUntil:0};
    if(job.state==='Completada'&&!request)return;
    if(job.callDay!==today){job.callDay=today;job.calls=0;job.pausedUntil=0;job.error='';}
    const candidates=translationCandidates_(job);job.total=job.processed+candidates.length;job.businessPending=candidates.filter(row=>row.priority===0).length;
    if(!candidates.length){job.state='Completada';job.error='';if(request&&job.started>=request&&properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===request){properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST');properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST');}markTranslationComplete_();return;}
    writeTranslationJob_(job);if(request&&job.started>=request&&properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===request){properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST');properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST');}
    if(job.pausedUntil>started)return;
    if(translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls&&candidates.length){job.state='En pausa';job.pausedUntil=nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone);job.error='Límite diario de traducción alcanzado. Continuará en la siguiente ejecución diaria.';return;}
    job.state='En curso';job.error='';writeTranslationJob_(job);
    const feeds=new Set(configuration_().feeds.map(feed=>feed.name)),known=articleTranslationIndex_();let calls=0;
    const dailyRequested=()=>collectionRequests_().some(request=>request.kind==='daily');
    outer:for(let offset=0;offset<Math.min(candidates.length,TRANSLATION_WORK.batchRows);offset+=TRANSLATION_WORK.readRows){
      if(backgroundPaused_()||Date.now()-started>=maxMs||dailyRequested())break;
      const selected=candidates.slice(offset,offset+TRANSLATION_WORK.readRows),articles=newsRowsForCandidates_(selected);
      for(const candidate of selected){
        if(backgroundPaused_()||Date.now()-started>=maxMs)break outer;
        const row=articles.get(candidate.id);
        if(row)for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames)){
          if(nativeArticle_(row,language,feeds)||known.has(articleTranslationKey_(row,language)))continue;
          if(backgroundPaused_()||Date.now()-started>=maxMs||dailyRequested())break outer;
          if(calls>=TRANSLATION_WORK.batchCalls||translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls)break outer;
          calls++;job.calls++;writeTranslationJob_(job);storeArticleTranslation_(row,language);job.translated++;
        }
        job.processed++;job.cursor={id:candidate.id,fecha:candidate.fecha,priority:candidate.priority};if(candidate.priority===0)job.businessPending--;job.updated=new Date().toISOString();
      }
    }
    job.state=job.processed===job.total?'Completada':translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls?'En pausa':'Pendiente';
    if(job.state==='En pausa'){job.pausedUntil=nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone);job.error='Límite diario de traducción alcanzado. Continuará en la siguiente ejecución diaria.';}
    if(job.state==='Completada'){compactArticleTranslations_();markTranslationComplete_();}
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();telemetry_('traduccion',Date.now()-started,'OK',job.processed+'/'+job.total+' noticias; '+calls+' llamadas; '+job.translated+' traducciones guardadas');
  }catch(error){
    if(!job)throw error;
    if(serviceQuotaPause_(error))properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+serviceQuotaPause_(error)));
    job.state='En pausa';job.errors++;job.error='Traducción temporalmente no disponible. Se reintentará automáticamente.';job.pausedUntil=Date.now()+(serviceQuotaPause_(error)||TRANSLATION_WORK.retryMs);
    telemetry_('traduccion',Date.now()-started,'Error',String(error.message).slice(0,180));
  }finally{if(job){job.updated=new Date().toISOString();writeTranslationJob_(job);if(job.state==='Completada')requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}}
}

let articleTranslationRows_,articleTranslationMemory_;
function articleFingerprint_(row){return sha256_(String(row.titular||'')+'\n'+String(row.extracto||''));}
function articleTranslationKey_(row,language){return language+':'+articleFingerprint_(row);}
let articleIdentityTitlesMemory_;
function articleIdentityTitles_(){
  const revisions=Object.keys(languageNames).map(language=>properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language)||'0'),revision=JSON.stringify(revisions);
  if(articleIdentityTitlesMemory_?.revision===revision)return articleIdentityTitlesMemory_.values;
  const key='news-records:translation-titles:'+sha256_(revision),cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);
  if(cached){const values=new Map(cached);articleIdentityTitlesMemory_={revision,values};return values;}
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones'),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,variants=new Map();
  // Deduplication needs titles only; never fetch or cache translated excerpts here.
  for(let offset=0;offset<count;offset+=2000)for(const [key,language,title] of sheet.getRange(offset+2,1,Math.min(2000,count-offset),3).getDisplayValues()){
    if(!supportedLanguage(language)||!key.startsWith(language+':'))continue;
    const fingerprint=key.slice(language.length+1),titles=variants.get(fingerprint)||new Map();titles.set(language,title);variants.set(fingerprint,titles);
  }
  const values=new Map([...variants].map(([fingerprint,titles])=>[fingerprint,[...new Set(Object.keys(languageNames).map(language=>titles.get(language)).filter(Boolean))]]));
  writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,[...values]);articleIdentityTitlesMemory_={revision,values};return values;
}
function translationIdentityRows_(rows){
  if(!rows.length||!Object.keys(languageNames).some(language=>properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language)))return rows;
  const titles=articleIdentityTitles_();
  rows.forEach(row=>{row.identityTitles=titles.size?(titles.get(articleFingerprint_(row.original||row))||[]):[];});
  return rows;
}
function articleTranslationIndexKey_(){return 'article-index:'+sha256_(JSON.stringify([book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones').getLastRow(),properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATIONS_INDEX_REVISION')||'0',Object.keys(languageNames).map(language=>properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language)||'0')]));}
function articleTranslationIndex_(){
  if(articleTranslationRows_)return articleTranslationRows_;
  const key=articleTranslationIndexKey_(),cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);if(cached)return articleTranslationRows_=new Map(cached);
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones'),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,entries=count?sheet.getRange(2,1,count,1).getDisplayValues().map(([key],index)=>[key,index+2]):[];
  writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,entries);return articleTranslationRows_=new Map(entries);
}
function cachedArticleTranslations_(keys){
  articleTranslationMemory_=articleTranslationMemory_||new Map();
  const missing=[...new Set(keys)].filter(key=>!articleTranslationMemory_.has(key));if(!missing.length)return articleTranslationMemory_;
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=cache.getAll(missing.map(key=>'article:'+key)),uncached=[];
  for(const key of missing){const value=cached['article:'+key];if(value)articleTranslationMemory_.set(key,JSON.parse(value));else uncached.push(key);}
  if(!uncached.length)return articleTranslationMemory_;
  const index=articleTranslationIndex_(),positions=uncached.filter(key=>index.has(key)).map(key=>({key,row:index.get(key)})).sort((a,b)=>a.row-b.row),values={};
  for(const key of uncached)articleTranslationMemory_.set(key,null);
  const byRow=new Map(positions.map(({key,row})=>[row,key]));
  for(const [first,last] of sheetRowRanges_(positions.map(item=>item.row),64)){
    const rows=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones').getRange(first,3,last-first+1,2).getDisplayValues();
    rows.forEach(([titular,extracto],offset)=>{const key=byRow.get(first+offset);if(!key)return;const value={titular:plainText_(titular),extracto:plainText_(extracto)};articleTranslationMemory_.set(key,value);const encoded=cacheJsonValue_(value);if(encoded)values['article:'+key]=encoded;});
  }
  if(Object.keys(values).length)try{cache.putAll(values,21600);}catch(_){}return articleTranslationMemory_;
}
function translateArticleText_(row,language){
  const escape=value=>String(value||'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,char=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[char]));
  const title=plainText_(row.titular).slice(0,5000),excerpt=plainText_(row.extracto).slice(0,5000),hasExcerpt=Boolean(excerpt),input='<p id="headline">'+escape(title)+'</p>'+(hasExcerpt?'<p id="excerpt">'+escape(excerpt)+'</p>':'');
  const html=LanguageApp.translate(input,'',language,{contentType:'html'});
  const blocks=[...html.matchAll(/<p\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/p>/gi)].map(match=>plainText_(match[1]));
  if(blocks.length!==(hasExcerpt?2:1)||!blocks[0]||(hasExcerpt&&!blocks[1]))throw Error('Respuesta de traducción incompleta.');
  return {titular:blocks[0].slice(0,5000),extracto:hasExcerpt?blocks[1].slice(0,5000):''};
}
function nativeArticle_(row,language,feeds){return feeds.has(row.fuente)&&String(row.idioma||'').toLowerCase().split(/[-_]/)[0]===language;}
function savedArticleTranslations_(rows,language){
  const feeds=new Set(configuration_().feeds.map(feed=>feed.name));
  const keys=rows.map(row=>nativeArticle_(row,language,feeds)?null:articleTranslationKey_(row,language)),values=cachedArticleTranslations_(keys.filter(Boolean));
  return rows.map((row,index)=>{
    if(nativeArticle_(row,language,feeds))return {...row,translation:{language,state:'native'}};
    const value=values.get(keys[index]);
    return {...row,...(value?{...value,original:{titular:row.titular,extracto:row.extracto}}:{}),translation:{language,state:value?'translated':'pending'}};
  });
}
function storeArticleTranslation_(row,language){
  const key=articleTranslationKey_(row,language),value=translateArticleText_(row,language),index=articleTranslationIndex_(),sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones'),position=index.get(key)||sheet.getLastRow()+1,values=[[key,language,value.titular,value.extracto,new Date().toISOString()]];
  if(index.has(key))sheet.getRange(position,1,1,5).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values.map(row=>row.map(safeCell_)));else append_('Traducciones',values);index.set(key,position);
  articleTranslationMemory_=articleTranslationMemory_||new Map();articleTranslationMemory_.set(key,value);cacheJson_('article:'+key,value,21600);
  const revision=Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  properties_().setProperties({['TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language]:revision,NEWS_REVISION:revision});return value;
}

function compactArticleTranslations_(){
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones'),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1);if(!count)return;
  const fingerprints=new Set();
  const source=newsSheet_(),total=source.getLastRow()-1;
  for(let offset=0;offset<total;offset+=1000)for(const [titular,extracto] of source.getRange(offset+2,6,Math.min(1000,total-offset),2).getDisplayValues())fingerprints.add(articleFingerprint_({titular,extracto}));
  const rows=sheet.getRange(2,1,count,5).getDisplayValues(),unique=new Map();
  for(const row of rows)if(supportedLanguage(row[1])&&row[0].startsWith(row[1]+':')&&fingerprints.has(row[0].slice(row[1].length+1)))unique.set(row[0],row);
  if(unique.size===rows.length)return;
  const kept=[...unique.values()];
  if(kept.length)sheet.getRange(2,1,kept.length,5).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(kept.map(row=>row.map(safeCell_)));
  sheet.getRange(kept.length+2,1,count-kept.length,5).clearContent();
  properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATIONS_INDEX_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());articleTranslationRows_=undefined;articleTranslationMemory_=undefined;articleIdentityTitlesMemory_=undefined;
  const revision=Utilities.getUuid();for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames))properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language,revision);
}

function newsSearchMatcher_(rows,query,entityName=entityKey_,geography){
 const q=searchText_(String(query.search||'').slice(0,160));if(!q)return null;
 const entity=query.entity?entityName(query.entity):'',scope={...query,country:''},matches=new Set(),pending=[];
 for(const row of rows)if(newsFiltersMatch_(row,scope,entity,entityName,geography)){if(newsSearchText_(row).includes(q))matches.add(row);else pending.push(row);}
 if(!pending.length)return row=>matches.has(row);
 const index=articleTranslationIndex_(),byKey=new Map();
 for(const row of pending){const fingerprint=articleFingerprint_(row.original||row);for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames)){const key=language+':'+fingerprint;if(index.has(key)){if(!byKey.has(key))byKey.set(key,[]);byKey.get(key).push(row);}}}
 const keys=[...byKey.keys()];
 for(let offset=0;offset<keys.length;offset+=NEWS_CACHE.chunkRows){
  const batch=keys.slice(offset,offset+NEWS_CACHE.chunkRows).filter(key=>byKey.get(key).some(row=>!matches.has(row))),values=cachedArticleTranslations_(batch);
  for(const key of batch){const text=values.get(key);if(text&&searchText_(text.titular+' '+text.extracto).includes(q))for(const row of byKey.get(key))matches.add(row);}
 }
 return row=>matches.has(row);
}

const identityIndexes=new Map();
function identityKey(value){return String(value||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?|^www\./,'').replace(/\/$/,'');}
function identityAsset(kind,name){
 if(!identityIndexes.has(kind)){
  const index=new Map();
  for(const [label,asset] of Object.entries(IDENTITY_ASSETS[kind]||{}))for(const alias of [label,...(asset.aliases||[])])index.set(identityKey(alias),asset);
  identityIndexes.set(kind,index);
 }
 const canonical=kind==='entities'&&typeof entityKey_==='function'?entityKey_(name):kind==='publishers'&&typeof publisherKey_==='function'?publisherKey_(name):name;
 return identityIndexes.get(kind).get(identityKey(canonical))||identityIndexes.get(kind).get(identityKey(name));
}
function identityMark(kind,name,escape,images){
 const asset=identityAsset(kind,name);
 if(!asset)return kind==='entities'&&name?'<span class="entity-monogram" title="'+escape(name)+'" aria-label="'+escape(name)+'">'+escape(name.split(/\s+/).map(word=>word.replace(/^[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u,'')[0]||'').join('').slice(0,2))+'</span>':'';
 if(images)images.set(asset.id,asset);
 const src=images?'cid:'+asset.id:'data:image/png;base64,'+asset.data;
 return '<img class="'+(kind==='countries'?'geography-flag':kind==='publishers'?'publisher-logo':'entity-logo')+'" src="'+src+'" width="'+asset.width+'" height="'+asset.height+'" alt="'+escape(name)+'" title="'+escape(name)+'"'+(images?'':' loading="lazy" decoding="async"')+'>';
}
function storyIdentity(entity,country,escape,images){
 const marks=(Array.isArray(entity)?entity:[entity]).map(name=>identityMark('entities',name,escape,images)).join('')+identityMark('countries',country,escape,images);
 return marks?'<span class="story-identity">'+marks+'</span>':'';
}

function doGet(event={}) {
 authorize_();const template=HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('Index'),params=event.parameter||{},view=readingViews.includes(params.view)?params.view:'briefing';let bootstrap=null;
 if(!params.edition&&view!=='news')try{const query={view,language:'es',initial:true};bootstrap={query,data:getDashboard(query)};}catch(error){console.warn('Carga inicial: '+error.message);}
 template.bootstrap=JSON.stringify(bootstrap).replace(/</g,'\\u003c');
 return template.evaluate().setTitle('News Radar · BBVA Empresas').setFaviconUrl('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/felixdelbarrio/News-Radar/87e9ef88d9331af498c1d3995ff6d1f5252bc3aa/assets/favicon.ico').addMetaTag('viewport','width=device-width, initial-scale=1');
}
function include_(name) {
  if(!['Tokens','Styles','Client'].includes(name))throw new Error('Fragmento desconocido.');
  const content=HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile(name).getContent();
  if(name!=='Styles')return content;
  const images=new Map(),styles=[];
  for(const value of ['positive','negative']){const asset='feedback-'+value;if(newsletterVisualAsset_(asset,images))styles.push('[data-rating-icon="'+value+'"]{background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,'+images.get(asset).data+'");font-size:0;width:var(--space-4);height:var(--space-4)}');}
  return content+(styles.length?'<style>'+styles.join('')+'</style>':'');
}

const WORK_COORDINATION=Object.freeze({waitMs:60000,leaseMs:600000,resumeMs:60000,pollMs:1000});
let workPauseCheck_,foregroundWriteDepth_=0;
function backgroundPaused_(cached=false){
  const now=Date.now();
  if(!cached||!workPauseCheck_||now-workPauseCheck_.checked>=WORK_COORDINATION.pollMs){
    refreshScriptProperties_();const values=properties_().getProperties();
    workPauseCheck_={checked:now,until:Math.max(0,...Object.entries(values).filter(([key])=>key.startsWith('WORK_INTENT:')).map(([,value])=>Number(value)||0))};
  }
  return workPauseCheck_.until>now;
}
function deferBackgroundWork_(name){properties_().setProperty('WORK_PENDING:'+name,'true');}
function scheduleWorkWake_(delay){
  scheduledTriggers_('workWake_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
  ScriptApp.newTrigger('workWake_').timeBased().after(delay).create();
}
function withForegroundWrite_(operation){
  const properties=properties_(),intent='WORK_INTENT:'+Utilities.getUuid(),lock=LockService.getScriptLock();let acquired=false;
  try{
    properties.setProperty(intent,String(Date.now()+WORK_COORDINATION.leaseMs));
    for(const [handler,name] of [['backgroundTick_','background'],['newsletterTick_','newsletter']])if(scheduledTriggers_(handler).length)deferBackgroundWork_(name);
    if(!lock.tryLock(WORK_COORDINATION.waitMs))throw Error('El trabajo activo aún no ha liberado el bloqueo. Vuelve a intentarlo cuando termine su llamada en curso.');
    acquired=true;foregroundWriteDepth_++;try{return operation();}finally{foregroundWriteDepth_--;}
  }finally{
    try{if(acquired){try{SpreadsheetApp.flush();}finally{lock.releaseLock();}}}
    finally{
      properties.deleteProperty(intent);workPauseCheck_=undefined;
      scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);
    }
  }
}
function workWake_(){
  if(backgroundPaused_()){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();let acquired=false;
  try{
    if(!lock.tryLock(1000)){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}acquired=true;
    const properties=properties_(),values=properties.getProperties(),now=Date.now();
    if(Object.entries(values).some(([key,value])=>key.startsWith('WORK_INTENT:')&&Number(value)>now)){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}
    scheduledTriggers_('workWake_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(values))if(key.startsWith('WORK_INTENT:')&&Number(value)<=Date.now())properties_().deleteProperty(key);
    workPauseCheck_={checked:now,until:0};
    const pending=Object.keys(values).filter(key=>key.startsWith('WORK_PENDING:'));
    for(const key of pending){
      if(backgroundPaused_(true)){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}
      const name=key.slice('WORK_PENDING:'.length);
      if(collectionPipelineSlots_().includes(name))requestDailyPipeline_(name);
      else if(name==='classification'){properties_().setProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST',recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone));ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
      else if(name==='taxonomy'){properties_().setProperty('TAXONOMY_REQUEST',recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone));ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
      else if(name==='edited'){invalidateConfiguration_();requestNewsClassification_(true);}
      else if(name==='news')invalidateNews_();
      else if(name==='newsletter')ensureNewsletterContinuation_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);
      else if(name==='background'){scheduledTriggers_('backgroundTick_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT');}
      if(backgroundPaused_()){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}
      properties_().deleteProperty(key);
    }
    if(pending.includes('WORK_PENDING:background'))ensureBackgroundWorker_();
  }catch(error){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);throw error;}
  finally{if(acquired)lock.releaseLock();}
}

  function llmUtf8(text) {
    return Array.from(unescape(encodeURIComponent(text)), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
  }
  function llmCrc(bytes, previous = 0) {
    let crc = previous ^ -1;
    for (let byte of bytes) {
      crc ^= byte;
      for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) crc = crc >>> 1 ^ (crc & 1 ? 3988292384 : 0);
    }
    return (crc ^ -1) >>> 0;
  }
  function llmZipWriter(encode = (text) => Uint8Array.from(llmUtf8(text))) {

        let name = encode(file.name), parts = file.parts || [encode(file.text)], length = parts.reduce((sum, part) => sum + part.length, 0), crc = parts.reduce((value, part) => llmCrc(part, value), 0), header = [];

      },

  function llmBundleWriter(encode) {
    let packages = [], manifest, instructions, review;
    return {
      add(result) {
        if (manifest || (manifest = JSON.parse(result.files.find((file) => file.name === "manifest.json").text), instructions = result.files.find((file) => file.name === "instructions.md"), review = result.review), !result.count) return;

      },
      finish() {
        let zip = llmZipWriter(encode), entries = packages.map((item, index) => ({ name: index + 1 + "_" + packages.length + ".zip", articles: item.count }));
        return zip.add({ name: "manifest.json", text: JSON.stringify({ ...manifest, packages: entries }) }), zip.add(instructions), zip.add(review), packages.forEach((item, index) => zip.add({ name: entries[index].name, parts: item.parts })), zip.finish();
      }
    };
  }

  function supportedLanguage(value) {
    return typeof value == "string" && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(languageNames, value);
  }
  function detectLanguage(preferences) {
    for (let value of preferences) {
      let code = String(value).toLowerCase().split(/[-_]/)[0];
      if (supportedLanguage(code)) return code;
    }
    return "es";
  }

  function inferredCountryCode(languages = [], timeZone = "") {
    if (zoneCountries[timeZone]) return zoneCountries[timeZone];
    for (let language2 of languages) {
      let match = String(language2).match(/^[a-z]{2,3}(?:-[a-z]{4})?-([a-z]{2})(?:-|$)/i);
      if (match) return match[1].toUpperCase();
    }
    return "";
  }
  function browserCountry(available = []) {
    let code = inferredCountryCode(navigator.languages || [navigator.language], Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone);
    if (!code) return "";
    let name = code === "TW" ? "APAC" : new Intl.DisplayNames(["es"], { type: "region" }).of(code);
    return !available.length || available.includes(name) ? name : "";
  }

  var NON_INCIDENT_SIGNAL = "Sin incidencias operativas", BRIEFING_ALLOWED_SIGNALS = Object.freeze(["Lanzamiento de producto", "Mejora de oferta", "Alianza estrat\xE9gica"]);

  function geographyLabel(name) {
    return !name || name === "Sin determinar" ? otherGeography : name;
  }
  function articleGeographies(row) {
    return [...new Set(Array.isArray(row.geografias) && row.geografias.length ? row.geografias : [row.pais || ""])];
  }
  function applicationGeography(scopes, segment, geographies = []) {
    let countries = new Set(scopes.filter((scope) => !segment || scope.name === segment).flatMap((scope) => scope.countries)), region = new Map(geographies.map((row) => [row.name, row.region || ""])), geography = (row) => articleGeographies(row).find((value) => countries.has(value)) || otherGeography;
    return geography.own = (country) => countries.has(country), geography.members = (row) => [...new Set(articleGeographies(row).map((value) => countries.has(value) ? value : otherGeography))], geography.region = (country) => region.get(country) || (REGION_CODES.includes(country) ? country : ""), geography.regions = [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...REGION_CODES, ...[...region.values()].filter(Boolean)])], geography.ownRegions = [...new Set([...countries].map((country) => region.get(country)).filter(Boolean))], geography;
  }
  function geographyOrder(a, b) {
    return +(a.name === otherGeography) - +(b.name === otherGeography) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "es");
  }
  function entityOrder(a, b) {
    return +(b.name === "BBVA") - +(a.name === "BBVA") || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "es");
  }
  var REGION_CODES = Object.freeze(["APAC", "EMEA", "AMER"]);
  function countryRegion(country, geographies = []) {
    return geographies.find((row) => row.name === country)?.region || "";
  }
  function geographyMatches(row, selection, geography) {
    return geography.regions.includes(selection) ? articleGeographies(row).some((country) => !geography.own(country) && geography.region(country) === selection) : selection === otherGeography ? geography.members(row).includes(otherGeography) : articleGeographies(row).includes(selection);
  }
  function unlocatedGeography(row, geography) {
    return articleGeographies(row).every((country) => !geography.own(country) && !geography.region(country));
  }
  function readingGeographyMatches(row, selection, geography) {
    return geographyMatches(row, selection, geography) || geography.regions.includes(selection) && unlocatedGeography(row, geography);
  }
  function preferredRegion(rows, local = "", configured = [], selected = "") {
    let known = rows.filter((row) => REGION_CODES.includes(row.name)), available = known.filter((row) => row.total > 0);
    return available.some((row) => row.name === selected) ? selected : available.some((row) => row.name === local) ? local : available.slice().sort((a, b) => Number(configured.includes(b.name)) - Number(configured.includes(a.name)) || b.total - a.total || REGION_CODES.indexOf(a.name) - REGION_CODES.indexOf(b.name))[0]?.name || known.find((row) => row.name === selected)?.name || known.find((row) => row.name === local)?.name || known[0]?.name || REGION_CODES[0];
  }
  function regionalGeographies(rows, geography) {
    let totals = new Map(geography.regions.map((name) => [name, 0]));
    for (let row of rows) for (let region of new Set(articleGeographies(row).filter((country) => !geography.own(country)).map((country) => geography.region(country)).filter(Boolean))) totals.has(region) && totals.set(region, totals.get(region) + 1);
    return [...totals].map(([name, total]) => ({ name, total }));
  }
  function geographyTabQuery(query, regions = REGION_CODES, geography = null) {
    let requested = query.newsGeography || query.country;
    if (query.view !== "news" || !requested) return query;
    let tab = requested;
    if (geography && requested !== otherGeography && !regions.includes(requested)) {
      let group = geography({ pais: requested });
      tab = group === otherGeography && !geography.own(requested) ? geography.region(requested) || otherGeography : group;
    }
    return { ...query, country: "", newsGeography: tab };
  }

  // src/client/features/heatmap-model.js
  var HEATMAP_PAGE = Object.freeze({ rows: 12, columns: 8 });
  function heatmapPage(data, axis, level, rowPage, columnPage) {
    let columns = data.nodes.map((node, index) => ({ ...node, index })).filter((node) => node.level === level).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || a.palanca.localeCompare(b.palanca) || a.subpalanca.localeCompare(b.subpalanca)), rows = data[axis] || [], indices = new Set(columns.map((node) => node.index)), max = 1;
    for (let row of rows) for (let [index, count] of row.counts) indices.has(index) && (max = Math.max(max, count));
    let pages = { rows: Math.ceil(rows.length / HEATMAP_PAGE.rows), columns: Math.ceil(columns.length / HEATMAP_PAGE.columns) };
    return rowPage = Math.min(Math.max(0, rowPage), Math.max(0, pages.rows - 1)), columnPage = Math.min(Math.max(0, columnPage), Math.max(0, pages.columns - 1)), { rows: rows.slice(0, (rowPage + 1) * HEATMAP_PAGE.rows).map((row) => ({ ...row, counts: new Map(row.counts) })), columns: columns.slice(columnPage * HEATMAP_PAGE.columns, (columnPage + 1) * HEATMAP_PAGE.columns), pages, rowPage, columnPage, max };
  }
  function heatmapValue(count, total, mode, max) {
    let share = total ? Math.round(count / total * 100) : 0;
    return { share, level: count ? Math.min(4, Math.max(1, Math.ceil((mode === "share" ? share / 100 : count / max) * 4))) : 0 };
  }

  // src/shared/record-filters.js
  function recordText(value) {
    return String(value ?? "").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/ı/g, "i").trim();
  }
  function recordQuery(input2 = {}, fields = []) {
    let query = {};
    for (let key of ["search", "from", "to", ...fields]) {
      let value = String(input2[key] ?? "").trim();
      if (value.length > 160) throw Error("Filtro demasiado largo.");
      value && (query[key] = value);
    }
    for (let key of ["from", "to"]) if (query[key] && (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(query[key]) || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(query[key])) || new Date(query[key]).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== query[key])) throw Error("Fecha no v\xE1lida.");
    if (query.from && query.to && query.from > query.to) throw Error("La fecha desde debe ser anterior o igual a la fecha hasta.");
    return query.page = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(input2.page) || 0)), query;
  }
  var recordDateFormatter;
  function filterRecords(rows, input2, fields, searchFields, dateKey = "fecha", timezone2 = "UTC") {
    let query = recordQuery(input2, fields), term = recordText(query.search);
    return rows.filter((row) => {
      if (fields.some((key) => query[key] && String(row[key]) !== query[key]) || term && !recordText(searchFields.map((key) => row[key] ?? "").join(" ")).includes(term)) return !1;
      if (!query.from && !query.to) return !0;
      let date2 = new Date(row[dateKey]);
      if (!Number.isFinite(date2.getTime())) return !1;
      let day2 = recordDay(date2, timezone2);
      return (!query.from || day2 >= query.from) && (!query.to || day2 <= query.to);
    });
  }
  function recordOptions(rows, fields) {
    return Object.fromEntries(fields.map((key) => [key, [...new Set(rows.map((row) => String(row[key] ?? "")).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, "es"))]));
  }
  function recordPage(rows, input2 = {}, pageSize = 10) {
    let page = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(input2.page) || 0)), Math.max(0, Math.ceil(rows.length / pageSize) - 1));
    return { items: rows.slice(page * pageSize, (page + 1) * pageSize), total: rows.length, page, pageSize };
  }
  function recordDay(value, timezone2 = "UTC") {
    recordDateFormatter?.timezone !== timezone2 && (recordDateFormatter = { timezone: timezone2, formatter: new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: timezone2, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }) });
    let parts = Object.fromEntries(recordDateFormatter.formatter.formatToParts(new Date(value)).map((part) => [part.type, part.value]));
    return parts.year + "-" + parts.month + "-" + parts.day;
  }

  // src/client/features/record-filters.js
  function createRecordFilters(id, fields, onChange, { dates = !1, placeholder = "Buscar" } = {}) {
    let page = 0, applied = {}, keys = ["search", ...fields.map(([key]) => key), ...dates ? ["from", "to"] : []], labels2 = Object.fromEntries([["search", "Buscar"], ...fields.map(([key, label]) => [key, label]), ["from", "Desde"], ["to", "Hasta"]]);
    function options(values) {
      return values.map((value) => {
        let [key, label] = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value, value];
        return "<option" + (/^\d{2}\./.test(label) ? ' data-catalog-name="' + escape2(label) + '"' : "") + ' value="' + escape2(key) + '">' + escape2(/^\d{2}\./.test(label) ? taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(label)) : displayRecord(label, language)) + "</option>";
      }).join("");
    }
    $(id + "-filters").innerHTML = `<button type="button" class="button" id="${id}-open-filters">${$("open-filters")?.querySelector?.("svg")?.outerHTML || ""} ${t("Filtros")}<span class="filter-count" id="${id}-filter-count"></span></button><div class="active-filters" id="${id}-chips" aria-label="${t("Filtros activos")}"></div><dialog class="filter-dialog admin-record-dialog" id="${id}-dialog" aria-label="${t("Filtros")}"><div class="dialog-header"><h2>${t("Filtros")}</h2><button type="button" class="button" id="${id}-close-filters" aria-label="${t("Cerrar panel")}">\u2715</button></div><form id="${id}-filter-form"><div class="record-filters"><label>${t("Buscar")}<input type="search" id="${id}-search" placeholder="${escape2(t(placeholder))}"></label>${fields.map(([key, label, values]) => `<label>${escape2(t(label))}<select id="${id}-${key}"><option value="">${t("Todos")}</option>${options(values || [])}</select></label>`).join("")}${dates ? ["from", "to"].map((key) => `<label>${t(labels2[key])}<input type="date" id="${id}-${key}"></label>`).join("") : ""}</div><div class="filter-dialog-actions"><button class="button" type="button" id="${id}-clear">${t("Limpiar filtros")}</button><button class="button primary" type="submit" id="${id}-apply">${t("Aplicar filtros")}</button></div></form></dialog>`;
    let dialog2 = $(id + "-dialog");
    function chips() {
      let values = keys.filter((key) => applied[key]);
      $(id + "-filter-count").textContent = values.length ? " \xB7 " + values.length : "", $(id + "-chips").innerHTML = values.map((key) => {
        let input2 = $(id + "-" + key), value = input2.tagName === "SELECT" && input2.selectedOptions[0]?.textContent || applied[key];
        return `<button type="button" class="filter-chip" data-clear-filter="${key}" aria-label="${escape2(t("Quitar") + " " + t(labels2[key]))}"><span>${escape2(t(labels2[key]) + ": " + value)}</span><span aria-hidden="true">\xD7</span></button>`;
      }).join("");
    }
    function notify() {
      page = 0, chips(), Promise.resolve(onChange()).catch((error) => message(error.message, !0));
    }
    function query() {
      return recordQuery({ ...applied, page }, fields.map(([key]) => key));
    }
    $(id + "-open-filters").addEventListener("click", () => {
      keys.forEach((key) => $(id + "-" + key).value = applied[key] || ""), dialog2.showModal();
    }), $(id + "-close-filters").addEventListener("click", () => dialog2.close()), dialog2.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.target === dialog2 && dialog2.close();
    }), $(id + "-filter-form").addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      let next = Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key) => [key, $(id + "-" + key).value]));
      try {
        recordQuery(next, fields.map(([key]) => key)), applied = next, dialog2.close(), notify();
      } catch (error) {
        message(error.message, !0);
      }
    }), $(id + "-clear").addEventListener("click", () => {
      keys.forEach((key) => $(id + "-" + key).value = ""), applied = {}, dialog2.close(), notify();
    }), $(id + "-chips").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let key = event.target.closest("[data-clear-filter]")?.dataset.clearFilter;
      key && (delete applied[key], $(id + "-" + key).value = "", notify());
    });
    let pagination = $(id + "-pagination"), paginate = (event) => {
      let button = event.target.closest("[data-page]");
      !button || button.disabled || (page += Number(button.dataset.page), Promise.resolve(onChange()).catch((error) => message(error.message, !0)));
    };
    return pagination?.addEventListener("click", paginate), { query, set(key, value) {
      keys.includes(key) && (applied[key] = value, $(id + "-" + key).value = value, notify());
    }, destroy() {
      pagination?.removeEventListener("click", paginate), dialog2.close();
    }, reset() {
      page = 0;
    }, options(values) {
      for (let [key, list] of Object.entries(values)) {
        if (!fields.some(([field]) => field === key)) continue;
        let input2 = $(id + "-" + key), value = applied[key] || "";
        input2.innerHTML = '<option value="">' + t("Todos") + "</option>" + options([...list].sort((a, b) => taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(String(Array.isArray(a) ? a[1] : a))).localeCompare(taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(String(Array.isArray(b) ? b[1] : b))), language))), input2.value = value;
      }
      chips();
    }, page(data) {
      if (!pagination) return;
      page = data.page;
      let pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.total / data.pageSize));
      pagination.innerHTML = '<button class="button" type="button" data-page="-1" ' + (page === 0 ? "disabled" : "") + '>Anterior</button><span class="small muted" role="status">' + t("{total} resultados \xB7 p\xE1gina {page} de {pages}", { total: data.total, page: page + 1, pages }) + '</span><button class="button" type="button" data-page="1" ' + (page >= pages - 1 ? "disabled" : "") + ">" + t("Ver m\xE1s") + "</button>";
    } };
  }

  function createTaxonomy() {

Ejecuta el job para generarlo.") + "</td></tr>", filters4.page(page), $("taxonomy-count").textContent = t("{blocks} bloques funcionales \xB7 {functions} funcionalidades / sub operativas", { blocks: new Set(items.map((row) => row.palanca)).size, functions: items.filter((row) => row.subpalanca).length });
    }
    return { async open() {

    } };
  }

  // src/client/features/runs.js
  var request = 0, timer, panelActive = !1, syncRecovery = () => {
  }, processActions = { classification: ["classification-start", "Clasificar pendientes"], translation: ["translation-start", "Traducir pendientes"], taxonomy: ["taxonomy-start", "Actualizar cat\xE1logo"], snapshot: ["snapshot-start", "Generar snapshots"], maintenance: ["maintenance-start", "Iniciar mantenimiento"] };
  function processCard(job) {
    let action2 = processActions[job.stage], active = !["Completada", "Parcial", "En pausa", "Detenido por falta de cuota", "Sin ejecuciones", "Revisar"].includes(job.progress.state), status = job.valid === !1 ? "error" : job.status, progress = job.progress;
    return `<article class="process-card" data-process="${escape2(job.id || job.stage)}"><div class="schedule-heading"><h4>${escape2(t(job.label))}</h4><span class="process-state" data-status="${escape2(status)}">${escape2(t(job.enabled ? "Activo" : "Inactivo"))}${progress.state === "Activo" ? "" : " \xB7 " + escape2(t(progress.state))}</span></div>${job.timezone ? `<p class="small muted">${escape2(job.timezone)}</p>` : ""}${job.modified ? `<p>${t("\xDAltima modificaci\xF3n")}: ${escape2(date(job.modified))}</p>` : ""}${job.total !== void 0 ? `<div id="${job.id || (job.stage === "newsletter" ? "newsletter-delivery" : job.stage === "taxonomyTranslation" ? "taxonomy-translation" : job.stage)}-progress"><progress max="${Math.max(1, job.total)}" value="${job.done}" aria-label="${escape2(t(job.label))}"></progress><p class="small muted">${job.done}/${job.total}</p></div>` : ""}${progressDetailsHtml(progress)}${job.comment ? `<p class="small muted">${escape2(t(job.comment))}</p>` : ""}${job.active ? `<p>${t("En curso")}: ${escape2(t(job.active))}</p>` : ""}${job.dispatched ? `<p class="small muted">${t("\xDAltimo proceso autorizado")}: ${escape2(t(job.dispatched.label))} \xB7 ${escape2(date(job.dispatched.at))}</p>` : ""}${job.waiting?.length ? `<details><summary>${t("Trabajos en espera")} (${job.waiting.length})</summary><ul>${job.waiting.map((row) => `<li>${escape2(t(row.label))}: ${escape2(t(row.reason))}${row.restartAt ? " \xB7 " + escape2(date(row.restartAt)) : ""}</li>`).join("")}</ul></details>` : ""}${job.stage === "daily" ? `<button type="button" class="button" data-collection-slot="${escape2(job.id)}" data-job-active="${active}" ${active ? "disabled" : ""}>${t("Recopilar ahora")}</button>` : ""}${action2 ? `<button type="button" class="button" id="${action2[0]}" data-process-action="${job.stage}" data-job-active="${active}" ${active ? "disabled" : ""}>${t(action2[1])}</button>` : ""}</article>`;
  }
  function closeRuns() {
    request++, clearTimeout(timer);
  }
  async function loadRuns() {
    closeRuns();
    let current = request;
    try {
      let data = await call("getControlPanel");
      return current !== request ? void 0 : (panelActive = !!data.groups?.some((group) => group.jobs.some((job) => job.status === "pending")), data.groups && ($("control-panel-groups").innerHTML = data.groups.map((group) => `<section class="process-group" data-process-group="${group.id}"><div class="panel-header"><h3>${escape2(t(group.label))}</h3><span class="small muted">${t("Prioridad")} ${group.priority}</span></div><div class="process-grid">${group.jobs.map(processCard).join("")}</div></section>`).join("")), renderCollectionJobs(data.collection), data);
    } catch (error) {
      current === request && message(error.message, !0);
    } finally {
      current === request && !$("runs-section").hidden && !$("administration-section").hidden && (timer = setTimeout(pollRuns, panelActive ? 3e4 : 12e4));
    }
  }
  function renderCollectionJobs(status) {
    syncRecovery(status);
  }
  function createRecoveryControls({ run }) {
    let busy = !1, status = {};
    function render(next = status) {
      status = next || {};
      for (let button of document.querySelectorAll("[data-collection-slot]"))
        button.disabled = busy || !!status.blocked?.today || button.dataset.jobActive === "true", button.title = status.blocked?.today ? t("Ya hay una recuperaci\xF3n diaria en curso.") : "";
    }
    return $("runs-section").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let button = event.target.closest("button");
      if (!button) return;
      if (button.dataset.collectionSlot) {
        run(async () => {
          message(await call("collectSlot", button.dataset.collectionSlot)), await loadRuns();
        }, !1);
        return;
      }
      let method = { classification: "startClassification", translation: "startTranslations", taxonomy: "startTaxonomy", snapshot: "rebuildDashboardSnapshots", maintenance: "startMaintenance" }[button.dataset.processAction];
      method && run(async () => {
        let result = await call(method);
        typeof result == "string" && message(result), await loadRuns();
      }, !1);
    }), syncRecovery = render, { setBusy(value) {
      busy = value, render();
    } };
  }
  function pollRuns() {
    if (document.hidden) {
      timer = setTimeout(pollRuns, 3e4);
      return;
    }
    loadRuns();
  }
  $("control-panel-refresh").addEventListener("click", loadRuns);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    clearTimeout(timer), !document.hidden && !$("runs-section").hidden && !$("administration-section").hidden && loadRuns();
  });

  // src/client/features/collection-progress.js
  function createCollectionProgress({ isActive, isBusy, onStatus }) {
    let timer2, polling = !1;
    function render(status) {
      let node = $("collection-progress");
      node.hidden = !isActive() || !(status?.total || status?.queued), onStatus(status), !node.hidden && (node.textContent = t("Recuperaci\xF3n: {processed}/{total} consultas; {pending} pendientes; {added} noticias incorporadas.", status) + (status.lastActivity ? " " + t("\xDAltima actividad") + ": " + date(status.lastActivity) + "." : "") + (status.queued ? " " + t("{queued} recargas en cola.", status) : "") + (status.failed ? " " + status.failed + " " + t("Errores") + "." : ""));
    }
    function update(data) {
      render(data.collection), clearTimeout(timer2), isActive() && (data.collection?.pending || data.collection?.queued) && (timer2 = setTimeout(poll, 3e4));
    }
    async function poll() {
      if (!isActive()) {
        clearTimeout(timer2);
        return;
      }
      if (document.hidden || isBusy() || polling) {
        timer2 = setTimeout(poll, 3e4);
        return;
      }
      polling = !0;
      try {
        let data = await call("getCollectionProgress");
        update(data);
      } catch {
        timer2 = setTimeout(poll, 6e4);
      } finally {
        polling = !1;
      }
    }
    return { update };
  }

  // src/client/features/subscriptions.js
  function createSubscriptions({ run }) {
    let options, own = [], all = [], request3 = 0, historyLimit = 3, filters4 = {}, editorId = (admin) => admin ? "admin-subscription-editor" : "personal-editor";
    function edit(admin, row) {
      let target = $(editorId(admin));
      target.hidden = !1, target.innerHTML = subscriptionForm(options, admin, row), target.scrollIntoView?.({ block: "nearest" }), target.querySelector("input,select,button")?.focus();
    }
    function render(admin) {
      if (!admin) {
        $("subscriptions-list").innerHTML = subscriptionCards(own);
        return;
      }
      let id = "subscribers", rows = all;
      filters4[id] ||= createRecordFilters(id, [...admin ? [["correo", "Suscriptor"]] : [], ["activa", "Estado", [["true", "Activa"], ["false", "Pausada"]]]], () => render(admin), { placeholder: "Correo o geograf\xEDa" }), filters4[id].options(recordOptions(rows, admin ? ["correo"] : []));
      let selected = filterRecords(rows, filters4[id].query(), admin ? ["correo", "activa"] : ["activa"], ["correo", "nombre"]), page = recordPage(selected, filters4[id].query());
      $("admin-subscriptions-list").innerHTML = subscriptionTable(page.items), filters4[id].page(page);
    }
    async function open(admin = !1) {
      let current = ++request3, [settings, rows, history] = await Promise.all([call("getNewsletterOptions"), call(admin ? "getAdminSubscriptions" : "getSubscriptions"), admin ? null : call("getMyNewsletterHistory", { limit: historyLimit })]);
      if (current === request3) {
        if (options = settings, admin)
          all = rows, $("subscribers-count").textContent = t("{subscribers} suscriptores \xB7 {subscriptions} suscripciones", { subscribers: rows.length, subscriptions: rows.length });
        else {
          own = rows;
          let count = rows.filter((row) => row.activa).length;
          $("subscriptions-count").textContent = t(count === 1 ? "1 suscripci\xF3n" : "{count} suscripciones", { count }), $("newsletter-delivery-status").textContent = settings.enabled ? "Entrega autom\xE1tica activa." : "Las entregas comenzar\xE1n cuando la programaci\xF3n est\xE9 activada.", renderHistory(history);
        }
        render(admin), admin || rows.length ? $(editorId(admin)).hidden = !0 : edit(!1);
      }
    }
    for (let admin of [!1, !0]) {
      let target = $(editorId(admin));
      target.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        event.target.closest("[data-close-editor]") && (target.hidden = !0);
      }), target.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        let form = event.target, data = new FormData(form), row = (admin ? all : own).find((row2) => row2.id === form.dataset.id);
        run(async () => {
          message(await call(admin ? "saveAdminSubscription" : "saveSubscription", { id: row?.id, email: data.get("email"), country: data.get("country"), language: data.get("language"), active: !0 })), await open(admin);
        }, !1);
      }), admin && $("new-admin-subscription").addEventListener("click", () => edit(!0)), $(admin ? "admin-subscriptions-list" : "subscriptions-list").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        let button = event.target.closest("[data-action]");
        if (!button) return;
        let row = (admin ? all : own).find((row2) => row2.id === button.dataset.id);
        row && (button.dataset.action === "edit" ? edit(admin, row) : button.dataset.action === "delete" && run(async () => {
          message(await call(admin ? "deleteAdminSubscription" : "deleteSubscription", row.id)), await open(admin);
        }, !1));
      });
    }
    function renderHistory(history) {
      $("personal-history").innerHTML = newsletterHistoryCards(history.items), $("personal-history-pages").innerHTML = history.items.length < history.total ? '<button class="button" data-history-more>Mostrar m\xE1s</button>' : "";
    }
    return $("personal-history-pages").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.target.closest("[data-history-more]") && run(async () => {
        historyLimit += 3, renderHistory(await call("getMyNewsletterHistory", { limit: historyLimit }));
      }, !1);
    }), attachNewsletterSummaries($("personal-history")), { open };
  }

  // src/client/features/newsletter-delivery.js
  function createNewsletterDelivery({ run }) {
    function feedback(text, error = !1) {
      let target = $("newsletter-test-result");
      target.hidden = !1, target.textContent = text, target.classList.toggle("error", error);
    }
    async function open() {
      let [status, options] = await Promise.all([call("getNewsletterDeliveryStatus"), call("getNewsletterOptions")]), form = $("newsletter-test-form");
      form.elements.language.options.length || (form.elements.language.innerHTML = Object.entries(languageNames).map(([code, name]) => '<option value="' + code + '"' + (code === language ? " selected" : "") + ">" + escape2(name) + "</option>").join(""));
      let selected = form.elements.country.value;
      form.elements.email.placeholder = options.email, form.elements.country.innerHTML = '<option value="">Sin personalizar</option>' + options.countries.map((name) => "<option>" + escape2(name) + "</option>").join(""), form.elements.country.value = selected, $("newsletter-sender").textContent = status.name + " <" + status.address + ">", $("newsletter-checks").innerHTML = [["Remitente", status.available ? "Configurado" : "Pendiente"], ["Entrega", status.enabled ? "Activada" : "Desactivada"], ["Programaci\xF3n", status.scheduled ? "Instalada" : "Sin activador"]].map(([name, value]) => `<div class="delivery-check"><strong>${name}</strong><span>${value}</span></div>`).join(""), $("newsletter-sender-status").textContent = status.available ? "El remitente se utiliza en los env\xEDos autom\xE1ticos y las pruebas." : status.error, $("newsletter-budget").textContent = status.remaining + " env\xEDos disponibles dentro del l\xEDmite configurado de 24 horas.", $("newsletter-content-note").textContent = status.untracked ? status.untracked + " env\xEDos anteriores no registraron las noticias incluidas. El control de contenido se aplica a los env\xEDos con inventario; los anteriores requieren contrastar los correos originales." : "El contenido de los nuevos env\xEDos queda registrado por suscriptor. Las pruebas se excluyen del control de duplicados.";
      let last = status.last;
      $("newsletter-history").innerHTML = last ? `<strong>\xDAltimo intento \xB7 ${escape2(date(last.fecha))}</strong><span>${escape2(last.estado)} \xB7 ${escape2(last.correo)}</span><span>${escape2(last.detalle)}</span>` : "<span>No hay intentos de env\xEDo registrados.</span>";
    }
    return $("newsletter-test-form").addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      let form = event.target;
      if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
      let data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));
      run(async () => {
        feedback("Procesando solicitud\u2026");
        try {
          let result = await call("sendNewsletterTest", data), status = result.accepted ? t("Gmail ha aceptado la prueba para {recipient} \xB7 {count} novedades.", result) : t("No hay noticias para esta edici\xF3n y geograf\xEDa."), details = result.cutoff ? t("Periodo {from} a {to} \xB7 corte {cutoff} \xB7 {eligible} de {stored} noticias elegibles \xB7 {local} locales y {global} internacionales.", result) : "";
          feedback([status, details].filter(Boolean).join(" "));
        } catch (error) {
          feedback(error.message, !0);
        }
        await open();
      }, !1);
    }), { open };
  }

  // src/client/features/configuration.js
  var capabilityFields = [["name", "Capacidad de detecci\xF3n", "text"], ["terms", "T\xE9rminos de b\xFAsqueda", "list"], ["enabled", "Activa", "boolean"]];
  function createConfiguration({ run }) {
    let config, revision, category = "entities", capabilityDefaults, storagePrimaryId, embedded = { globalTaxonomy: "taxonomy-section", sourcesCatalog: "sources-section" }, entries = () => config[category === "applicationScope" ? "geographies" : category], list = (input2) => input2.value.split(/[;\n]/).map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean), read = (input2) => input2.type === "checkbox" ? input2.checked : input2.type === "number" ? Number(input2.value) : input2.dataset.list === "true" ? list(input2) : input2.value.trim(), filters4 = createRecordFilters("configuration", [["enabled", "Estado", [["true", "Activa"], ["false", "Inactiva"]]]], filterRows, { placeholder: "Nombre, c\xF3digo o t\xE9rmino" });
    async function fetchConfig() {
      let snapshot = await call("getConfiguration");
      config = snapshot.config, revision = snapshot.revision, capabilityDefaults = snapshot.capabilityDefaults, storagePrimaryId = snapshot.storagePrimaryId;
    }
    function record(row) {
      return Object.fromEntries([...row.querySelectorAll("[data-key]")].map((input2) => [input2.dataset.key, read(input2)]));
    }
    function readFields() {
      if (config && !embedded[category])
        if (category === "applicationScope") {
          let countries = [...$("catalog-fields").querySelectorAll("[data-geography]")];
          config.geographies = countries.map(record), config.applicationScope = [{ name: config.applicationScope[0].name, countries: countries.filter((row) => row.querySelector("[data-country]").checked).map((row) => record(row).name) }];
        } else if (category === "taxonomy")
          config.settings.searchTerms = list($("catalog-search-terms")), config.capabilities.Empresas = [...$("catalog-fields").querySelectorAll("[data-capability]")].map(record), config.taxonomy = [...$("catalog-fields").querySelectorAll("[data-taxonomy-block]")].map((block) => ({ name: block.querySelector('[data-key="name"]').value.trim(), terms: list(block.querySelector('[data-key="terms"]')), emerging: [...block.querySelectorAll("[data-emerging]")].map(record), functions: [...block.querySelectorAll("[data-function]")].map(record) }));
        else if (admin_schema_default[category].groups)
          for (let group of $("catalog-fields").querySelectorAll("[data-config-section]")) for (let input2 of group.querySelectorAll("[data-key]")) config[group.dataset.configSection][input2.dataset.key] = read(input2);
        else config[category] = [...$("catalog-fields").children].map(record);
    }
    function fields(definitions, row) {
      return definitions.map(([key, label, type, choices]) => `<label class="${type === "list" ?   // src/shared/news-groups.js
  function articleEntities(row) {
    return row.entidades?.length ? row.entidades : [row.entidad || "Entidad no identificada"];
  }
  function newsEntityGroups(items, primaryOnly = !1) {
    let entities = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    for (let row of items)
      for (let name of new Set(primaryOnly ? [row.entidad || "Entidad no identificada"] : articleEntities(row))) {
        entities.has(name) || entities.set(name, { name, total: 0, items: [] });
        let group = entities.get(name);
        group.total++, group.items.push(row);
      }
    return [...entities.values()].sort(entityOrder);
  }

  // src/shared/novelty-groups.js
  function noveltyOverview(items, signalNames = [], country = (row) => articleGeographies(row).map(geographyLabel)) {
    let signals = new Map(signalNames.map((name) => [name, 0])), geographies = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), entities = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    for (let row of items) {
      let names = new Set(country.members?.(row) || [country(row)].flat());
      for (let entity of articleEntities(row)) entities.add(entity);
      for (let signal of new Set(row.senales || [])) signals.set(signal, (signals.get(signal) || 0) + 1);
      for (let name of names) {
        geographies.has(name) || geographies.set(name, { name, total: 0, entities: /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), signals: new Map(signalNames.map((name2) => [name2, 0])) });
        let geography = geographies.get(name);
        geography.total++;
        for (let entity of articleEntities(row)) geography.entities.add(entity);
        for (let signal of new Set(row.senales || [])) geography.signals.set(signal, (geography.signals.get(signal) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    let counts = (values) => [...values].map(([name, total]) => ({ name, total }));
    return { total: items.length, entities: entities.size, bySignal: counts(signals), geographies: [...geographies.values()].map(({ signals: signals2, entities: entities2, ...row }) => ({ ...row, entityCount: entities2.size, bySignal: counts(signals2) })).sort(geographyOrder) };
  }
  function publicationOrder(a, b) {
    return String(b.fecha || "").localeCompare(String(a.fecha || "")) || String(a.id || a.url || a.titular || "").localeCompare(String(b.id || b.url || b.titular || ""), "es");
  }
  function noveltyGroups(items, country = (row) => articleGeographies(row).map(geographyLabel)) {
    let geographies = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    for (let row of items) for (let name of new Set(country.members?.(row) || [country(row)].flat()))
      geographies.has(name) || geographies.set(name, { name, items: [] }), geographies.get(name).items.push(row);
    return [...geographies.values()].map((group) => ({ ...group, items: group.items.sort(publicationOrder) })).sort(geographyOrder);
  }
  function noveltyCount(count, singular, plural, translate = (value) => value) {
    return count + " " + translate(count === 1 ? singular : plural);
  }

  // src/client/features/article-text.js
  function articleOriginal(row) {
    let original = row.original;
    return original && (original.titular !== row.titular || (original.extracto || "") !== (row.extracto || "")) ? '<details class="article-original"><summary>Ver original</summary><p data-original><strong>' + escape2(original.titular) + "</strong></p>" + (original.extracto ? "<p data-original>" + escape2(original.extracto) + "</p>" : "") + "</details>" : "";
  }
  function articleHeader(row, content) {
    return '<div class="story-topline"><div class="story-heading">' + content + "</div>" + storyIdentity(articleEntities(row), row.pais, escape2) + "</div>";
  }
  function articleTags(row, selection = {}, novelty = !1) {
    let values = [...row.tipo ? [row.tipo] : [], ...row.segmentos || [], ...row.senales || []];
    return newsCoverage(row) + newsTaxonomy(row) + [...new Set(values)].map((value) => '<span class="badge" data-original>' + escape2(t(value === "Incidencia operativa" ? "Indisponibilidad / Incidencia operativa" : value)) + "</span>").join("");
  }
  function articleDate(row) {
    return '<time datetime="' + escape2(row.fecha) + '">' + escape2(t("Publicado")) + ": " + escape2(formatCalendarDay(row.fecha, language)) + "</time>";
  }
  function articleTitle(row) {
    return '<h3 class="story-title" data-original><a class="story-link" href="' + escape2(validUrl(row.url)) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">' + escape2(row.titular) + "</a></h3>";
  }
  function articleContent(row, selection = {}, novelty = !1) {
    return articleHeader(row, articleTitle(row)) + (row.extracto ? "<p data-original>" + escape2(row.extracto) + "</p>" : "") + articleOriginal(row) + '<div class="article-metadata"><div class="news-meta news-tags">' + articleTags(row, selection, novelty) + '</div><div class="news-meta">' + articleDate(row) + newsPublisher(row) + "</div></div>";
  }

  // src/client/features/activity-chart.js
  var arrow = (direction) => `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="${direction < 0 ? "M15 6l-6 6 6 6" : "M9 6l6 6-6 6"}"/></svg>`;
  function chartNavigation(content, { previous, next, label, tag = "div" } = {}) {
    let control = (direction, text) => `<button type="button" class="activity-control" data-activity-step="${direction}" aria-label="${escape2(t(text))}">${arrow(direction)}</button>`;
    return `<div class="activity-navigation">${control(-1, previous)}<${tag} class="activity-chart" tabindex="0" aria-label="${escape2(t(label))}">${content}</${tag}>${control(1, next)}</div>`;
  }
  function activityChart(days) {
    if (!days.length) return '<div class="note">' + t("No hay actividad diaria registrada en este per\xEDodo.") + "</div>";
    let maximum = Math.max(1, ...days.map((day2) => day2.users)), months = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), monthFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(language, { month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
    for (let day2 of days) {
      let key = day2.date.slice(0, 7);
      months.set(key, (months.get(key) || 0) + 1);
    }
    return `<section class="activity-timeline" aria-label="${escape2(t("Usuarios activos por d\xEDa"))}"><div class="activity-heading"><div><strong>${t("Actividad diaria")}</strong><p class="activity-range" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></p></div><button type="button" class="activity-latest" data-activity-end title="${escape2(t("Ir al d\xEDa m\xE1s reciente"))}">${t("\xDAltimos d\xEDas")}</button></div>${chartNavigation(days.map((day2, index) => `<li class="activity-column ${Number(day2.date.slice(0, 4)) * 12 + Number(day2.date.slice(5, 7)) & 1 ? "activity-month-alternate" : ""}" data-date="${escape2(day2.date)}" aria-label="${escape2(formatCalendarDay(day2.date, language) + " \xB7 " + t("{count} usuarios", { count: day2.users }))}"><span class="activity-value">${day2.users}</span><div class="activity-bar" style="--bar-height:calc(var(--activity-chart-height) * ${day2.users / maximum})"></div><span class="activity-date">${escape2(day2.date.slice(8))}</span>${index === 0 || days[index - 1].date.slice(0, 7) !== day2.date.slice(0, 7) ? `<span class="activity-month" aria-hidden="true" style="width:calc(${months.get(day2.date.slice(0, 7))} * var(--activity-column-size,var(--activity-column-width)) + ${months.get(day2.date.slice(0, 7)) - 1} * var(--space-1))"><span>${escape2(monthFormat.format(/* @__PURE__ */ new Date(day2.date + "T00:00:00Z")))}</span></span>` : ""}</li>`).join(""), { previous: "Ver d\xEDas anteriores", next: "Ver d\xEDas siguientes", label: "Usuarios activos por d\xEDa", tag: "ul" })}</section>`;
  }
  function createTimelineChart(container, { markup, formatDate }) {
    let viewport, columns = [], previous, next, latest, range, atEnd = !0, step = () => columns.length > 1 ? columns[1].getBoundingClientRect().left - columns[0].getBoundingClientRect().left : columns[0]?.getBoundingClientRect().width || 0;
    function update() {
      if (!viewport || !viewport.clientWidth) return;
      let end = Math.max(0, viewport.scrollWidth - viewport.clientWidth), left = Math.max(0, viewport.scrollLeft), width = step();
      if (previous.disabled = left <= 1, next.disabled = left >= end - 1, latest && (latest.disabled = next.disabled), atEnd = next.disabled, !width) return;
      let first = Math.min(columns.length - 1, Math.floor((left + 1) / width)), last = Math.min(columns.length - 1, Math.ceil((left + viewport.clientWidth - 1) / width) - 1), text = formatDate(columns[first].dataset.date) + " \u2014 " + formatDate(columns[last].dataset.date);
      range.textContent !== text && (range.textContent = text);
    }
    function move(direction) {
      if (!viewport) return;
      let width = step(), page = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(viewport.clientWidth / (width || 1)) - 1) * (width || viewport.clientWidth), left = direction === "start" ? 0 : direction === "end" ? viewport.scrollWidth : viewport.scrollLeft + direction * page;
      viewport.scrollTo({ left: Math.max(0, Math.min(viewport.scrollWidth - viewport.clientWidth, left)), behavior: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "instant" : "smooth" });
    }
    container.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let button = event.target.closest("[data-activity-step],[data-activity-end]");
      button && !button.disabled && move(button.hasAttribute("data-activity-end") ? "end" : Number(button.dataset.activityStep));
    }), container.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.target !== viewport) return;
      let direction = { ArrowLeft: -1, ArrowRight: 1, PageUp: -1, PageDown: 1, Home: "start", End: "end" }[event.key];
      direction !== void 0 && (event.preventDefault(), move(direction));
    });
    function layout() {
      if (!viewport || !viewport.clientWidth) return;
      let styles = window.getComputedStyle(viewport), minimum = parseFloat(styles.getPropertyValue("--activity-column-width")) || columns[0].getBoundingClientRect().width, gap = parseFloat(styles.columnGap) || 0, width = viewport.clientWidth, visible = Math.max(1, Math.min(columns.length, Math.floor((width + gap) / (minimum + gap)))), first = step() ? Math.round(viewport.scrollLeft / step()) : 0;
      viewport.style.setProperty("--activity-column-size", (width - gap * (visible - 1)) / visible + "px"), viewport.scrollLeft = atEnd ? Math.max(0, viewport.scrollWidth - width) : first * step(), update();
    }
    return new ResizeObserver(layout).observe(container), { render(days) {
      atEnd = !0, container.innerHTML = markup(days), viewport = container.querySelector(".activity-chart"), viewport && (columns = Array.from(viewport.children), previous = container.querySelector('[data-activity-step="-1"]'), next = container.querySelector('[data-activity-step="1"]'), latest = container.querySelector("[data-activity-end]"), range = container.querySelector(".activity-range"), viewport.addEventListener("scroll", update, { passive: !0 }), layout());
    } };
  }
  var createActivityChart = (container) => createTimelineChart(container, { markup: activityChart, formatDate: (date2) => formatCalendarDay(date2, language) });

  // src/client/features/trend-chart.js
  function trendChart({ buckets, series }, availableWidth = 900) {
    if (!buckets.length) return '<div class="chart-empty"><span class="empty-orbit" aria-hidden="true">\u25CE</span><p>La evoluci\xF3n aparecer\xE1 cuando haya publicaciones en esta selecci\xF3n.</p></div>';
    let width = Math.max(320, Math.min(900, availableWidth || 900)), height = 260, left = 38, right = 20, top = 24, bottom = 42, max = Math.max(1, ...series.flatMap((row) => row.values)), ceiling = Math.max(4, Math.ceil(max / 4) * 4), x = (index) => left + (buckets.length === 1 ? 0.5 : index / (buckets.length - 1)) * (width - left - right), y = (value) => height - bottom - value / ceiling * (height - top - bottom), ticks = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => {
      let value = ceiling * i / 4;
      return `<line x1="${left}" x2="${width - right}" y1="${y(value)}" y2="${y(value)}" class="chart-grid"/><text x="${left - 12}" y="${y(value) + 4}" text-anchor="end">${value}</text>`;
    }).join(""), labels2 = [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([0, Math.floor((buckets.length - 1) / 2), buckets.length - 1])].map((i) => `<text x="${x(i)}" y="${height - 12}" text-anchor="${i === 0 ? "start" : i === buckets.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}">${formatTrendDay(buckets[i], language)}</text>`).join(""), lines = series.map((row, i) => {
      let points = row.values.map((value, index) => [x(index), y(value)]), path = points.map(([px, py], index) => (index ? "L" : "M") + px.toFixed(1) + "," + py.toFixed(1)).join(" "), color = "var(--chart-series-" + (i + 1) + ")", area = series.length === 1 ? `<path d="${path} L${x(buckets.length - 1)},${y(0)} L${x(0)},${y(0)} Z" class="chart-area"/>` : "";
      return `<g data-series="${i}">` + area + `<path d="${path}" stroke="${color}" class="chart-line"></path>` + points.map(([px, py], j) => `<circle class="chart-point" data-point="${j}" aria-label="${escape2(row.entity)} \xB7 ${buckets[j]} \xB7 ${row.values[j]} publicaciones" cx="${px}" cy="${py}" r="4" fill="${color}"></circle>`).join("") + "</g>";
    }).join(""), bands = buckets.map((day2, index) => {
      let start = index ? (x(index - 1) + x(index)) / 2 : left, end = index < buckets.length - 1 ? (x(index) + x(index + 1)) / 2 : width - right, label = day2 + " \xB7 " + series.map((row) => row.entity + ": " + row.values[index] + " publicaciones").join(" \xB7 ");
      return `<rect class="chart-band" data-bucket="${index}" tabindex="0" aria-label="${escape2(label)}" x="${start}" y="${top}" width="${end - start}" height="${height - top - bottom}"/>`;
    }).join(""), legend = series.map((row, i) => `<span><i style="background:var(--chart-series-${i + 1})"></i>${escape2(row.entity)}<strong>${row.total}</strong></span>`).join("");
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="group" aria-label="Evoluci\xF3n del n\xFAmero de publicaciones por entidad">${ticks}${labels2}${bands}${lines}</svg><div class="chart-legend">${legend}</div>`;
  }

  async function loadSourceQuality(isCurrent) {
    let view2 = "sourceQuality";

  // src/client/features/admin-tables.js
  function enhanceAdminTables(content) {
    let tables = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
    function update() {
      for (let table of content.querySelectorAll("table")) {
        let render = function() {
          rows.forEach((row, index) => row.hidden = index < state2.page * 10 || index >= (state2.page + 1) * 10);
          let pages = Math.ceil(rows.length / 10);
          pager.innerHTML = '<button type="button" class="button" data-step="-1" ' + (state2.page === 0 ? "disabled" : "") + ">" + escape2(t("Anterior")) + '</button><span role="status" class="small muted">' + escape2(t("{total} resultados \xB7 p\xE1gina {page} de {pages}", { total: rows.length, page: state2.page + 1, pages })) + '</span><button type="button" class="button" data-step="1" ' + (state2.page === pages - 1 ? "disabled" : "") + ">" + escape2(t("Siguiente")) + "</button>";
        }, rows = [...table.querySelectorAll("tbody tr")], previous = tables.get(table);
        if (previous?.rows.length === rows.length && previous.rows.every((row, index) => row === rows[index])) continue;
        let headings = [...table.querySelectorAll("thead th")].map((cell) => cell.textContent.trim());
        for (let row of rows) for (let [index, cell] of [...row.cells].entries())
          if (cell.colSpan === 1 && (cell.dataset.label = headings[index] || "", cell.textContent.trim().length > 180 && !cell.querySelector("input,select,textarea,button,details"))) {
            let text = cell.textContent.trim(), details = document.createElement("details"), summary = document.createElement("summary"), body = document.createElement("div");
            details.className = "record-detail", summary.textContent = text.slice(0, 100) + "\u2026", body.append(...cell.childNodes), details.append(summary, body), cell.append(details);
          }
        previous?.pager?.remove();
        let state2 = { rows, page: 0, pager: null };
        if (tables.set(table, state2), rows.length <= 10) continue;
        let pager = document.createElement("div");
        pager.className = "pagination", state2.pager = pager, table.closest(".table-wrap")?.after(pager), pager.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          let button = event.target.closest("[data-step]");
          !button || button.disabled || (state2.page += Number(button.dataset.step), render());
        }), render();
      }
    }
    new MutationObserver(update).observe(content, { childList: !0, subtree: !0 }), update();
  }

  }

  // src/client/features/usage.js
  function createUsage({ getView, isReady, getAttribution }) {
    let session = crypto.randomUUID(), events = [];
    function track2(event, duration = 0, performance2) {
      events.push({ event, view: getView(), session, duration, ...getAttribution() ? { id: crypto.randomUUID(), edition: getAttribution() } : {}, ...performance2 ? { performance: performance2 } : {} }), events.length > 20 && events.shift();
    }
    async function flush2() {
      if (!events.length || !isReady()) return;
      let batch = events.splice(0, 20);
      try {
        (await call("recordEvents", batch)).saved || events.unshift(...batch);
      } catch {
        events.unshift(...batch);
      }
      events.length > 20 && events.splice(0, events.length - 20);
    }
    return setInterval(flush2, 3e4), { track: track2, flush: flush2 };
  }

  // src/client/core/localization.js
  var observer, translateChanges;
  function flushLocalization() {
    observer && translateChanges(observer.takeRecords());
  }
  var originals = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
  function localized(node, key, value) {
    let values = originals.get(node);
    values || (values = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), originals.set(node, values));
    let previous = values.get(key), source = previous?.output === value ? previous.source : translateText(value, "es", language), output = t(source);
    return values.set(key, { source, output }), output;
  }
  var attributes = ["placeholder", "title", "aria-label", "alt"], excluded = "[data-original],script,style,textarea";
  function localize(root) {
    if (root.nodeType === 3) {
      if (!root.parentElement?.closest(excluded)) {
        let output = localized(root, "text", root.textContent);
        output !== root.textContent && (root.textContent = output);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (root.nodeType === 1) {
      if (root.dataset.catalogName) {
        root.textContent = taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(root.dataset.catalogName));
        return;
      }
      if (!root.matches(excluded)) {
        if (root.tagName === "TABLE" && root.closest(".table-wrap") && root.setAttribute("role", "table"), root.tagName === "TR" && root.closest(".table-wrap") && root.parentElement.tagName === "TBODY") {
          let headings = root.closest("table").tHead?.rows[0]?.cells;
          for (let [index, cell] of [...root.cells].entries()) cell.colSpan === 1 && headings?.[index] && (cell.dataset.label = t(headings[index].textContent));
        }
        root.tagName === "OPTION" && !root.hasAttribute("value") && root.setAttribute("value", root.value);
        for (let key of attributes) if (root.hasAttribute(key)) {
          let value = root.getAttribute(key), translated = localized(root, key, value);
          value !== translated && root.setAttribute(key, translated);
        }
        for (let node of root.childNodes) localize(node);
      }
    }
  }
  function initializeLocalization() {
    let title = document.title;
    document.documentElement.lang = language, document.title = t(document.title);
    let select = document.getElementById("preview-language");
    select.innerHTML = '<option value="">' + t("Idioma del navegador") + "</option>" + Object.entries(languageNames).map(([code, name]) => '<option value="' + code + '">' + name + "</option>").join(""), select.value = getLanguageOverride(), select.addEventListener("change", () => {

      } catch (error) {

        target.textContent = error.message, target.classList.add("error"), target.hidden = !1;
      }
    });
    let invalid = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakSet();
    document.addEventListener("invalid", (event) => {
      let input2 = event.target;
      input2.validity.customError || (input2.setCustomValidity(t(input2.validity.valueMissing ? "Campo obligatorio." : "Introduce un valor v\xE1lido.")), invalid.add(input2));
    }, !0), document.addEventListener("input", (event) => {

    }, !0), window.addEventListener("news-radar-language-change", () => {
      flushLocalization(), observer.disconnect(), document.documentElement.lang = language, document.title = t(title), localize(document.body), observer.observe(document.body, options);
    }), window.addEventListener("news-radar-taxonomy-translations", () => {
      flushLocalization(), observer.disconnect(), localize(document.body), observer.observe(document.body, options);
    }), localize(document.body);
    let options = { subtree: !0, childList: !0, characterData: !0, attributes: !0, attributeFilter: attributes };
    translateChanges = (records) => {
      observer.disconnect();
      let roots = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
      for (let record of records)
        if (record.type === "childList") for (let node of record.addedNodes) roots.add(node);
        else roots.add(record.target);
      for (let node of roots) {
        if (!node.isConnected || node.parentElement?.closest(excluded)) continue;
        let parent = node.parentNode;
        for (; parent && !roots.has(parent); ) parent = parent.parentNode;
        parent || localize(node);
      }
      observer.observe(document.body, options);
    }, observer = new MutationObserver(translateChanges), observer.observe(document.body, options);
  }
